Ember Early Access.name: Ember Early Access
Ember Early Access.description:
Ember is a digital roleplaying game that seamlessly blends traditional tabletop elements with video game features, designed to support Gamemasters and their players experience an epic, imaginative, and immersive open-world campaign. Ember offers groundbreaking systems that are optimized for online play, and is available for both Dungeons & Dragons 5.5e and Foundry VTT's brand new system, Crucible!

Ember is now in the Early Access phase of development with a ongoing pre-release testing and development.
Ember Early Access.caption: Welcome to Ember!

Kern.name: Kern

Kern's Mushroom Walking Stick.name: Kern's Mushroom Walking Stick
Kern's Mushroom Walking Stick.descriptionpublic: An unassumingly simple wooden staff around six to eight feet long crafted from braided and knotted strands of mycelium, Kern's mushroom walking staff is a deceptively balanced weapon that can be deadly in trained hands.

Thornling Lineage.name: Thornling Lineage
Thornling Lineage.description:
The fibrous biology of Thornlings is incredibly resilient, providing the following benefits:

  • Your Armor defense cannot be below 6 regardless of what type of equipment you are wearing.

  • Damage taken from Falling is reduced by half before other resistances apply.
Thornling Lineage.actiondesc:
When you are targeted by a melee attack, you can cause thorny barbs to extrude from your body. For one minute you gain the following benefits.

  • Melee attacks which Hit or Glance you wound the attacker in retaliation who suffers damage equal to your Toughness ability score.

  • Attempts to Grapple or Push you suffer +2 Banes.

The effects of this Action apply to the attack which triggered the reaction.

ALPHA ONE: The effects of Thornbark are not yet fully automated.

Shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
Shapeshifter.description:
You possess supernatural ability to transform your body into the shapes of beasts.

You undergo a transformation where you assume the form of a beast that you are familiar with and which is half your level or less. While transformed you have the exact attributes and abilities of the chosen beast.

Your equipment is magically incorporated into the form that you take, however you gain no benefit from that equipment while transformed.

If your bestial form becomes Incapacitated you revert back to your normal form with any excess damage becoming Wounds. If your Morale is Broken while in beast form your transformation ends and any excess damage becomes Madness.
actiondesc: You assume the form of a beast that you are familiar with of one-half your level or less.
You end your bestial transformation, returning to your normal form.

Natural Weapon Training.name: Natural Weapon Training
Natural Weapon Training.description: You have a developed familiarity with using features of your own body as a natural weapons including claws, jaws, tails, or other mechanisms of self-defense. You are Trained with weapons in the Natural category.
Natural Weapon Training.actiondesc: Immediately after you perform a basic Strike, you perform a reduced-cost follow-up Strike against the same target using a different Natural weapon that you have access to.

Assess Strength.name: Assess Strength
Assess Strength.description:
You take a moment to observe a creature which you can see and develop intuition about its areas of strength.

Perform a Knowledge Test using a Skill chosen by the Gamemaster. On a success, you learn which Defense type of Physical, Fortutude, Willpower, or Reflex is highest for the creature. On a Critical Success you learn the two highest defense types.
Assess Strength.actiondesc: You observe a creature you can see to assess it's notable areas of strength.

Steadfast.name: Steadfast
Steadfast.description: Your patient resolve allows you to endure psychologically grueling ordeals with steadfast determination.
Steadfast.actiondesc: You harden yourself against demoralization. Your Morale is increased by your Wisdom score and you temporarily gain the Resolute condition.

Rune: Earth.name: Rune: Earth
Rune: Earth.description:
The orderly force of elemental earth, responsible for physical matter. The Earth rune governs minerals, metals, soils, and other physical compounds.

The Earth rune scales using Wisdom, targets Reflex, and deals Acid damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Lightning.
Rune: Earth.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Earth allows you to manipulate raw forces of rock, mineral, and soil in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Quickly shape up to one cubic foot of available material into a simple geometric form like a cuboid, ellipsoid, or polyhedron.

  • Precisely copy the physical shape of a held object that is smaller than a 6-inch cube, reproducing it from available clay, stone, or metal. The replica retains no useful properties except for its physical form.

  • Separate and collect earthen particles from the surface of an object, creature, or liquid that you touch, rendering the subject completely cleaned or purified in moments.

Mould may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Life.name: Rune: Life
Rune: Life.description:
A chaotic force of creation, responsible for living matter. The Life rune governs health and matters relating to biological growth.

The Life rune scales using Wisdom and provides Restoration of Health or inflicts Poison damage opposed by Fortitude. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Death.
Rune: Life.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Life allows you to stimulate biological growth and nourish physical health, producing one of the following effects:

  • Cultivate 1 cubic foot of existing plants or fungus to rapidly grow to a healthy, blossoming, or harvestable state.

  • Identify a negative physical condition that is affecting a creature such as @Condition[diseased], @Condition[poisoned], @Condition[bleeding], or @Condition[weakened].

  • Verify whether a portion of food or drink is free of contamination from bacteria, parasites, or poison.

Bloom may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Flame.name: Rune: Flame
Rune: Flame.description:
The chaotic force of elemental, thermal energy. The Flame rune governs fire and heat.

The Flame rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Fire damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Frost.
Rune: Flame.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Flame allows you to manipulate fire and thermal energy in creative ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Manifest a burst of elemental flame in one inch sphere which can ignite a candle, torch, or other flammable materials.

  • Imbue your body with momentary thermal shielding which provides you with immunity to fire damage on an immediately subsequent action that costs 1 Action or less.

  • Control the movement of flames within a small area, causing them to flicker, dance, or shift in an animated performance of light and shadow.

Enkindle may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Soul.name: Rune: Soul
Rune: Soul.description:
An orderly force of creation and spiritual essence. The Soul rune governs the fundamental procession of souls through life and death and relates to matters of sapience, personality, and mental health.

The Soul rune scales using Presence and provides Restoration of Morale or inflicts Psychic damage opposed by Willpower. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Oblivion.
Rune: Soul.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Arrow.name: Gesture: Arrow
Gesture: Arrow.description:
You hurl a projectile imbued with the magical power of a Rune at a distant target.

The Arrow gesture scales using Intellect and targets a single creature up to a distance of 60 feet, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Aspect.name: Gesture: Aspect
Gesture: Aspect.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect, casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Create.name: Gesture: Create
Gesture: Create.description:
You coalesce arcane power into tangible form, manifesting a Sprite which appears within 10 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Sprite is a Minion of half your own Level.

The Create gesture scales with Wisdom and the Sprite survives for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Sprite, casting another spell using the Create gesture replaces your previous Sprite. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

Not all Runes have a Sprite actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Creation will — for now — manifest a Flame Sprite.

Gesture: Influence.name: Gesture: Influence
Gesture: Influence.description:
You intensify the arcane power of a Rune into a concentrated direct contact which is generally a more powerful evolution of the basic Touch gesture.

The Influence gesture scales using Presence and targets a single adjacent creature. It deals 10 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Ray.name: Gesture: Ray
Gesture: Ray.description:
You funnel the arcane power of a Rune into a point and project it outwards in a beam.

The Ray gesture scales using Wisdom and produces a line that is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Sense.name: Gesture: Sense
Gesture: Sense.description:
You attune your mind to the arcane power of a Rune to sense nearby sources of energy.

The Sense gesture scales with Presence and produces an emanation with 30 feet radius and position that remains centered upon the spellcaster. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus. It may optionally be Maintained at the additional cost of 1 Focus every subsequent round.

This spell allows the caster to detect the presence of spellcraft using the same Rune as the one incorporated in this spell. The sense will also momentarily detect the presence of creatures according to their type.

  • Control: Fiends

  • Death: Undead

  • Earth: Oozes and Earth Elementals

  • Flame: Dragons and Fire Elementals

  • Frost: Giants and Frost Elementals

  • Illumination: Celestials

  • Illusion: Fey

  • Kinesis: Monstrosities

  • Life: Plants and Beasts

  • Lightning: Constructs and Storm Elementals

  • Oblivion: Outsiders

  • Soul: Humanoids

Playtest Notes

There is no automation for the sense that is temporarily granted by this spell, but such automation can be provided in the future via a Detection Mode which temporarily reveals creatures of the appropriate type to the spellcaster while the spell is maintained.

Gesture: Step.name: Gesture: Step
Gesture: Step.description:
You infuse runic power into a movement, crossing physical and spatial boundaries.

The Step gesture scales with Dexterity and allows you to move up to 20 feet in a straight line with width equal to your Size. It deals 2 Base Damage to targets along that line which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture does not require any free hands to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

The movement aspect of this talent is not yet automated and must be manually performed as a consequence of the spell.

Gesture: Strike.name: Gesture: Strike
Gesture: Strike.description:
You empower a direct close-range attack with the arcane essence of a Rune, performing a Strike with your equipped weapon.

The Strike gesture scales using Strength and deal damage based on your used weapon but with the damage type of the incorporated Rune. This gesture does not require any free hand and has a base cost of 1 Focus in addition to the cost of your weapon Strike.

Gesture: Ward.name: Gesture: Ward
Gesture: Ward.description:
You shape the arcane power of a Rune into a protective barrier used to shield yourself from harm.

The Ward gesture scales using Toughness and provides +6 Resistance against the damage type of the Rune used in the spell. This resistance lasts for 1 Round and you may only have a single Ward at a time. Casting another spell using the Ward gesture replaces your prior Ward. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Aura.name: Gesture: Aura
Gesture: Aura.description:
You concentrate the arcane power of a Rune to create a maintained field of energy that washes over allies and enemies near to you.

The Aura gesture scales with Presence and produces an emanation with 20 feet radius centered on the spellcaster. The center of this Aura moves with the spellcaster.

Depending on the Rune used, the Aura deals damage or provides healing to any creature which begins its turn inside the Aura. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast, has a base cost of 5 Action and 1 Focus, and must be Maintained costing an additional 1 Focus every subsequent round.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Emanation templates which are linked to the Token and move when the Token moves are a feature coming in Foundry VTT version 14. Automation of the Aura gesture will occur once Crucible depends on Foundry VTT version 14.

Gesture: Blast.name: Gesture: Blast
Gesture: Blast.description:
You hurl the arcane power of a Rune into an intense explosion of energy at a nearby point you can see.

The Blast gesture scales with Intellect and produces a blast with 6 feet radius centered on a point within 60 feet of the spellcaster. The blast deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Cone.name: Gesture: Cone
Gesture: Cone.description:
You focus the arcane power of a Rune into a narrow cone that projects outwards from your location.

The Cone gesture scales with Intellect and produces a 60 degree cone with a 30 foot radius originating from the spellcaster. The Cone deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Conjure.name: Gesture: Conjure
Gesture: Conjure.description:
You coalesce arcane power into a superior form, manifesting a Visitor which appears within 30 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Visitor is a Minion equal to your own Level.

The Conjure gesture scales with Wisdom and the Visitor survives for 12 Rounds. You may only have one active Visitor. Casting another spell using the Conjure gesture replaces your previous Visitor. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Not all Runes have a Visitor actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Conjuration will — for now — manifest a Flame Visitor.

Gesture: Pulse.name: Gesture: Pulse
Gesture: Pulse.description:
Expel the arcane power of a Rune in a radius that travels outward with you at its center.

The Pulse gesture scales using Presence and produces an emanation with 10 foot radius, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Surge.name: Gesture: Surge
Gesture: Surge.description:
You channel the arcane power of a Rune into a rushing wave of energy that surges forward from your current position.

The Surge gesture scales with Wisdom and produces a line that is 10 feet wide and 15 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Earth Proficiency.name: Earth  Proficiency
Earth Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Earth. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Mould action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Flame Proficiency.name: Flame Proficiency
Flame Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Flame. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Enkindle action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Lightning Proficiency.name: Lightning Proficiency
Lightning Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Lightning. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Energize action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Life Proficiency.name: Life Proficiency
Life Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Life. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Blossom action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Soul Proficiency.name: Soul Proficiency
Soul Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Soul. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Evoke action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Mender.name: Mender
Mender.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Life. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[mending] condition on Critical Hits.

The Mending effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Wisdom score as additional Restoration to Health.

Recognize Spellcraft.name: Recognize Spellcraft
Recognize Spellcraft.description: You can interpret the arcane incantations of others to discern the nature of their spellcraft. When an enemy within 40 feet that you can see and hear begins casting a spell, you can identify its Rune if you also know that Rune.

Legerdemain.name: Legerdemain
Legerdemain.description: You can silently alter your spellcraft. You can apply Lesser Inflections using only your hands without the need for vocalization.

Shield Ward.name: Shield Ward
Shield Ward.description: You have mastered a specialized technique to incorporate a physical shield into the Ward gesture. You may ignore the free-hand requirement for spells using the Ward gesture while you have a Shield equipped.

Spellmute.name: Spellmute
Spellmute.description:
Currents of magic flow strangely around you, as if unaware of your presence.

You cannot perform any action with the Spell tag. Spells which target you suffer +2 Banes regardless of whether they impose harmful or beneficial effects.

Common Clothing.name: Common Clothing
Common Clothing.descriptionpublic: A shirt, pair of pants, undergarments, socks and shoes or boots suitable for menial labour or travel, cannot be worn with armor.

Diplomacy Adept.name: Diplomacy Adept
Diplomacy Adept.description: You gain the Adept rank in the Diplomacy skill, providing a +2 Skill Bonus.

Kern.biographyprivate:
Kern is an ancient druid who has wandered the world of Ember for innumerable years. His memory is no longer fully accessible to him, and it takes great concentration to recall ancient experiences. He ventured into the Pathways at some point recently, following his own intuition and lack of concern for danger. He views the Pathways as just another recent adventure despite living in the area for many years at this point and he may have spent time below the surface during his many adventures before. It's clear that nothing is really tying Kern to the area, and he could leave any time he chooses to.

Personality

Kern is an erratic, eccentric, and energetic character. He delights in new experiences and greatly enjoys meeting new people to torment with cryptic sayings and pranks. He constantly tests the resolve of any strangers foolish enough to meet with him through constant games of misdirection and nonsense. His playful personality is a genuine expression of his peculiar nature and wealth of experience as one of Ember's oldest living Thornlings. His eccentricities include trivializing any danger and an infuriating tendency to pretend not to hear people when asked direct questions.

Despite his age and outwardly impish demeanor, Kern possesses immense wisdom and power, having experienced countless trials throughout his long life. The sprawling underground Pathways pose no real threat to him, but he finds the area constantly engaging; he is especially interested in the "Shakings," which are his way of referring to the random earthquakes that seem to now trouble the region.

Connections

Kern is akin to a legendary figure among certain groups of Thornlings, and he has followers who model themselves on his whimsical and mischievous mannerisms upon the surface.

Phrases

"Remember: if the path seems easy, you’ve probably wandered into a Jurtak trap. But make sure you don't just watch your feet, because they'll be up over your head!"

"You don't hear the breathing of the pathways? Open your ears, your elbows, and perhaps even your pockets. It's all a question of resonance."

"What was I saying about what? Resin Ants? Oh they are good for gluing things together. Very useful, there's a mound just down the way, actually."
Kern.biographypublic: @ref[name] is an ancient, wizened druid who is so old that he barely remembers his origins. This gnarled little thornling lives in the pathways, blithely roaming through its depths. He is utterly unconcerned by the readily apparent dangers around him, which speaks to his hidden strength, wisdom, and experience.
Kern.biographyappearance: This ancient, wizened Thornling leans upon a small, stout branch of fossiled wood, with a crooked grin barely visible beneath a bushy, exuberant beard of leaves. Thorny gnarled limbs and spindly legs are barely visible underneath a veritable mound of greenery and foliage. A great, scraggly bush grows from his back, creating a canopy of verdant growth over him and across leafy back and shoulders, sport clusters of blue, luminescent mushrooms.

Luxaroth.name: Luxaroth

Golden Weapon.name: Golden Weapon
Golden Weapon.description: [[lookup @name]]'s weapon attacks are magical. When [[lookup @name]] hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

Searing Burst.name: Searing Burst
Searing Burst.description:
[[lookup @name]] emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of [[lookup @name]]’s choice within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=dnd5eactivity100]] feet of it must make the following saving throw.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=dnd5eactivity100]]

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Legendary Movement.name: Legendary Movement
Legendary Movement.description: [[lookup @name]] moves up to his full speed.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: [[lookup @name]] attacks twice with his [[/item Sunsword]].

Sunsword.name: Sunsword
Sunsword.descriptionprivate:
[[lookup @name]] wields a colossal magical sword of the ancient First Giants of Ember, infused with light energy and blessings of Lantyr.

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

When [[lookup @name]] scores a critical hit with this weapon, the target takes an extra [[/damage average activity=JOZRzLlo3Za14r5R]] damage and has the &Reference[blinded] condition until the start of [[lookup @name]]’s next turn.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: If [[lookup @name]] fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

Flickering Essence.name: Flickering Essence
Flickering Essence.description:
[[lookup @name]] is tied to the Orb of Lantyr relic on top of the Primoridal Bastion deep within the Pathways. Long ago, when the Orb was fully powered, [[lookup @name]] could roam through the Pathways and was also empowered with greater energy, enhancing his considerable natural strength.

Unfortunately, the Orb of Lantyr is waning, and [[lookup @name]] has lost a great deal of his ancient power and his ability to stray far from the Bastion Apex.

[[lookup @name]] takes damage as the Orb of Lantyr does, when the orb is destroyed, so too does [[lookup @name]]

Radiant Absorption.name: Radiant Absorption
Radiant Absorption.description: Whenever the [[lookup @name]] is subjected to radiant damage, he takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the radiant damage dealt.

Beacon of Light.name: Beacon of Light
Beacon of Light.description: Other creatures which Luxaroth chooses within 30 feet of [[lookup @name]] have advantage on Wisdom and Death saving throws. This benefit does not apply if Luxaroth is incapacitated.

Radiant Sense.name: Radiant Sense
Radiant Sense.description: Luxaroth can detect Celestials, Fiends, Fae, Undead, and Abyssal creatures within 60 feet. Within the same radius, he can also detect the presence of any Abyssal influence, such as levels of Abyssal Attunement or Abyssal objects or items.

Leadership.name: Leadership
Leadership.description: For 1 minute, whenever a nonhostile creature [[lookup @name]] can see within 30 feet of them makes an attack roll or a saving throw, the creature can add 1d4 to the roll if it can hear and understand [[lookup @name]]. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if [[lookup @name]] has the incapacitated condition.

Luxaroth.biographyprivate:
Luxaroth is a powerful warrior who was once a pivotal hero of the First Giants during the events of the Unveiling in the Pathways at the end of the Age of Beasts. He was instrumental in pushing back the forces of the Niethun and helped many of his kin escape to the surface during the civil war. For his deeds and service, his existence was tied to a relic as the First Giants' civilization collapsed completely. He clung to his physical form with a personal mission to protect the Orb of Lantyr relic and hold back Abyssal energies. He was remembered by the Shent to some extent as a legendary, or rather mythical, hero, though his existence is a complete mystery to present-day cultures.

Personality

Luxaroth is a stern, unyielding Giant who has little tolerance for corruption, evils, or trickery. He is a warrior first and foremost and has little regard for detailed histories, magical theory or the like. He wasn't responsible for his magical connection and link to the orb above him, which was the work of some of his peers, and he will have little to say on the matter. He is, however, deeply pious and worships the orb and the subtle connection to Lantyr herself that it provides. He speaks with casual adoration about Lantyr herself and will note that he used to be able to reach out and speak with Lantyr on a whim, but as the Orb fades, that connection grows increasingly difficult and rare. He will be initially surprised and pleased to learn that there are mortal ancestries on Ember and will quickly become enamored with his party or specific characters if they pledge to help him restore the Orb.

If a character in the party is a follower of Lantyr, he will immediately recognize them and trust them without hesitation. His demeanor changes to one of unbridled joy, and he will be intensely curious about any rites, practices, or beliefs that the character holds. He will also ask repeatedly about the light of Lantyr directly on the surface, a sight he was never able to see.

Any character with Abyssal influence, necrotic connections, or energies will be immediately suspect. Though Luxaroth will not attack without warning, he will demand such characters explain themselves, and should they fail to offer any convincing argument of their failings, he will attack with every intent to destroy them utterly.

Connections

Luxaroth has never encountered present-day mortal ancestries or cultures before, having been tied to and protecting the Orb of Lantyr relic for eons. He has no knowledge of common or other languages except his own, a distinct ancient dialect of Pathward which sounds quite different from the language spoken by the Shent.

Luxaroth has no connections to any living beings. A few deities are aware of his existence, and the Shent memory Miroroth is also aware of his deeds and legacy, guarding the Orb of Lantyr in the Pathways.

Phrases

"Hallowed is the distant light of Lantyr, may her shining embrace banish the evil of the dark!"
Luxaroth.biographypublic:
Standing before you, atop the Bastion, stands a colossal figure, outlined by the massive orb of light above. He is clad in archaic golden armor, his presence awe-inspiring, and both his size and ancient power is clearly visible. With a fierce intensity of ancient judgment, he holds tightly a gigantic golden sword that glitters with magical radiant energy. His burning eyes are locked onto you, narrowed in a blend of curiosity, surprise, and concern.

[[lookup @name]] is a primordial hero of the First Giants of Ember. He is not truly alive, but rather a tangible projection or avatar, and the edges of his physical form flicker in the light. He is an extremely ancient entity but has very limited knowledge, as he has been standing guard over the Orb of Lantyr upon the peak of the Primordial Bastion for uncounted years. He is a powerful warrior infused with radiant light energy, but he is seemingly tied to the Orb above him, and as it fades, so does his presence.

Mioroth.name: Mioroth

Shent Memory.name: Shent Memory
Shent Memory.description:
Mioroth is entirely intangible and making physical contact with them of any kind impossible. They cannot wear or use any equipment and they are immune to all physical and elemental damage types.

Mioroth is a fraction of the original being's memory, which lingers in the area where it was placed. It has extensive knowledge from the time that the memory was fragmented from the original creature, but little additional knowledge about the world afterward. It can only speak of events that the original Mioroth knew about to some extent.

Mioroth.biographyprivate:
Mioroth is an extremely strange being, one that discovered a way to live beyond death without succumbing to the horrors of undeath or corruption in any way. He was a member of the Shent, a people who lived two and a half thousand years ago across the great spine of the world that splits the continent of Aterica in two, which they called the Shana mountains. He was born in the Shent capital of She'lu in [[/date AT24571]] and spent much of his life studying the stars and the cosmos like his peers, but he was also fascinated by mechanical contraptions and moved to the outskirts of the Shent lands to pursue research and build mechanical machines that could help him understand the cosmos in greater detail. He gained immense knowledge and magical insights over the years, and even among his own people, he was considered a great sage and powerful seer. As the Shattering approached and the Shent knew their doom would soon fall upon them, Mioroth decided to do something about it and constructed a great machine to forestall his own destruction. The exact mechanism or process he used is unknown, but as the forces of the Abyss annihilated his people during the Abyssal Shear, he somehow managed to survive. Survive, however, is a subjective term, as his physical body was destroyed by monsters of the Abyss, but his spirit lived on in some way, and the being that now appears in the world seems to be aware that he's not truly alive.

Personality

Mioroth is an incredibly wise, calm, and thoughtful being, but he is also inherently cryptic and mysterious. He was this way in life, and in death, his reflection has become only more obtuse and likely to speak in riddles and cryptic metaphors. However, he has a deep desire to protect the cosmos, the world, and the peoples and creatures that live upon it from the horrors of the Abyss. To that end, he is deeply empathetic to the struggles people may face in trying to resist and battle the forces of evil, and he will gladly aid those he deems worthy.

  • Ideals - To shield Ember from the Monsters that lurk in the darkness, I will always aid those who battle the horrors of the Abyss.

  • Bonds - My people, the Shent, are forever etched in my essence. I carry their memory within me and strive to protect any vestiges of their culture and knowledge.

  • Flaws - The memory of my people’s destruction weighs heavily on my spirit. I often find myself lost in those memories, unable to escape the guilt of my failure to save them.

Connections

Mioroth was once a renowned seer and Sage among his people, and although the Shent culture no longer exists, there are many scattered remnants and even descendants who may remember or recognize his form. He is known to the Varun culture as the Bright One and is worshipped as a minor deity by some tribes. The Kithil culture and Bejak are more aware of his legacy, though they consider him more a myth and reverse his wisdom and skills with the arcane and future sight.

In addition, while very few mortals know that he still exists in some form as a projection, many older and powerful beings are aware of him, such as the Shard God family of Katu, Vekalla, and Raineka, many of the Elder Gods, including Alar and Sockets, and several other beings that predate the Shattering.

Phrases

"There are many paths and many events the Shent foretold before our time on Ember was up, and I have not forgotten all I've seen."

"The stars still sing to me, their ancient melodies guiding my thoughts across this fractured existence."
Mioroth.biographypublic: Mioroth is a projection of the ancient Shent Giants, and a former Seer, Sage, and Artificer that lived before the events of the Shattering two and a half thousand years ago. He seems to now exist as some kind of ghostly spirit, but strangely, he is not undead and seems to maintain his form and mind in some other manner unknown to you.
Mioroth.biographyappearance: Appearing as if from legends, a ghostly, semi-transparent, colossal figure looms over you even as he sits with his legs crossed. He is serene, calm, and intangible, as if made of pure energy and flickering strands of light. Shadows and motes of magic constantly evaporate from his body, and his only constant is his wise and gentle smiling expression. He looks faintly like a Kivahr, but as if carved from stone, with heavy brows, long limbs, and a muscular frame. The clothing he wears matches no recognizable style.

Nadin.name: Nadin

Limited Telepathy.name: Limited Telepathy
Limited Telepathy.description: Nadin can telepathically communicate with anyone within 120 ft of her while is she located inside her tent. This constant telepathic connection also makes them highly resistant to Psychic damage.

Eyes in the Shadows.name: Eyes in the Shadows
Eyes in the Shadows.description: Nadin can see through the black smoke surrounding her. While in her tent, within 120 feet of it, she cannot be blinded. She can also speak telepathically to any one or all creatures within 120 feet of her.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: [[lookup @name]] magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: Nadin makes two attacks with her [[/item Gleeful Smash]] and one with her [[/item Crimson Ray]]. Alternatively, she can use Crimson Ray twice.

Crimson Ray.name: Crimson Ray
Crimson Ray.description:
Nadin shoots a deep red beam from her outstretched hand in a line that is [[lookup @target.template.size activity=dnd5eactivity000]]-feet-long and [[lookup @target.template.width activity=dnd5eactivity000]]-feet-wide, provided that it has no creature grappled.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=dnd5eactivity000]], creatures in the area.

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
[[lookup @name]]'s spellcasting ability is [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]).

[[lookup @name]] knows and has prepared the spells presented on the Spells tab of their character sheet. They automatically satisfy the material component requirements to cast these spells, if any.

Keen Senses.name: Keen Senses
Keen Senses.description: Nadin has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.

Move.name: Move
Move.description: Nadin moves up to half her speed.

Blasphemous Word.name: Blasphemous Word
Blasphemous Word.description:
Nadin utters a word of such horror it cannot be understood.

Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=dnd5eactivity000]], each non-[[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]] creature of [[lookup @name]]'s choice within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=dnd5eactivity000]] feet of it that can hear it.

Failure: The creature has the &Reference[Stunned apply=false] condition until the end of [[lookup @name]]'s next turn.

Success: No effect.

Create Abyssal Eye.name: Create Abyssal Eye
Create Abyssal Eye.description:
[[lookup @name]] targets any unconscious humanoid within 30 feet of her. The target’s spirit rises as an @UUID[Actor.z8lCnghb89oIEWAZ]{Abyssal Eye} in the space the Humanoid occupied. The Abyssal Eye is under [[lookup @name]]'s control, but she can have no more than three Abyssal Eyes under her control simultaneously.

Performing this action does not permanently harm the unconscious Humanoid, and they can be revived as normal. If they are revived, the Abyssal Eye created using their spirit is destroyed.

Targets risen in this way must also roll on the @UUID[RollTable.YktgyhNcShUVGd6X]{Minor Abyssal Madness} table.

Sunlight Sensitivity.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Sunlight Sensitivity.description: While in sunlight, [[lookup @name]] has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Blindness/Deafness.name: Blindness/Deafness
Blindness/Deafness.description:
One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] or &Reference[Deafened apply=false] condition (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

Feather Fall.name: Feather Fall
Feather Fall.description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If a creature lands before the spell ends, the creature takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for that creature.

Fear.name: Fear
Fear.description:
Each creature in a 30-foot Cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and have the &Reference[frightened apply=false] condition for the duration.

A Frightened creature takes the &Reference[dash] action and moves away from you by the safest route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a space where it doesn't have line of sight to you, the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends on that creature.

See Invisibility.name: See Invisibility
See Invisibility.description: For the duration, you see creatures and objects that have the &Reference[invisible apply=false] condition as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane. Creatures and objects there appear ghostly.

Confusion.name: Confusion
Confusion.description:
Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or that target can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions and must roll 1d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn, consulting the table below.

@Embed[Compendium.dnd5e.tables24.RollTable.phbsplConfusionB rollable cite=false classes="caption-top"]{Behavior for the Turn}

At the end of each of its turns, an affected target repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Sphere's radius increases by 5 feet for each spell slot level above 4.

Sending.name: Sending
Sending.description:
You send a short message of 25 words or fewer to a creature you have met or a creature described to you by someone who has met it. The target hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell enables targets to understand the meaning of your message.

You can send the message across any distance and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a 5 percent chance that the message doesn't arrive. You know if the delivery fails.

Upon receiving your message, a creature can block your ability to reach it again with this spell for 8 hours. If you try to send another message during that time, you learn that you are blocked, and the spell fails.

Nadin.biographyprivate:
Nadin is an incredibly mysterious being who appears to be humanoid, but looking at her reveals some unsettling traits that hint at either an unknown origin or possibly innate biological changes that have twisted her at a fundamental level. She does not reveal where she came from or how old she is and seems content to reside within her tent. She doesn't appear to require food or water, and she has no supplies or necessary amenities that typical mortals might need. While she appears to be completely hale and healthy, every so often, she will cough and retch in a profoundly unpleasant and sickening fashion, possibly as a result of spending so much time in the black smoke coming from the large red brazier in her tent.

By her own account, Nadin is a follower of a goddess called "The Red Eye." When she utters this term, a slight pain reverberates inside the minds of anyone nearby. She is fanatical about this entity and calls her many beautiful names, like the Wondrous, the Nurturing, the Lifegiver, and the Comforter; however, her smiles and adoring tone seem extremely out of place.

Personality

Nadin is clearly unhinged, fanatical, and to some degree insane, having spent countless years within the Pathways and seemingly trapped in her tent. She slightly twitches her head when questioned about her past or nature, and her long, delicate fingers twirl in unusual patterns when she moves or talks. Nadin is profoundly evil at her core, and while she makes no move to attack those within her tent, she seems fascinated by their presence. If observed long enough, her hands appear to extend toward nearby throats, as if she is mentally attempting to strangle them.

Connections

Nadin has no connections to anyone and doesn’t seem to understand much about the world above, at least from a modern perspective. However, she does speak Common, but her words are slow, suggesting that she is somehow translating internally in her head. While she may not know about any modern culture, she does seem at least aware of the Shent and the Aedir.

Phrases

So lovely to have visitors, please please take a breath.. relax…

"Cough" "Cough" The distant eye always finds you in the end.
Nadin.biographypublic: A thin, wiry woman with long, blood-red hair and a mask stands before you. Her skin is almost pure alabaster white with a strangely smooth and almost glasslike texture. At first glance, she appears to be human, but her long, thin limbs, fingers, and extremely unsettling demeanor make her origins suspect. Her face is partially hidden behind a veil of some kind, with the eyes of her face completely obscured; however, as she moves her hands slowly upwards, a large red eye can be seen in the middle of her right palm.

Tethra Shùl.name: Tethra Shùl

Ennervating Claw.name: Ennervating Claw
Ennervating Claw.descriptionpublic: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has elongated and sharpened claws that siphon life from any creature they strike.

Finger of Nethehepticas.name: Finger of Nethehepticas
Finger of Nethehepticas.descriptionprivate:
Requires investment by a character with spellcasting ability and Abyssal Attunement.

Having this talisman equipped and invested grants +1 Boon to any action with the Spell tag for each Finger of Nethehepticas in your possession, up to a maximum of +3.

Attempting investiture to this item, regardless of whether you meet the criteria for attunement, increases your degree of Abyssal Attunement by 1 and decreases your degree of all other attunements by 1.
Finger of Nethehepticas.descriptionpublic: This glassy wand of ink-black stone resembles the petrified finger of a fiendish outsider, and it functions as an arcane talisman.
actiondesc: While holding the wand, you can use an action to target the corpse or remains of a creature of size 4 or larger. A Corrupted Cadrithor rises in the space the remains occupied or in the nearest unoccupied space.

When you damage a creature that you can see with a Spell, you can subsequently make an Arcana skill attack against their Fortitude defense to steal a portion of their vital essence. On a success you recover the amount of damage dealt by the spell as Health.

You can force each enemy you can see within 30 feet to defend against an Arcana skill attack targeting their Willpower defense. If successful, the target suffers the @Condition[frightened] and @Condition[entropy] conditions for 3 Turns.

Sunlight Weakness.name: Sunlight Weakness
Sunlight Weakness.description:
While in sunlight, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} suffers 2 Banes to all actions.

This mechanic is handled through an Active Effect that is easily toggled when applicable.

Restless Dead.name: Restless Dead
Restless Dead.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature}'s life is sustained by necromantic magic or otherworldly forces. When it would be considered @Condition[dead] it is instead @Condition[incapacitated].

After the conclusion of combat, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} may begin to perform the Recover action, regaining consciousness after the recovery is complete. Recovery in this fashion may be prevented in one of the following ways:

  • The creature was incapacitated by a type of damage for which it is Vulnerable.

  • The magical forces which caused it to rise as undead are disrupted, countered, or otherwise dispelled.

  • The creature's body is destroyed to a degree that it can no longer maintain its physical form.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} may move through a space as narrow as 1 inch in diameter without any penalty to its Stride. It gains a bonus to Dodge equal to half its Toughness score and is immune to the @Condition[restrained] condition.

Rune: Death.name: Rune: Death
Rune: Death.description:
The orderly force of destruction, responsible for the corruption of all biological matter. The Death rune governs decay and destruction.

The Death rune scales using Presence, targets Fortitude, and deals Corruption damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Life.
Rune: Death.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Death allows for basic communion with the dead and for rudimentary manipulation of unholy forces, producing one of the following effects:

  • Spread decay over an object no larger than a 1-foot cube, causing plants to wither, metallic objects to rust, wood to become rotten, food to grow foul, or a corpse to rapidly decompose. Magical objects are typically unaffected.

  • Cause a corpse which has been dead for less than seven days or otherwise preserved to perform a lifeless reenactment of its final moments. Its movements imitate those that occurred during the creature's final 30 seconds of life. You have no control over the creature nor can it communicate in any other way.

  • Hasten the death of a willing creature that is currently dying, causing it to pass swiftly and peacefully.

Ennervate may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Create.name: Gesture: Create
Gesture: Create.description:
You coalesce arcane power into tangible form, manifesting a Sprite which appears within 10 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Sprite is a Minion of half your own Level.

The Create gesture scales with Wisdom and the Sprite survives for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Sprite, casting another spell using the Create gesture replaces your previous Sprite. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

Not all Runes have a Sprite actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Creation will — for now — manifest a Flame Sprite.

Rune: Control.name: Rune: Control
Rune: Control.description:
The orderly force of discipline and permanence. The Control rune governs thought, reason, and persistence.

The Control rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Kinesis.
Rune: Control.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Control allows you to affect the decision making of others in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Moderately intensify or dampen the primary emotion being felt by a creature you touch. If the creature is intelligent enough to be aware of the laws governing spellcraft, they are aware of your actions.

  • Understand the abstract motivations of another living creature which allows you to touch it. You are able to intuit their immediate goals expressed in the form of a single verb.

  • Intensely focus on your current objective and the means of achieving it. You receive a brief hint or reminder from the Gamemaster about that objective containing only information which you have previously learned.

Motivate may only affect a creature or object which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Ray.name: Gesture: Ray
Gesture: Ray.description:
You funnel the arcane power of a Rune into a point and project it outwards in a beam.

The Ray gesture scales using Wisdom and produces a line that is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Influence.name: Gesture: Influence
Gesture: Influence.description:
You intensify the arcane power of a Rune into a concentrated direct contact which is generally a more powerful evolution of the basic Touch gesture.

The Influence gesture scales using Presence and targets a single adjacent creature. It deals 10 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Shadow Gait.name: Shadow Gait
Shadow Gait.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is able to step into and out of shadow itself to move in nightmarish and unpredictable ways.
Shadow Gait.actiondesc: While in dim light or darkness, the @ref[actor.name] can meld into shadow to disappear from view. It may Move and reappear within a different area which is also dim light or darkness. This is a Displace movement which provokes no disengagement.

Rune: Oblivion.name: Rune: Oblivion
Rune: Oblivion.description:
A chaotic force of destruction and annihilation of existence. The Oblivion rune governs unmaking of matter or decoherence of spirit.

The Oblivion rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower, and deals Void damage to Morale. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Soul.
Rune: Oblivion.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Oblivion allows you to unravel tiny holes in the fabric of existence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Disintegrate a non-magical object you hold smaller than a 6-inch cube, sundering it to a fine particulate dust of its component elements.

  • Anesthetize the ability to feel emotion from yourself or a willing target that you touch, causing it to enter a placid, stoic, or dispassionate state. This effect can be maintained as long as you make no further Action.

  • Subdue the potency of a light source, causing its visible radius to be reduced by half for as long as you maintain physical contact with it. Only one light source may be dampened in this way at a given time.

Erase may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Aspect.name: Gesture: Aspect
Gesture: Aspect.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect, casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Grave Mark.name: Grave Mark
Grave Mark.description: When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} achieves a Critical Hit with a melee attack, it leaves a baleful Grave Mark upon its target.
Grave Mark.actiondesc:
After achieving a Critical Hit with a melee attack, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks the target's Willpower defense, leaving a Grave Mark upon a success that inflicts the @Condition[exhausted] condition that persists until the target completes a Rest.

If a humanoid creature bearing a Grave Mark dies while under the effects of the mark, it rises from death on its subsequent Turn as a @UUID[Compendium.crucible.taxonomy.Item.ghoul00000000000]{Ghoul}.

Death Proficiency.name: Death Proficiency
Death Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Death. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Ennervate action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Inflection: Negate.name: Inflection: Negate
Inflection: Negate.description:
Invert the effect of a spell. An Inverted Life Touch spell which normally heals a target deals Poison damage instead. An Inverted Death Ward spell inflicts vulnerability to Corruption damage upon an adjacent enemy.

The effects of the Negate inflection are not yet automated for Playtest 1. This inflection is included as an example of the intended direction for the Spellcraft system.

Corruption Absorption.name: Corruption Absorption
Corruption Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to shrug off the effects of Death magic. Its Corruption resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Gesture: Conjure.name: Gesture: Conjure
Gesture: Conjure.description:
You coalesce arcane power into a superior form, manifesting a Visitor which appears within 30 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Visitor is a Minion equal to your own Level.

The Conjure gesture scales with Wisdom and the Visitor survives for 12 Rounds. You may only have one active Visitor. Casting another spell using the Conjure gesture replaces your previous Visitor. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Not all Runes have a Visitor actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Conjuration will — for now — manifest a Flame Visitor.

Inflection: Extend.name: Inflection: Extend
Inflection: Extend.description:
Enhance the duration of a spell, increasing the duration of its effect. For spells which are instantaneous, any corresponding status conditions that they cause are increased in duration.

Effect duration increases from the Extend inflection are not yet automated in Playtest 1. This inflection is included as an example of the intended direction for the Spellcraft system.

Gloom Sight.name: Gloom Sight
Gloom Sight.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can gaze into the gloom of total darkness and see normally. Magical darkness does not impede the creature's vision.

System Development: This feature needs automation to configure vision and detection modes that are unaffected by magical darkness.

Abyssal Protection.name: Abyssal Protection
Abyssal Protection.description:
While in an area of dim light or darkness, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} gains a +2 bonus to their Armor defense and is @Condition[guarded].

This is implemented via an Active Effect which can easily be toggled to enable or disable the benefit.

Gesture: Pulse.name: Gesture: Pulse
Gesture: Pulse.description:
Expel the arcane power of a Rune in a radius that travels outward with you at its center.

The Pulse gesture scales using Presence and produces an emanation with 10 foot radius, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Inflection: Push.name: Inflection: Push
Inflection: Push.description: Empower a spell to repel affected creatures away from the caster. Creatures affected by a spell with the Push inflection move 4 feet away from the spellcaster if that destination is unoccupied.

Necromancer.name: Necromancer
Necromancer.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Death. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[decaying] condition on Critical Hits.

The Decaying effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals your Intellect score as Corruption damage to Health each Round.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description:
You immediately react to a spell being cast and compose a rune and gesture designed to unravel and negate the spellcraft of an enemy mage.

Playtest Notes

This action can now be used in playtesting, but it is not yet fully automated. The Counterspell can be performed, but it is up to the Gamemaster to manually reverse a previously applied spell and to manually deduct its Action and Focus cost. These steps of the overall Counterspell workflow will be automated in a subsequent update such that a confirmed Counterspell will also confirm the spell that was countered, but with its effects removed.
Counterspell.actiondesc:
You form arcane energy into a countervailing spellcraft, targeting a spellcaster you can see within 30 feet.

Designate a Rune and Gesture which you know to attempt to counter the spell. Choosing a Rune which is opposed to one used in the spell grants +2 Boons to your attempt. Selecting the identical Gesture as the one being cast also adds +2 Boons to your attempt.

Perform a harmless Spell Attack against your target's Willpower defense. If your roll exceeds their defense, the spell is countered and its magic is nullified, producing no effects.

Tattered Robes.name: Tattered Robes
Tattered Robes.descriptionpublic: Consisting of quilted layers of cloth stuffed with rags or wool, padded armor cushions the body against blunt force and serves as the foundation beneath heavier gear.

Curse of Delusion.name: Curse of Delusion
Curse of Delusion.description: You cloud the clarity of your target's mind, permanently impairing their perception and sound judgment in ways that resist ordinary healing.
Curse of Delusion.actiondesc: Touch the target to becloud their perceptions with a curse that permanently reduces their Wisdom by 2.

Engulfing Darkness.name: Engulfing Darkness
Engulfing Darkness.description: You conjure an oppressive sphere of magical darkness that shrouds vision and suffocates light within its area.
Engulfing Darkness.actiondesc:
You create a sphere of magical darkness around your current position with 20 foot radius which remains in place for 6 rounds or until dispelled.

Within the area of this darkness all non-magical light sources are quenched and creatures are treated as @Condition[blinded].

The area of this sphere is constrained by solid walls. Creatures outside this area cannot see into it and the effective area of light sources outside this area ends at its perimeter.

WIP: This spell does not yet automatically create a darkness source, which must be done manually for now. Eventually this will be automated using a new Foundry VTT version 14 framework for template placement.

Rune: Kinesis.name: Rune: Kinesis
Rune: Kinesis.description:
The chaotic force of space and physical movement. The Kinesis rune governs all things related to the act of movement and physicality.

The Kinesis rune scales using Presence, targets Physical defense, and deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Control.
Rune: Kinesis.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Curse of Atrophy.name: Curse of Atrophy
Curse of Atrophy.description: You sap the physical strength of your target, causing their muscles to wither and weaken in a way that cannot be undone by ordinary rest or recovery.
Curse of Atrophy.actiondesc: Touch the target to afflict them with a wasting curse that permanently reduces their Strength by 2.

Talisman Weapon Training.name: Talisman Weapon Training
Talisman Weapon Training.description: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft. You are Trained with weapons in the Talisman categories.
Talisman Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a Harmless Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a critical success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.

Talisman Weapon Proficiency.name: Talisman Weapon Proficiency
Talisman Weapon Proficiency.description: You have a fluent education in the use of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar weapons. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Talisman category.

Tethra Shùl.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

Tethra Shùl is a unique undead creature who persists as a wraithlike warlock, capable of casting an array of arcane spells thanks to her otherworldly patron. Tenebrous remnants of her skeletal remains are held together by eldritch magic, cloaked in tattered Varùn robes and Abyssal shadow. A powerful relic of dark purple stone serves as her arcane focus: a petrified alien digit the size of a small rod known as a @UUID[Item.KIRSWcFMZoW52CpM]{Finger of Nethehepticas}. And she keeps this most precious of possessions hidden until the need arises to harness its terrible potential.

The crimson motes of light that comprise Tethra Shùl's eyes glare with an eerie, unsettling brilliance and unmistakable cruelty. When this wraithlike warlock is finally slain, her semi-spectral form will be violently pulled like ghostly tar towards the Heart of Ember in a piteous and inevitable struggle; and all that will remain are those brilliant red eyes, enduring as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.thkvJ5QBRORIwkkV]{Gem of Brightness} and an @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.dsjke4vPPsc9gsxH]{Elemental Gem of Fire}.

Behavior

In conversation as well as action, Tethra Shùl is cruel and direct. Her self interests are only eclipsed by the influence of her dark master @UUID[JournalEntry.emberDeities0000.JournalEntryPage.VXFOxdzzDefX5dQ8]{Nethehepticas}. Thanks to the powerful and malevolent influence of this otherworldly patron, Tethra Shùl also serves as a conduit for a terrible curse that has seeped into her surroundings: @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}, which can drive an afflicted humanoid mad with arcane confusion before dooming them to an early grave. Instead of passing on to the Bonelands, these poor souls become hideous @UUID[Actor.e67w5IOBScYtJKXr]{Horrendors}, rather effective puppets for the undead warlock and her insidious schemes.

In combat, Tethra Shùl utilizes an array of spells granted to her via her odious pact with Nethehepticas, alongside her wraith-like ability to drain the energy of living creatures. As soon as combat begins, she will also draw upon the power of the Finger of Nethehepticas to summon a @UUID[Actor.oNP6JkB5Me8gYrc1]{Corrupted Cadrithor}.

Lore

In the year 5 A.S., alongside a quintet of Varùn spellswords, the mortal warlock named Tethra Shùl journeyed to the remote @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCultures000.JournalEntryPage.dKvFRTSqJcJwDeAJ]{Shent} repository known as @UUID[JournalEntry.skQcdBxw8K0AS7hv]{The Bleak Archive} in search of Abyssal magic that might strengthen her bond with Nethehepticas. Little did Tethra Shùl know, she was merely a pawn in a greater plan that the loathsome Abyssal Horror had devised from the unseen depths of the Slumbering Vault.

After becoming trapped in the Shent's ingenious repository, Tethra Shùl faced a gruesome choice: death by starvation or unfaltering eternal servitude to Nethehepticas. And this grim subjugation has finally been made manifest, by the insidious dispersion of the Bewilderment into @UUID[JournalEntry.emberArctusGazet.JournalEntryPage.QpeeUqr3NZMsObnG]{Skybrush} and beyond. As this odious influence spreads, Tethra Shùl hopes to usher in the dawn of an Age of Nethehepticas alongside her own vile rise to power.
Tethra Shùl.biographypublic: Tethra Shùl is the sadistic wraith of a long-dead Varùn warlock. Her decayed, incorporeal form is adorned with the arcane baubles and eldritch trinkets she wore in life, along with trophies and jewelry of bone and viscera; all of it the spectral stuff of uncanny gloom.
Tethra Shùl.biographyappearance: You see the umbral apparition of a long-dead giant clad in the ancient, esoteric robes of a soothsayer. Her rotten form is draped in ever-flowing shadow, and from the depths of her grim countenance shine two motes of eerie crimson light, unholy eyes which regard you with a cruel malice the likes of which you've never seen.

Ifton Shepp.name: Ifton Shepp

Human Lineage.name: Human Lineage
Human Lineage.description: When you perform a Reaction which involves a Focus cost, you gain +1 Boon on any associated roll.
Human Lineage.actiondesc: When you become Weakened or sustain damage while Weakened, you can activate a burst of extraordinary adrenaline called Blaze. You immediately replenish your Action and Focus pools to their maximum value.

Hand Crossbow.name: Hand Crossbow
Hand Crossbow.descriptionpublic: This palm-sized crossbow trades power for concealability, perfect for close-quarters surprise shots or the desperate last bolt of a cornered rogue.

Iron Wrench.name: Iron Wrench
Iron Wrench.descriptionpublic: A heavy tool designed for the tightening or loosening of bolts on heavy machinery. Can also serve as a close combat melee weapon.

Smith's Toolkit.name: Smith's Toolkit
Smith's Toolkit.descriptionpublic: A leather-bound wooden kitbag. Contains awls, pincers, scrap metal and a small anvil as well as space for storing bits of scrap metal.

Science Novice.name: Science Novice
Science Novice.description:
You've learned to study the world around you through structured observation, mathematics, physics, chemistry, and other disciplines. You gain the Novice rank in the Science skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You are familiar with the basic principles of mathematics, physics, chemistry, or other scientific studies. You know how to construct and use simple machines for the purposes of making physical tasks easier. You know some of the more commonly understood scientific theories, and given suitable time to study more complex machines you might be able to at least operate them.

Smithing Novice.name: Smithing Novice
Smithing Novice.description:
You have received training in the fundamentals of Smithing and are capable of working with most common metals.

You still need to reference schematics and books to identify particular alloys and their properties.

Awareness Novice.name: Awareness Novice
Awareness Novice.description:
You have been trained in the basics of situational awareness, and are able to notice important details about your environment. You gain the Novice rank in the Awareness skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know to check for exits when you enter a room, and how to look for concealed weapons, hidden traps, and other threats. You know how to spot when you are being followed, and how to search for common hiding places.

Science Journeyman.name: Science Journeyman
Science Journeyman.description: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Science skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.

Field Repairs.name: Field Repairs
Field Repairs.description: The @ref[actor.name]{engineer} can quickly repair some damage on an allied Construct.
Field Repairs.actiondesc: You rapidly treat the wounds of an allied construct within 4 feet. Perform a Science Check against the target's Wounds Threshold. Your ally's Health is increased by the amount of the Roll in excess of the threshold.

Common Clothing.name: Common Clothing
Common Clothing.descriptionpublic: A shirt, pair of pants, undergarments, socks and shoes or boots suitable for menial labour or travel, cannot be worn with armor.

Machinist's Coveralls.name: Machinist's Coveralls
Machinist's Coveralls.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Mealkit.name: Mealkit
Mealkit.descriptionpublic: A leather pouch containing a metal cup, plate, fork, and a piece of cloth for wiping them clean.

Machine Oil.name: Machine Oil
Machine Oil.descriptionpublic: A leather-wrapped glass or clay flask containing lubricating oil.

Hammer.name: Hammer
Hammer.descriptionpublic: A common hand tool used in carpentry or metal working. Not designed for combat.

Ifton Shepp.biographyprivate:
@ref[name] was once the assistant to Vartholomew Chess, helping with the construction of Chessian constructs, but got headhunted by Silver Beam when they moved into town. Given an offer he couldn't refuse, he took all of the knowledge of Chess' constructs with him, and was instrumental in helping them rip off the designs for the Mark 1 construct line.

However, his conscience got the better of him, and he tried to argue against what the company was doing, which saw him immediately dismissed. Unable to return to Chess, and out of work, he settled in Rock Bottom where he maintains tools and makes simple repairs for the workers in the tent camp.
Ifton Shepp.biographypublic: @ref[name] is tinker and engineer who lives in Rock Bottom and does maintenance on tools and machines for spare coin. Locals know that he used to be a member of the Silver Beam company, and before that, was building constructs for Vartholomew Chess.
Ifton Shepp.biographyappearance: Wearing a dark apron over grease stained tunic and pants, this technician looks ready to tackle any technical issues put in front of him. Not outwardly armed or armored, he has a pack of tools on-hand to make field repairs if necessary.

Vartholomew Chess.name: Vartholomew Chess

Hulg'run Lineage.name: Hulg'run Lineage
Hulg'run Lineage.description:
You are immune to the Asleep condition.

You can commune with the essence of Ember when you Rest. If you are resting upon solid ground, you do not require sleep and can remain conscious. You may not engage in any strenuous activity in order to gain the benefits of the rest.
Hulg'run Lineage.actiondesc:
Your form temporarily calcifies, providing enhanced protection against physical blows.

  • You gain resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage equal to your Level + 1.

  • Your Stride is reduced by -2.

  • You are immune to the Prone condition and cannot be involuntarily moved.

Hammer.descriptionpublic: A common hand tool used in carpentry or metal working. Not designed for combat.

Hacksaw.name: Hacksaw
Hacksaw.descriptionpublic: A common hand tool used to cut through metal.

Mealkit.name: Mealkit
Mealkit.descriptionpublic: A leather pouch containing a metal cup, plate, fork, and a piece of cloth for wiping them clean.

Common Clothing.name: Common Clothing
Common Clothing.descriptionpublic: A shirt, pair of pants, undergarments, socks and shoes or boots suitable for menial labour or travel, cannot be worn with armor.

Expanded Toolbelt.name: Expanded Toolbelt
Expanded Toolbelt.descriptionpublic:
An expanded toolbelt in the form of a utility belt, a bandolier, or an array of pockets stitched into your equipment.

This item provides a number of additional Toolbelt slots according to its quality tier:

  • Standard: +1 Toolbelt slot

  • Fine: +2 Toolbelt slots

  • Superior: +3 Toolbelt slots

  • Masterwork: +4 Toolbelt slots

Machine Oil.name: Machine Oil
Machine Oil.descriptionpublic: A leather-wrapped glass or clay flask containing lubricating oil.

Smithing Journeyman.name: Smithing Journeyman
Smithing Journeyman.description:
You have a professional degree of experience with the skill of Smithing and can work through some of the more advanced techniques and schematics given time.

The basic properties of most common metals are easy for you to remember without reference material, but you still need books for rarer schematics and alloys.
