Machinist's Hammer.name: Machinist's Hammer
Machinist's Hammer.descriptionpublic: A seemingly humble tool with a flat striking face and curved claw, the claw hammer can become a savage weapon in determined hands.

Machinist's Coveralls.name: Machinist's Coveralls
Machinist's Coveralls.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Diplomacy Novice.name: Diplomacy Novice
Diplomacy Novice.description:
You know the basics of debate and how to use rhetorical devices to make your arguments more convincing. You gain the Novice rank in the Diplomacy skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know how to leverage emotion in your words to inspire others or sway their opinions. You can make a convincing argument, and you can generally steer others to agree with your point of view.

Vartholomew Chess.biographyprivate: The famed Vartholomew Chess maintains a workshop known as Arcturian Automations in the upper Arcturel Tradeway. He’s a proud and gregarious fellow who is happy to extol the virtues of his constructs and show off their many capabilities.
Vartholomew Chess.biographypublic: @ref[name] is a visionary mechanic and inventor responsible for the creation of the Chessman, a construct that eschews traditional Arcturian design elements in favor of older, ancient Aediri styles.
Vartholomew Chess.biographyappearance: You see a Hulg'run carved out of a rich brown stone, adorned with rugged, angular aesthetics. His literally chiseled jaw and hard-edged forearms are accented with pale pink marbling. He is dressed as a workman, with a heavy leather apron slung over plain, rugged clothing.

Zodi Trask.name: Zodi Trask

Leather Armor.name: Leather Armor
Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Pickaxe.name: Pickaxe
Pickaxe.descriptionpublic: A crescent spike mounted atop a sturdy haft, the pickaxe is conventionally a mining implement, but can be wielded in combat to deliver dangerous piercing blows.

Crowbar.name: Crowbar
Crowbar.descriptionpublic: A slightly curved bar of strong metal featuring a hook with a flattened head on one end. Used to apply leverage, prying one object loose of another.

Rope.name: Rope
Rope.descriptionpublic: A 30' length of plant-fibre rope that can be used to assist climbing or for many other purposes.

Torch.name: Torch
Torch.descriptionpublic: Layered oil-soaked affixed around the end of a rod made of bone or another non-flammable material, an inexpensive, if inefficient, temporary lightsource. Each torch can burned for one hour before it can no longer be used.

Claw Hammer.name: Claw Hammer
Claw Hammer.descriptionpublic: A seemingly humble tool with a flat striking face and curved claw, the claw hammer can become a savage weapon in determined hands.

Kiska Lineage.name: Kiska Lineage
Kiska Lineage.description:
Your blend effortlessly into the darkness. While standing within dim light or darkness you gain +2 Boons to any usage of the Stealth skill.

You instinctually know the Rune of Illusion and can use it for spellcraft.
Kiska Lineage.actiondesc: You draw on a limited reserve of energy to make a spectacular bounding leap. You may immediately Jump up to three times your Stride. Movement made in this way is so sudden that it affords no opportunity for Disengagement attacks.

Powerful Physique.name: Powerful Physique
Powerful Physique.description: You can wield weapons with the Slow trait and wear Armor with the Bulky trait without suffering Banes to your Initiative rolls.

Leg Sweep.name: Leg Sweep
Leg Sweep.description: You use a weapon which scales using Strength to sweep your enemy off balance, swinging low to knock them from their feet.
Leg Sweep.actiondesc: You make a Strike attack with your mainhand weapon. This technique is Difficult to execute and deals reduced damage, but if successful renders your target Prone.

Concussive Blows.name: Concussive Blows
Concussive Blows.description:
Your physical power wielding melee weapons which deal Bludgeoning damage can cause the Staggered condition on Critical Hits which deal damage to Health.

The Staggered effect lasts for 1 round and reduces your target's maximum Action by 1.

Unarmed Combat Training.name: Unarmed Combat Training
Unarmed Combat Training.description: You are familiar with basic martial arts and hand-to-hand combat. You know how to subdue or restrain opponents using your physical Strength. You are Trained with weapons in the Unarmed category.
Unarmed Combat Training.actiondesc: You attempt to physically restrain or subdue an opponent. Perform a Athletics skill attack against an adjacent target. If successful, both you and your target are @Condition[restrained] for 1 Round.

Zodi Trask.biographyprivate:
Zodi has served House Cevher for nearly five years as a foreman in the local mines, and is regarded as both a trustworthy steward of their business and a popular voice of the people who work for them. A third-generation Arcturian by way of Primordis, Zodi is remarkably proud of his otherworldly heritage; indeed, his maternal grandmother is said to have been a talented architect who designed breathtaking castles for many a barmy Fae lord (a legend which Zodi is quite fond of, and brags about at length). When he isn't working the mines and caverns around Arcturel, this thirty-something Kiska miner can be found sharing a round of drinks with the gang in Rallyhome.

Personality

Zodi is a capable and determined folk leader who admittedly enjoys his life as one of Arcturel's working class heroes. He's the first one to arrive and the last one to leave; the kind of trustworthy guy you'd want on your side in a brawl or to celebrate the time of your life.

Connections

Although his allegiances lie with House Cevher, Zodi has also taken up some contracts for work with the Silver Beam Mining Consortium, an enterprise that both he and House Cevher remain wary of.

Zodi is known throughout Arcturel as one of the subterranean town's most liked citizens, and many of the locals wouldn't hesitate to call themselves his friend. As such, they can be somewhat protective of each other, and are appropriately suspicious of outsiders who might come asking too many questions.

Phrases

The only thing that settles in Arcturel is the gloom. Somebody's gotta keep the lights on around here.

I never met a gemstone or a drinker I didn't like!

Trouble never sleeps.
Zodi Trask.biographypublic: Zodi Trask is a gregarious Arcturian miner who works the quarries near Arcturel as a foreman for House Cevher. Known for his proud work ethic and tenacity in the face of tribulation, Zodi is generally regarded as "one of the good ones" by the other citizens of Arcturel. Even when he's off duty, he's known to wear the dusty stains of the work day's toil and along with his trusty pickaxe — citing a perpetual need for "community watch" and when asked about his hesitation to relax.
Zodi Trask.biographyappearance: You regard a burly Kiska male whose corded muscles suggest a life of strenuous labor, a detail readily confirmed by the timeworn pickaxe at his side and the simplicity of his loose-hanging garb. Covered in a coat of gray-brown fur and quarry dust, this miner wears his long mane of vibrant hair in a thick braid to keep it dutifully out of the way. A smug countenance presides upon his mustachioed face, which appears to be marked by a few scars from some violent childhood scuffle or accident.

Chamberlain.name: Chamberlain

War Pick.name: War Pick
War Pick.descriptionpublic: A crescent spike mounted atop a sturdy haft, the pickaxe is conventionally a mining implement, but can be wielded in combat to deliver dangerous piercing blows.

Shock Spear.name: Shock Spear
Shock Spear.descriptionpublic: A weapon of reach and rhythm, the spear features a long shaft tipped with steel, perfect for holding the line or launching with deadly force from behind a shield wall.

Servitor.name: Servitor
Servitor.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} serves the will of another and maintains a connection to that master that allows the transmission or messages or even the sharing of senses between the servitor and its controller.
Servitor.actiondesc: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can contact its master, sending inaudible communication which is instantaneously received by its controller as long as that other creature is capable of receiving messages.

False Appearance.name: False Appearance
False Appearance.description: While it remains motionless, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is indistinguishable from some other object or material.

Net.name: Net
Net.descriptionpublic: These thickly woven fibers are reinforced for use in combat to entrap and entangle even the most dangerous foes, rendering them vulnerable.
Net.actiondesc: The target captured by the thrown net is @Condition[restrained] until they can get free.

Electricity Absorption.name: Electricity Absorption
Electricity Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to take lightning blasts in stride. Its Electricity resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Improvisational Expertise.name: Improvisational Expertise
Improvisational Expertise.description: A broken chair, a tankard, the spine of a book, a sealed jar, anything can be a weapon in the right hands. You're used to working with what you have at hand during a fight. Strikes you make with improvised weapons gain @Advantage[2] to hit, and deal damage of a type the GM feels most appropriate to the item used.
Improvisational Expertise.actiondesc: You grab a random object within your reach and smash it against your target.

Steam Vent.name: Steam Vent
Steam Vent.description: Steam-powered constructs store dangerous amounts of superheated steam within their bodies that, if not discharged safely, can cause serious injury.
Steam Vent.actiondesc: Superheated steam bursts forth from inside the steam-powered construct in a burst of searing damage, knocking back those standing too close.

Body Block.name: Body Block
Body Block.description: You lean into an attack which was otherwise defended with your Armor, converting its result into a Block instead.
Body Block.actiondesc: An attack which otherwise is defended by your Armor or produced a Glancing blow is converted to a Block and deals no damage.

Chessman Plating.name: Chessman Plating
Chessman Plating.descriptionpublic: This once-impermeable reinforced plating has become deteriorated and weathered over centuries of neglect.

Chamberlain's Rapier.name: Chamberlain's Rapier
Chamberlain's Rapier.descriptionpublic: A long, slender, and exquisitely balanced weapon, Chamberlain's personal rapier has been modified, heavier than is typical, its hilt has been carefully carved out in an intricate geometric design and its guard slotted in a way that allows his hand to fit perfectly into it, making it a literal extension of his arm.

Chamberlain.biographyprivate: Chamberlain was built as a customer service and personal attendant construct, but has all the same capacities and ability of a standard Chessman construct.
Chamberlain.biographypublic: @ref[name] is a Chessman construct and a member of the Downsiders, a group of awakened constructs. It used to be in the employ of the Silver Beam Consortium but went rogue without warning and fled the offices.
Chamberlain.biographyappearance: A humanoid clad in smooth silver steel stands before you. It moves with mechanical precision, and you can’t help but notice that its chassis is scuffed, worn and dirty. This faceless construct has only glowing eyes on its otherwise smooth head. It's body bears the logo of the Silver Beam Consortium, though it looks like some vain effort was made to pry it free.

This faceless construct is heavy and reinforced, meant for manual labor. It has only glowing eyes on its otherwise smooth head. It's body bears a series of shallow scrapes gouges on its chest, and a pale spot, like something was pried off it recently.

Electricity Absorption.name: Electricity Absorption
Electricity Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to take lightning blasts in stride. Its Electricity resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Improvisational Expertise.name: Improvisational Expertise
Improvisational Expertise.description: A broken chair, a tankard, the spine of a book, a sealed jar, anything can be a weapon in the right hands. You're used to working with what you have at hand during a fight. Strikes you make with improvised weapons gain @Advantage[2] to hit, and deal damage of a type the GM feels most appropriate to the item used.
Improvisational Expertise.actiondesc: You grab a random object within your reach and smash it against your target.

Steam Vent.name: Steam Vent
Steam Vent.description: Steam-powered constructs store dangerous amounts of superheated steam within their bodies that, if not discharged safely, can cause serious injury.
Steam Vent.actiondesc: Superheated steam bursts forth from inside the steam-powered construct in a burst of searing damage, knocking back those standing too close.

Body Block.name: Body Block
Body Block.description: You lean into an attack which was otherwise defended with your Armor, converting its result into a Block instead.
Body Block.actiondesc: An attack which otherwise is defended by your Armor or produced a Glancing blow is converted to a Block and deals no damage.

Chessman Plating.name: Chessman Plating
Chessman Plating.descriptionpublic: This once-impermeable reinforced plating has become deteriorated and weathered over centuries of neglect.

Heavy Crossbow.name: Heavy Crossbow
Heavy Crossbow.descriptionpublic: A powerful, steel-limbed crossbow requiring a crank or lever to draw, it delivers devastating bolts capable of punching through armor or pinning enemies to walls.

Lucent.biographyprivate: Lucent was built as a security construct, but has all the same capacities and ability of a standard Chessman construct.
Lucent.biographypublic: @ref[name] is a Chessman construct and a member of the Downsiders, a group of awakened constructs. It used to be in the employ of Nodrick Stolas of Glimmer, but went rogue without warning and fled the offices.
Lucent.biographyappearance:
A humanoid clad in brushed rose gold metal stands before you. It moves with smooth but mechanical precision, and appears especially watchful. This faceless construct has only glowing eyes on its otherwise smooth head. It's body bears a silvery badge that reads:

Lucent

Rider.name: Rider

Construct.name: Construct
Construct.description:
As constructs, [[lookup @name]] is not a living being; they don’t require food, air, or sleep to survive, and cannot restore hit points by healing magic or medicine.

They can be repaired by characters with adequate training and proficiency in Smith's or Tinker's tools, or abilities and spells that mend inanimate objects.

  • Manual repair with tools restores 1d6 hit points per hour of work.

  • Magical repair methods and the HP restoration effects are left to the GM's discretion.

Lesser Lightning Absorption.name: Lesser Lightning Absorption
Lesser Lightning Absorption.description: Whenever [[lookup @name]] is subjected to lightning damage, they take no damage and instead regain a number of hit points equal to half the lightning damage dealt.

Sure-Footed.name: Sure-Footed
Sure-Footed.description: The [[lookup @name]] has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: [[lookup @name]] makes two attacks with their [[/item War Pick]], two attacks with their [[/item Shock Spear]], or two attacks with their [[/item Greater Improvised Weaponry]].

Greater Improvised Weaponry.name: Greater Improvised Weaponry
Greater Improvised Weaponry.description:
[[lookup @name]] can use almost any object as a greater improvised weapon. A greater improvised weapon follows the rules below.

Proficiency. Add the [[lookup @name]]'s Proficiency Bonus to attack rolls with an improvised weapon.

Damage. On a hit, the weapon deals 1d6 damage of a type the GM thinks is appropriate for the object.

Range. If the [[lookup @name]] throws the weapon, it has a normal range of 40 feet and a long range of 80 feet.

Weapon Equivalents. If an improvised weapon resembles a Simple or Martial weapon, the GM may say it functions as that weapon and uses that weapon’s rules. For example, the GM could treat a table leg as a Club.

Steam Vent.name: Steam Vent
Steam Vent.description: Steam-powered constructs store dangerous amounts of superheated steam within their bodies that, if not discharged safely, can cause serious injury.
Steam Vent.actiondesc: Superheated steam bursts forth from inside the steam-powered construct in a burst of searing damage, knocking back those standing too close.

War Pick.name: War Pick
War Pick.descriptionpublic: A crescent spike mounted atop a sturdy haft, the pickaxe is conventionally a mining implement, but can be wielded in combat to deliver dangerous piercing blows.

Shock Spear.name: Shock Spear
Shock Spear.descriptionpublic: A weapon of reach and rhythm, the spear features a long shaft tipped with steel, perfect for holding the line or launching with deadly force from behind a shield wall.

Servitor.name: Servitor
Servitor.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} serves the will of another and maintains a connection to that master that allows the transmission or messages or even the sharing of senses between the servitor and its controller.
Servitor.actiondesc: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can contact its master, sending inaudible communication which is instantaneously received by its controller as long as that other creature is capable of receiving messages.

False Appearance.name: False Appearance
False Appearance.description: While it remains motionless, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is indistinguishable from some other object or material.

Net.name: Net
Net.descriptionpublic: These thickly woven fibers are reinforced for use in combat to entrap and entangle even the most dangerous foes, rendering them vulnerable.
Net.actiondesc: The target captured by the thrown net is @Condition[restrained] until they can get free.

You're used to working with what you have at hand during a fight. Strikes you make with improvised weapons gain @Advantage[2] to hit, and deal damage of a type the GM feels most appropriate to the item used.
Improvisational Expertise.actiondesc: You grab a random object within your reach and smash it against your target.

Body Block.description: You lean into an attack which was otherwise defended with your Armor, converting its result into a Block instead.
Body Block.actiondesc: An attack which otherwise is defended by your Armor or produced a Glancing blow is converted to a Block and deals no damage.

Chessman Plating.name: Chessman Plating
Chessman Plating.descriptionpublic: This once-impermeable reinforced plating has become deteriorated and weathered over centuries of neglect.

Wilderness Journeyman.name: Wilderness Journeyman
Wilderness Journeyman.description: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Wilderness skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.

Rope.name: Rope
Rope.descriptionpublic: A 30' length of plant-fibre rope that can be used to assist climbing or for many other purposes.

Rider.biographyprivate: Rider was built to wrangle, care for and ride animals, it has been modified to be lighter and to move more slowly so as not to spook animals. It has all the same capacities and ability of a standard Chessman construct.
Rider.biographypublic: @ref[name] is a Chessman construct and a member of the Downsiders, a group of awakened constructs. It used to be in the employ of Hob Korell's Unconventional Steeds but went rogue without warning and fled the offices.
Rider.biographyappearance:
A humanoid clad in oxidized copper stands before you. It moves with a slow, smooth gait, unhurried but still precise. You notice that it has a simpler, lighter frame that other constructs of its type, as though weight were a concern. This faceless construct has only glowing eyes on its otherwise smooth head. It's chest has a word engraved into it:

Rider

Larissa Toth.name: Larissa Toth

Labradorite Earring.name: Labradorite Earring
Labradorite Earring.descriptionpublic: This crystaline earring is derived from a Railen talisman and serves as a focus for magical energies.

Larissa Toth's Memory Shard.name: Larissa Toth's Memory Shard
Larissa Toth's Memory Shard.descriptionprivate: This memory shard contains a recording from Larissa Toth (intended for delivery to an unknown recipient) that explains her nefarious plans for the Silver Beam Consortium in Arcturel. These plans reveal a desire to: undermine House Cevher operations, sabotage Chessmen construct production via corrupted inkaro pearls, and establish a chokehold on exports from Arcturel. In the hands of Silver Beam's enemies, this confession would be most incriminating.
Larissa Toth's Memory Shard.descriptionpublic:
This 2-inch-long sliver of arcane crystal can be activated to project the small illusion of a moment in time it has previously recorded. Up to 3 recordings can be stored in a single memory shard.

This shard currently contains one recorded memory.

Altyra Lineage.name: Altyra Lineage
Altyra Lineage.description: You are immune to the Diseased condition which otherwise prevents you from regaining Health.
Altyra Lineage.actiondesc:
You can imbue yourself with the temporary visage and capabilities of Tyraphem, assuming an otherworldly visage. While transformed, you gain the following benefits.

  • You gain resistance to Radiant damage equal to 2 times your level.

  • Your attacks deal additional Radiant damage equal to half your Presence.

  • You gain +2 Boons to your use of the Intimidation skill.

You may end this transformation prior to its full duration on your turn at no cost.

Gesture: Ray.name: Gesture: Ray
Gesture: Ray.description:
You funnel the arcane power of a Rune into a point and project it outwards in a beam.

The Ray gesture scales using Wisdom and produces a line that is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Talisman Weapon Training.name: Talisman Weapon Training
Talisman Weapon Training.description: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft. You are Trained with weapons in the Talisman categories.
Talisman Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a Harmless Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a critical success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.

Rune: Flame.name: Rune: Flame
Rune: Flame.description:
The chaotic force of elemental, thermal energy. The Flame rune governs fire and heat.

The Flame rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Fire damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Frost.
Rune: Flame.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Flame allows you to manipulate fire and thermal energy in creative ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Manifest a burst of elemental flame in one inch sphere which can ignite a candle, torch, or other flammable materials.

  • Imbue your body with momentary thermal shielding which provides you with immunity to fire damage on an immediately subsequent action that costs 1 Action or less.

  • Control the movement of flames within a small area, causing them to flicker, dance, or shift in an animated performance of light and shadow.

Enkindle may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Illumination.name: Rune: Illumination
Rune: Illumination.description:
The orderly force of light and energy. The Illumination rune governs light and radiance.

The Illumination rune scales using Presence, targets Reflex, and deals Radiant damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Illusion.
Rune: Illumination.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Illumination allows you to create light and exert basic control over its radiance, producing one of the following effects:

  • Create a ball of light called a "tosslight" which sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius. The light can hover near your body, be affixed to an item or surface, or be thrown up to a distance of 30 feet. You may dismiss your tosslight at any time and may only have a single tosslight at a time, casting this spell again causes your previous tosslight to disappear.

  • Inscribe up to 200 words of invisible text into paper like a scroll, page, or book. The text is written from light itself and hidden from non-magical detection. It can be made visible by yourself or another through use of this spell combined with a spoken passphrase that you define at the time of inscription.

  • Touch a physical object that produces dim light, causing it to become bright light for as long as you maintain physical contact. Only one light source may be intensified in this way at a given time.

Reveal may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Control.name: Rune: Control
Rune: Control.description:
The orderly force of discipline and permanence. The Control rune governs thought, reason, and persistence.

The Control rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Kinesis.
Rune: Control.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Control allows you to affect the decision making of others in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Moderately intensify or dampen the primary emotion being felt by a creature you touch. If the creature is intelligent enough to be aware of the laws governing spellcraft, they are aware of your actions.

  • Understand the abstract motivations of another living creature which allows you to touch it. You are able to intuit their immediate goals expressed in the form of a single verb.

  • Intensely focus on your current objective and the means of achieving it. You receive a brief hint or reminder from the Gamemaster about that objective containing only information which you have previously learned.

Motivate may only affect a creature or object which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Create.name: Gesture: Create
Gesture: Create.description:
You coalesce arcane power into tangible form, manifesting a Sprite which appears within 10 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Sprite is a Minion of half your own Level.

The Create gesture scales with Wisdom and the Sprite survives for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Sprite, casting another spell using the Create gesture replaces your previous Sprite. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

Not all Runes have a Sprite actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Creation will — for now — manifest a Flame Sprite.

Dawn Beacon.name: Dawn Beacon
Dawn Beacon.description: You call forth the piercing light of dawn that penetrates the darkness around you, revealing the area and dispelling sources of magical darkness.
Dawn Beacon.actiondesc:
You create a pillar of magical light centered upon your current position which creates a cylinder of light creating 30 feet of bright light and an additional 30 feet of dim light. The pillar remains in place for 6 rounds or until dispelled.

This magical light counteracts magical darkness and destroys any source of magical darkness whose origin is contained within its area.

Enemies within the area when the light is first created must resist an attack against their Fortitude or be @Condition[blinded] for one round.

WIP: This spell does not yet automatically create a light source, which must be done manually for now. Eventually this will be automated using a new Foundry VTT version 14 framework for template placement.

Dress Clothing.name: Dress Clothing
Dress Clothing.descriptionpublic: A regal set of fine vestments fit for attending celebrations and high society functions, includes an overcoat or dress, kerchief or necktie, a fine shirt or corset, a vest or bodice, trousers or petticoat, belt or braces, stockings and fine shoes.

Luminary Band.name: Luminary Band
Luminary Band.descriptionprivate: This item is presented as a ring, but it can be any type of accessory like an amulet, cloak, bracers, or other type of trinket.
Luminary Band.descriptionpublic:
An intricately engraved golden ring that wraps around a elliptical glinting orange gemstone.

While equipped and Invested, this ring provides boons to the casting of any composed spell which incorporates an Inflection.

  • Minor enchantment: +1 Boon

  • Major enchantment: +2 Boons

  • Legendary enchantment: +3 Boons

Pen.name: Pen
Pen.descriptionpublic: A common writing implement used by scribes, allows for a variety of tips to be interchanged for different stroke styles.

Rallying Elixir.name: Rallying Elixir
Rallying Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly fortify the psyche and improve morale.
Rallying Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Morale dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Morale.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Morale.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Morale.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Morale.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Morale.

Inflection: Pull.name: Inflection: Pull
Inflection: Pull.description: Empower a spell to attract affected creatures toward the caster. Creatures affected by a spell with the Pull inflection move 1 space closer towards the spellcaster if that destination space is unoccupied.

Gesture: Aura.name: Gesture: Aura
Gesture: Aura.description:
You concentrate the arcane power of a Rune to create a maintained field of energy that washes over allies and enemies near to you.

The Aura gesture scales with Presence and produces an emanation with 20 feet radius centered on the spellcaster. The center of this Aura moves with the spellcaster.

Depending on the Rune used, the Aura deals damage or provides healing to any creature which begins its turn inside the Aura. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast, has a base cost of 5 Action and 1 Focus, and must be Maintained costing an additional 1 Focus every subsequent round.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Emanation templates which are linked to the Token and move when the Token moves are a feature coming in Foundry VTT version 14. Automation of the Aura gesture will occur once Crucible depends on Foundry VTT version 14.

Talisman Weapon Proficiency.name: Talisman Weapon Proficiency
Talisman Weapon Proficiency.description: You have a fluent education in the use of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar weapons. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Talisman category.

Larissa Toth.biographyprivate:
This upper-class denizen of Arcturel is one of the most ambitious and merciless entrepreneurs the sinkhole city has ever known. @ref[name] is an austere woman of stoic purpose and cruel intentions, which she expertly hides behind a veneer of refinement and outland civility. Unbeknownst to most of Arcturel's locals, @ref[name] is also a skilled transmuter whose interests are deviously aligned with the Tyraphem mastermind known as Pyix.

Clad in traditional Railen garb and ornamentation, Larissa’s elegant garments are usually tailored to fit her slender figure. Her clothes are somewhat posh despite their utility, and she often dons a dark hooded robe when navigating Arcturel and the Pathways beyond. Larissa’s arcane focus is an intricate labradorite earring that scintillates when she casts a spell with it.

Personality

@ref[name] carries the extreme pride of the Railen people with her and is generally xenophobic towards the people of the Arctus Plateau (which she expertly conceals behind a veneer of courtesy). She can be flirty with those she deems worthy or attractive, but will never allow a close intimate connection to foster with anyone who isn’t Altyran. Ultimately, when charm doesn’t get her what she wants, she results to sarcasm and (not-so-thinly-veiled) threats.

Whether through research or intuition, @ref[name] knows the value of nearly everything, and she has a soft spot for those who cater to her outlander’s pride with arcane knowledge or Railen gifts. Larissa rarely makes eye contact with those she deems to be lesser, and she won’t suffer an insult without returning one in kind. She’d rather use mage hand than get her actual hands dirty.

Connections

@ref[name] was born into a noble lineage of Railen aristocrats and was educated from an early age to become a courtier to a powerful Railen sorcerer baron named Orus Karanthus. Larissa was even poised to one day wed Karanthus's son, and the powerful union of these two noble houses was veritably the stuff of legend.

During her years at court, Larissa developed prodigious arcane talents of her own, which gained the attention of the celestial mastermind Pyix and his cohort of advisors. It was Pyix who began to sow seeds of discontent among the baron’s court by manipulating the young mage, and it was Pyix who ultimately drove an enterprising Larissa to murder her betrothed in an effort to usurp his power — a gambit that resulted in Larissa’s acquisition of the baron’s holdings.

Larissa subsequently inherited the Silver Beam Consortium, which she uses to further her esoteric goals in arcane research and the practise of rare transmutation magic. The Consortium’s latest endeavors — the slow assimilation of Arcturel’s inkaro pearl trade and seizure of the area’s automaton production — have put Larissa and her cohorts at the center of the sinkhole city’s political turmoil and threaten to expose her unsavory goals and opportunistic transgressions. As the chief executive of the Silver Beam Mining Consortium, she has a small army of Altyra engineers and constructs at her beck and call.

Phrases

An opportunity is a terrible thing to waste.

I suppose you pity yourself for your lack of privilege. It's your pity, however, that defeats you. Pity is the antithesis of confidence. And confidence is power.

If it isn't Railen, it isn't real.
Larissa Toth.biographypublic: @ref[name] is the charismatic and austere executive officer of the Silver Beam Consortium, a shrewd coalition of Altyra engineers and entrepreneurs from the Railen city of Ancalen to the west. Silver Beam's modern interests, which mirror Larissa's own, include several holdings in the Sinkhole Depths beneath Arcturel and the resources harvested therein.
Larissa Toth.biographyappearance: You regard a tall Altyra woman dressed in Railen fineries, her porcelain-colored skin marked with silver hexagonal lattices. Her long silver hair is worn in a braided low bun, and her attentive eyes are a striking color of bright lambent gold. This atristocrat's sharp features are overtly feminine, and noticeably bereft of scars or blemishes; she is undeniably attractive, and somewhat out of place amidst the grimy industrial subterranea of Arcturel.

Silver Beam Engineer.name: Silver Beam Engineer

Iron Wrench.name: Iron Wrench
Iron Wrench.descriptionpublic: A heavy tool designed for the tightening or loosening of bolts on heavy machinery. Can also serve as a close combat melee weapon.

Hand Crossbow.name: Hand Crossbow
Hand Crossbow.descriptionpublic: This palm-sized crossbow trades power for concealability, perfect for close-quarters surprise shots or the desperate last bolt of a cornered rogue.

Servitor.name: Servitor
Servitor.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} serves the will of another and maintains a connection to that master that allows the transmission or messages or even the sharing of senses between the servitor and its controller.
Servitor.actiondesc: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can contact its master, sending inaudible communication which is instantaneously received by its controller as long as that other creature is capable of receiving messages.

False Appearance.name: False Appearance
False Appearance.description: While it remains motionless, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is indistinguishable from some other object or material.

Repair Kit (smith).name: Repair Kit (smith)
Repair Kit (smith).descriptionpublic: A leather-bound bag containing sharpening stones and a grinder, a small hammer, a small crucible for liquifying metal, and an assortment of small pieces of scrap metal. Can be used to repair metal armor, weapons, and accessories.

Silver Beam Uniform.name: Silver Beam Uniform
Silver Beam Uniform.descriptionpublic: This standard-issue uniform of the Silver Beam Consortium bears a distinctly far-western design crafted from Railen silk.

Field Repairs.name: Field Repairs
Field Repairs.description: The @ref[actor.name]{engineer} can quickly repair some damage on an allied Construct.
Field Repairs.actiondesc: You rapidly treat the wounds of an allied construct within 4 feet. Perform a Science Check against the target's Wounds Threshold. Your ally's Health is increased by the amount of the Roll in excess of the threshold.

Science Novice.name: Science Novice
Science Novice.description:
You've learned to study the world around you through structured observation, mathematics, physics, chemistry, and other disciplines. You gain the Novice rank in the Science skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You are familiar with the basic principles of mathematics, physics, chemistry, or other scientific studies. You know how to construct and use simple machines for the purposes of making physical tasks easier. You know some of the more commonly understood scientific theories, and given suitable time to study more complex machines you might be able to at least operate them.

Electricity Absorption.name: Electricity Absorption
Electricity Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to take lightning blasts in stride. Its Electricity resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Restraining Bolt.name: Restraining Bolt
Restraining Bolt.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} carries a special type of ammunition designed to restrain opponents from a distance.
Restraining Bolt.actiondesc: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} fires a special type of ammunition designed to restrain an opponent through the use of an electrical charge.

Silver Beam Engineer.biographyprivate:
A collection of highly skilled tinkerers, engineers, and crafters hired by the Silver Beam company. They are well trained, well paid, and have become a vital asset to the company as it begins to expand into construct production.

Anatomy

The Silver Beam company hires the best engineers and crafters they can find regardless of background and creed. They are all clad in the same uniforms as the rest of the Silver Beam consortium, and are provided the finest tools money and forge can produce.

Behavior

Poached from smaller operations, trade houses, and anywhere else they can be found, these engineers are plied with large payouts and generous salaries, making them quite loyal as time goes on. Each engineer is afforded the tools and materials they need to do their job, and enough freedom to pursue it on their own. However, company demands cannot be ignored, and they are often reminded that results ensure job safety, making them especially hard working and dedicated.

Lore

There are effectively two groups of Silver Beam engineers inside the company. The most numerous are the rank-and-file workers who keep the company and its hardware running, work the forges, smith tools, and the like. While they are complicit in the unsavory practices of the company, they are separate from the inner circle of specialist engineers who have been entrusted with the top-secret projects undertaken by the company.
Silver Beam Engineer.biographypublic: The @ref[name] is a member of the Silver Beam mining consortium, and is a well funded, well equipped and monetarily motivated member of the company's engineering arm. They are well trained, and loyal to the company.
Silver Beam Engineer.biographyappearance: Wearing a dark apron over a grey and blue uniform of the Silver Beam mining consortium, this technician is one of many hired to tackle technical issues for the company. Not outwardly armed or armored, they do have packs of tools and resources they can use to make field repairs and assist in the operation of Silver Beam machinery.

Silver Beam Guard.name: Silver Beam Guard

Steel Mace.name: Steel Mace
Steel Mace.descriptionpublic: A one-handed blunt weapon that features a heavy head, typically forged of metal, which converts the momentum of its wielder's swing into a bone-shattering impact.

Crossbow.name: Crossbow
Crossbow.descriptionpublic: A powerful, steel-limbed crossbow requiring a crank or lever to draw, it delivers devastating bolts capable of punching through armor or pinning enemies to walls.

Silver Beam Uniform.name: Silver Beam Uniform
Silver Beam Uniform.descriptionpublic: This standard-issue uniform of the Silver Beam Consortium bears a distinctly far-western design crafted from Railen silk.
