False Appearance.description: While it remains motionless, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is indistinguishable from some other object or material.

Intercept.name: Intercept
Intercept.description: You protect your allies, intercepting blows that might otherwise be directed towards your companions.
Intercept.actiondesc:
You intercept the path of an enemy which enters your Engagement radius, immediatly moving up to your Stride to interpose yourself and block their path.

If the enemy moves out of your Engagement radius or attacks any other creature during their turn, you may make a Disengagement Strike against them.

Projectile Weapon Training.name: Projectile Weapon Training
Projectile Weapon Training.description: You have a basic education in archery and other projectile weaponry. You are no longer treated as Untrained with weapons in the Projectile categories.
Projectile Weapon Training.actiondesc: You can loose a shot under pressure, although with decreased accuracy. You perform a Strike that is Difficult, but has a reduced Action cost.

Preparedness.name: Preparedness
Preparedness.description: You seem to always be prepared for the moment at hand. You may sacrifice your free movement for the Round to instead equip an Item from your inventory without spending any Action points.

Unarmed Combat Training.name: Unarmed Combat Training
Unarmed Combat Training.description: You are familiar with basic martial arts and hand-to-hand combat. You know how to subdue or restrain opponents using your physical Strength. You are Trained with weapons in the Unarmed category.
Unarmed Combat Training.actiondesc: You attempt to physically restrain or subdue an opponent. Perform a Athletics skill attack against an adjacent target. If successful, both you and your target are @Condition[restrained] for 1 Round.

Intimidator.name: Intimidator
Intimidator.description: You specialize in exerting your intimidating presence to break the morale of your foes.
Intimidator.actiondesc: You physically intimidate an enemy that is within your engagement range, performing an Intimidation skill attack against your target. On a success they sustain Void damage to Morale.

Mark Prey.name: Mark Prey
Mark Prey.description: You fire a special shot which deals no damage, but explodes in luminous powder clearly marking your target.
Mark Prey.actiondesc: You Strike using a special shot. If your attack is successful the target is Exposed for the next 3 Turns.

Pinning Shot.name: Pinning Shot
Pinning Shot.description: You fire a tactically placed shot to pin your target against a nearby surface.
Pinning Shot.actiondesc: You Strike from distance. The attack is Difficult, however if your target is it it becomes Restrained until the end of their next Turn.

Disarming Strike.name: Disarming Strike
Disarming Strike.description: A martial technique designed to disarm your opponent, forcing them to drop an object held in one of their hands.
Disarming Strike.actiondesc: You make a Strike against a the Reflex defense of a single target. The technique is Difficult to perform and deals reduced damage. If successful, the target's mainhand weapon is Dropped.

Silver Beam Plating.name: Silver Beam Plating
Silver Beam Plating.descriptionpublic: This once-impermeable reinforced plating has become deteriorated and weathered over centuries of neglect.

Silver Beam Guard.biographyprivate:
A collection of hired security personnel paid to look after the interests and operations of the Silver Beam mining consortium. They are a uniformed guard force with standardized equipment and more focus on company values than martial training.

Anatomy

The Silver Beam company hires any and all willing to take up arms in defense of their property. They only require that new recruits are loyal to the company line, and respect their contractual obligations as a paid member of the consortium's team. Each guard is trained up to a basic level of competence with their weapons, afforded a tailored uniform, and high quality chain shirt that is meant to be worn under their uniform. Outwardly they don't appear to be well armored, but that is by design.

Behavior

Well paid, and indoctrinated into the company culture, Silver Beam guards are highly loyal to their bosses. However, their jobs are rarely dangerous, with most guards spending their time training or standing watch. As a result, most guards are not battle hardened unless they came to the company with prior experience. They are unlikely to die for the consortium, even if ordered to do so.

Lore

There is no significant lore about the Silver Beam security guards. They are a uniformed defensive force paid for by a company which has motives they often aren't privy to, leaving them out of the loop and oblivious to the darker operations of the company. However, those that are aware, and are trusted to guard more sensitive locations are always the most diehard and dedicated of company stooges.
Silver Beam Guard.biographypublic: The @ref[name] is a member of the Silver Beam Consortium. They are well funded, well equipped and monetarily motivated members of the company's security arm. They are well trained, and loyal to the company.
Silver Beam Guard.biographyappearance: Clad in the grey and blue uniform of the Silver Beam mining consortium, this guard is one of many hired security personnel entrusted with the safety of the company's operation. They stand ready with steel maces and light crossbows, and don't wear any visually obvious armor.

Edivel Sprout.name: Edivel Sprout

Mage Hand.name: Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

You can use your action to control the hand. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. You can move the hand up to 30 feet each time you use it.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

Mending.name: Mending
Mending.description:
This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage.

This spell can physically repair a magic item or construct, but the spell can't restore magic to such an object.

Fog Cloud.name: Fog Cloud
Fog Cloud.description:
You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for the Duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius of the fog increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st.

Gust of Wind.name: Gust of Wind
Gust of Wind.description:
A line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the spell's duration. Each creature that starts its turn in the line must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you in a direction following the line.

Any creature in the line must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves when moving closer to you.

The gust disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles, torches, and similar unprotected flames in the area. It causes protected flames, such as those of lanterns, to dance wildly and has a 50 percent chance to extinguish them.

As a bonus action on each of your turns before the spell ends, you can change the direction in which the line blasts from you.

Misty Step.name: Misty Step
Misty Step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

Entangle.name: Entangle
Entangle.description:
Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting from a point within range. For the Duration, these Plants turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain.

A creature in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be &Reference[Restrained] by the entangling Plants until the spell ends. A creature restrained by the plants can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.

When the spell ends, the conjured Plants wilt away.

Web.name: Web
Web.description:
You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point of your choice within range. The webs fill a 20-foot cube from that point for the Duration. The webs are difficult terrain and lightly obscure their area.

If the webs aren't anchored between two solid masses (such as walls or trees) or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling, the conjured web collapses on itself, and the spell ends at the start of your next turn. Webs layered over a flat surface have a depth of 5 feet.

Each creature that starts its turn in the webs or that enters them during its turn must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is Restrained as long as it remains in the webs or until it breaks free.

A creature Restrained by the webs can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer Restrained.

The webs are flammable. Any 5-foot cube of webs exposed to fire burns away in 1 round, dealing 2d4 fire damage to any creature that starts its turn in the fire.

Edivel's Book of Spells.name: Edivel's Book of Spells
Edivel's Book of Spells.descriptionprivate: Bound by treated leaves instead of leather, this prized possession of Edivel Sprout contains room for 100 recorded spells, though only a few pages have completed spells on them thus far - the rest are either blank or filled with notes that might one day lead to spells.

Spike Growth.name: Spike Growth
Spike Growth.description:
The ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range twists and sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes difficult terrain for the Duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 2d4 piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that can't see the area at the time the spell is cast must make a Wisdom (Perception) check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.

Tree Trimmer.name: Tree Trimmer
Tree Trimmer.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

Though it was designed to help clear vines and trim trees, Edivel's tendency to go out into places they shouldn't has led to them using this short blade more than once to fend off a beast that they couldn't take care of with a spell.

Agrimagical Artifact: Everbloom.name: Agrimagical Artifact: Everbloom
Agrimagical Artifact: Everbloom.description:
Once per day Edivel can touch a single stone, plant, or other natural item and imbue it with the following agrimagical effect:

Everbloom. Ground within a 100-foot square of the artifact doubles in productivity - all plants yield double their normal amount. In addition, the artifact gains [[/r 1d4]] charges - when Edivel is within 50 feet of it, any conjuration spell that they cast is cast twice, expending one of the charges. Once the charges are fully expended, the item loses its power and becomes mundane.

Produce Flame.name: Produce Flame
Produce Flame.description:
A flickering flame appears in your hand. The flame remains there for the Duration and harms neither you nor your Equipment. The flame sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The spell ends if you dismiss it as an action or if you cast it again.

You can also Attack with the flame, although doing so ends the spell. When you cast this spell, or as an action on a later turn, you can hurl the flame at a creature within 30 feet of you. Make a ranged spell Attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 fire damage.

This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

Guidance.name: Guidance
Guidance.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

Detect Poison and Disease.name: Detect Poison and Disease
Detect Poison and Disease.description:
For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet of you. You also identify the kind of poison, poisonous creature, or disease in each case.

The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

Goodberry.name: Goodberry
Goodberry.description:
Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can use its action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 hit point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.

The berries lose their potency if they have not been consumed within 24 hours of the casting of this spell.

Fibrous Resilience.name: Fibrous Resilience
Fibrous Resilience.description:
The fibrous biology of Thornlings is incredibly resilient, providing the following benefits:

  • Your armor class cannot be less than 16 regardless of what type of armor you are wearing.

  • You have resistance to damage taken from falling.

  • You gain double the effects of healing from expended Hit Dice.

Thornbark.name: Thornbark
Thornbark.description:
Trigger: When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you erupt with thorny barbs for 1 minute.

While the barbs last, you gain the following benefits:

  • Retaliatory Barbs. When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack (including the attack that triggered this reaction), it takes [[/damage activity=dnd5eactivity000]] damage.

  • Hard to Handle. A creature has disadvantage on Strength (Athletics) checks it makes to Grapple or Shove you.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

Edivel Sprout.biographyprivate:
If Edivel had a motto, it would be You Only Live Once – they’re willing to go anywhere and take any risk in the pursuit of knowledge, especially if it will help them reach their goal of becoming a famed agrimagical wizard. They often travel through the Arctus Plateau in search of places that have agrimagical resonance or that are associated with famous agrimages from the past, in part for what they'll learn and in part because they need an area away from others to do their experiments with agrimagic, which sometimes backfire but have yet to seriously harm anyone.

Personality

Edivel appears as if they were made from the trunk of a tree, with hair reminiscent of straw. They're young in both age and appearance, with a mischievous smile, and use vines as an accent on their wrists and ankles. Edivel thinks anything can be figured out through trial and error, and is always moving from place to place, peering at the ground or heading up a tree to try to get a different perspective.

They often go out into the wilds of the Arctus Plateau, and while their Thornling ancestry keeps them from serious damage, their clothes often look a bit worse for wear. They also have a tendency to wave their wand around a bit wildly as they work, often stopping in the middle of a conversation to page through their spellbook or write down a note from a thought they've had.

Connections

Edivel was in the first generation to be fully raised in Brevin – one of their parents, Ashe, was one of the seeders who helped to found and create the city. After growing up hearing stories about the famed agrimages of the Arctus Plateau, Edivel decided that they wanted to follow in the footsteps of wizards like Kali Andrella, their personal hero. They have been trying to build an agrimagical spell book and trade knowledge with other wizards by organizing a spell collective where different wizards trade spells by mail.

Edivel's closet friend for many years, Carmin, grew up with them in Brevin. The two often went on walks together through the Arctus Plateau in search of adventure, but in recent years they’ve grown apart. Both are risktakers, but Edivel believes that their risks are necessary to gaining knowledge, while Carmin primarily wants an adrenaline rush.

Phrases

I'll figure this spell out - just give me a minute!

Bodies heal, knowledge is forever.

I'm sure it's safe. More or less.
Edivel Sprout.biographypublic:
The young thornling's body is reminiscent of the trunk of a sturdy sapling, but they are full of motion, darting from place to place with a smile on their face and a wand in their hand. Their frayed cloak suggests that they may have left a bit of chaos in their wake, but if so, it hasn't affected their friendly nature or chipper attitude.

Edivel is a young thornling driven by a single goal - become the best agrimagical wizard in all of the Arctus Plateau. Brave to the point of being foolhardy, they have yet to meet a risk they won't take in pursuit of their goal, relying on their natural Thornling hardiness to protect them from serious danger as they experiment and build their spellbook.

Steros Kraver.name: Steros Kraver

Kraver's Greataxe.name: Kraver's Greataxe
Kraver's Greataxe.descriptionpublic: The well-used battleaxe of Steros Kraver, its haft engraved with a stylized emblem of the Burnished Hand. The blades have been keenly honed with care to a pristinely feathered edge.

Bronze Plate Mail.name: Bronze Plate Mail
Bronze Plate Mail.descriptionpublic: The pinnacle of personal protection, plate mail encases the body in carefully fitted steel plates, offering near-complete protection while allowing impressive mobility for a trained wearer.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.descriptionpublic: The shortsword is a straight-bladed weapon which is nimble to wield and quick to strike in close combat. It features a crossguard ideal for parrying incoming blows.

Human Lineage.name: Human Lineage
Human Lineage.description: When you perform a Reaction which involves a Focus cost, you gain +1 Boon on any associated roll.
Human Lineage.actiondesc: When you become Weakened or sustain damage while Weakened, you can activate a burst of extraordinary adrenaline called Blaze. You immediately replenish your Action and Focus pools to their maximum value.

Armored Efficiency.name: Armored Efficiency
Armored Efficiency.description: You are trained in wearing the heaviest types of armor while still retaining mobility. You are able to use a free Movement action once per Turn while wearing Heavy armor.

Leg Sweep.name: Leg Sweep
Leg Sweep.description: You use a weapon which scales using Strength to sweep your enemy off balance, swinging low to knock them from their feet.
Leg Sweep.actiondesc: You make a Strike attack with your mainhand weapon. This technique is Difficult to execute and deals reduced damage, but if successful renders your target Prone.

Heavy Weapon Training.name: Heavy Weapon Training
Heavy Weapon Training.description: You know how to use a heavy weapon to deliver punishing blows, putting your entire strength behind every swing. You are Trained with all weapons in the Heavy and Balanced categories.
Heavy Weapon Training.actiondesc: You unleash a powerful Strike with your mainhand weapon. The attack is slower to execute, but is Empowered to deliver additional damage.

Bulwark.name: Bulwark
Bulwark.description:
You have expertise in using a Shield to defend yourself and others.

Once per Turn while you have a Shield equipped, you may use the Defend action at a reduced cost of 1 Action Point.

Rallying Cry.name: Rallying Cry
Rallying Cry.description: You are a battlefield leader, using your presence and voice to harden the resolve of your allies.
Rallying Cry.actiondesc: You emit a courageous bellow that inspires Allies within 12 feet of you to remain stalwart in the face of danger. You perform an Intimidation skill test against the Madness threshold of your allies. On a success, affected allies become @Condition[resolute] for one Round.

Steadfast.name: Steadfast
Steadfast.description: Your patient resolve allows you to endure psychologically grueling ordeals with steadfast determination.
Steadfast.actiondesc: You harden yourself against demoralization. Your Morale is increased by your Wisdom score and you temporarily gain the Resolute condition.

Cleave.name: Cleave
Cleave.description: This martial technique is a specialized two-handed fighting maneuver which relies upon brute strength to swing your weapon in a wide arc, hitting multiple enemies in its path.
Cleave.actiondesc: A ferocious two-handed swing cleaves through foes in a 120 degree arc.

Strong Grip.name: Strong Grip
Strong Grip.description: Your grasp of your weaponry is firm and unyielding. You can perform Actions which require a free hand while wielding a two-handed melee weapon. Attempts to Disarm you are made with +2 Banes.

Counter Riposte.name: Counter Riposte
Counter Riposte.description: You are expert in translating a parried attack into a swift counter against your exposed enemy.
Counter Riposte.actiondesc: When you defend against a melee attack with a Parry, you may react and expend Focus to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike which benefits from the Exposed condition.

Artful Parry.name: Artful Parry
Artful Parry.description: You anticipate dodging an attack, intercepting it to intentionally Parry the strike.
Artful Parry.actiondesc: When you defend against a melee attack using the Dodge defense, you can react and expend Focus to instead Parry the attack.

Sundering Strike.name: Sundering Strike
Sundering Strike.description: You know a martial technique to exploit the weakest points of an enemy's defenses, exposing them to further harm.
Sundering Strike.actiondesc: You make a Strike with your mainhand weapon which, if successful, applies the Exposed condition to your target for 3 rounds. This attack is Difficult to perform and deals reduced damage.

Heavy Weapon Proficiency.name: Heavy Weapon Proficiency
Heavy Weapon Proficiency.description: You have a fluent education in the use of martial weaponry. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Simple, Heavy, and Balanced categories.

Steros Kraver.biographyprivate:
Born and raised in the city of Ordain, @ref[name] leads the militant ranks of the Burnished Hand from the organization's stronghold on Bura Island. When duty calls, Steros is known to lead his Burnished Hand Protectors into the hills and dales of the Arctus Plateau, where people in need await salvation. Steros is an attractive and stylish warrior whose reputation with a greataxe precedes him — and whose raw charisma is a powerful asset, on and off the battlefield.

Personality

Steros is regarded as a charismatic leader whose rugged appeal is only accentuated by his exceptionally well-manicured appearance. He is direct and commanding in both battle and social situations, preferring truth to deception and justice above vengeance. Even those who are slighted by Steros struggle to find faults in his methods, whether due to his innate comeliness or his calming assurance. Steros is quite proud of the Burnished Hand's Oaken lineage, and constantly seeks to refine his understanding of the culture's cabalistic teachings.

Connections

Thanks to the traditions of the Burnished Hand and the Cindaric Sages, Steros maintains close ties to the @UUID[Actor.KQ9uGdZu6zDlM66n]{Old Holy Speaker} and his Steward @UUID[Actor.Gw2LWZ2e1MU6KuIY]{Vinarith} in Ordain, who frequently serve as financial patrons for Steros and his militant order. Steros keeps his other intimates out of sight and out of mind, including his infirm Ordani father (a retired soldier named Veros) and his estranged sister (an artful vagabond named Shisa).

Phrases

I heard you needed the most competent soldiers this side of the Spine. So here we are.

The Burnished Hand is only as strong as the arm that wields it.

The winds of change mean very little to a mountain.
Steros Kraver.biographypublic: @ref[name] is the stalwart Head Commander of the Burnished Hand, the order sworn to protect the Cindaric Sages. He is also a loyal adherent to the edicts of the Cindarin Temple in Ordain, where the Holy Speaker presides over the Cindaric Sages and their closest allies. Steros is a skilled warrior and a charismatic leader, and is regarded by many to be one of the most competent military leaders in Arcturian history.
Steros Kraver.biographyappearance: This remarkably spruce warrior is clad in an impressive suit of aged bronze armor. The etching of a symmetrical crimson hand with roots like an ancient oak is emblazoned on the breast piece, and a lavish fur cloak is draped upon the matching pauldrons. A shock of long white hair frames this bearded soldier's handsome face, which is decorated with utter discernment. He wields a mighty greataxe as tall as he is, and equally as deadly.

Evesso.name: Evesso

Black Jade Dagger.name: Black Jade Dagger
Black Jade Dagger.descriptionpublic: This blade is less functional and more ornamented than a regular dagger. Its inscriptions and craftsmanship are purposeful for use as a tool for spellcraft. In combat, it projects piercing blasts of arcane energy.

Sage's Staff.name: Sage's Staff
Sage's Staff.descriptionpublic: The iconic staff of a Cindaric Sage, which serves as a talisman which provides additional defensive capabilities.

Rune: Death.name: Rune: Death
Rune: Death.description:
The orderly force of destruction, responsible for the corruption of all biological matter. The Death rune governs decay and destruction.

The Death rune scales using Presence, targets Fortitude, and deals Corruption damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Life.
Rune: Death.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Death allows for basic communion with the dead and for rudimentary manipulation of unholy forces, producing one of the following effects:

  • Spread decay over an object no larger than a 1-foot cube, causing plants to wither, metallic objects to rust, wood to become rotten, food to grow foul, or a corpse to rapidly decompose. Magical objects are typically unaffected.

  • Cause a corpse which has been dead for less than seven days or otherwise preserved to perform a lifeless reenactment of its final moments. Its movements imitate those that occurred during the creature's final 30 seconds of life. You have no control over the creature nor can it communicate in any other way.

  • Hasten the death of a willing creature that is currently dying, causing it to pass swiftly and peacefully.

Ennervate may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Death Proficiency.name: Death Proficiency
Death Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Death. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Ennervate action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Gesture: Create.name: Gesture: Create
Gesture: Create.description:
You coalesce arcane power into tangible form, manifesting a Sprite which appears within 10 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Sprite is a Minion of half your own Level.

The Create gesture scales with Wisdom and the Sprite survives for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Sprite, casting another spell using the Create gesture replaces your previous Sprite. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

Not all Runes have a Sprite actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Creation will — for now — manifest a Flame Sprite.

Gesture: Conjure.name: Gesture: Conjure
Gesture: Conjure.description:
You coalesce arcane power into a superior form, manifesting a Visitor which appears within 30 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Visitor is a Minion equal to your own Level.

The Conjure gesture scales with Wisdom and the Visitor survives for 12 Rounds. You may only have one active Visitor. Casting another spell using the Conjure gesture replaces your previous Visitor. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Not all Runes have a Visitor actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Conjuration will — for now — manifest a Flame Visitor.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description:
You immediately react to a spell being cast and compose a rune and gesture designed to unravel and negate the spellcraft of an enemy mage.

Playtest Notes

This action can now be used in playtesting, but it is not yet fully automated. The Counterspell can be performed, but it is up to the Gamemaster to manually reverse a previously applied spell and to manually deduct its Action and Focus cost. These steps of the overall Counterspell workflow will be automated in a subsequent update such that a confirmed Counterspell will also confirm the spell that was countered, but with its effects removed.
Counterspell.actiondesc:
You form arcane energy into a countervailing spellcraft, targeting a spellcaster you can see within 30 feet.

Designate a Rune and Gesture which you know to attempt to counter the spell. Choosing a Rune which is opposed to one used in the spell grants +2 Boons to your attempt. Selecting the identical Gesture as the one being cast also adds +2 Boons to your attempt.

Perform a harmless Spell Attack against your target's Willpower defense. If your roll exceeds their defense, the spell is countered and its magic is nullified, producing no effects.

Inflection: Compose.name: Inflection: Compose
Inflection: Compose.description: Enhance a spell by taking extra time in its formation, reducing other resource costs in exchange. The Compose inflection reduces the Focus cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Action cost by 1 in exchange.

Rune: Soul.name: Rune: Soul
Rune: Soul.description:
An orderly force of creation and spiritual essence. The Soul rune governs the fundamental procession of souls through life and death and relates to matters of sapience, personality, and mental health.

The Soul rune scales using Presence and provides Restoration of Morale or inflicts Psychic damage opposed by Willpower. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Oblivion.
Rune: Soul.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Life.name: Rune: Life
Rune: Life.description:
A chaotic force of creation, responsible for living matter. The Life rune governs health and matters relating to biological growth.

The Life rune scales using Wisdom and provides Restoration of Health or inflicts Poison damage opposed by Fortitude. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Death.
Rune: Life.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Life allows you to stimulate biological growth and nourish physical health, producing one of the following effects:

  • Cultivate 1 cubic foot of existing plants or fungus to rapidly grow to a healthy, blossoming, or harvestable state.

  • Identify a negative physical condition that is affecting a creature such as @Condition[diseased], @Condition[poisoned], @Condition[bleeding], or @Condition[weakened].

  • Verify whether a portion of food or drink is free of contamination from bacteria, parasites, or poison.

Bloom may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Ring of Gliding.name: Ring of Gliding
Ring of Gliding.descriptionprivate: This item is presented as a ring, but it can be any type of accessory like an amulet, cloak, bracers, or other type of trinket.
Ring of Gliding.descriptionpublic:
A band of elegant pale blue steel that features a spiraling pattern to the metal that presents the illusion that it is perpetually spinning slowly upon its wearer's finger.

This ring can be instinctually activated by its bearer when in freefall to enter a graceful and controlled descent.
Ring of Gliding.actiondesc:
If used while Falling, you may laterally move a number of spaces from your initial location as you glide.

  • Minor enchantment: 1 foot per 20 feet of descent.

  • Superior enchantment: 2 feet per 20 feet of descent.

  • Masterwork enchantment: 4 feet per 20 feet of descent.

You take no falling damage upon landing, nor are you rendered @Condition[prone].

Padded Armor.name: Padded Armor
Padded Armor.descriptionpublic: Consisting of quilted layers of cloth stuffed with rags or wool, padded armor cushions the body against blunt force and serves as the foundation beneath heavier gear.

Ashka Lineage.name: Ashka Lineage
Ashka Lineage.description:
Your Stride is not penalized while in water. You can hold your breath while underwater for up to twenty minutes.

You can detect subtle differences in temperature with precision, allowing you to locate creatures which are warm-blooded or otherwise emit heat up to 60 feet away as long as they are not behind total cover and you are not Blinded or Incapacitated. A creature detected using Thermal Vision is treated as visible for the purposes of actions which require you to see your target.

ALPHA ONE: This feature is not yet automated.

Gesture: Arrow.name: Gesture: Arrow
Gesture: Arrow.description:
You hurl a projectile imbued with the magical power of a Rune at a distant target.

The Arrow gesture scales using Intellect and targets a single creature up to a distance of 60 feet, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Ray.name: Gesture: Ray
Gesture: Ray.description:
You funnel the arcane power of a Rune into a point and project it outwards in a beam.

The Ray gesture scales using Wisdom and produces a line that is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Evesso.biographyprivate:
Despite his benevolent scholarly guise, Evesso is actually a cruel necromancer who seeks to strengthen his own wizardly power via forbidden Abyssal magic. Evesso's time with the Cindaric Sages has been an elaborate ruse, one that has allowed him the opportunity to gain access to the Cindaric order's most hallowed traditions and ancient secrets. Soon enough, he plans to actualize his malevolent schemes by raising an army of undead soldiers from the tombs beneath Corpin Sanctuary. Evesso conceals a ceremonial dagger carved from black jade upon his person, which is paired with the secret @UUID[JournalEntry.maDMFsfifjKH0sjS.JournalEntryPage.jPYv3Z4n7vOswB7z]{Profane Altar} in @UUID[JournalEntry.maDMFsfifjKH0sjS.JournalEntryPage.F5mVhRRToX0Z8QMz]{Evesso's Chamber} at Corpin Sanctuary.

Personality

Evesso carries himself with a dignity that borders on arrogance, but he is always willing to take time to instruct those with curious instincts. He is eager to point out the failures and fallibilities of others, and reacts to his own failures (or the scrutiny of them) with dismissal and disdain. Nevertheless, Evesso's erudition is considered to be a valuable asset to Mira Wavehorn and the other sages of Corpin Sanctuary. In actuality, Evesso is an utterly self-serving individual, whose evil nature lurks far beneath the artificial benevolence he presents to the world.

Connections

Evesso's past is an enigmatic one, and he keeps an extremely close circle of loyalists — none of which are present with him at Corpin Sanctuary. Beyond the veil of his duplicity, Evesso takes inspiration from @UUID[Actor.Gw2LWZ2e1MU6KuIY]{Vinarith}, Steward to the Holy Speaker, who is actually the evil dragon @UUID[Actor.TU4SxinE07hpdTwB]{Zerranyss} in disguise.

Phrases

Perhaps you simply haven't given it the proper thought.

A new fool is born every five minutes.

There are grim forces at work much greater than these.
Evesso.biographypublic: Evesso is an experienced Cindaric Sage stationed at Corpin Sanctuary. Following several years of dedicated service at the Cindarin Temple in Ordain, Evesso made his way to Mial Mountain to apply his extensive knowledge of esoteric arcana to his work for Mira Wavehorn's enclave. His taciturn nature and sardonic sense of humor have earned Evesso the reputation of a grumpy uncle among Corpin's younger sages.
Evesso.biographyappearance: This tall Ashka scholar is draped in the burgundy robes of a Cindaric Sage. His viridian-scaled form is lean and austere, and his countenance betrays an erudite contrition. Surely, this scholar is an accomplished practitioner of the Cindaric arts, if the age of his blue-green squama and the patina of his weathered staff are any indication.

Lilla Arien.name: Lilla Arien

Signborn Lineage.name: Signborn Lineage
Signborn Lineage.description:
You have two ethereal arms in addition to your corporeal limbs. These arms may not wield weapons, shields, or other equipment. They can be used, however, to quickly manipulate items in addition to your regular limbs. Once per Round you may equip an Item from your inventory without spending any Action points to do so.

Using special Signborn language and physiology, you synchronize your ethereal limbs into the weaving of spellcraft to effortlessly perform feats of magic. You know the unique Glyphspeak inflection which can be added to spells. A spell augmented with Glyphspeak costs +1 Heroism to cast, but can be performed at a reduced cost of -2 Action.

Rune: Life.name: Rune: Life
Rune: Life.description:
A chaotic force of creation, responsible for living matter. The Life rune governs health and matters relating to biological growth.

The Life rune scales using Wisdom and provides Restoration of Health or inflicts Poison damage opposed by Fortitude. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Death.
Rune: Life.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Life allows you to stimulate biological growth and nourish physical health, producing one of the following effects:

  • Cultivate 1 cubic foot of existing plants or fungus to rapidly grow to a healthy, blossoming, or harvestable state.

  • Identify a negative physical condition that is affecting a creature such as @Condition[diseased], @Condition[poisoned], @Condition[bleeding], or @Condition[weakened].

  • Verify whether a portion of food or drink is free of contamination from bacteria, parasites, or poison.

Bloom may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Soul.name: Rune: Soul
Rune: Soul.description:
An orderly force of creation and spiritual essence. The Soul rune governs the fundamental procession of souls through life and death and relates to matters of sapience, personality, and mental health.

The Soul rune scales using Presence and provides Restoration of Morale or inflicts Psychic damage opposed by Willpower. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Oblivion.
Rune: Soul.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Influence.name: Gesture: Influence
Gesture: Influence.description:
You intensify the arcane power of a Rune into a concentrated direct contact which is generally a more powerful evolution of the basic Touch gesture.

The Influence gesture scales using Presence and targets a single adjacent creature. It deals 10 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Sense.name: Gesture: Sense
Gesture: Sense.description:
You attune your mind to the arcane power of a Rune to sense nearby sources of energy.

The Sense gesture scales with Presence and produces an emanation with 30 feet radius and position that remains centered upon the spellcaster. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus. It may optionally be Maintained at the additional cost of 1 Focus every subsequent round.

This spell allows the caster to detect the presence of spellcraft using the same Rune as the one incorporated in this spell. The sense will also momentarily detect the presence of creatures according to their type.

  • Control: Fiends

  • Death: Undead

  • Earth: Oozes and Earth Elementals

  • Flame: Dragons and Fire Elementals

  • Frost: Giants and Frost Elementals

  • Illumination: Celestials

  • Illusion: Fey

  • Kinesis: Monstrosities

  • Life: Plants and Beasts

  • Lightning: Constructs and Storm Elementals

  • Oblivion: Outsiders

  • Soul: Humanoids

Playtest Notes

There is no automation for the sense that is temporarily granted by this spell, but such automation can be provided in the future via a Detection Mode which temporarily reveals creatures of the appropriate type to the spellcaster while the spell is maintained.

Gesture: Surge.name: Gesture: Surge
Gesture: Surge.description:
You channel the arcane power of a Rune into a rushing wave of energy that surges forward from your current position.

The Surge gesture scales with Wisdom and produces a line that is 10 feet wide and 15 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Aura.name: Gesture: Aura
Gesture: Aura.description:
You concentrate the arcane power of a Rune to create a maintained field of energy that washes over allies and enemies near to you.

The Aura gesture scales with Presence and produces an emanation with 20 feet radius centered on the spellcaster. The center of this Aura moves with the spellcaster.

Depending on the Rune used, the Aura deals damage or provides healing to any creature which begins its turn inside the Aura. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast, has a base cost of 5 Action and 1 Focus, and must be Maintained costing an additional 1 Focus every subsequent round.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Emanation templates which are linked to the Token and move when the Token moves are a feature coming in Foundry VTT version 14. Automation of the Aura gesture will occur once Crucible depends on Foundry VTT version 14.

Rune: Earth.name: Rune: Earth
Rune: Earth.description:
The orderly force of elemental earth, responsible for physical matter. The Earth rune governs minerals, metals, soils, and other physical compounds.

The Earth rune scales using Wisdom, targets Reflex, and deals Acid damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Lightning.
Rune: Earth.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Earth allows you to manipulate raw forces of rock, mineral, and soil in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Quickly shape up to one cubic foot of available material into a simple geometric form like a cuboid, ellipsoid, or polyhedron.

  • Precisely copy the physical shape of a held object that is smaller than a 6-inch cube, reproducing it from available clay, stone, or metal. The replica retains no useful properties except for its physical form.

  • Separate and collect earthen particles from the surface of an object, creature, or liquid that you touch, rendering the subject completely cleaned or purified in moments.

Mould may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Frost.name: Rune: Frost
Rune: Frost.description:
The orderly force of water and cold. The Frost rune governs the creation of water or other fluids and their transfer between liquid and frozen states.

The Frost rune scales using Wisdom, targets Fortitude, and deals Cold damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Flame.
Rune: Frost.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Frost allows you to manipulate liquids and their thermal properties, producing one of the following effects:

  • Draw up to one quarter gallon of fresh water from the atmosphere into a container or upon a surface you touch. The created water may be affected by relevant atmospheric properties of your current location.

  • Manipulate the temperature of up to 1 gallon of water, causing it to immediately freeze or thaw. The water need not be in a container; this technique can be used to coat a surface or join two objects together via regelation. Ice created in this way remains frozen for as long as the ambient temperature of the environment allows.

  • Gather up to a six-foot cube of nearby snow, forming it into a solidified sculpture, shape, or shelter.

Condense may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Talisman Weapon Training.name: Talisman Weapon Training
Talisman Weapon Training.description: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft. You are Trained with weapons in the Talisman categories.
Talisman Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a Harmless Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a critical success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.

Talisman Weapon Proficiency.name: Talisman Weapon Proficiency
Talisman Weapon Proficiency.description: You have a fluent education in the use of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar weapons. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Talisman category.

Soothe.name: Soothe
Soothe.description: You administer a soothing Performance which rallies your allies, restoring Morale.
Soothe.actiondesc: You perform a calming verse, benefiting all allies who can perceive you within 12 feet. Make a Performance Check against the Madness threshold of each ally. On success, each ally's Morale is restored.

Conserve Effort.name: Conserve Effort
Conserve Effort.description: You find calmness and focus in conserving your effort in battle. When you end your Turn with un-spent Action you gain +1 Focus.

Inflection: Compose.name: Inflection: Compose
Inflection: Compose.description: Enhance a spell by taking extra time in its formation, reducing other resource costs in exchange. The Compose inflection reduces the Focus cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Action cost by 1 in exchange.

Sage's Staff.name: Sage's Staff
Sage's Staff.descriptionpublic: The iconic staff of a Cindaric Sage, which serves as a talisman which provides additional defensive capabilities.

Cindaric Keeper's Robes.name: Cindaric Keeper's Robes
Cindaric Keeper's Robes.descriptionpublic: A finer variant of the cloth armor worn by other Cindaric sages, these robes are adorned with markings designating the wearer as the Keeper of Sages. The robes consist of quilted layers of cloth stuffed with fine fiber held in place with fitted leather support bands to cushion the body against blunt force and offer more custom-fitted protection.

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Rallying Elixir.name: Rallying Elixir
Rallying Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly fortify the psyche and improve morale.
Rallying Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Morale dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Morale.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Morale.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Morale.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Morale.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Morale.

Periapt of Determination.name: Periapt of Determination
Periapt of Determination.descriptionprivate: This item is presented as an amulet, but it can be any type of accessory like a ring, cloak, bracers, or other type of trinket.
Periapt of Determination.descriptionpublic:
A graceful silver amulet embedded with blue jewels imbues you with a feeling of steadfastness while you clutch it, prepared to weather any challenge.

This amulet provides a bonus to Willpower defense equal to the minimum of its Quality and Enchantment bonuses.

  • Fine quality and Minor enchantment: +1 Willpower

  • Superior quality and Major enchantment: +2 Willpower

  • Masterwork quality and Legendary enchantment: +3 Willpower

Ring of Evasion.name: Ring of Evasion
Ring of Evasion.descriptionprivate: This item is presented as a ring, but it can be any type of accessory like an amulet, cloak, bracers, or other type of trinket.
Ring of Evasion.descriptionpublic:
This elegant ornamented ring feels slightly slick and difficult to grasp. While held it vibrates almost imperceptibly.

This ring provides a bonus to Dodge defense equal to the minimum of its Quality and Enchantment bonuses.

  • Fine quality and Minor enchantment: +1 Dodge

  • Superior quality and Major enchantment: +2 Dodge

  • Masterwork quality and Legendary enchantment: +3 Dodge

Rune: Control.name: Rune: Control
Rune: Control.description:
The orderly force of discipline and permanence. The Control rune governs thought, reason, and persistence.

The Control rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Kinesis.
Rune: Control.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Control allows you to affect the decision making of others in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Moderately intensify or dampen the primary emotion being felt by a creature you touch. If the creature is intelligent enough to be aware of the laws governing spellcraft, they are aware of your actions.

  • Understand the abstract motivations of another living creature which allows you to touch it. You are able to intuit their immediate goals expressed in the form of a single verb.

  • Intensely focus on your current objective and the means of achieving it. You receive a brief hint or reminder from the Gamemaster about that objective containing only information which you have previously learned.

Motivate may only affect a creature or object which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Inflection: Extend.name: Inflection: Extend
Inflection: Extend.description:
Enhance the duration of a spell, increasing the duration of its effect. For spells which are instantaneous, any corresponding status conditions that they cause are increased in duration.

Effect duration increases from the Extend inflection are not yet automated in Playtest 1. This inflection is included as an example of the intended direction for the Spellcraft system.

Lifebloom.name: Lifebloom
Lifebloom.description: Few are those that can serve as a conduit within the physical world and allow the raw powers of Life and Soul to comingle, tipping the balance in their favour. This spell allows the caster to serve as a wellspring for the abundant forces that bring all soulful life into being. With a susurration of air the caster is surrounded with dancing motes of the pure energies of life and soul, like dozens of fireflies or the sparks from a fire, and a those within the radius are filled with a calming sensation as if they were immersed in pleasantly warm water. All plant life in the vicinity immediately surges through stages of growth to bloom, and the scent of pollen and lush greenery fills the air.
Lifebloom.actiondesc:
You channel vital magic into an aura that restores the Health and Morale of all allies within 30 feet of you. Each round, allies who start their turn within this aura recover your Wisdom in both Health and Morale. The spell must be maintained.

WIP: This spell is currently treated as an Area of Effect, granting healing-over-time effects to those within initial range. Removal of these effects if the spell ceases being maintained must be done manually for now. When auras are automated by the system in Foundry VTT version 14, the mechanical implementation of this spell will match the description.

Inflection: Push.name: Inflection: Push
Inflection: Push.description: Empower a spell to repel affected creatures away from the caster. Creatures affected by a spell with the Push inflection move 4 feet away from the spellcaster if that destination is unoccupied.

Revive.name: Revive
Revive.description: A potent expression of Life and Control magics, Revive allows the caster to intervene in the natural process of death by driving a surge of the essence of life into the body of the recently deceased. Those who have experienced Revival are often reluctant to discuss it, but describe it as a sensation that is unpleasantly reminiscent of being woken suddenly from a deep slumber to find they have been freezing— the flesh prickles and aches, the mind reels, and the soul aches with the memory of its interrupted departure.
Revive.actiondesc: You restore a creature which has recently become @Condition[dead] back to life, reducing its Wounds by your Wisdom score. If successful, the revived creature is @Condition[disoriented] and @Condition[staggered] for 10 minutes.

Lilla Arien.biographyprivate:
Lilla was born and raised in Ordain, surrounded by a family deeply committed to community and the Cindaric cause. Service to others, helping the less fortunate, and easing the burdens of those with less than her family was common. As a result, her upbringing instilled strong values of service and dedication to community. This is turn lead her to join the Cindaric Sages in her teens.

Early on, she distinguished herself as remarkably adept at managing resources and coordinating others, setting her apart as an invaluable asset that could be relied upon to handle tasks without need for supervision.

Over several decades, through consistent hard work and unwavering dedication, Lilla rose to the prominent role of Keeper of Sages, where she now oversees the room, board, and wellbeing of all sages within the faith.

Personality

Lilla is a kindhearted, warm, well-meaning and utterly devoted member of not just the Cindaric faith, but of Ordani and Arcturian society. She wants nothing more than to help the people of the Arctus Plateau.

She has a strong desire to be more involved in her community, and to be a more proactive part of finding solutions to ongoing issues. However, her duties as Keeper of Sages consume much of her time, leaving her feeling overworked and stretched thin at the best of time.

Lilla is a hardworking and dedicated individual, constantly juggling her responsibilities with a sense of stress and guilt over not being able to do more. She takes her role seriously, striving to maintain a balance between her duties and her personal aspirations.

Connections

A well-respected and well connected member of the Cindaric Sages, Lilla diligently ensures the wellbeing of the sages under her care and everyone knows her name as a result. She is connected to various members of the faith, the offices therein, and their offices. She is the first point of contact for many of the lesser leaders of the faith seeking support for those in need in the faith itself.

Phrases

"Caring for one spirit is good, but caring for all is best."

"The faith is made of people, and they must come first before anything else."

"Communities live and die by the unity and communication. We cannot isolate ourselves from our own people."
Lilla Arien.biographypublic: @ref[name] is the Keeper of Sages within the Cindaric Sages. This high position is tasked with handling the room, board, and wellbeing of all other sages in the religion, and it is one she does with great dedication.
Lilla Arien.biographyappearance: A signborn woman with a round, friendly face that belies the stress she carries. Her gray skin contrasts with her bright blue eyes, rosy cheese, and messy head of white hair. Short, pale blue horns curve softly from her forehead. She is clad in the ornate robes of the Cindaric order.

Mira Wavehorn.name: Mira Wavehorn

Kiska Lineage.name: Kiska Lineage
Kiska Lineage.description:
Your blend effortlessly into the darkness. While standing within dim light or darkness you gain +2 Boons to any usage of the Stealth skill.

You instinctually know the Rune of Illusion and can use it for spellcraft.
Kiska Lineage.actiondesc: You draw on a limited reserve of energy to make a spectacular bounding leap. You may immediately Jump up to three times your Stride. Movement made in this way is so sudden that it affords no opportunity for Disengagement attacks.
