This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Energize action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Oblivion Proficiency.name: Oblivion Proficiency
Oblivion Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Oblivion. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Erase action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Soul Proficiency.name: Soul Proficiency
Soul Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Soul. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Evoke action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Legerdemain.name: Legerdemain
Legerdemain.description: You can silently alter your spellcraft. You can apply Lesser Inflections using only your hands without the need for vocalization.

Recognize Spellcraft.name: Recognize Spellcraft
Recognize Spellcraft.description: You can interpret the arcane incantations of others to discern the nature of their spellcraft. When an enemy within 40 feet that you can see and hear begins casting a spell, you can identify its Rune if you also know that Rune.

Shield Ward.name: Shield Ward
Shield Ward.description: You have mastered a specialized technique to incorporate a physical shield into the Ward gesture. You may ignore the free-hand requirement for spells using the Ward gesture while you have a Shield equipped.

Spellmute.name: Spellmute
Spellmute.description:
Currents of magic flow strangely around you, as if unaware of your presence.

You cannot perform any action with the Spell tag. Spells which target you suffer +2 Banes regardless of whether they impose harmful or beneficial effects.

Bind Armament.name: Bind Armament
Bind Armament.description:
You bind the weapon currently equipped in your main-hand as your Bound Armament.

While bound, you may conjure the weapon into a free hand without any resource cost. You can conjure the weapon across any distance including if it has been Disarmed.
actiondesc: You bind the weapon currently equipped in your main-hand as your Bound Armament.
You call your bound armament back into your grasp. As long as you have sufficient free hands to hold it, the weapon returns instantaneously to you and is no longer Disarmed.

Dawn Beacon.name: Dawn Beacon
Dawn Beacon.description: You call forth the piercing light of dawn that penetrates the darkness around you, revealing the area and dispelling sources of magical darkness.
Dawn Beacon.actiondesc:
You create a pillar of magical light centered upon your current position which creates a cylinder of light creating 30 feet of bright light and an additional 30 feet of dim light. The pillar remains in place for 6 rounds or until dispelled.

This magical light counteracts magical darkness and destroys any source of magical darkness whose origin is contained within its area.

Enemies within the area when the light is first created must resist an attack against their Fortitude or be @Condition[blinded] for one round.

WIP: This spell does not yet automatically create a light source, which must be done manually for now. Eventually this will be automated using a new Foundry VTT version 14 framework for template placement.

Engulfing Darkness.name: Engulfing Darkness
Engulfing Darkness.description: You conjure an oppressive sphere of magical darkness that shrouds vision and suffocates light within its area.
Engulfing Darkness.actiondesc:
You create a sphere of magical darkness around your current position with 20 foot radius which remains in place for 6 rounds or until dispelled.

Within the area of this darkness all non-magical light sources are quenched and creatures are treated as @Condition[blinded].

The area of this sphere is constrained by solid walls. Creatures outside this area cannot see into it and the effective area of light sources outside this area ends at its perimeter.

WIP: This spell does not yet automatically create a darkness source, which must be done manually for now. Eventually this will be automated using a new Foundry VTT version 14 framework for template placement.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description: A sophisticated use of Illusory magic, the Invisibility spell allows the caster to wrap light and shadow around themselves like donning a cloak, reflecting the world about them as if they were not standing there. What person wouldn't believe it when their own eyes tell them that there is nothing to see?
Invisibility.actiondesc: You become @Condition[invisible] and cannot be detected using sight-based perception. You cannot be directly targeted by any action. This spell must be Maintained in order to remain in effect.

Lifebloom.name: Lifebloom
Lifebloom.description: Few are those that can serve as a conduit within the physical world and allow the raw powers of Life and Soul to comingle, tipping the balance in their favour. This spell allows the caster to serve as a wellspring for the abundant forces that bring all soulful life into being. With a susurration of air the caster is surrounded with dancing motes of the pure energies of life and soul, like dozens of fireflies or the sparks from a fire, and a those within the radius are filled with a calming sensation as if they were immersed in pleasantly warm water. All plant life in the vicinity immediately surges through stages of growth to bloom, and the scent of pollen and lush greenery fills the air.
Lifebloom.actiondesc:
You channel vital magic into an aura that restores the Health and Morale of all allies within 30 feet of you. Each round, allies who start their turn within this aura recover your Wisdom in both Health and Morale. The spell must be maintained.

WIP: This spell is currently treated as an Area of Effect, granting healing-over-time effects to those within initial range. Removal of these effects if the spell ceases being maintained must be done manually for now. When auras are automated by the system in Foundry VTT version 14, the mechanical implementation of this spell will match the description.

Protective Mirage.name: Protective Mirage
Protective Mirage.description: You Aspect yourself in a mirage of shifting Illumination and Shadow which mask your current position and allow you to Elude incoming blows.
Protective Mirage.actiondesc: You become surrounded by three illusory duplicates which last up to 10 Rounds. Any incoming Strike against you is made with a number of Banes equal to two times your number of duplicates remaining. Each time a Strike misses you, one of your duplicates disappears.

Revive.name: Revive
Revive.description: A potent expression of Life and Control magics, Revive allows the caster to intervene in the natural process of death by driving a surge of the essence of life into the body of the recently deceased. Those who have experienced Revival are often reluctant to discuss it, but describe it as a sensation that is unpleasantly reminiscent of being woken suddenly from a deep slumber to find they have been freezing— the flesh prickles and aches, the mind reels, and the soul aches with the memory of its interrupted departure.
Revive.actiondesc: You restore a creature which has recently become @Condition[dead] back to life, reducing its Wounds by your Wisdom score. If successful, the revived creature is @Condition[disoriented] and @Condition[staggered] for 10 minutes.

Telecognition.name: Telecognition
Telecognition.description: A rudimentary example of the complex art of penetrating the minds of others, Telecognition skims thoughts from the surface of a subject's mind like leaves from the surface of a pond. Though it may not be disruptive, it is unsubtle— just as the pond ripples when its surface is touched, so too does the mind.
Telecognition.actiondesc:
You reach into the mind of a Humanoid or Giant creature, attempting to penetrate their Willpower defense to understand their thoughts and motives. The target of this spell is aware of the intrusion, even if they cannot perceive you.

If successful, the Gamemaster (in the case of an Adversary target) or Player (in the case of a Hero target) must describe to you in 3 words or less what idea or sentiment is at the forefront of their thoughts in the current moment.

Upon a Critical Success, this description may use up to 10 words to convey deeper understanding.

Sigil.biographyprivate:
See @UUID[JournalEntry.emberDeities0000.JournalEntryPage.q1ZQkDuvlTY1lzaE]{Sigil}.

Personality

Sigil is devoted to knowledge, but believes that it cannot be forced into any particular shape. In his eyes, the job of the researcher to follow and preserve information instead of trying to control it, even if that path is a winding one. He sometimes cites his upbringing as a child of refugees as an influence on the way he studies — he loves the permanence of information and research found in a physical form, but is also dedicated to knowledge as an endless journey that may take the researcher to unexpected places.

Conversations with Sigil often follow the same winding course as his intellectual pursuits, with one piece of information leading him to another and another. Sometimes, this leads him to rattle off seemingly unrelated information rapid fire, while at others, he drifts off into thought as if plunging into some unseen ocean of knowledge, lapsing into silence only to start speaking about a different topic when he emerges. While he never seems fully lost during these flights of knowledge, those who speak with him have been known to get confused by the twists and turns, and it is believed that no one except Sigil himself can truly follow what is in his mind. Perhaps surprisingly, the many books that he keeps and adds to as a record of knowledge are often quite readable, though finding the exact book needed can be a journey in and of itself.

While Sigil is well-respected on the Arctus Plateau, he is often dismissed as weak or harmless — an image that he has carefully cultivated. His winding conversation is true to the way he thinks, but can also be a way of avoiding answering questions or giving out information that he doesn't want to, in the hopes that those who ask the question will be curious enough to journey for the knowledge on their own.

Connections

Sigil has no real followers, but his residence at Oldcraft Lodge is thought of as a beacon of knowledge on the Arctus Plateau. Perhaps because of his parents' experience seeking a home, Sigil never turns away anyone in need, asking only that they give something to either the Lodge itself or their fellow guests in return, whether it is organizing a part of his seemingly endless library, adding a new line or scroll to his tomes of knowledge, or providing an evening's entertainment for those gathered at the lodge. Often, he is absent from these gatherings, focused instead on gathering or capturing new learnings, and expects those around him to guide their own path to knowledge without his direct assistance.

Still, Sigil has also been known to mentor those who he feels need guidance in their pursuit of knowledge or who he thinks may learn something of true worth along the way, providing encouragement and hints on where they can go next without ever sending them directly. They must find that path on their own.

Phrases

"Now here's something you might not know. Or I might not know. Not fully anyway."

"Write that down, someone, before we all forget it!"

"The halls of knowledge are filled with secret passageways."
Sigil.biographypublic: Sigil is a shard god often called "The God of Books" for his love of knowledge. Determined to journey through knowledge the way he once moved through the world, he can spend a full season contemplating one particular section of a text and the next in the company of adventurers off to discover a hidden tome. It is said that one of these adventures led to his becoming a shard god, which has given him what he always desired: more time to learn about the world and capture its knowledge for others. Focused on his pursuit of knowledge above all other things, Sigil is not a god you follow — he is one you learn from, if you can. Over the years, his broad collection of knowledge has become a whirlwind of information, and while most can't fully keep up with his thoughts, many still find it worth it to try.
Sigil.biographyappearance: The old man is small, dwarfed by his large cloak, a long winding beard that gains a deep gleam of magic where it curls around his waist, and the sheer number of papers around him. And yet he is focused, moving his eyes and hands seamlessly from one to the next, as if each open scroll and loose sheet of vellum is in precisely the place he expected and needed it to be. He looks at you much the same way, glancing up as he flips through a book in his hands and makes a precise note in the margins, as if assessing you to determine where you belong.

Sionia.name: Sionia

Shard God.name: Shard God
Shard God.description:
[[lookup @name]] is a@UUID[JournalEntry.emberDeities0000.JournalEntryPage.6pJu6l3a7RTzcaRM]{ Shard God}, imbued with Lifeforce from the Heart of Ember after her interaction with one of Ember's Heart Crystals. She is not a typical opponent, as she can tap into massive amounts of power if needed to elevate the damage done by one of her typical features, destroying most mortal creatures without much effort.

It would be highly perilous for characters to attempt to fight a Shard God, unless a quest event specifically calls for it and provides the party with the specific and capable means for doing so.

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description: [[lookup @name]] has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: [[lookup @name]] makes five [[/item .Ylgdn6En9cEjKGTB]] attacks.

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
[[lookup @name]]'s spellcasting ability is [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]], +[[lookup @attributes.spell.attack]] to hit with spell attacks).

[[lookup @name]] knows and has prepared the spells presented on the Spells tab of her character sheet. She automatically satisfies the material component requirements to cast these spells, if any.

Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Detect Thoughts.name: Detect Thoughts
Detect Thoughts.description:
You activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns.

Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don't read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target's mind right now. If the target doesn't know any languages and isn't telepathic, you learn nothing.

As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target's mind. If you probe deeper, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you discern the target's reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind (such as a worry, love, or hate). On a successful save, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target's mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an [[/check ability=int skill=arc dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.

Disguise Self.name: Disguise Self
Disguise Self.description:
You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the spell ends. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.

The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing.

To discern that you are disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on an [[/check ability=int skill=inv dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description:
A creature you touch has the &Reference[invisible apply=false] condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.

Light.name: Light
Light.description:
You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.

Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.

Mage Hand.name: Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

Prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
You create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time.

Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.

Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot.

Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.

Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour.

Minor Creation. You create a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.

Fly.name: Fly
Fly.description:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft unless it can stop the fall.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 3.

Lightning Bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description:
A stroke of lightning forming a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.

Cone of Cold.name: Cone of Cold
Cone of Cold.description:
You unleash a blast of cold air. Each creature in a 60-foot Cone originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

Mind Blank.name: Mind Blank
Mind Blank.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch has Immunity to Psychic damage and the Charmed condition. The target is also unaffected by anything that would sense its emotions or alignment, read its thoughts, or magically detect its location, and no spell—not even @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish}—can gather information about the target, observe it remotely, or control its mind.

Scrying.name: Scrying
Scrying.description:
You can see and hear a creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw, which is modified (see the tables below) by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. The target doesn't know what it is making the save against, only that it feels uneasy.

Your Knowledge of the Target Is …Save Modifier
Secondhand (heard of the target)+5
Firsthand (met the target)+0
Extensive (know the target well)−5
You Have the Target's …Save Modifier
Picture or other likeness−2
Garment or other possession−4
Body part, lock of hair, or bit of nail−10

On a successful save, the target isn't affected, and you can't use this spell on it again for 24 hours.

On a failed save, the spell creates an Invisible, intangible sensor within 10 feet of the target. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the target, remaining within 10 feet of it for the duration. If something can see the sensor, it appears as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.

Instead of targeting a creature, you can target a location you have seen. When you do so, the sensor appears at that location and doesn't move.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description:
This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select. If you target an object, it must be Large or smaller, and it can't be held or carried by an unwilling creature.

The destination you choose must be known to you, and it must be on the same plane of existence as you. Your familiarity with the destination determines whether you arrive there successfully. The DM rolls [[/gmr 1d100]] and consults the Teleportation Outcome table and the explanations after it.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.tables24.RollTable.phbsplTeleportMi]{Teleportation Outcome}
FamiliarityMishapSimilar AreaOff TargetOn Target
Permanent circle———01–00
Linked object———01–00
Very familiar01–0506–1314–2425–00
Seen casually01–3334–4344–5354–00
Viewed once or described01–4344–5354–7374–00
False destination01–5051–00——

Familiarity. Here are the meanings of the terms in the table's Familiarity column:

  • "Permanent circle" means a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know.
  • "Linked object" means you possess an object taken from the desired destination within the last six months, such as a book from a wizard's library.
  • "Very familiar" is a place you have visited often, a place you have carefully studied, or a place you can see when you cast the spell.
  • "Seen casually" is a place you have seen more than once but with which you aren't very familiar.
  • "Viewed once or described" is a place you have seen once, possibly using magic, or a place you know through someone else's description, perhaps from a map.
  • "False destination" is a place that doesn't exist. Perhaps you tried to scry an enemy's sanctum but instead viewed an illusion, or you are attempting to teleport to a location that no longer exists.

Mishap. The spell's unpredictable magic results in a difficult journey. Each teleporting creature (or the target object) takes [[/damage 3d10 type=force]] damage, and the DM rerolls on the table to see where you wind up (multiple mishaps can occur, dealing damage each time).

Similar Area. You and your group (or the target object) appear in a different area that's visually or thematically similar to the target area. You appear in the closest similar place. If you are heading for your home laboratory, for example, you might appear in another person's laboratory in the same city.

Off Target. You and your group (or the target object) appear [[/r 2d12]] miles away from the destination in a random direction. Roll [[/r 1d8]] for the direction: 1, east; 2, southeast; 3, south; 4, southwest; 5, west; 6, northwest; 7, north; or 8, northeast.

On Target. You and your group (or the target object) appear where you intended.

Misty Step.name: Misty Step
Misty Step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Protective Magic.name: Protective Magic
Protective Magic.description: [[lookup @name]] casts [[/item .Gms519pFLaUCptHP]]{Counterspell} or [[/item .125pueaN1W5MEuWZ]]{Shield} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.description: An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}.

Sionia.biographyprivate:
@UUID[JournalEntry.emberDeities0000.JournalEntryPage.gT5S5ncAEUvkYYYg]{Sionia} is one of Ember's @UUID[JournalEntry.emberDeities0000.JournalEntryPage.6pJu6l3a7RTzcaRM]{Shard Gods}, and her rise to power is as mysterious and unpredictable as her terrestrial influence. Considered by many to be the "Necromancer Goddess," [[lookup @name]] is a supremely powerful spellcaster in her own right, and her macabre talents and interests are likely to blame for her relative ostracism from society. [[lookup @name]]'s penchant for necromancy, however, is guided by scientific practicality more than some perverse inclination; she leaves the Souls of mortals well alone, and only uses the so-called "dark arts" to raise corpses for material concerns (and often benevolent ones, at that).

Nevertheless, Sionia's proximity to the reviled practice of @UUID[JournalEntry.emberPlayerGuide.JournalEntryPage.0RXUc08I2fOUESTL]{Necromancy} — and the advent of an unwanted legion of undead adherents — has resulted in her condemnation from most surface-dwelling cultures of Ember. As a consequence, Sionia spends much of her time wandering Ember in search of answers to unheard questions; a solitary and pensive being of gloriously bleak splendor, with no place to call home.

Personality

[[lookup @name]] is a sharp-tongued, sarcastic woman whose prickly demeanor is ultimately an armor to hide her own vulnerability. No matter what kind of grim and mysterious exterior she displays to the world, [[lookup @name]] is a thoughtful dreamer, who cares deeply about the people of Ember. She just wants to help in her own way (one that involves careful research, intense scrutiny, and a wary conscience).

Connections

Sionia has very few followers who actively reach out to commune with her. Part of this can be attributed to the fact that she largely ignores the prayers of would-be clerics and priests; but much of it is due to her relative obscurity. Scant denizens of Ember are truly aware of Sionia's teachings, but a rare chosen few have come to embrace her true nature — and her most devout acolytes have learned many secrets of the cosmos directly from "The Deadbinder's" lips.

Unfortunately, thanks to Sionia's spheres of influence, some of the darker denizens of Ember have come to worship her — including necromancers, deviant cults, and the whole society of the Moiran @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCultures000.JournalEntryPage.ZMHd8i0tOkhfOiKK]{Blood Barons}. Sionia herself is mostly offended by these worshippers and their sinister aims, and is known to hunt down and slay those who would use her name against the people of Ember in vain.

Phrases

Death is never the end.

I've walked more roads than I can count, and have met fewer friends than I can admit.

The cosmos is a cold place. That doesn't mean your heart must be.
Sionia.biographypublic:
Clad in shining silver armor and exquisite argentine garments, this alluring woman is shrouded in an otherworldly gown of pale and ghostly light. Her breathtaking beauty is weighted by a troubled expression on her forlorn face. And the longer you look at her sterling eyes, the more her sorrow becomes your own.

Known to some as "The Lonely Goddess," [[lookup @name]] is an enigmatic shard god and powerful necromancer, whose domains of influence are insight and solitude. [[lookup @name]] is perhaps the most reviled of The Nineteen, scorned by many for the unsavory fact that she is worshipped by sentient undead creatures the world over. [[lookup @name]]'s past is a mysterious one, and her concerns about the mortal world and its inhabitants are most curious.

Elder God.name: Elder God
Elder God.description: [[lookup @name]] is an Elder God, a primordial forces of the Ember Cosmos. It is not possible for mortals to fight an Elder God.

Spectra.name: Spectra

Elder God.name: Elder God
Elder God.description: [[lookup @name]] is an Elder God, a primordial forces of the Ember Cosmos. It is not possible for mortals to fight an Elder God.

Spectra.biographypublic: Standing resplendently in front of you is the Elder Goddess Spectra, taking the form of a very tall and striking woman with hair alight as if made of magical energy itself, wearing a gown that flickers and shifts with all manner of elemental magics. A massive tome floats in front of her outstretched hand, and arcane symbols rotate around her feet and lower body, alighting onto papers and scrolls as she appears deep in thought. She jumps slightly as she finally notices your presence and grins down at you with the friendly, excitable aura of someone who has just encountered something magical.

Kazra Steelshift.name: Kazra Steelshift

Chain Shirt.name: Chain Shirt
Chain Shirt.descriptionpublic: A mesh of interlinked steel rings worn over padding, chain mail provides excellent protection against cuts and decent defense against thrusts, though it distributes weight across the whole body.

Mace.name: Mace
Mace.descriptionpublic: A one-handed blunt weapon that features a heavy head, typically forged of metal, which converts the momentum of its wielder's swing into a bone-shattering impact.

Prayer Book.name: Prayer Book
Prayer Book.descriptionprivate: A book containing prayers and incantations dedicated to the god of knowledge Sigil. This one has extensive notes and ruminations in it written by Kazra Steelshift, the book's original owner.
Prayer Book.descriptionpublic: A book containing religions incantations and scriptures.

Hooded Lantern.name: Hooded Lantern
Hooded Lantern.descriptionpublic: An oil-burning or magically illuminated lantern that sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius.

Kazra's Log.name: Kazra's Log
Kazra's Log.descriptionprivate: A book containing the extensive notes, observations, ruminations and logs of the Fulgurite Blades from the perspective of Kazra Steelshift. The writing is neat, tight, and organized, with extensive notation and references between pages.

Censer.name: Censer
Censer.descriptionprivate: The type of damage dealt by this talisman can be tailored to the domain of whichever deity its weilder worships.
Censer.descriptionpublic: This talisman is a visible proclamation of its wielder's faith and the power it bestows upon them. In combat it can be used to project a searing beam of radiant light towards an enemy.

Kivahr Lineage.name: Kivahr Lineage
Kivahr Lineage.description:
Your body is strengthened with the lineage of giants. Your mind and your body work in harmony to solve problems and withstand physical strain.

You gain a bonus to your Fortitude and Willpower defenses equal to your Level divided by 4.
Kivahr Lineage.actiondesc:
You engage your supernatural ability to harmonize your mind and body. You enter a trance-like state which provides the following benefits at the start of your Turn.

  • You gain +1 Focus.

  • If your Morale is higher than your Health, you transfer up to your Presence ability score reducing Morale and gaining Health.

  • If your Health is higher than your Morale, you transfer up to your Toughness ability score, reducing Health and gaining Morale.

These transfers will not cause any resource to exceed it's maximum value.

Gesture: Influence.name: Gesture: Influence
Gesture: Influence.description:
You intensify the arcane power of a Rune into a concentrated direct contact which is generally a more powerful evolution of the basic Touch gesture.

The Influence gesture scales using Presence and targets a single adjacent creature. It deals 10 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Ray.name: Gesture: Ray
Gesture: Ray.description:
You funnel the arcane power of a Rune into a point and project it outwards in a beam.

The Ray gesture scales using Wisdom and produces a line that is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Aspect.name: Gesture: Aspect
Gesture: Aspect.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect, casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Steadfast.name: Steadfast
Steadfast.description: Your patient resolve allows you to endure psychologically grueling ordeals with steadfast determination.
Steadfast.actiondesc: You harden yourself against demoralization. Your Morale is increased by your Wisdom score and you temporarily gain the Resolute condition.

Healing Tonic.name: Healing Tonic
Healing Tonic.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to gradually close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Tonic.actiondesc:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Health dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Health each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Health each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Health each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Health each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Health each Round

Anachraenum Member.name: Anachraenum Member
Anachraenum Member.description:
You have full access to the Anachraenum's, Amaranthine Archives, training facilities, and equipment. You can spend one hour researching in the restricted section of Archives, allowing you to gain advantage on one Intelligence (History) or Intelligence (Arcana) check you make in the next 24 hours.

In addition, when you are within a dungeon or ruin, you gain +4 on initiative rolls, and you can use the environment to your advantage. If you are surprised, you can make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to act normally as if you were not surprised.

Rune: Illumination.name: Rune: Illumination
Rune: Illumination.description:
The orderly force of light and energy. The Illumination rune governs light and radiance.

The Illumination rune scales using Presence, targets Reflex, and deals Radiant damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Illusion.
Rune: Illumination.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Illumination allows you to create light and exert basic control over its radiance, producing one of the following effects:

  • Create a ball of light called a "tosslight" which sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius. The light can hover near your body, be affixed to an item or surface, or be thrown up to a distance of 30 feet. You may dismiss your tosslight at any time and may only have a single tosslight at a time, casting this spell again causes your previous tosslight to disappear.

  • Inscribe up to 200 words of invisible text into paper like a scroll, page, or book. The text is written from light itself and hidden from non-magical detection. It can be made visible by yourself or another through use of this spell combined with a spoken passphrase that you define at the time of inscription.

  • Touch a physical object that produces dim light, causing it to become bright light for as long as you maintain physical contact. Only one light source may be intensified in this way at a given time.

Reveal may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Oblivion.name: Rune: Oblivion
Rune: Oblivion.description:
A chaotic force of destruction and annihilation of existence. The Oblivion rune governs unmaking of matter or decoherence of spirit.

The Oblivion rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower, and deals Void damage to Morale. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Soul.
Rune: Oblivion.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Oblivion allows you to unravel tiny holes in the fabric of existence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Disintegrate a non-magical object you hold smaller than a 6-inch cube, sundering it to a fine particulate dust of its component elements.

  • Anesthetize the ability to feel emotion from yourself or a willing target that you touch, causing it to enter a placid, stoic, or dispassionate state. This effect can be maintained as long as you make no further Action.

  • Subdue the potency of a light source, causing its visible radius to be reduced by half for as long as you maintain physical contact with it. Only one light source may be dampened in this way at a given time.

Erase may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Life.name: Rune: Life
Rune: Life.description:
A chaotic force of creation, responsible for living matter. The Life rune governs health and matters relating to biological growth.

The Life rune scales using Wisdom and provides Restoration of Health or inflicts Poison damage opposed by Fortitude. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Death.
Rune: Life.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Life allows you to stimulate biological growth and nourish physical health, producing one of the following effects:

  • Cultivate 1 cubic foot of existing plants or fungus to rapidly grow to a healthy, blossoming, or harvestable state.

  • Identify a negative physical condition that is affecting a creature such as @Condition[diseased], @Condition[poisoned], @Condition[bleeding], or @Condition[weakened].

  • Verify whether a portion of food or drink is free of contamination from bacteria, parasites, or poison.

Bloom may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Talisman Weapon Training.name: Talisman Weapon Training
Talisman Weapon Training.description: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft. You are Trained with weapons in the Talisman categories.
Talisman Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a Harmless Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a critical success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.

Rune: Soul.name: Rune: Soul
Rune: Soul.description:
An orderly force of creation and spiritual essence. The Soul rune governs the fundamental procession of souls through life and death and relates to matters of sapience, personality, and mental health.

The Soul rune scales using Presence and provides Restoration of Morale or inflicts Psychic damage opposed by Willpower. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Oblivion.
Rune: Soul.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Kazra Steelshift.biographyprivate:
Kazra Steelshift is the chief scribe of the Fulgerite Blades. She is responsible for recording absolutely everything the party finds and does, and has a mind capable of categorizing and understanding complex theories, almost never forgetting a detail. She is terse in her conversational style, but not rude, as she is deeply curious. She is a remarkable scholar of the arcane, and her passion and desire to study historical magic, artifacts, and arcane events are unmatched. If she meets another mage in her travels, her personality changes completely, and she turns from a soft-spoken and reserved scholar into a passionate, eager traveler.

Personality

As a member of a rare sect, her background is somewhat mysterious, and little is known about her upbringing, and she does not share much with anyone. Sajor, on the other hand, seems to know the full details and was eager for Kazra to join the Fulgerites after discovering the truth.

Connections

Kazra has been a trainee within the Anachraenum for several years, and while she values their knowledge gathering and commitment to uncovering history, she despises some other members for their tendency to restrict access to "dangerous" magical knowledge. She hopes to become a full member soon to access the restricted sections of the Amaranthine Archives and remove any constraints on her own path to enlightenment. In her pursuit of knowledge, she follows Sajor blindly and instinctively recognizes that Sajor shares a similarly intense pursuit of knowledge; staying by her side will likely lead to greater and greater discoveries.

Phrases

Arcane knowledge, the truth of the universe, is my one true pursuit.

I care little for what you claim to understand, my magic will reveal the truth.
Kazra Steelshift.biographypublic: Kazra is a member of the Anachraenum and the chief scribe and priest of the Fulgurite Blades. She wears the colors and symbolism of the Elder Goddess Spectra, the Goddess of Magic, but she is also part of a rare faction of Spectra's priesthood called the Sect of Arcvold, who believe that the pursuit of magic leads to spiritual enlightenment.
Kazra Steelshift.biographyappearance: Hooded and wrapped in a vibrant, shimmering shawl, this young Kivahr woman is initially slightly imposing, but her bookish demeanor and obvious curiosity about your presence reveal a true scholar at heart. Looking at the robes and symbols draped across the well-made chain mail armor, she confidently displays her devotion to the Goddess of Magic, Spectra, and appears to be a fanatic member of the Sect of Arcvold. She holds a mace in one hand and keeps her large pack at her side steady, which appears to be bulging with scrolls, tomes, and journals that she carries with her and studies while adventuring.

Leeph.name: Leeph

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.descriptionpublic: Tthe shortsword is a straight-bladed weapon which is nimble to wield and quick to strike in close combat. It features a crossguard ideal for parrying incoming blows.

Hand Crossbow.name: Hand Crossbow
Hand Crossbow.descriptionpublic: This palm-sized crossbow trades power for concealability, perfect for close-quarters surprise shots or the desperate last bolt of a cornered rogue.

Leather Armor.name: Leather Armor
Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Thornling Lineage.name: Thornling Lineage
Thornling Lineage.description:
The fibrous biology of Thornlings is incredibly resilient, providing the following benefits:

  • Your Armor defense cannot be below 6 regardless of what type of equipment you are wearing.

  • Damage taken from Falling is reduced by half before other resistances apply.
Thornling Lineage.actiondesc:
When you are targeted by a melee attack, you can cause thorny barbs to extrude from your body. For one minute you gain the following benefits.

  • Melee attacks which Hit or Glance you wound the attacker in retaliation who suffers damage equal to your Toughness ability score.

  • Attempts to Grapple or Push you suffer +2 Banes.

The effects of this Action apply to the attack which triggered the reaction.

ALPHA ONE: The effects of Thornbark are not yet fully automated.

Safecracker.name: Safecracker
Safecracker.description: You are skilled in the arts of disarming traps and picking locks. You gain +1 Boon on Stealth checks to disable a device or open a lock.

Diversionist.name: Diversionist
Diversionist.description: You specialize in using subterfuge to distract or trick your opponent during combat.
Diversionist.actiondesc: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.

Skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
Skirmisher.description: You are adept at entering and exiting the fray. When moving out of the Engagement radius of an enemy, that enemy has 2 Banes to any Disengagement Strike against you.

Preternatural Instinct.name: Preternatural Instinct
Preternatural Instinct.description: Your quickness of mind and body are equally impressive. You gain +2 Boons to all Initiative checks.

Healing Tonic.name: Healing Tonic
Healing Tonic.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to gradually close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Tonic.actiondesc:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Health dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Health each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Health each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Health each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Health each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Health each Round

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.descriptionpublic: An oil-burning or magically illuminated lantern that sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius.

Pinning Shot.name: Pinning Shot
Pinning Shot.description: You fire a tactically placed shot to pin your target against a nearby surface.
Pinning Shot.actiondesc: You Strike from distance. The attack is Difficult, however if your target is it it becomes Restrained until the end of their next Turn.

Backstab.name: Backstab
Backstab.description: You focus your cunning instincts on exploiting the weak points of a flanked target. You identify an opportunity and strike with deadly efficiency.
Backstab.actiondesc: You Strike with your mainhand weapon against a Flanked target, dealing Deadly damage.

Anachraenum Member.name: Anachraenum Member
Anachraenum Member.description:
You have full access to the Anachraenum's, Amaranthine Archives, training facilities, and equipment. You can spend one hour researching in the restricted section of Archives, allowing you to gain advantage on one Intelligence (History) or Intelligence (Arcana) check you make in the next 24 hours.

In addition, when you are within a dungeon or ruin, you gain +4 on initiative rolls, and you can use the environment to your advantage. If you are surprised, you can make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to act normally as if you were not surprised.

Light Weapon Training.name: Light Weapon Training
Light Weapon Training.description: You know how to wield light weapons fluidly with a high degree of maneuverability and grace in combat. You are Trained with all weapons in the Light and Balanced categories.
Light Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You dart forward nimbly, making a strike with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a Finesse weapon against a single target with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is Difficult, but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke Disengagement.

Mechanical Weapon Training.name: Mechanical Weapon Training
Mechanical Weapon Training.description: You are familiar in the design and usage of crossbows, firearms, and other similar armaments. You are Trained with weapons in the Mechanical category.
Mechanical Weapon Training.actiondesc: You focus deeply and calm your nerves to quickly Reload your mechanical weapon with exceptional haste.

Leeph.biographyprivate:
Leeph is a chaotic little ball of energy. They are a thief, a criminal, and utterly unconcerned with any concept of morality, eager to steal all kinds of things to keep their mischievous mind busy. They are especially skilled at getting into and out of places, disarming traps, and scouting out ruins. Before joining the Fulgerite Blades, Leeph was a loner and had very little memory of family or friends, they don't really care about thier past and are perfectly happy doing random things with the Fulgerite Blades.

Personality

They tend to chatter about nonsense, just filling the air with their random thoughts, much of it pointless and non-sequitur. In most situations, this chatter is either an outlet for thier need to stay busy or a distraction so they can pickpocket the listener.

Connections

Unlike the other members of the Fulgerite Blades, Leeph is a recent addition and not yet even a trainee member of the Anachraenum. They joined the group only a few months ago after being picked up on the road by Sajor after Leeph tried to steal from them in the middle of the night. Sajor was originally going to stuff Leeph into a nearby hole in the ground, but Leeph managed to convince her that he could be very valuable instead, in a desperate plea to save his own skin. Since joining the group, however, he has quickly displayed a myriad of useful skills that the group previously lacked, such as a keen eye for traps, the ability to pass unnoticed, and swift fingers, perfectly made to swipe unsuspecting loot from the unwary. The other members of the Fulgerite Blades have grown very fond of Leeph, especially Sajor, who considers him to be a little protege.

Phrases

I'm sorry, but you don't seem to understand. I want it more.

Oh! OH! Look at that!

So you're saying I shouldn't steal things?!
Leeph.biographypublic: Leeph is the new scout of the Fulgurite Blades. They are an excitable and mischievous thief who has very little impulse control.
Leeph.biographyappearance: A fidgety little radish-looking Thornling with eyes of shimmering pearlescence looks up at you with an unreadable expression. Their overly large leaves like fronds of hair, sweep back from their head, which they are constantly smoothing backwards to no effect, as if trying to calm themselves. They seem to be a restless ball of energy in all other respects, and even when standing still, their hands and eyes dart about in search of something to keep them occupied. They are clad in dark leathers over the top of their thorny barkskin, with a short-sword that appears to be nothing but a large dagger to anyone else hanging at thier side.

Rorhim Iron-Cask.name: Rorhim Iron-Cask

Bastard Sword.name: Bastard Sword
Bastard Sword.descriptionpublic: A bastard sword, also known as a hand-and-a-half sword, is a versatile weapon with a straight, double-edged blade around 40 inches long. This weapon is forged for both single-handed agility and two-handed power.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.descriptionpublic: Tthe shortsword is a straight-bladed weapon which is nimble to wield and quick to strike in close combat. It features a crossguard ideal for parrying incoming blows.

Heavy Crossbow.name: Heavy Crossbow
Heavy Crossbow.descriptionpublic: A powerful, steel-limbed crossbow requiring a crank or lever to draw, it delivers devastating bolts capable of punching through armor or pinning enemies to walls.

Splint Mail.name: Splint Mail
Splint Mail.descriptionpublic: A layer of vertical metal strips riveted to a backing of leather or mail, splint armor offers strong limb protection while sacrificing some flexibility.

Healing Tonic.name: Healing Tonic
Healing Tonic.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to gradually close wounds and improve bodily health.

Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Health dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Health each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Health each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Health each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Health each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Health each Round

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.descriptionpublic: An oil-burning or magically illuminated lantern that sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius.

Cor'ak Lineage.name: Cor'ak Lineage
Cor'ak Lineage.description: Your thick and partially-metallic hide provides natural protection from blows. While you are unarmored, you gain an Armor bonus equal to your Toughness ability score.
Cor'ak Lineage.actiondesc: When you become Weakened or suffer damage while Weakened, a crystalline carapace forms over your body. For a short period of time you gain resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage equal to your Toughness modifier. You also immediately gain an amount of Health equal to two times your Level.

Armored Efficiency.name: Armored Efficiency
Armored Efficiency.description: You are trained in wearing the heaviest types of armor while still retaining mobility. You are able to use a free Movement action once per Turn while wearing Heavy armor.

Leg Sweep.name: Leg Sweep
Leg Sweep.description: You use a weapon which scales using Strength to sweep your enemy off balance, swinging low to knock them from their feet.
Leg Sweep.actiondesc: You make a Strike attack with your mainhand weapon. This technique is Difficult to execute and deals reduced damage, but if successful renders your target Prone.

Heavy Weapon Training.name: Heavy Weapon Training
Heavy Weapon Training.description: You know how to use a heavy weapon to deliver punishing blows, putting your entire strength behind every swing. You are Trained with all weapons in the Heavy and Balanced categories.
Heavy Weapon Training.actiondesc: You unleash a powerful Strike with your mainhand weapon. The attack is slower to execute, but is Empowered to deliver additional damage.

Bulwark.name: Bulwark
Bulwark.description:
You have expertise in using a Shield to defend yourself and others.

Once per Turn while you have a Shield equipped, you may use the Defend action at a reduced cost of 1 Action Point.

Heater Shield.name: Heater Shield
Heater Shield.descriptionpublic: Named for its iron shape resembling the base of a clothes iron, the heater shield offers a balance of coverage and mobility.

Counter Strike.name: Counter Strike
Counter Strike.description: You are trained to transition between defending with your shield and a swift counter-attack.
Counter Strike.actiondesc: When you defend against a melee attack with a Block you may expend Focus to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike using your mainhand weapon.

Anachraenum Member.name: Anachraenum Member
Anachraenum Member.description:
You have full access to the Anachraenum's, Amaranthine Archives, training facilities, and equipment. You can spend one hour researching in the restricted section of Archives, allowing you to gain advantage on one Intelligence (History) or Intelligence (Arcana) check you make in the next 24 hours.

In addition, when you are within a dungeon or ruin, you gain +4 on initiative rolls, and you can use the environment to your advantage. If you are surprised, you can make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to act normally as if you were not surprised.

Rorhim Iron-Cask.biographyprivate:
Rorhim is happiest in the thick of a good fight, besides that, he enjoys manual labor, such as setting up the group's tents or chopping firewood. But once charts, maps, or books are brought out, he makes a point to let everyone know how bored he is. His parents were once ambassadors from Mazira, who stayed in Ordain many years ago, bringing the young Rorhim from across the entire known world to live in a new city.

Personality

While Rorhim still follows some teachings from his distant culture, he considers Ordain, the Anachraenum, and the Fulgerite Blades his home and family now.

Connections

Rorhim has been a trainee in the Anachraenum for several years. He loves the idea of fighting challenging foes in distant and forsaken ruins, but his laziness and disinterest in other matters have prevented any real growth. He has no interest in history, the cultural influence of ancient empires, or any other scholarly pursuits, and he would just love to hit things very hard all the time. He knows that Sajor picked him to be the team's muscle and is completely fine with that. Despite his indifferent and blasé attitude, he cares about everyone on his team and would risk his life for them. He follows Sajor because she often seeks out danger in her quest for knowledge, and he respects her significant arcane power.

Phrases

Yeah, what do you want? I'm busy.

Strength and power, give it your all!
Rorhim Iron-Cask.biographypublic: Rorhim Iron-Cask is a fighter of considerable strength and power. He is a trainee of the Anachraenum and member of the Fulgurite Blades. Rorhim is unofficially the second in command of the group, following the lead of Sajor.
Rorhim Iron-Cask.biographyappearance: A burly figure, tall even for Cor'ak, with a thick hornplate above his head and skin in varying shades of tan and brown. His bright blue eyes take in his surroundings with a noticeable lack of interest. He is clearly a warrior of considerable power, given the presence of an oversized sword slung across his back, an accompanying shortsword on his hip, and heavy armor strapped around his stocky frame.

Sajor Velex.name: Sajor Velex

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.descriptionpublic: Small, swift, and deadly, the dagger slips between ribs or into gaps in armor with ease, its wicked edge favored by assassins, thieves, and those who prefer a silent kill.

Healing Tonic.name: Healing Tonic
Healing Tonic.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to gradually close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Tonic.actiondesc:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Health dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Health each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Health each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Health each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Health each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Health each Round

Fine Healing Elxiir.name: Fine Healing Elxiir
Fine Healing Elxiir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.
Fine Healing Elxiir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Sajor's Spellbook.name: Sajor's Spellbook
Sajor's Spellbook.descriptionpublic: This heavy tome is used as a repository of knowledge as well as an implement for spellcraft. In the hands of an arcane practitioner, it can project concussive blasts of force towards a target.

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.descriptionpublic: An oil-burning or magically illuminated lantern that sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius.

Sajor's Journal.name: Sajor's Journal
Sajor's Journal.descriptionprivate: A personal journal belonging to Sajor, leader of the Fulgurite Blades. It covers most of her personal adventures and struggles as a leader and adventurer. It is private in nature, but could provide insights into the woman if thoroughly read.
Sajor's Journal.descriptionpublic: A book used to record personal recollections.

Fulgurite Ledger.name: Fulgurite Ledger
Fulgurite Ledger.descriptionprivate: This book contains the ledger and records of work, finds, expenses, and travels for the Fulgurite Blades. Thorough examination of the book reveals that the team runs a generally tight margin of profit, typically getting by selling valuables found in ruins, or by taking odd jobs for paying parties. There is nothing notable untoward in the logs.
Fulgurite Ledger.descriptionpublic: A ledger book used for recording facts and figures.

Luminary Band.name: Luminary Band
Luminary Band.descriptionprivate: This item is presented as a ring, but it can be any type of accessory like an amulet, cloak, bracers, or other type of trinket.
Luminary Band.descriptionpublic:
An intricately engraved golden ring that wraps around a elliptical glinting orange gemstone.

While equipped and Invested, this ring provides boons to the casting of any composed spell which incorporates an Inflection.

  • Minor enchantment: +1 Boon

  • Major enchantment: +2 Boons

  • Legendary enchantment: +3 Boons

Nir'ae Lineage.name: Nir'ae Lineage
Nir'ae Lineage.description:
You know the Rune of Illumination and may use it for spellcraft.

Your iridescent birthmarks provide you with a remarkable ability to evade or instinctually redirect hostile magic. Spell attacks against you suffer from +2 Banes.
Nir'ae Lineage.actiondesc:
When a spell which targets you directly is resisted with a critical failure, you can instinctually redirect the energy of the spell, causing it to instead dissipate or affect an alternative target within range of the spell other than its original caster.

The alternative target must defend against the spell instead and any effects of the spell are applied to that target instead. If no alternative target is chosen, the energy of the spell dissipates harmlessly.

Gesture: Fan.name: Gesture: Fan
Gesture: Fan.description:
You shape the essence of a Rune into a sweeping or splintered arc to strike multiple targets in close proximity.

The Fan gesture scales using Intellect and targets a 120 degree arc with 6 foot radius. It deals 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Arrow.name: Gesture: Arrow
Gesture: Arrow.description:
You hurl a projectile imbued with the magical power of a Rune at a distant target.

The Arrow gesture scales using Intellect and targets a single creature up to a distance of 60 feet, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description:
You immediately react to a spell being cast and compose a rune and gesture designed to unravel and negate the spellcraft of an enemy mage.

Playtest Notes

This action can now be used in playtesting, but it is not yet fully automated. The Counterspell can be performed, but it is up to the Gamemaster to manually reverse a previously applied spell and to manually deduct its Action and Focus cost. These steps of the overall Counterspell workflow will be automated in a subsequent update such that a confirmed Counterspell will also confirm the spell that was countered, but with its effects removed.
Counterspell.actiondesc:
You form arcane energy into a countervailing spellcraft, targeting a spellcaster you can see within 30 feet.

Designate a Rune and Gesture which you know to attempt to counter the spell. Choosing a Rune which is opposed to one used in the spell grants +2 Boons to your attempt. Selecting the identical Gesture as the one being cast also adds +2 Boons to your attempt.

Perform a harmless Spell Attack against your target's Willpower defense. If your roll exceeds their defense, the spell is countered and its magic is nullified, producing no effects.

Recognize Spellcraft.name: Recognize Spellcraft
Recognize Spellcraft.description: You can interpret the arcane incantations of others to discern the nature of their spellcraft. When an enemy within 40 feet that you can see and hear begins casting a spell, you can identify its Rune if you also know that Rune.

Padded Armor.name: Padded Armor
Padded Armor.descriptionpublic: Consisting of quilted layers of cloth stuffed with rags or wool, padded armor cushions the body against blunt force and serves as the foundation beneath heavier gear.

War Mage.name: War Mage
War Mage.description: Your spellcraft is honed as a weapon of war to thwart the incantations of other magi. You may ask the Gamemaster if you know a Rune capable of countering an enemy spell, even if you do not recognize the spell being cast. You gain +2 Boons to any Counterspell attempt.

Inflection: Quicken.name: Inflection: Quicken
Inflection: Quicken.description: Enhance a spell by hastening the speed with which it can be cast, at the expense of increased Focus. The Quicken inflection reduces the Action cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Focus cost by 1 in exchange.

Inflection: Push.name: Inflection: Push
Inflection: Push.description: Empower a spell to repel affected creatures away from the caster. Creatures affected by a spell with the Push inflection move 4 feet away from the spellcaster if that destination is unoccupied.

Gesture: Step.name: Gesture: Step
Gesture: Step.description:
You infuse runic power into a movement, crossing physical and spatial boundaries.

The Step gesture scales with Dexterity and allows you to move up to 20 feet in a straight line with width equal to your Size. It deals 2 Base Damage to targets along that line which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture does not require any free hands to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

The movement aspect of this talent is not yet automated and must be manually performed as a consequence of the spell.

Anachraenum Member.name: Anachraenum Member
Anachraenum Member.description:
You have full access to the Anachraenum's, Amaranthine Archives, training facilities, and equipment. You can spend one hour researching in the restricted section of Archives, allowing you to gain advantage on one Intelligence (History) or Intelligence (Arcana) check you make in the next 24 hours.

In addition, when you are within a dungeon or ruin, you gain +4 on initiative rolls, and you can use the environment to your advantage. If you are surprised, you can make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to act normally as if you were not surprised.

Rune: Flame.name: Rune: Flame
Rune: Flame.description:
The chaotic force of elemental, thermal energy. The Flame rune governs fire and heat.

The Flame rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Fire damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Frost.
Rune: Flame.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Flame allows you to manipulate fire and thermal energy in creative ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Manifest a burst of elemental flame in one inch sphere which can ignite a candle, torch, or other flammable materials.

  • Imbue your body with momentary thermal shielding which provides you with immunity to fire damage on an immediately subsequent action that costs 1 Action or less.

  • Control the movement of flames within a small area, causing them to flicker, dance, or shift in an animated performance of light and shadow.

Enkindle may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Lightning.name: Rune: Lightning
Rune: Lightning.description:
The chaotic force of raw electrical energy. The Lightning rune governs sources of electrical charge and discharge.

The Lightning rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Electrical damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Earth.
Rune: Lightning.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Lightning allows you to conduct the flow of both air and electricity, manipulating charge and aerodynamics to produce one of the following effects:

  • Instill an electromagnetic charge into a metallic object that you touch no larger than a one-foot cube, causing it to strongly adhere to other metals. Only one object can be charged in this way at a given time, casting this spell on a different object causes the prior object to lose its magnetic effect.

  • Gather a squall of wind at your current location in a six-foot radius which blows either as a gust in a single controlled direction or as a cyclone with centripetal force in all directions. Airborne effects in the immediate area are dispersed and unsecured objects with weight less than 1 are flung in the direction of the gust.

  • Produce the concussive sound of a thunderclap at a location you can see within 15 feet of your current position.

Energize may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Talisman Weapon Training.name: Talisman Weapon Training
Talisman Weapon Training.description: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft. You are Trained with weapons in the Talisman categories.
Talisman Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a Harmless Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a critical success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.

Sajor Velex.biographyprivate:
Sajor Velex grew up in Ordain under mysterious circumstances. She spent her childhood hearing about the adventures and exploits of her celebrated adventurer father from her mother, Lasslen Velex, but she never met him until news reached her that her father had died on an expedition when she was only twelve years old. She was trained as a wizard by her mother, and she excelled in the art, deciding early on that she would follow in her father's footsteps. Eventually, Sajor’s desire to explore and go on adventures led her to enter the Anachraenum as a trainee, where she found like-minded individuals to form a group called the Fulgerite Blades. The following year, her mother also died from an unexplained medical condition, and her death finally allowed Sajor to look through both of her parents' effects in thier family home. What she discovered was shocking: it turned out that her mother had no idea who her father was. She only knew that he was a Nir'ae she had met many years ago, and she had fabricated the stories and letters to Sajor in her youth. This caused a burning fury to grow inside Sajor, and she became utterly driven to uncover his identity.

Personality

Sajor is dour and contemplative; she slowly ruminates on issues and considers all of her options before acting. She is somewhat morally flexible and thoroughly self-interested in her desires to uncover the truth about her father, other Nir'ae, and the ancient Aedir, which she believes is connected to her father. Though she can appear mercenary in her dealings, she is loyal to her friends and party members. She is even caring and protective of her team. Combined with her quiet, careful leadership, she has earned unwavering loyalty from her team members.

Connections

Sajor has been a trainee in the Anachraenum for three years, and while she has yet to uncover anything of real note, she is determined to prove her worth as a Wayfinder and competent adventurer. She considers the upcoming Expedition Challenge to be a showcase where she can show the other guild members what she is made of, become a full member, and start researching restricted areas of the Amaranthine Archives.

Within her team of Fulgerite Blades, she is regarded as the most competent and formidable member. She is the team's arcana and magical specialist, and a highly skilled wizard. At first glance, she might not seem like an obvious choice for the team's leader, but she is ruthless and driven, fully believing in the philosophy that the ends justify the means.

Phrases

I will discover the truth about my father.

I couldn't care less about you, I am on my own path.

You are useful, therefore I will work with you, but you are merely a stepping stone.
Sajor Velex.biographypublic: Sajor Velex is the leader of the Fulgurite Blades a group of Anachraenum Trainees from Ordain. She is a skilled wizard and spellcaster, and she has a passion for investigating Aedir ruins.
Sajor Velex.biographyappearance: A bright-eyed woman stands before you with a curious expression, yet the corners of her mouth are turned downwards, as if she is slightly displeased with your presence. She has short black hair with a shock of white at the front, two large downwards-facing ears, and dark olive skin marked with vivid glittering patterns that signify she is either a descendant or a full Nir'ae herself.

Sadri Zhalimorne.name: Sadri Zhalimorne

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.descriptionpublic: Tthe shortsword is a straight-bladed weapon which is nimble to wield and quick to strike in close combat. It features a crossguard ideal for parrying incoming blows.

Councilor's Plastron.name: Councilor's Plastron
Councilor's Plastron.descriptionprivate: This item is presented as an amulet, but it can be any type of accessory like a ring, cloak, bracers, or other type of trinket.
Councilor's Plastron.descriptionpublic:
A graceful silver amulet embedded with blue jewels imbues you with a feeling of steadfastness while you clutch it, prepared to weather any challenge.

This amulet provides a bonus to Willpower defense equal to the minimum of its Quality and Enchantment bonuses.

  • Fine quality and Minor enchantment: +1 Willpower

  • Superior quality and Major enchantment: +2 Willpower

  • Masterwork quality and Legendary enchantment: +3 Willpower

Leather Armor.name: Leather Armor
Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Mnemonic Realization.name: Mnemonic Realization
Mnemonic Realization.description:
Your sharpened mind is full of secrets and techniques to remember them. Once per Day you may focus your thoughts and attempt to recall a word that sparks your memory.

The Gamemaster must provide you with a one-word clue that is appropriate for your direction of inquiry. It is left to Gamemaster discretion how direct or vague to be with the clue they provide.
Mnemonic Realization.actiondesc: You survey your memories attempting to recall a clue for your current situation.

Diversionist.name: Diversionist
Diversionist.description: You specialize in using subterfuge to distract or trick your opponent during combat.
Diversionist.actiondesc: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.

Provocateur.name: Provocateur
Provocateur.description: You specialize in barbed repartee crafted to highlight your opponent's shortcomings. In combat you can launch quips which provoke your foes.
Provocateur.actiondesc: You exaggerate your opponent's shortcomings with a scathing bon mot, performing a Diplomacy skill attack against your target's Willpower. On a success they suffer modest Psychic damage to Morale and become Enraged for 1 Round.

Altyra Lineage.name: Altyra Lineage
Altyra Lineage.description: You are immune to the Diseased condition which otherwise prevents you from regaining Health.
Altyra Lineage.actiondesc:
You can imbue yourself with the temporary visage and capabilities of Tyraphem, assuming an otherworldly visage. While transformed, you gain the following benefits.

  • You gain resistance to Radiant damage equal to 2 times your level.

  • Your attacks deal additional Radiant damage equal to half your Presence.

  • You gain +2 Boons to your use of the Intimidation skill.

You may end this transformation prior to its full duration on your turn at no cost.

Disarming Strike.name: Disarming Strike
Disarming Strike.description: A martial technique designed to disarm your opponent, forcing them to drop an object held in one of their hands.
Disarming Strike.actiondesc: You make a Strike against a the Reflex defense of a single target. The technique is Difficult to perform and deals reduced damage. If successful, the target's mainhand weapon is Dropped.

Feinting Strike.name: Feinting Strike
Feinting Strike.description: A two-weapon technique which makes a feint with your primary weapon, exposing your target for an off-hand attack.
Feinting Strike.actiondesc:
You feint with your mainhand weapon, making a Deception attack against the target's Reflex defense. You immediately make a Strike with your offhand weapon.

If your Deception was successful, you gain +2 Boons to your Strike and it deals an additional +6 Damage.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.descriptionpublic: Small, swift, and deadly, the dagger slips between ribs or into gaps in armor with ease, its wicked edge favored by assassins, thieves, and those who prefer a silent kill.

Sadri Zhalimorne.biographyprivate:
