The 61-year-old Arcturian Magistrate was born to Altyra parents in Ordain, and excelled in matters of school and friendship, where her determination, ambition, and outspoken nature led to her becoming a natural leader in her own social circles.

However, she would not spend her whole life in Ordain, and when her parents pulled up stakes and moved into the Golden Flats, Sadri was likewise dragged beyond the borders of the great city into the world at large.

Feeling stifled by small town life, Sadri pursued a career as a courier, which granted her the freedom to travel the Flats, meet new people, make connections, and recapture some of the unpredictable excitement living in a massive city provided.

Already keen in the ways of diplomacy and negotiation, Sadri turned her position as courier into one of mediation and trade negotiation for merchants and the Trading Houses. This gave her a taste of influence and allowed her to make sure people were treated fairly. While not everyone she dealt with appreciated her approach, she won some early friends in House Bastilla who appreciated her desire for fairness above opinion and existing sentiment.

As Sadri grew older and travel became less enticing she turned to politics proper, and settled in Helkas where she could look after her ailing parents and have a positive effect on the lives of working folk. These days, the headstrong Magistrate serves the people of Helkas alongside a modest town council of three other local leaders from the warm and welcoming offices of Council Hall.

Personality

Sadri is suitably kind and gregarious to a degree, but manages to pepper her conversations with a sardonic sense of humor that occasionally belies her inherent sense of duty.

She takes her position as Magistrate rather seriously, and is eager to continue serving the people and businesses of Helkas for decades to come. She believes that deals should be equitable, work should be duly repaid, and that nobody should suffer if a community has the means to prevent it. She's also not afraid to make that opinion known, especially if she thinks the people in power have forgotten.

She often snaps her fingers to accentuate a point of conversation.

Connections

An early alliance with @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrganizatio.JournalEntryPage.JOQCjyaSIPRhrEd6]{House Bastilla} of Ordain led to Sadri's involvement as one of the Trading House’s key representatives in the western reaches of the Plateau, and she remains an invaluable asset to the whole of Arcturian trade to this very day.

Phrases

Well met, and welcome to Helkas — the Plateau's window to the West!

As I always say [snaps fingers and points]: anything worth doing is worth doing however many times it takes to get it right.

Well, that's certainly an interesting way to go about things.
Sadri Zhalimorne.biographypublic: [[lookup @name]] is the ambitious Magistrate of Helkas, a prosperous mining town situated on the eastern edge of the Forest of Stone. A well-traveled lawmaker, she often wears a wry grin that reveals her gregarious nature with playfully sardonic flare.
Sadri Zhalimorne.biographyappearance: You regard a steel-skinned woman with luminous golden eyes and side-parted bob of short-cropped silver hair. Adorned in a brown sleeveless tunic with leather shorts and boots, her countenance is equal parts purposeful and amused, and you can’t help but notice the lambent lines of bright copper that decorate her legs. A beaded Arcturian plastron necklace hangs around her neck, proudly signifying some kind of social station.

Juro Wandren.name: Juro Wandren

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.descriptionpublic: Small, swift, and deadly, the dagger slips between ribs or into gaps in armor with ease, its wicked edge favored by assassins, thieves, and those who prefer a silent kill.

Wirrun Lineage.name: Wirrun Lineage
Wirrun Lineage.description:
You are immune to the effects of extreme cold. Your vision is not impaired by fog, mist, snow, or other atmospheric effects.

Alpha One: This vision effect is not yet automated.
Wirrun Lineage.actiondesc:
You designate one creature you can see as your quarry.

  • You gain +2 Boons to any Awareness or Wilderness roll which pertains to identifying its location.

  • When you move closer to your quarry on your turn, you gain +2 Boons on the next attack roll made against your quarry on that same turn.

Operator.name: Operator
Operator.description:
You have ice in your veins and remain cool under pressure. Your physical toughness and mental acuity allow you to hone the danger of your situation to achieve the greatest results when the stakes are highest.

While in combat and not Incapacitated, you gain +1 Boon to all checks when you have less than 50% of your maximum Health remaining. You gain +2 Boons to all checks when you have less than 25% of your maximum Health remaining.

Strategic Repositioning.name: Strategic Repositioning
Strategic Repositioning.description:
You are always thinking ahead about where to position yourself should danger loom. Before Turn 1 of a Combat encounter, provided that you are not Unaware, you may immediately move 4 feet in any permitted direction.

If multiple combatants have this feature, repositioning occurs in reverse order of Initiative.

Subtle Extrication.name: Subtle Extrication
Subtle Extrication.description: You understand how to move away from an opponent without exposing yourself to the worst attacks in return. Any Disengagement Attack against you is performed without the 2 Boons that would ordinarily apply to such an attack.

Weak Points.name: Weak Points
Weak Points.description: You identify moments of opportunity to strike at an enemy's weak points. When attacking a target that is Unaware, Flanked, or Exposed using Finesse weaponry, you gain +2 damage to any Strike.

Light Weapon Training.name: Light Weapon Training
Light Weapon Training.description: You know how to wield light weapons fluidly with a high degree of maneuverability and grace in combat. You are Trained with all weapons in the Light and Balanced categories.
Light Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You dart forward nimbly, making a strike with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a Finesse weapon against a single target with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is Difficult, but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke Disengagement.

Studded Leather Armor.name: Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: A base of leather reinforced with small metal studs or riveted plates, this armor strikes a balance between mobility and modest protection against slashes.

Ring of Gliding.name: Ring of Gliding
Ring of Gliding.descriptionprivate: This item is presented as a ring, but it can be any type of accessory like an amulet, cloak, bracers, or other type of trinket.
Ring of Gliding.descriptionpublic:
A band of elegant pale blue steel that features a spiraling pattern to the metal that presents the illusion that it is perpetually spinning slowly upon its wearer's finger.

This ring can be instinctually activated by its bearer when in freefall to enter a graceful and controlled descent.
Ring of Gliding.actiondesc:
If used while Falling, you may laterally move a number of spaces from your initial location as you glide.

  • Minor enchantment: 1 foot per 20 feet of descent.

  • Superior enchantment: 2 feet per 20 feet of descent.

  • Masterwork enchantment: 4 feet per 20 feet of descent.

You take no falling damage upon landing, nor are you rendered @Condition[prone].

Poison Vial.name: Poison Vial
Poison Vial.descriptionpublic: This small vial contains murky liquid that is noticeably thicker than water. It emits a disconcerting scent that evokes a sense of wrongness.
actiondesc:
When this toxin is ingested or otherwise enters the bloodstream of a creature, it is initially Harmless, but the target must defend an attack against its Fortitude or become @Condition[poisoned].

The amount of poison damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[name]:

  • Shoddy - 2 damage for 4 rounds

  • Standard - 4 damage for 6 rounds

  • Fine - 6 damage for 8 rounds

  • Superior - 8 damage for 10 rounds

  • Masterwork - 10 damage for 12 rounds

This action should be used when the poison is ingested rather than when it is first applied.

The contents of this vial can be added to food, drink, smeared upon a bladed weapon, or combined with some alternative delivery mechanism.

This action, which consumes the available usage of the poison, should be used when it is first applied.

Antitoxin.name: Antitoxin
Antitoxin.descriptionpublic: A slender phial that contains a slightly golden-colored liquid. It smells foul, but contains the alchemical agents necessary to neutralize a wide variety of toxins.
Antitoxin.actiondesc:
Consuming this @ref[name] is able to neutralize any @Condition[poisoned] conditions affecting the target. Stronger poisons require a stronger antitoxin to neutralize.

The category of poison negated by this @ref[name] depends on its quality:

  • Shoddy - Poisons dealing 3 damage or less per round

  • Standard - Poisons dealing 5 damage or less per round

  • Fine - Poisons dealing 7 damage or less per round

  • Superior - Poisons dealing 9 damage or less per round

  • Masterwork - Poisons dealing 11 damage or less per round

Lockpicks.name: Lockpicks
Lockpicks.descriptionpublic: A set of long thin metal pins with slightly hooked ends designed to manipulate the internal mechanisms of locks and a metal bar for applying torsion. In the right hands, these can be used to open locks just as well as any key.

Grapnel.name: Grapnel
Grapnel.descriptionpublic: A simple steel two-pronged or four-pronged hook designed to be used with rope or chain to secure a rope to wooden structures.

Rope Ladder.name: Rope Ladder
Rope Ladder.descriptionpublic: 25 feet of wooden slats and knotted rope tied together and rolled into a convenient climbing device. When secured at one end significantly reduces the chances that those climbing might fall.

Poisoner's Toolkit.name: Poisoner's Toolkit
Poisoner's Toolkit.descriptionpublic: A wooden box wrapped in leather etched with a decorative cross-stitch to make it clear it contains dangerous goods. Contains a stone mortar and pestle spaces for securing several stoppered vials of poisonous ingredients, a silver spoon, and a small collapsible iron frame and small brass pot for combining ingredients above a fire.

Preternatural Instinct.name: Preternatural Instinct
Preternatural Instinct.description: Your quickness of mind and body are equally impressive. You gain +2 Boons to all Initiative checks.

Backstab.name: Backstab
Backstab.description: You focus your cunning instincts on exploiting the weak points of a flanked target. You identify an opportunity and strike with deadly efficiency.
Backstab.actiondesc: You Strike with your mainhand weapon against a Flanked target, dealing Deadly damage.

Impetus.name: Impetus
Impetus.description: You are gifted at exploiting the slowness with which others think. If you are first in Initiative order during a round of Combat, you gain +1 current and maximum Action.

Strike First.name: Strike First
Strike First.description: Shoot first, ask questions later. You gain +1 Boon on any Strike or Spell attack against an enemy whose initiative score is lower than your own.

Dual Wield.name: Dual Wield
Dual Wield.description: You are adept at fighting with two weapons simultaneously. You can weave attacks together to strike more rapidly than possible with a single weapon.
Dual Wield.actiondesc: Immediately after you perform a basic Strike with your mainhand weapon, you make a reduced-cost fullow-up Strike with your offhand weapon.

Athletics Novice.name: Athletics Novice
Athletics Novice.description:
You have received training in basic athletics. You gain the Novice rank in the Athletics skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know whether a surface can support your weight or not, how to find handholds while climbing, and how to distribute your weight for buoyancy when swimming. You know how to run for distance, and how to pace yourself to avoid exhaustion.

Juro Wandren.biographyprivate:
Juro Wandren believes in knowing the value of things — what will last, what can be sold, what will be missed if it suddenly disappears. A smuggler (or, as he might put it, redistributor of excess goods), he sees the world as if he were a merchant sizing up a cart full of goods, and he is always attracted to the hardest and most valuable baubles to walk away with. While some might claim that this is a very mercenary way of viewing the world, it has helped him become a successful businessman and helps him gauge the worthiness of those around him as partners, clients, and even friends.

Personality

While Juro's frank assessment of the worth of things can throw others off, it has also given him a reputation as an "honest liar." He may create trouble for others in the pursuit of his personal goals, but he is always willing to own up to it after the immediate danger is past, often with a wry use of humor. This can come off as flippant to some, and he sometimes uses it to stop others from seeing him as a threat, but it comes from a genuine belief that it is always better to be honest … once that honesty can no longer hurt you.

Connections

In recent years, Juro has become a bit of a loner, but in his younger days he spent time with other young people associated with the Trading Houses, a group he often jokingly called the Houselings. He was particularly close with Lyla Cevher for a time, but when one of his early smuggling operations disrupted her attempts to prove a new method of trade to her father, and he jokingly admitted it to her without apologizing, she wrote him off. While he would likely never admit it, this hurt him enough that he began looking for a new base of operations where he wouldn't be hampered by close ties and eventually settled in Nain. This has put him somewhat on the outside of the Wandren trading house, but his own business is successful enough that he doesn't much care.

Phrases

I would never stab you in the back. The front, on the other hand…

What's that worth to you again?

That cost is a little too high for me, friend. Good luck when the bill comes due.
Juro Wandren.biographypublic: Juro Wandren is a self-starter, a businessman who trades goods throughout the Arctus Plateau. If the majority of those goods are illicit, so be it. Juro tends to think of rules as suggestions and barriers as challenges, which has helped him get to his current position as the face of one of the fastest growing independent smuggler networks on the Golden Flats. Honest to a fault after he's gotten what he wants, he's considered by many to be an "honest liar" whose charm can sometimes make up for the underhandedness of whatever his current scheme might be.
Juro Wandren.biographyappearance: Though he maintains a pleasant smile, with an expression that appears calculated to seem warm, the tall lanky wirrun is unmistakeably sizing up everyone and everything nearby, letting his gaze brush past any potential items of value before focusing on whatever is directly in front of him. As he finishes his appraisal, he smiles more brightly, though whether that's because it's met his expectations or not is hard to tell.

Issa Sunsword.name: Issa Sunsword

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
[[lookup @name]] is a [[lookup @attributes.spell.level]]st level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]], +[[lookup @attributes.spell.attack]] to hit with spell attacks).

[[lookup @name]] knows and has prepared the spells presented on the Spells tab of her character sheet. She automatically satisfies the material component requirements to cast these spells, if any.

Lantyr's Blade.name: Lantyr's Blade
Lantyr's Blade.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]] or [[/damage twoHanded average]] damage if used with two hands.

Able to be wielded in one hand or two, this longsword seems to gleam with light as it slices through the air, and the cuts it leaves behind glow ever-faintly for a moment, as if light has been seared into the wound.

Ember Blaze.name: Ember Blaze
Ember Blaze.description: When [[lookup @name]] is reduced to 0 hit points, he rolls a d20. On a 16 or higher, [[lookup @name]] instead drops to 1 hit point, and it can immediately take an action. Until the end of its next turn, his Speed increases by 10 feet, and he has advantage on weapon attack rolls and spell attack rolls.

Abyssal Sensitivity.name: Abyssal Sensitivity
Abyssal Sensitivity.description:
When [[lookup @name]] takes necrotic damage, she makes a [[/save cha format=long]] with DC equal to either 10 or half the total necrotic damage taken - whichever value is greater.

  • On a success, apply the Abyssal Resistance effect, gaining resistance to necrotic damage until the end of your next long rest.

  • On a failure, apply the Abyssal Susceptibility effect, inflicting vulnerability to necrotic damage until the end of your next long rest. Each time you take additional necrotic damage you may repeat the saving throw, ending this effect immediately on a success.

This check is not repeated while either Abyssal Resistance or Abyssal Sensitivity are active.

Light.name: Light
Light.description:
You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.

Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

Guidance.name: Guidance
Guidance.description: You touch a willing creature and choose a skill. Until the spell ends, the creature adds 1d4 to any ability check using the chosen skill.

Sacred Flame.name: Sacred Flame
Sacred Flame.description:
Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this save.

Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Cure Wounds.name: Cure Wounds
Cure Wounds.description:
A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

Detect Evil and Good.name: Detect Evil and Good
Detect Evil and Good.description:
For the duration, you sense the location of any Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead within 30 feet of yourself. You also sense whether the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHallow0000]{Hallow} spell is active there and, if so, where.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Divine Favor.name: Divine Favor
Divine Favor.description: Until the spell ends, your attacks with weapons deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit.

Issa Sunsword.biographyprivate:
Issa is usually on the road, and usually alone, often fighting against the evils and monsters in places that do not know what she's done or even that she's done it. As a way to combat any loneliness she feels, she has a number of rituals and routines that keep her going, including collecting sand from as many places as she can, which she mixes with sand she carried from Kessia's Obsidian Desert to remind herself that anywhere she goes can be home.

Personality

While she has always been willing to put her own comfort and safety on the line for the things she believes in, Issa once aspired to be a renowned priestess, hoping to hear her name carried on the winds of the Obsidian Desert. However, after being stranded in the desert due to an act of ambition and barely surviving under Lantyr's scorching rays, she recognized another path—not one of glory, but of selfless deeds and small acts against darkness and corruption. Over time, these journeys have taken her further and further away, many miles from the home she once knew. Although she feels lonely at times, she finds comfort in knowing that she is a messenger from Lantyr, and that light and warmth will reach even those who do not ask for it, while monsters have nowhere to hide.

Connections

Issa is usually alone, but once she was one of many. She let her bravery and ambition drive her early years, using her knack for sandsailing to become one of the youngest-ever Torchbearer Acolytes and travel the desert fighting the monsters and aberrations that lurked in Kessia's deep desert sands. After becoming stranded in the Obsidian Desert due to her own foolhardiness, she left the group, but always speaks well of them, thinking of them as yet another expression of Lantyr's light. On days when she thinks she will never see any of them again, she takes comfort that Lantyr shines on them all the same.

Phrases

May the light of Lantyr shine on you.

Monsters get my blade. Lantyr knows my heart.
Issa Sunsword.biographypublic:
At first glance, the gleam of golden armor is almost the only thing visible, catching even the faintest nearby rays and seemingly multiplying them. The woman beneath the armor is less ostentatious, standing at ease with a hand on her sword hilt, her expression conveying readiness for whatever dangers may approach her.

A paladin of Lantyr, Issa Sunsword has traveled across the ocean from her homeland of Kessia, following signs of corruption and striving to eradicate it wherever it has taken hold. Although she once aspired to be a renowned chosen priestess of Lantyr in her homeland, she now believes her true calling lies in a solitary life as a traveling paladin, helping those she may meet only once or not at all by sharing the Sunalin belief in worshiping Lantyr and ridding the land of monstrous threats.

Luna Karrowrath.name: Luna Karrowrath

Superior Lunaran Plate.name: Superior Lunaran Plate
Superior Lunaran Plate.descriptionpublic: The pinnacle of personal protection, plate mail encases the body in carefully fitted steel plates, offering near-complete protection while allowing impressive mobility for a trained wearer.

Superior Great Hammer.name: Superior Great Hammer
Superior Great Hammer.descriptionpublic: This two-handed behemoth features a massive head of iron or stone, used to crush armor, bone, and will alike with every thunderous blow.

Javelin.name: Javelin
Javelin.descriptionpublic: With a sharp metal head mounted atop a long pole, the javelin is light enough to be thrown but sturdy enough to remain useful in close quarters.

Fej Lineage.name: Fej Lineage
Fej Lineage.description: Your Ancestry's resistance to Fire damage is further increased by your character Level. If you are submersed in water for longer than 6 seconds or begin your turn submersed in water you must test your resolve using the Water Aversion action.
actiondesc:
You activate your fiery metabolism to engage a burst of supernatural speed.

  • Your Stride increases by +2.

  • You gain a bonus to Dodge equal to half your Dexterity.

  • You gain +1 to both your current and maximum Action.

When submersed in water for longer than 6 seconds, or when you begin your turn submersed in water, you must test your own resolve.

ALPHA ONE: This action needs further balancing.

Justiciar.name: Justiciar
Justiciar.description: You are an instrument of justice. Critical Strike attacks also deal the Overflow portion of damage to enemy Morale.

Heavy Weapon Training.name: Heavy Weapon Training
Heavy Weapon Training.description: You know how to use a heavy weapon to deliver punishing blows, putting your entire strength behind every swing. You are Trained with all weapons in the Heavy and Balanced categories.
Heavy Weapon Training.actiondesc: You unleash a powerful Strike with your mainhand weapon. The attack is slower to execute, but is Empowered to deliver additional damage.

Heavy Weapon Proficiency.name: Heavy Weapon Proficiency
Heavy Weapon Proficiency.description: You have a fluent education in the use of martial weaponry. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Simple, Heavy, and Balanced categories.

Zealous Smite.name: Zealous Smite
Zealous Smite.description: You can imbue righteous power into your blow with a heavy weapon.
Zealous Smite.actiondesc: You Strike using a Strength-based weapon. The attack becomes Deadly and any damage dealt is Radiant.

Vow of Animus.name: Vow of Animus
Vow of Animus.description: You swear a vow to destroy a specific character or creature. You gain +2 Boons to Strike or Spell attacks against to subject of your vow. You may only swear such a vow against one enemy at a time. Swearing a new vow relinquishes your prior vow.
Vow of Animus.actiondesc: You vow to vanquish a specific foe who becomes the subject of your animus.

Uppercut.name: Uppercut
Uppercut.description: A two-handed weapon technique where you swing your weapon upwards, making a second Strike with the backswing of your weapon.
Uppercut.actiondesc: Following a basic Strike attack which did not critically miss, you Strike the same target again with the backswing of your weapon at reduced Action cost.

Seasoned Veteran.name: Seasoned Veteran
Seasoned Veteran.description: You battlefield experience makes you accustomed to engaging multiple foes. Your Engagement increases by +1, allowing you to simultaneously engage more adjacent foes.

Rune: Flame.name: Rune: Flame
Rune: Flame.description:
The chaotic force of elemental, thermal energy. The Flame rune governs fire and heat.

The Flame rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Fire damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Frost.
Rune: Flame.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Flame allows you to manipulate fire and thermal energy in creative ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Manifest a burst of elemental flame in one inch sphere which can ignite a candle, torch, or other flammable materials.

  • Imbue your body with momentary thermal shielding which provides you with immunity to fire damage on an immediately subsequent action that costs 1 Action or less.

  • Control the movement of flames within a small area, causing them to flicker, dance, or shift in an animated performance of light and shadow.

Enkindle may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Flame Proficiency.name: Flame Proficiency
Flame Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Flame. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Enkindle action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Gesture: Strike.name: Gesture: Strike
Gesture: Strike.description:
You empower a direct close-range attack with the arcane essence of a Rune, performing a Strike with your equipped weapon.

The Strike gesture scales using Strength and deal damage based on your used weapon but with the damage type of the incorporated Rune. This gesture does not require any free hand and has a base cost of 1 Focus in addition to the cost of your weapon Strike.

Torch.name: Torch
Torch.descriptionpublic: Able to be used as either a light source or as an improvised weapon, a torch can illuminate dark places and ward off the foes that lurk there.

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Rallying Elixir.name: Rallying Elixir
Rallying Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly fortify the psyche and improve morale.
Rallying Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Morale dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Morale.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Morale.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Morale.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Morale.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Morale.

Superior Ring of Reinforcement.name: Superior Ring of Reinforcement
Superior Ring of Reinforcement.descriptionprivate: This item is presented as a ring, but it can be any type of accessory like an amulet, cloak, bracers, or other type of trinket.
Superior Ring of Reinforcement.descriptionpublic:
This steel ring feels permanently cool to the touch and gives the sensation of weighing more than expected given its narrow band.

This ring provides a bonus to Armor defense equal to the minimum of its Quality and Enchantment bonuses.

  • Fine quality and Minor enchantment: +1 Armor

  • Superior quality and Major enchantment: +2 Armor

  • Masterwork quality and Legendary enchantment: +3 Armor

Inexorable Flame.name: Inexorable Flame
Inexorable Flame.description: You recognize that fire can spread with inevitable and unstoppable purpose. Your usage of the Rune of Flame scales with Wisdom instead of Intellect.

Luna Karrowrath.biographyprivate:
Luna was born in the city of Ash during a long period of peace. Like everyone else in her homeland, she joined the Flameguard and spent her year in training and preparation for a war that didn't seem to be coming. As the years went on, it looked more and more likely that that Luna would be able to live a life free of war. So, like many around her, she began planning out that life: she pursued a career as a dancer, got engaged to the love of her life, and watched her city flourish in a period of unprecedented peace.

This peace would not last, however, and soon Luna saw her city come under siege by an endless horde of undead directed by Kindard Valax the Blood Baron of Kel'shen. His forces were relentless, and after decades of pieace the city was not prepared. Its walls quickly fell, and soon the streets were flooded with death.

Luna fought bravely, as all members of the Flameguard did, but in the chaos she watched her family and fiancé perish, unable to protect them. Eventually she and a handful of defenders found themselves cornered, facing down Kindard Valax himself, who promised the defenders the most agonizing death he could muster.

Luna, defiant, having lost all she had, and seeing her own loved ones in the crowd of undead following Valax, swore to slay him where he stood, to make him pay for what he did to her and her city. As she made this declaration the fire of Lumé flooded her, and the goddess made a single promise: "You will know victory this day, as my champion."

From that point onward Luna has carried the power of her god, and has turned countless battles against the legions of the dead. It has been eight years these events, and yet the scars are still fresh. As of late, she has taken to wandering the world, rooting out sources of undead before they can fully take root.

Personality

Luna is intense, focused, and an absolute zealot when it comes to her service to Lumé. There is no higher cause, no greater duty than this in her eyes. since her hatred for the undead knows no bounds, and she lost all else she cared about, she gladly throws herself into this cause.

Luna remains haunted by the visions of her family's deaths, seeing them marching with the undead, and having to cut them down during the fighting. She has not gotten over the death of her fiancé, and often has nightmares of his death and undeath.

Beyond this haunted intensity, beyond her duty to her goddess, Luna tries to find ways to live despite her pain. She enjoys drawing, and dancing, and takes any chance she gets to cast off her armor and wear clothing of bright, flowing materials.

At times, this feels performative, and fills her with guilt, like she shouldn't allowed to enjoy these things anymore without her loved ones. Survivor's guilt is something she may never be able to get past, but she is trying.

Connections

Luna is a celebrated warrior of the Lumek people, and more than that, a chosen Champion of Lumé directly. They have considerable influence and clout in their homeland as a result. She is nothing less than a hero, and enjoys the authority of a militia Captain, often being granted platoons of soldiers to fight alongside her.

Phrases

The flame of Lumé will light the way to victory. With the fire of Lumé in my heart I will never know defeat.

Death should be the end of suffering, but the Blood Barons cannot even let us have that.

I do not enjoy war, but I do enjoy destroying the undead, and will fight so that others may live.
Luna Karrowrath.biographypublic: Luna Karrowrath is a legend among the Lumek. During the last great siege on the city of Ash, she slew Kindard Valax, the Blood Baron of Kel’shen, and prevented the city from completely falling to the endless legion of the dead. She is the current Champion of Lumé.
Luna Karrowrath.biographyappearance: Clad in battle scarred Lunaran steel armor covered in the symbols of the Flameguard and the goddess Lumé, this Fej warrior has been through countless battles, and her intense, haunted gaze only reinforces this. She carries herself with an uncharacteristic grace for someone so heavily armored. Even the immense mace strapped to her back doesn't seem to slow her down.

Kalasak the Cutter.name: Kalasak the Cutter

Fatal Contingency.name: Fatal Contingency
Fatal Contingency.description:
When @ref[actor.name] dies, suspended magic is unleashed that causes their mouth and throat to erupt with a powerful corrosive, eating away both and leaving nothing behind but a rancid slurry of blood and flesh.

The damage is precise and intended to make it impossible to question the corpse after defeat.
Fatal Contingency.actiondesc: @ref[actor.name]'s mouth begins to foam and hiss, emitting a noxious smell as acid rapidly corrodes their mouth and throat.

Drakon Lineage.name: Drakon Lineage
Drakon Lineage.description:
You are extraordinarily resistant to the influence of Necromancy and death magic. Spells using the Rune of Death have +2 Banes to their spell attack rolls against you.

You instinctually know the Rune of Flame and can use it for basic spellcraft.
Drakon Lineage.actiondesc:
During moments of great duress, you can harness this power to expel flame in a cone, searing all creatures in your path. You expel draconic flame in a conical area.

This Deadly attack scales using your Toughness and targets the Reflex defense of affected creatures. This action counts as a Natural weapon with which the Drakon is, at least, trained.

Kalasak's Cutter.name: Kalasak's Cutter
Kalasak's Cutter.descriptionpublic: A uniquely sharp scalpel with a narrow, smooth channel cut into it for the easy application of toxins.

Poisoner's Toolkit.name: Poisoner's Toolkit
Poisoner's Toolkit.descriptionpublic: A wooden box wrapped in leather etched with a decorative cross-stitch to make it clear it contains dangerous goods. Contains a stone mortar and pestle spaces for securing several stoppered vials of poisonous ingredients, a silver spoon, and a small collapsible iron frame and small brass pot for combining ingredients above a fire.

Chirurgeon's Toolkit.name: Chirurgeon's Toolkit
Chirurgeon's Toolkit.descriptionpublic: A leather-bound wooden kitbag. Contains a razor, handsaw, pliers, bandages, a bottle of alchemical spirits, needle and thread, and a four inch wooden branch wrapped in leather. Everything one might need to perform amputations or excisions.

Rallying Elixir.name: Rallying Elixir
Rallying Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly fortify the psyche and improve morale.
Rallying Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Morale dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Morale.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Morale.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Morale.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Morale.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Morale.

Poison Vial.name: Poison Vial
Poison Vial.descriptionpublic: This small vial contains murky liquid that is noticeably thicker than water. It emits a disconcerting scent that evokes a sense of wrongness.
actiondesc:
When this toxin is ingested or otherwise enters the bloodstream of a creature, it is initially Harmless, but the target must defend an attack against its Fortitude or become @Condition[poisoned].

The amount of poison damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[name]:

  • Shoddy - 2 damage for 4 rounds

  • Standard - 4 damage for 6 rounds

  • Fine - 6 damage for 8 rounds

  • Superior - 8 damage for 10 rounds

  • Masterwork - 10 damage for 12 rounds

This action should be used when the poison is ingested rather than when it is first applied.

The contents of this vial can be added to food, drink, smeared upon a bladed weapon, or combined with some alternative delivery mechanism.

This action, which consumes the available usage of the poison, should be used when it is first applied.

Antitoxin.name: Antitoxin
Antitoxin.descriptionpublic: A slender phial that contains a slightly golden-colored liquid. It smells foul, but contains the alchemical agents necessary to neutralize a wide variety of toxins.
Antitoxin.actiondesc:
Consuming this @ref[name] is able to neutralize any @Condition[poisoned] conditions affecting the target. Stronger poisons require a stronger antitoxin to neutralize.

The category of poison negated by this @ref[name] depends on its quality:

  • Shoddy - Poisons dealing 3 damage or less per round

  • Standard - Poisons dealing 5 damage or less per round

  • Fine - Poisons dealing 7 damage or less per round

  • Superior - Poisons dealing 9 damage or less per round

  • Masterwork - Poisons dealing 11 damage or less per round

Chirurgeon.name: Chirurgeon
Chirurgeon.description: Your improvisational expertise with battlefield medicine can save many lives. You make all Medicine checks during combat with +1 Boon.
Chirurgeon.actiondesc:
You delve into your medical supplies, hastily combining whatever you might have available to salve the target's wounds or calm the target's mind. Perform a Medicine Check.

The attempt is contested by the higher of the target's Healing Threshold or Rallying Threshold. If successful the target immediately regains both Health and Morale as well as half that amount at the beginning of each of the subsequent 3 turns.

Light Weapon Training.name: Light Weapon Training
Light Weapon Training.description: You know how to wield light weapons fluidly with a high degree of maneuverability and grace in combat. You are Trained with all weapons in the Light and Balanced categories.
Light Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You dart forward nimbly, making a strike with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a Finesse weapon against a single target with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is Difficult, but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke Disengagement.

Light Weapon Proficiency.name: Light Weapon Proficiency
Light Weapon Proficiency.description: You have a fluent education in the use of martial weaponry. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Light and Balanced categories.

Alchemical Resolve.name: Alchemical Resolve
Alchemical Resolve.description: You rapidly apply alchemical vapours which instill your ally with supplemental bravery in the face of horror.
Alchemical Resolve.actiondesc: You rapidly bolster the Morale of an ally within 4 feet by applying vapours. Perform a Medicine check against the target's Madness Threshold. Successful checks restore Morale.

Combat Medicine.name: Combat Medicine
Combat Medicine.description: Your knowledge and skill in Medicine covers the rapid triage, diagnosis, and treatment of wounds.
Combat Medicine.actiondesc: You rapidly treat the wounds of an ally within 4 feet. Perform a Medicine Check against the target's Wounds Threshold. Your ally's Health is increased by the amount of the Roll in excess of the threshold.

Medicine Novice.name: Medicine Novice
Medicine Novice.description:
You have a basic education in anatomy, physiology, and medicine. You gain the Novice rank in the Medicine skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You’ve learned the basics of treating common wounds and illnesses, and keep a running list of known alchemical and herbal compounds that can be used for treating particular illnesses. With a little time studying an injured, diseased, or otherwise ill individual you can perform a basic diagnosis and treat accordingly.

Medicine Journeyman.name: Medicine Journeyman
Medicine Journeyman.description: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Medicine skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.

Paralytic Vial.name: Paralytic Vial
Paralytic Vial.descriptionpublic: This small vial contains an oily liquid that is noticeably thicker than water. It emits a an acrid scent that evokes a sense of wrongness.
actiondesc:
When this toxin is ingested or otherwise enters the bloodstream of a creature, it is initially Harmless, but the target must defend an attack against its Fortitude or become @Condition[paralyzed].

The duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[name]:

  • Shoddy - 1 rounds

  • Standard - 2 rounds

  • Fine - 4 rounds

  • Superior - 8 rounds

  • Masterwork - Indefinite

This action should be used when the poison is ingested rather than when it is first applied.

The contents of this vial can be added to food, drink, smeared upon a bladed weapon, or combined with some alternative delivery mechanism.

This action, which consumes the available usage of the poison, should be used when it is first applied.

Electrocharge Ampoule.name: Electrocharge Ampoule
Electrocharge Ampoule.descriptionprivate: Primarily used to power small electromechanical machines for short periods of time, these alchemical containers are somewhat unstable and react poorly when their contents are exposed to air, making them useful if unpredictable improvised explosives. If combined in a large enough quantity in the correct way, they can also be used to power more significant devices and discharge even more electrical energy.
Electrocharge Ampoule.descriptionpublic: A sealed glass tube filled with a yellow liquid explodes when it breaks open, creating a sudden electrical discharge.
Electrocharge Ampoule.actiondesc:
You throw the @ref[name], dealing weakened Electricity damage to all enemies in the radius of the discharge and leaving them briefly @Condition[staggered]. The radius of the Discharge depends on the quality of the bomb:

  • Shoddy - 3 feet

  • Standard - 4 feet

  • Fine - 6 feet

  • Superior - 8 feet

  • Masterwork - 10 feet

Frostdrop Phial.name: Frostdrop Phial
Frostdrop Phial.descriptionprivate: Primarily used to rapidly cool metallurgical compounds in advanced smithing, these alchemical phials can be quite dangerous to living tissue if exposed for a long period of time.
Frostdrop Phial.descriptionpublic: A suspension of white crystal inside a blue liquid contained within a sealed glass container. Its contents rapidly evaporate when exposed to air, creating a small blast of freezing liquid that coats nearby matter in an icy film.
Frostdrop Phial.actiondesc:
You throw the @ref[name], dealing weakened Cold damage to all enemies in the radius of the explosion and causing them to be @Condition[slowed] briefly. The radius of the Blast depends on the quality of the bomb:

  • Shoddy - 3 feet

  • Standard - 4 feet

  • Fine - 6 feet

  • Superior - 8 feet

  • Masterwork - 10 feet

Caustic Phial.name: Caustic Phial
Caustic Phial.descriptionpublic: Corrosive liquid swirls within this vial of intentionally thin glass, designed to shatter on impact and spill the caustic substance upon a target.
Caustic Phial.actiondesc:
You fling the @ref[name], dealing Weakened immediate damage but causing the @Condition[corroding] condition to all enemies in a 4 foot radius Blast who fail to avoid the attack.

The amount of burning damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[name]:

  • Shoddy - 2 damage for 2 rounds

  • Standard - 3 damage for 3 rounds

  • Fine - 4 damage for 4 rounds

  • Superior - 6 damage for 5 rounds

  • Masterwork - 8 damage for 6 rounds

Alchemist's Fire.name: Alchemist's Fire
Alchemist's Fire.descriptionpublic: A flammable concoction that ignites upon impact and burns intensely for a short time.
Alchemist's Fire.actiondesc:
You hurl the @ref[name], dealing Weakened immediate damage but causing the @Condition[burning] condition to all enemies in a 4 foot radius Blast who fail to avoid the attack.

The amount of burning damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[name]:

  • Shoddy - 2 damage for 2 rounds

  • Standard - 3 damage for 3 rounds

  • Fine - 4 damage for 4 rounds

  • Superior - 6 damage for 5 rounds

  • Masterwork - 8 damage for 6 rounds

Brigandine.name: Brigandine
Brigandine.descriptionpublic: A coat or vest of cloth or leather lined with small, riveted steel plates hidden inside, brigandine is favored by mercenaries and guards for its impressive mix of flexibility and solid defense.

Kalasak the Cutter.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

@ref[name] is a drakon that has repeatedly ingested and injected himself with experimental alchemical compounds in pursuit of physical enhancements. His ancestry allows him to test compounds that would usually be fatal to other humanoids, but it has had a profound effect on his body, turning his scales and horns a sickly green.

Once a healer, he fell down a rabbit-hole of research and dark curiosities that led him to abandon his creed of helping others and take up the cruel artistry of torture and vivisection. Eventually he joined with the Mutagists, and rapidly ascended up the ranks by proving willing to do what others refused to, whether that was dangerous alchemy or inhuman surgery.

Behavior

Kalasak doesn't care about anyone but himself, and only worries about the pursuit of knowledge, undertaking any means or methods necessary to make what he perceives to be an advancement. He is a highly skilled alchemist and healer, and rather than helping others, wields that knowledge toward the ends of advancing the mutagist cause, and by extension, his own pursuit of grim insights into the body.

Connections

Beyond the ranks of the Mutagists, Kalasak has no allies or friends, and has been exiled from any reputable or honorable institutions he once claimed membership to.

Phrases

If you won't tell me your secrets, I'll just cut them out of you!
Kalasak the Cutter.biographypublic: @ref[name] is a dangerous surgeon obsessed with injecting subjects with chemicals, and then cutting open their corpses (if they are lucky) to see what effects those compounds had on their victims.
Kalasak the Cutter.biographyappearance: Clad in stained apron and coat, they regard you coolly from behind goggles and mask which make it impossibly to discern anything about them. They turn a razor sharp scalpel in their hand, as their off-hand rests on a pouch containing several vials of undoubtedly dangerous compounds. The air around them is thick with the scent of medicine and blood.

Amalthea Stonecraft.name: Amalthea Stonecraft

Sealing Wax.name: Sealing Wax
Sealing Wax.descriptionprivate: A wax material of a seal which, after melting, hardens quickly forming a bond that is difficult to separate without noticeable tampering.

Oil Flask.name: Oil Flask
Oil Flask.description:
Oil usually comes in a clay flask that holds 1 pint. As an action, you can splash the oil in this flask onto a creature within 5 feet of you or throw it up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. Make a ranged attack against a target creature or object, treating the oil as an improvised weapon.

On a hit, the target is covered in oil. If the target takes any fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an additional 5 fire damage from the burning oil. You can also pour a flask of oil on the ground to cover a 5-foot-square area, provided that the surface is level.

If lit, the oil burns for 2 rounds and deals 5 fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn in the area. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Captivating Tale.name: Captivating Tale
Captivating Tale.description:
[[lookup @name]] orates a magical tale.

Wisdom Saving Throw: [[/save format=long]], each humanoid and giant within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=dnd5eactivity000]] feet of Amalthea that can hear the tale.

Failure: The creature has the &Reference[charmed] condition until the tale ends. While &Reference[charmed] in this way, the creature is &Reference[incapacitated] and has disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws against Amalthea and her allies. The creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Success: The creature is immune to Amalthea’s tale for 24 hours.

To keep the tale going, Amalthea must take a bonus action on each of its turns to continue orating, and she can stop orating at any time. The tale ends if Amalthea is &Reference[incapacitated].

Steadfast.name: Steadfast
Steadfast.description: [[lookup @name]] can't be frightened while she can see an allied creature within 30 feet of her.

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
[[lookup @name]] is a [[lookup @attributes.spell.level]]th level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]], +[[lookup @attributes.spell.attack]] to hit with spell attacks).

[[lookup @name]] knows and has prepared the spells presented on the Spells tab of her character sheet. She automatically satisfies the material component requirements to cast these spells, if any.

Well Practiced.name: Well Practiced
Well Practiced.description: [[lookup @name]] adds half her proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check she makes that doesn't already include her proficiency bonus.

Countercharm.name: Countercharm
Countercharm.description:
[[lookup @name]] can use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects. As an action, she can start a performance that lasts until the end of her next turn.

During that time, [[lookup @name]] and any friendly creatures within 30 feet of her have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed. A creature must be able to hear her to gain this benefit.

The performance ends early if she is incapacitated, silenced, or voluntarily ends it (no action required).

Rations.name: Rations
Rations.description: Rations consist of dry foods suitable for extended travel, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts.

Candle.name: Candle
Candle.description: For 1 hour, a candle sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet.

Lamp.name: Lamp
Lamp.description: A lamp casts bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Once lit, it burns for 6 hours on a flask (1 pint) of oil

Amalthea's Manuscript.name: Amalthea's Manuscript
Amalthea's Manuscript.descriptionprivate: A hand-written manuscript penned by the famed storyteller of Nain, Amalthea Stonecraft.
Amalthea's Manuscript.descriptionpublic: A hand-written manuscript penned by the famed storyteller of Nain, Amalthea Stonecraft.

Book of Arcturian Lore.name: Book of Arcturian Lore
Book of Arcturian Lore.descriptionprivate: A book containing historical accounts, information pertaining to a particular field of Arcturian lore, myth, or legend.
Book of Arcturian Lore.descriptionpublic: A book containing historical accounts, information pertaining to a particular field of Arcturian lore, myth, or legend.

Parchment.name: Parchment
Parchment.descriptionprivate: A single sheet of heavier parchment paper.

Ink Pen.name: Ink Pen
Ink Pen.descriptionprivate: A deviced used in combination with ink to write or draw on a sheet of paper.

Ink Bottle.name: Ink Bottle
Ink Bottle.descriptionprivate: A small bottle of ink for writing upon parchment.

Hourglass.name: Hourglass
Hourglass.descriptionprivate: A device used to measure the passage of time. It is comprised of two glass bulbs connected vertically by a narrow neck that allows a regulated trickle of sand from the upper bulb to the lower one.

Pouch.name: Pouch
Pouch.description: A cloth or leather pouch can hold up to 20 sling bullets or 50 blowgun needles, among other things. A compartmentalized pouch for holding spell components is called a component pouch. A pouch can hold up to ⅕ cubic foot or 6 pounds of gear.

Backpack.name: Backpack
Backpack.description: A backpack can hold one cubic foot or 30 pounds of gear. You can also strap items, such as a bedroll or a coil of rope, to the outside of a backpack.

Wayfarer's Staff.name: Wayfarer's Staff
Wayfarer's Staff.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]] or [[/damage twoHanded average]] damage if used with two hands.

The staff made of gnarled and knotted wood has 6 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: [[/item .b5OZ5DGNX8ctJb7q]]{Shillelagh} (1 charge), [[/item .uqijIkNcSnk8pr2N]]{Cure Wounds} (2 charges), or [[/item .Xllb5z7C97YpcwjG]]{Shield} (2 charges).

The staff regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff turns to dust and is destroyed.

Spellcasting Focus. An arcane focus is a special item designed to channel the power of arcane spells. A sorcerer, warlock, or wizard can use such an item as a spellcasting focus, using it in place of any material component that does not list a cost
Wayfarer's Staff.descriptionpublic: A staff made of gnarled and knotted wood.

Leadership.name: Leadership
Leadership.description: For 1 minute, whenever a nonhostile creature [[lookup @name]] can see within 30 feet of them makes an attack roll or a saving throw, the creature can add 1d4 to the roll if it can hear and understand [[lookup @name]]. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if [[lookup @name]] has the incapacitated condition.

Song of Rest.name: Song of Rest
Song of Rest.description:
[[lookup @name]] can use soothing music or oration to help revitalize her wounded allies during a short rest.

If [[lookup @name]] or any friendly creatures who can hear her performance regain hit points at the end of the short rest by spending one or more Hit Dice, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d8 hit points.

Mage Hand.name: Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

Prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
You create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time.

Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.

Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot.

Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.

Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour.

Minor Creation. You create a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.

Vicious Mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
Vicious Mockery.description:
You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at one creature you can see or hear within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d6 Psychic damage and have Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

Bane.name: Bane
Bane.description:
Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must each make a Charisma saving throw. Whenever a target that fails this save makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must subtract 1d4 from the attack roll or save.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

Charm Person.name: Charm Person
Charm Person.description:
One Humanoid you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. It does so with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the &Reference[charmed apply=false] condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The Charmed creature is Friendly to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

Comprehend Languages.name: Comprehend Languages
Comprehend Languages.description: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any language that you hear or see signed. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text. This spell doesn't decode symbols or secret messages.

Disguise Self.name: Disguise Self
Disguise Self.description:
You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the spell ends. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.

The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing.

To discern that you are disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on an [[/check ability=int skill=inv dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC.

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.

Calm Emotions.name: Calm Emotions
Calm Emotions.description:
Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects (choose for each creature):

  • The creature has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the spell ends. If the creature was already Charmed or Frightened, those conditions are suppressed for the duration.
  • The creature becomes Indifferent about creatures of your choice that it's Hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target takes damage or witnesses its allies taking damage. When the spell ends, the creature's attitude returns to normal.

Detect Thoughts.name: Detect Thoughts
Detect Thoughts.description:
You activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns.

Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don't read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target's mind right now. If the target doesn't know any languages and isn't telepathic, you learn nothing.

As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target's mind. If you probe deeper, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you discern the target's reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind (such as a worry, love, or hate). On a successful save, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target's mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an [[/check ability=int skill=arc dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.

Silence.name: Silence
Silence.description: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the Sphere has Immunity to Thunder damage, and creatures have the &Reference[deafened apply=false] condition while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a Verbal component is impossible there.

Beacon of Hope.name: Beacon of Hope
Beacon of Hope.description: Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws and regains the maximum number of Hit Points possible from any healing.

Dispel Magic.name: Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You automatically end a spell on the target if the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you use.

Hypnotic Pattern.name: Hypnotic Pattern
Hypnotic Pattern.description:
You create a twisting pattern of colors in a 30-foot Cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who can see the pattern must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[charmed apply=false] condition for the duration. While Charmed, the creature has the &Reference[incapacitated apply=false] condition and a Speed of 0.

The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

Tongues.name: Tongues
Tongues.description: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken or signed language that it hears or sees. Moreover, when the target communicates by speaking or signing, any creature that knows at least one language can understand it if that creature can hear the speech or see the signing.

Freedom of Movement.name: Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description:
You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by &Reference[DifficultTerrain], and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's Speed nor cause the target to have the &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] or &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions. The target also has a Swim Speed equal to its Speed.

In addition, the target can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature imposing the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition on it.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

Greater Invisibility.name: Greater Invisibility
Greater Invisibility.description: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends.

Locate Creature.name: Locate Creature
Locate Creature.description:
Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature's location if that creature is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you know the direction of its movement.

The spell can locate a specific creature known to you or the nearest creature of a specific kind (such as a human or a unicorn) if you have seen such a creature up close—within 30 feet—at least once. If the creature you described or named is in a different form, such as under the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFleshtoSto]{Flesh to Stone} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPolymorph0]{Polymorph} spell, this spell doesn't locate the creature.

This spell can't locate a creature if any thickness of lead blocks a direct path between you and the creature.

Legend Lore.name: Legend Lore
Legend Lore.description:
Name or describe a famous person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about that famous thing, as described by the DM.

The lore might consist of important details, amusing revelations, or even secret lore that has never been widely known. The more information you already know about the thing, the more precise and detailed the information you receive is. That information is accurate but might be couched in figurative language or poetry, as determined by the DM.

If the famous thing you chose isn't actually famous, you hear sad musical notes played on a trombone, and the spell fails.

Bardic Inspiration.name: Bardic Inspiration
Bardic Inspiration.description: One creature other than [[lookup @name]] within 60 feet that can hear [[lookup @name]] gains one Bardic Inspiration die (d6). Within the next hour, that creature can roll the die and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes. The creature can wait until after rolling the d20 before deciding to use the die, but must decide before the GM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

Shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
Shillelagh.description:
A Club or Quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes a d8. If the attack deals damage, it can be Force damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).

The spell ends early if you cast it again or if you let go of the weapon.

Cantrip Upgrade. The damage die changes when you reach levels 5 (d10), 11 (d12), and 17 (2d6).

Cure Wounds.name: Cure Wounds
Cure Wounds.description:
A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.description: An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}.

Amalthea Stonecraft.biographyprivate:
[[emberCharacterDetails]]

[[lookup @name]] is a world-famous storyteller with countless tales in her pocket, gathered during three-and-a-half centuries of life on the Arctus Plateau. Indeed, although she appears to be an octogenarian in her golden years, Amalthea has lived for 325 annual cycles on Ember. In addition to her avian feathers and lunar birthmarks, Amalthea's esoteric Aster abilities manifest in a form of immortality by way of reincarnation every 80 years via a younger, 5-year-old version of herself. Thus, Amalthea is nearing the end of her fourth life cycle as an Aster; a reincarnation heralded with a special rite, and powered by the innate magic of Ember via Amalthea's storytelling.

From her curio-cluttered home in Nain, Amalthea inspires and emboldens the people of the Arctus Plateau with her enchanted narratives. Verily, there are many who maintain that Amalthea's stories are life-changing affairs, and will travel from far afield just to hear her read one aloud. Little do most of them know, Amalthea's latest book of tales will be this cycle's last; and the famed storyteller actually seeks a group of skilled raconteurs who may help her weave this opus into the necessary rites to be born anew once more.

Personality

Amalthea is warm-hearted and curious. Despite her relative fame, she maintains an intimate sense of humility, and is eager to pass on her knowledge to others. She recognizes the roles of audience and storyteller with equal parts mirth and reverence, and believes in the potential kindness of strangers. She wears her many years with an air of comfort, and speaks with a low, raspy voice that only accentuates her love of all things mysterious and fantastical.

Connections

As the Arctus Plateau's preeminent storyteller, Amalthea has established a wide array of personal relationships and influential contacts throughout her half-dozen previous incarnations. Indeed, several lifetimes have afforded the Arcturian bard more opportunities than most to establish meaningful connections and put down lasting roots.

Some of her closest allies include Arcos Sarinland of the Anachraenum, the wandering minstrel Larka Hex, and the esteemed scholar Darius Cevher — although the list of hopeful bards and curious academics who seek her counsel is respectably long.

Phrases

Everyone's story deserves to be told.

My dear, I've lived long enough to know that what you speak is only part of the truth.

The future is unwritten. Pen your own fate, lest the world scribe it for you.
Amalthea Stonecraft.biographypublic:
A wizened woman dressed in loose-fitting Arcturian garb stands before you, her elderly hands perched upon a knotted walking stick. You spy a pair of feathered wings on her stooped back, as brilliant and violet as any amythest, draped beneath the folds of a stitched brown apron. Similar quills line her forearms, and a ruffle of smaller feathers around her neck serves as an ersatz collar.

A plume of purple feathers sits upon her aged head like a posh hat, capturing a fashionable kind of folk sensibility, which she wears with grace and aplomb. Her smile is as bright as the dawn, and her wrinkled eyes regard the world with a warm and perpetual interest.

[[lookup @name]] is an 85-year old Aster bard famed for being one of the Arctus Plateau's most accomplished storytellers and historians of local legends. Amalthea's Human physiology is complemented by a pair of feathered wings and colorful purple plumage, along with an array of birthmarks on her aged skin that evoke the esoteric imagery of Ember's moons. If there is a good story to tell, Amalthea has most certainly told it, or so they say.

Svala Bronwen.name: Svala Bronwen

Svala's Battleaxe.name: Svala's Battleaxe
Svala's Battleaxe.descriptionpublic: A stout double crescent blade mounted on a thick shaft wrapped in a sturdy grip. This axe is large enough to be wielded with two hands and is balanced for a Vrjnhar's frame.

Round Shield.name: Round Shield
Round Shield.descriptionpublic: A round metal shield nearly two feet in diameter which is the basic defensive armament of foot soldiers lacking specialized training in shield combat.

Chain Mail.name: Chain Mail
Chain Mail.descriptionpublic: A mesh of interlinked steel rings worn over padding, chain mail provides excellent protection against cuts and decent defense against thrusts, though it distributes weight across the whole body.

Handaxe.name: Handaxe
Handaxe.descriptionpublic: Compact and deadly, the hand axe is a one-handed chopper with a short haft and sharp blade, ideal for throwing or close-quarters strikes where speed outmatches reach.

Vrjnhar Lineage.name: Vrjnhar Lineage
Vrjnhar Lineage.description: When an attack against you results in a Glance, you protect yourself by taking the blow upon your magnificent beard which fully protects you from the damage otherwise dealt by a glancing blow.
Vrjnhar Lineage.actiondesc: You draw upon incredible reserves of energy to keep fighting past the point of exhaustion. For a period of time, whenever you exhaust your pool of Action points, you have a 25% chance to immediately recover one Action point.

Bulwark.name: Bulwark
Bulwark.description:
You have expertise in using a Shield to defend yourself and others.

Once per Turn while you have a Shield equipped, you may use the Defend action at a reduced cost of 1 Action Point.

Steadfast.name: Steadfast
Steadfast.description: Your patient resolve allows you to endure psychologically grueling ordeals with steadfast determination.
Steadfast.actiondesc: You harden yourself against demoralization. Your Morale is increased by your Wisdom score and you temporarily gain the Resolute condition.

Second Wind.name: Second Wind
Second Wind.description: Your physical hardiness allows you to push yourself beyond conventional limits.
Second Wind.actiondesc: You focus your energy and recover your Toughness score in Health.

Cadence.name: Cadence
Cadence.description: You are drilled in performing sequences of melee attacks with rhythmic precision. When you Strike multiple times in sequence using a one-handed melee weapon you gain a stacking +1 Boon for each successive attack.

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.descriptionpublic: An oil-burning or magically illuminated lantern that sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius.

Shield Combat Training.name: Shield Combat Training
Shield Combat Training.description: You are practiced at fighting with shield, using it to slam into and imbalance your foes. You are Trained with weapons in the Shield category.
Shield Combat Training.actiondesc: Following a basic Strike with your mainhand weapon, you Strike with your shield, causing the @Condition[staggered] condition for one Round.

Intercept.name: Intercept
Intercept.description: You protect your allies, intercepting blows that might otherwise be directed towards your companions.
Intercept.actiondesc:
You intercept the path of an enemy which enters your Engagement radius, immediatly moving up to your Stride to interpose yourself and block their path.

If the enemy moves out of your Engagement radius or attacks any other creature during their turn, you may make a Disengagement Strike against them.

Disarming Strike.name: Disarming Strike
Disarming Strike.description: A martial technique designed to disarm your opponent, forcing them to drop an object held in one of their hands.
Disarming Strike.actiondesc: You make a Strike against a the Reflex defense of a single target. The technique is Difficult to perform and deals reduced damage. If successful, the target's mainhand weapon is Dropped.

Healing Tonic.name: Healing Tonic
Healing Tonic.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to gradually close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Tonic.actiondesc:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Health dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Health each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Health each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Health each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Health each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Health each Round

Hold Fast.name: Hold Fast
Hold Fast.description: You are a calm anchor in the swirling sea of combat. When you have a Shield equipped, your Engagement increases by +1, allowing you to simultaneously engage more adjacent foes.

Heavy Weapon Training.name: Heavy Weapon Training
Heavy Weapon Training.description: You know how to use a heavy weapon to deliver punishing blows, putting your entire strength behind every swing. You are Trained with all weapons in the Heavy and Balanced categories.
Heavy Weapon Training.actiondesc: You unleash a powerful Strike with your mainhand weapon. The attack is slower to execute, but is Empowered to deliver additional damage.

Svala Bronwen.biographyprivate:
Svala was born and raised in the Oaken culture, and that raising was done alongside the mightiest warriors her people had. She was destined for battle before she could even heft an axe, and by the time she reached adulthood was a blooded warrior with several monster kills to her name.

Svala has been through more campaigns than she bothers to count, and has slain countless monsters in all manner of inhospitable arenas, from soaring, treacherous mountains, to reeking bogs, and frigid, snowy wastes between. Though she prefers axes for their reliability, she is handy with most any weapon that a smith has wrought, and no slouch bare handed.

Having heard of the rising troubles to the south, she set out from her homeland to lend a hand and maybe set things right.

Personality

Svala is confident above all else, she has faced danger, nearly died, lost friends, and more so many times over the centuries that she knows what she can do, and when she's in over her head. Beyond this, Svala believes strongly about doing what is right, helping others, and fighting for something. Battle for its own sake is hollow, and wastes lives. But fighting to a cause is worthy of one's dedication.

Connections

Svala has few connections beyond her homeland, but there she is a celebrated warrior well known across several fronts and settlements, having helped keep the Oaken lands free for centuries before striking out on her own.

Phrases

Better to try and help and fail than stand by and watch others suffer.

Only cowards have no room behind their shields.

I hope you and death remain strangers for a while longer.
Svala Bronwen.biographypublic: @ref[name] is a powerful Vrjnhar warrior that travels the world helping those in need, slaying monsters, and dishing out her own brand of justice as she sees fit. She is old, grizzled, and fearless, expecting that she and death will not meet for several centuries yet.
Svala Bronwen.biographyappearance:
The vrjnhar woman is broad shouldered and intensely muscled, carrying herself with a fearless confidence. She sports pale white fur that pours off her chin and turns into a lengthy beard which is split into several braided coils and draped over her shoulders in several places. Each strand is adorned with bronze clasps and rings which contrast richly against her pale hair.

A wickedly sharp looking battle axe is slung across her shoulder, and a heavy wooden shield adorned with ornate, intertwined knots hangs from her hip. What little armor she wears seems to be layers of chain and cloth.

Bassa the Firebug.name: Bassa the Firebug

Alchemist's Fire.name: Alchemist's Fire
