Alchemist's Fire.descriptionpublic: A flammable concoction that ignites upon impact and burns intensely for a short time.
Alchemist's Fire.actiondesc:
You hurl the @ref[name], dealing Weakened immediate damage but causing the @Condition[burning] condition to all enemies in a 4 foot radius Blast who fail to avoid the attack.

The amount of burning damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[name]:

  • Shoddy - 2 damage for 2 rounds

  • Standard - 3 damage for 3 rounds

  • Fine - 4 damage for 4 rounds

  • Superior - 6 damage for 5 rounds

  • Masterwork - 8 damage for 6 rounds

Firebug's Leather.name: Firebug's Leather
Firebug's Leather.descriptionprivate: This leather armor has been alchemically treated with compounds that make it practically immune to fire. It provides +5 Fire Resistance while equipped.
Firebug's Leather.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Dual Wield.name: Dual Wield
Dual Wield.description: You are adept at fighting with two weapons simultaneously. You can weave attacks together to strike more rapidly than possible with a single weapon.
Dual Wield.actiondesc: Immediately after you perform a basic Strike with your mainhand weapon, you make a reduced-cost fullow-up Strike with your offhand weapon.

Backstab.name: Backstab
Backstab.description: You focus your cunning instincts on exploiting the weak points of a flanked target. You identify an opportunity and strike with deadly efficiency.
Backstab.actiondesc: You Strike with your mainhand weapon against a Flanked target, dealing Deadly damage.

Pinning Shot.name: Pinning Shot
Pinning Shot.description: You fire a tactically placed shot to pin your target against a nearby surface.
Pinning Shot.actiondesc: You Strike from distance. The attack is Difficult, however if your target is it it becomes Restrained until the end of their next Turn.

Opportunist.name: Opportunist
Opportunist.description: You sieze any opportunity you can to capitalize on an enemy who turns their back on you. You may make a Disengagement Attack even if you are otherwise Fully Engaged, but you do so without the 2 Boons that would ordinarily apply to such an attack.

Weak Points.name: Weak Points
Weak Points.description: You identify moments of opportunity to strike at an enemy's weak points. When attacking a target that is Unaware, Flanked, or Exposed using Finesse weaponry, you gain +2 damage to any Strike.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.descriptionpublic: Tthe shortsword is a straight-bladed weapon which is nimble to wield and quick to strike in close combat. It features a crossguard ideal for parrying incoming blows.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.descriptionpublic: Small, swift, and deadly, the dagger slips between ribs or into gaps in armor with ease, its wicked edge favored by assassins, thieves, and those who prefer a silent kill.

Death Throes.name: Death Throes
Death Throes.description: When Bassa dies, he detonates his remaining explosives if he has at least one @UUID[Actor.Geaj9bagPJdTicsk.Item.MxYVu3N8UXCxmXFb] remaining.
Death Throes.actiondesc: Bassa ignites his remaining Alchemist's Fire dealing damage to all creatures within a 10 foot radius. This attack causes @Condition[burning] and gains +1 Boon per quantity of Alchemist's Fire that Bassa has remaining.

Kivahr Lineage.name: Kivahr Lineage
Kivahr Lineage.description:
Your body is strengthened with the lineage of giants. Your mind and your body work in harmony to solve problems and withstand physical strain.

You gain a bonus to your Fortitude and Willpower defenses equal to your Level divided by 4.
Kivahr Lineage.actiondesc:
You engage your supernatural ability to harmonize your mind and body. You enter a trance-like state which provides the following benefits at the start of your Turn.

  • You gain +1 Focus.

  • If your Morale is higher than your Health, you transfer up to your Presence ability score reducing Morale and gaining Health.

  • If your Health is higher than your Morale, you transfer up to your Toughness ability score, reducing Health and gaining Morale.

These transfers will not cause any resource to exceed it's maximum value.

Shortbow.name: Shortbow
Shortbow.descriptionpublic: Compact and quick to draw, the shortbow excels in rapid, close-quarters archery and skirmishes, favored by scouts, hunters, and swift-footed raiders.

Projectile Weapon Training.name: Projectile Weapon Training
Projectile Weapon Training.description: You have a basic education in archery and other projectile weaponry. You are no longer treated as Untrained with weapons in the Projectile categories.
Projectile Weapon Training.actiondesc: You can loose a shot under pressure, although with decreased accuracy. You perform a Strike that is Difficult, but has a reduced Action cost.

Saboteur.name: Saboteur
Saboteur.description: You are skilled with the use of thrown munitions. When using a consumable of the Bomb type you always count as at least Trained regardless of which skill is used and you gain +1 Boon to any involved check.

Bassa the Firebug.biographyprivate:
Bassa is a lower-level leader within the Otherhood of Fortune. While he is certainly able to drive people forward with threats and inspiring speeches based on giving in to base desires, he is unfortunately far too reckless to be given any true power or responsibility.

Personality

Bassa is an unpredictable, dangerous bandit, and sees the chaos and upheaval promised by the Otherhood of Fortune as a sure-fire way to have a great deal of fun. He thrives in chaotic environments, where his unorthodox personality and chaotic nature allow him to take bold, wild risks. His enthusiasm for alchemy and fire is borderline fanatic, and he often speaks with a fervor that leaves others both inspired and wary.

  • Ideals: Bassa believes that fire is the best tool for rampant destruction and a great deal of fun.

  • Bonds: Bassa has an almost spiritual bond with fire itself, treating it as a companion that guides him through his recklessness.

  • Flaws: He often acts without thinking, driven by the thrill of destruction, which can endanger himself and his allies.

Lore

Bassa is a loyal and even joyful member of the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrganizatio.JournalEntryPage.TdMk2KY9vGQJUggH]{Otherhood of Fortune}. Many view his instability as a problem, and as a result, many within the organization are unwilling to work with him, which makes him a liability.

Phrases

Embrace the fire, you blockheads! It’s where we truly find ourselves!
Bassa the Firebug.biographypublic: Bassa, called the "Firebug", is somewhere between unhinged maniac and alchemical savant. His love of fire borders on religious, and any chance he gets to set things ablaze he takes. How he came to be trusted to lead his fellow raiders is unknown, and seems ill-advised.
Bassa the Firebug.biographyappearance: A wild-eyed fellow wearing scorched leather armor covered in dark metal studs, and multiple armored bandoliers packed with vials of unknown liquids. He smells of chemicals and smoke, and looks ready for a fight.

Gafto the Howler.name: Gafto the Howler

Scale Mail.name: Scale Mail
Scale Mail.descriptionpublic: Overlapping metal plates sewn or riveted onto a leather or cloth backing, scale mail resembles the hide of a dragon and protects well against cuts and stabs—though it's noisy and inflexible.

Quick Chop.name: Quick Chop
Quick Chop.descriptionpublic: A heavy, crescent-bladed weapon built for cleaving through armor and bone alike. Its haft is marked from countless blows. This weapon can be gripped either in one hand or two.

Swift Smash.name: Swift Smash
Swift Smash.descriptionpublic: A seemingly humble tool with a flat striking face and curved claw, the claw hammer can become a savage weapon in determined hands.

Zeph Lineage.name: Zeph Lineage
Zeph Lineage.description:
You know the Rune of Lightning and can use it to weave Spellcraft.

A Zeph’s mask is capable of a limited amount of supernatural malleability. You can alter your mask slightly for regular communication and emotional expressiveness. When you die, only your mask remains. Your mask counts as your physical remains for the purposes of spells or magical effects which target a deceased creature.

The inscrutable nature of your mask makes reading your intentions difficult. During social challenges, Awareness checks to read your motives suffer +2 Banes.
actiondesc:
Your mask assumes an inscrutable expression.

  • You gain +2 Boons to all uses of the Deception skill.

  • Your Reflex defense increases by +2.

You may only have one active mask expression at a given time.

Your mask assumes a menacing expression.

  • You gain +2 Boons to all uses of the Intimidation skill.

  • Your Fortitude defense increases by +2.

You may only have one active mask expression at a given time.

Your mask assumes a beguiling expression.

  • You gain +2 Boons to all uses of the Persuasion skill.

  • Your Willpower defense increases by +2.

You may only have one active mask expression at a given time.

Thick Skin.name: Thick Skin
Thick Skin.description: Your physical toughness makes you more resistant to harm. You gain +2 Resistance to Bludgeoning, Slashing, and Piercing damage.

Berserker.name: Berserker
Berserker.description: You revel in the thrill of combat, hurling yourself into the fray with reckless abandon.
Berserker.actiondesc: You become Enraged. While Enraged you deal 4 additional damage on all melee attacks. You may attempt to end the effect on your own turn by succeeding on a Willpower test against a DC of 20. The effect ends automatically when Combat is concluded.

Heavy Weapon Training.name: Heavy Weapon Training
Heavy Weapon Training.description: You know how to use a heavy weapon to deliver punishing blows, putting your entire strength behind every swing. You are Trained with all weapons in the Heavy and Balanced categories.
Heavy Weapon Training.actiondesc: You unleash a powerful Strike with your mainhand weapon. The attack is slower to execute, but is Empowered to deliver additional damage.

Gesture: Strike.name: Gesture: Strike
Gesture: Strike.description:
You empower a direct close-range attack with the arcane essence of a Rune, performing a Strike with your equipped weapon.

The Strike gesture scales using Strength and deal damage based on your used weapon but with the damage type of the incorporated Rune. This gesture does not require any free hand and has a base cost of 1 Focus in addition to the cost of your weapon Strike.

Iramancer.name: Iramancer
Iramancer.description: Your feats of arcana are fueled by anger. While Enraged you may still spend Focus and you deal 2 additional damage to all spell attacks.

Dual Wield.name: Dual Wield
Dual Wield.description: You are adept at fighting with two weapons simultaneously. You can weave attacks together to strike more rapidly than possible with a single weapon.
Dual Wield.actiondesc: Immediately after you perform a basic Strike with your mainhand weapon, you make a reduced-cost fullow-up Strike with your offhand weapon.

Gafto the Howler.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

The Otherhood Raider is recruited from all cultures and walks of life, though each and every one is selected for their prowess in combat or potential to become a dangerous fighter. Raiders are the Otherhood's frontline fighter, and are relied upon to handle the most dangerous missions. Their armor, though a patchwork of stolen, scavenged, repaired, and hand-me-down pieces, is more than sufficient to protect them in their brutal hit-and-run attacks.

Behavior

The Otherhood Raider operates with a blend of strategy and opportunism. Trained to work seamlessly with each other, most raiders form dedicated squads that train and plan together to increase cohesion. In combat they engage targets with efficient precision, often laying traps to disorient their targets and provide them as many advantages in combat as possible. Raiders exhibit loyalty to their group and cause, often prioritizing the objective or the preservation of fellow raiders over their own safety.

Lore

The Otherhood is seen as one of the more prominent threats within the Arctus Plateau. Their unpredictable attack patterns, resourcefulness, and ferocity make them a constant danger that one can never truly prepare for sort of posting large numbers of defenders, which itself presents issues they can exploit. While their ultimate goals remain obscure to most raiders themselves, their actions nourish the unrest and instability upon which their organization thrives. To the local populations the Otherhood is often seen as little more than glorified bandits.
Gafto the Howler.biographypublic: Gafto "the Howler" is a burly, unhinged berserker spoiling for a fight, and always happy to throw down. In combat they howl like the wind, striking fear into the hearts of their foes. Their signature weapons are a hammer and axe, used in tandem to split skulls, shatter bones, and end lives.
Gafto the Howler.biographyappearance: Clad in scraps of golden robes and leather covered in bronze plates, this Zeph raider looks like they've been countless battles and never bothered to replace a single thread of their gear. They carry an axe and hammer in either hand, and threads of pulsating energy crawl up their thick arms in wild patterns only to erupt out of their head in great swirls of mist.

Salara, Queen of Scales.name: Salara, Queen of Scales

Ashka Lineage.name: Ashka Lineage
Ashka Lineage.description:
Your Stride is not penalized while in water. You can hold your breath while underwater for up to twenty minutes.

You can detect subtle differences in temperature with precision, allowing you to locate creatures which are warm-blooded or otherwise emit heat up to 60 feet away as long as they are not behind total cover and you are not Blinded or Incapacitated. A creature detected using Thermal Vision is treated as visible for the purposes of actions which require you to see your target.

ALPHA ONE: This feature is not yet automated.

Mnemonic Realization.name: Mnemonic Realization
Mnemonic Realization.description:
Your sharpened mind is full of secrets and techniques to remember them. Once per Day you may focus your thoughts and attempt to recall a word that sparks your memory.

The Gamemaster must provide you with a one-word clue that is appropriate for your direction of inquiry. It is left to Gamemaster discretion how direct or vague to be with the clue they provide.
Mnemonic Realization.actiondesc: You survey your memories attempting to recall a clue for your current situation.

Preparedness.name: Preparedness
Preparedness.description: You seem to always be prepared for the moment at hand. You may sacrifice your free movement for the Round to instead equip an Item from your inventory without spending any Action points.

Diversionist.name: Diversionist
Diversionist.description: You specialize in using subterfuge to distract or trick your opponent during combat.
Diversionist.actiondesc: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.

Provocateur.name: Provocateur
Provocateur.description: You specialize in barbed repartee crafted to highlight your opponent's shortcomings. In combat you can launch quips which provoke your foes.
Provocateur.actiondesc: You exaggerate your opponent's shortcomings with a scathing bon mot, performing a Diplomacy skill attack against your target's Willpower. On a success they suffer modest Psychic damage to Morale and become Enraged for 1 Round.

Padded Armor.name: Padded Armor
Padded Armor.descriptionpublic: Consisting of quilted layers of cloth stuffed with rags or wool, padded armor cushions the body against blunt force and serves as the foundation beneath heavier gear.

Stiletto.name: Stiletto
Stiletto.descriptionpublic: Thin, tapered, and made for piercing, the stiletto is a killer’s weapon — designed to slide between ribs or gaps in armor and leave barely a trace.

Grimoire.name: Grimoire
Grimoire.descriptionpublic: This heavy tome is used as a repository of knowledge as well as an implement for spellcraft. In the hands of an arcane practitioner, it can project concussive blasts of force towards a target.

Rune: Control.name: Rune: Control
Rune: Control.description:
The orderly force of discipline and permanence. The Control rune governs thought, reason, and persistence.

The Control rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Kinesis.
Rune: Control.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Control allows you to affect the decision making of others in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Moderately intensify or dampen the primary emotion being felt by a creature you touch. If the creature is intelligent enough to be aware of the laws governing spellcraft, they are aware of your actions.

  • Understand the abstract motivations of another living creature which allows you to touch it. You are able to intuit their immediate goals expressed in the form of a single verb.

  • Intensely focus on your current objective and the means of achieving it. You receive a brief hint or reminder from the Gamemaster about that objective containing only information which you have previously learned.

Motivate may only affect a creature or object which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Frost.name: Rune: Frost
Rune: Frost.description:
The orderly force of water and cold. The Frost rune governs the creation of water or other fluids and their transfer between liquid and frozen states.

The Frost rune scales using Wisdom, targets Fortitude, and deals Cold damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Flame.
Rune: Frost.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Frost allows you to manipulate liquids and their thermal properties, producing one of the following effects:

  • Draw up to one quarter gallon of fresh water from the atmosphere into a container or upon a surface you touch. The created water may be affected by relevant atmospheric properties of your current location.

  • Manipulate the temperature of up to 1 gallon of water, causing it to immediately freeze or thaw. The water need not be in a container; this technique can be used to coat a surface or join two objects together via regelation. Ice created in this way remains frozen for as long as the ambient temperature of the environment allows.

  • Gather up to a six-foot cube of nearby snow, forming it into a solidified sculpture, shape, or shelter.

Condense may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Influence.name: Gesture: Influence
Gesture: Influence.description:
You intensify the arcane power of a Rune into a concentrated direct contact which is generally a more powerful evolution of the basic Touch gesture.

The Influence gesture scales using Presence and targets a single adjacent creature. It deals 10 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Create.name: Gesture: Create
Gesture: Create.description:
You coalesce arcane power into tangible form, manifesting a Sprite which appears within 10 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Sprite is a Minion of half your own Level.

The Create gesture scales with Wisdom and the Sprite survives for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Sprite, casting another spell using the Create gesture replaces your previous Sprite. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

Not all Runes have a Sprite actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Creation will — for now — manifest a Flame Sprite.

Inflection: Compose.name: Inflection: Compose
Inflection: Compose.description: Enhance a spell by taking extra time in its formation, reducing other resource costs in exchange. The Compose inflection reduces the Focus cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Action cost by 1 in exchange.

Talisman Weapon Training.name: Talisman Weapon Training
Talisman Weapon Training.description: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft. You are Trained with weapons in the Talisman categories.
Talisman Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a Harmless Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a critical success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.

Salara, Queen of Scales.biographyprivate:
Salara has been in Seawall for years and has been a well known merchant and accountant for most of it. She built a reputation for being incredible with numbers and a stickler for rules and procedure.

Personality

Salara is neat and meticulous, a perfectionist in almost every way she can be. She believes in rules and order, and the value of both in society, especially one where pirates in charge.

Salara is the epitome of lawful neutral, who believes in seeing her tasks done with efficiency and precision. Personal feelings have no place in her work, though instinct and a keen eye are always useful. She can come off as cold and detached, but she is rarely intentionally rude or insulting.

Connections

When the Otherhood took over she was selected to oversee Seawall's markets by Sticks personally. She took the position without question, and has run the market with unflinching, uncompromising effect.

She is not an unfair manager, quite the opposite, in fact, but she expects all who do business in her market to know the rules and measures by which she runs it. Ignorance is not and will never be a defense. This has earned her the moniker "Queen of Scales" and she wears it with pride.

Phrases

You don't mess with money. Never mess with the money.

There are ways things are meant to be done, and I expect you to do them that way.
Salara, Queen of Scales.biographypublic: Salara is a seneschal in charge of the Seawall markets. She is informally known as the Queen of Scales due to her command over the workings of Seawall's ports and the informal role she plays in adjudicating the fates of those whose favor with Sticks and the Otherhood fall into question.
Salara, Queen of Scales.biographyappearance: A tall, imperious Ashka woman, Salara is of middle age with gray-blue scales and icy eyes that can cut like daggers if properly directed. She dresses in fine clothing, with little accents of gold and silver to contrast her naturally darker garb and scale. She wears a low slung belt, and from that hangs a pouch packed with notes and ledgers, plus all manner of rulers, weights, tools used to keep her market in check

Shimz Shimring.name: Shimz Shimring

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.descriptionpublic: The shortsword is a straight-bladed weapon which is nimble to wield and quick to strike in close combat. It features a crossguard ideal for parrying incoming blows.

Shortbow.name: Shortbow
Shortbow.descriptionpublic: Compact and quick to draw, the shortbow excels in rapid, close-quarters archery and skirmishes, favored by scouts, hunters, and swift-footed raiders.

Studded Leather Armor.name: Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: A base of leather reinforced with small metal studs or riveted plates, this armor strikes a balance between mobility and modest protection against slashes.

Altyra Lineage.name: Altyra Lineage
Altyra Lineage.description: You are immune to the Diseased condition which otherwise prevents you from regaining Health.
Altyra Lineage.actiondesc:
You can imbue yourself with the temporary visage and capabilities of Tyraphem, assuming an otherworldly visage. While transformed, you gain the following benefits.

  • You gain resistance to Radiant damage equal to 2 times your level.

  • Your attacks deal additional Radiant damage equal to half your Presence.

  • You gain +2 Boons to your use of the Intimidation skill.

You may end this transformation prior to its full duration on your turn at no cost.

Bard.name: Bard
Bard.description:
You practice the oral and musical traditions of heroic storytelling to inspire courage in your allies, demoralize your foes, and be quick with unconventional solutions to problems.

You learn Rune: Soul if you do not already know it. When restoring the morale of allies using the Rune of Spirit you gain +2 Boons to your roll.
Bard.actiondesc:
When an enemy uses an attack that fails to affect you or any ally, you construct a cutting jest or pantomime which makes a fool of their feeble effort.

You make an Performance skill attack against the target's Fortitude, dealing Psychic damage to Morale upon a success. Furthermore, upon a success, the target suffers 1 Bane to all rolls until the start of their next turn.

The target must be able to see and understand you to be affected by this ability.

Inspire Heroism.name: Inspire Heroism
Inspire Heroism.description: Your courageous presence inspires your nearby allies to strike with confidence.
Inspire Heroism.actiondesc: Each ally, excluding yourself, within 10 Feet gains +1 Boon to actions performed until the end of their next Turn.

Extoll Deeds.name: Extoll Deeds
Extoll Deeds.description: You inspire courage within your allies by extolling the heroic deeds of a companion. You may react by composing a verse, making a quip, or shouting a battle cry when an ally you can see Incapacitates or achieves a Critical Hit against an enemy creature. The celebration of these heroic deeds restores the Morale of your allies within 6 spaces.
Extoll Deeds.actiondesc: You compose a verse, make a quip, or shout a battle cry to extoll the heroic deeds of one of your allies. All allies near to you regain Morale equal to half your Presence score.

Rune: Soul.name: Rune: Soul
Rune: Soul.description:
An orderly force of creation and spiritual essence. The Soul rune governs the fundamental procession of souls through life and death and relates to matters of sapience, personality, and mental health.

The Soul rune scales using Presence and provides Restoration of Morale or inflicts Psychic damage opposed by Willpower. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Oblivion.
Rune: Soul.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Inspirator.name: Inspirator
Inspirator.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Soul. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[inspired] condition on Critical Hits.

The Inspired effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Presence score as additional Restoration to Morale.

Rune: Illumination.name: Rune: Illumination
Rune: Illumination.description:
The orderly force of light and energy. The Illumination rune governs light and radiance.

The Illumination rune scales using Presence, targets Reflex, and deals Radiant damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Illusion.
Rune: Illumination.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Illumination allows you to create light and exert basic control over its radiance, producing one of the following effects:

  • Create a ball of light called a "tosslight" which sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius. The light can hover near your body, be affixed to an item or surface, or be thrown up to a distance of 30 feet. You may dismiss your tosslight at any time and may only have a single tosslight at a time, casting this spell again causes your previous tosslight to disappear.

  • Inscribe up to 200 words of invisible text into paper like a scroll, page, or book. The text is written from light itself and hidden from non-magical detection. It can be made visible by yourself or another through use of this spell combined with a spoken passphrase that you define at the time of inscription.

  • Touch a physical object that produces dim light, causing it to become bright light for as long as you maintain physical contact. Only one light source may be intensified in this way at a given time.

Reveal may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Illusion.name: Rune: Illusion
Rune: Illusion.description:
The chaotic force of trickery and whimsy. The illusion rune governs magical manifestations of falsehood or misdirection.

The Illusion rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower defense, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Illumination.
Rune: Illusion.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Illusion allows you to fabricate perception in various simple ways and to manipulate shadow and light to create distraction or entertainment, producing one of the following effects:

  • Modify a single aspect of your own physical appearance. Such alterations might include adjusting the sound of your voice, changing the color of your eyes, gaining illusory horns, or appearing slightly taller or shorter. The alteration persists until you Rest or enact a different alteration and can be verified as illusory by physical inspection.

  • Manifest a convincing recreation of a short sound or single scent that you can clearly recall. The illusion originates from your position and lasts for 10 seconds. You can control the volume of the sound or odorousness of the scent to be perceptible up to a range of 60 feet or shorter.

  • Decouple your shadow from your form, specifically controlling its movements separately from your own. You can maintain this illusion as long as you do not perform any other action that consumes Focus.

Seeming may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Aspect.name: Gesture: Aspect
Gesture: Aspect.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect, casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Inflection: Elude.name: Inflection: Elude
Inflection: Elude.description: Enhance a spell to make it more difficult for an enemy to retaliate against its casting. This spell does not provide any opportunity to make reactions that involve Strike attacks, regardless of the results of the spell.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description: A sophisticated use of Illusory magic, the Invisibility spell allows the caster to wrap light and shadow around themselves like donning a cloak, reflecting the world about them as if they were not standing there. What person wouldn't believe it when their own eyes tell them that there is nothing to see?
Invisibility.actiondesc: You become @Condition[invisible] and cannot be detected using sight-based perception. You cannot be directly targeted by any action. This spell must be Maintained in order to remain in effect.

Gesture: Arrow.name: Gesture: Arrow
Gesture: Arrow.description:
You hurl a projectile imbued with the magical power of a Rune at a distant target.

The Arrow gesture scales using Intellect and targets a single creature up to a distance of 60 feet, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Lyre.name: Lyre
Lyre.descriptionpublic: A stringed instrument within a curved frame. The lyre is a favored instrument of many roving bards or storytellers which use music to augment their magic or oration.

Shimz Shimring.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

Raiders are the Otherhood's frontline fighter, and are relied upon to handle the most dangerous missions. To the local populations the Otherhood is often seen as little more than glorified bandits.
Shimz Shimring.biographypublic: Shimz Shimring was once a well known bard before she fell on hard times and resorted to robbing her patrons rather than performing for them. She is a charismatic and dangerous spellcaster who now serves the Otherhood with distinction. Though she is more than happy to wield her magic and weapons against good and innocent folk, her most barbed words are reserved for those under her command.
Shimz Shimring.biographyappearance: Tall, slender, and imposing, this altyran raider holds herself with a confident swagger, and speaks with a resonant voice that vibrates with magic. At hand are her tools: a lyre made of gray wood, a bow with plentiful arrows, and a keen short sword slung from her hip.

Sticks.name: Sticks

Kiska Lineage.name: Kiska Lineage
Kiska Lineage.description:
Your blend effortlessly into the darkness. While standing within dim light or darkness you gain +2 Boons to any usage of the Stealth skill.

You instinctually know the Rune of Illusion and can use it for spellcraft.
Kiska Lineage.actiondesc: You draw on a limited reserve of energy to make a spectacular bounding leap. You may immediately Jump up to three times your Stride. Movement made in this way is so sudden that it affords no opportunity for Disengagement attacks.

Dual Wield.name: Dual Wield
Dual Wield.description: You are adept at fighting with two weapons simultaneously. You can weave attacks together to strike more rapidly than possible with a single weapon.
Dual Wield.actiondesc: Immediately after you perform a basic Strike with your mainhand weapon, you make a reduced-cost fullow-up Strike with your offhand weapon.

Light Weapon Training.name: Light Weapon Training
Light Weapon Training.description: You know how to wield light weapons fluidly with a high degree of maneuverability and grace in combat. You are Trained with all weapons in the Light and Balanced categories.
Light Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You dart forward nimbly, making a strike with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a Finesse weapon against a single target with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is Difficult, but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke Disengagement.

Swashbuckler.name: Swashbuckler
Swashbuckler.description: Your bravado inspires your allies and cowes your enemies. When you Dodge or Parry a Strike, the attacker loses Morale equal to your Presence attribute. When you achieve a Critical Hit, all nearby allies who can see you gain Morale equal to your Presence attribute.

Inspire Heroism.name: Inspire Heroism
Inspire Heroism.description: Your courageous presence inspires your nearby allies to strike with confidence.
Inspire Heroism.actiondesc: Each ally, excluding yourself, within 10 Feet gains +1 Boon to actions performed until the end of their next Turn.

Rallying Cry.name: Rallying Cry
Rallying Cry.description: Your presence as a battlefield leader fortifies and restores the morale of your allies.
Rallying Cry.actiondesc: You emit a courageous bellow that inspires allies within 12 feet of you to remain stalwart in the face of peril. All allies within range immediately recover your Presence score in Morale and become @Condition[resolute] for 3 Rounds.

Feinting Strike.name: Feinting Strike
Feinting Strike.description: A two-weapon technique which makes a feint with your primary weapon, exposing your target for an off-hand attack.
Feinting Strike.actiondesc:
You feint with your mainhand weapon, making a Deception attack against the target's Reflex defense. You immediately make a Strike with your offhand weapon.

If your Deception was successful, you gain +2 Boons to your Strike and it deals an additional +6 Damage.

Mechanical Weapon Training.name: Mechanical Weapon Training
Mechanical Weapon Training.description: You are familiar in the design and usage of crossbows, firearms, and other similar armaments. You are Trained with weapons in the Mechanical category.
Mechanical Weapon Training.actiondesc: You focus deeply and calm your nerves to quickly Reload your mechanical weapon with exceptional haste.

Studded Leather Armor.name: Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: A base of leather reinforced with small metal studs or riveted plates, this armor strikes a balance between mobility and modest protection against slashes.

Crowbar.name: Crowbar
Crowbar.descriptionpublic: A slightly curved bar of strong metal featuring a hook with a flattened head on one end. Used to apply leverage, prying one object loose of another.

Lockpicks.name: Lockpicks
Lockpicks.descriptionpublic: A set of long thin metal pins with slightly hooked ends designed to manipulate the internal mechanisms of locks and a metal bar for applying torsion. In the right hands, these can be used to open locks just as well as any key.

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.descriptionpublic: An oil-burning or magically illuminated lantern that sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius.

Stiletto.name: Stiletto
Stiletto.descriptionpublic: Thin, tapered, and made for piercing, the stiletto is a killer’s weapon — designed to slide between ribs or gaps in armor and leave barely a trace.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.descriptionpublic: Small, swift, and deadly, the dagger slips between ribs or into gaps in armor with ease, its wicked edge favored by assassins, thieves, and those who prefer a silent kill.

Hand Crossbow.name: Hand Crossbow
Hand Crossbow.descriptionpublic: This palm-sized crossbow trades power for concealability, perfect for close-quarters surprise shots or the desperate last bolt of a cornered rogue.

Ring of Reinforcement.name: Ring of Reinforcement
Ring of Reinforcement.descriptionprivate: This item is presented as a ring, but it can be any type of accessory like an amulet, cloak, bracers, or other type of trinket.
Ring of Reinforcement.descriptionpublic:
This steel ring feels permanently cool to the touch and gives the sensation of weighing more than expected given its narrow band.

This ring provides a bonus to Armor defense equal to the minimum of its Quality and Enchantment bonuses.

  • Fine quality and Minor enchantment: +1 Armor

  • Superior quality and Major enchantment: +2 Armor

  • Masterwork quality and Legendary enchantment: +3 Armor

Expanded Toolbelt.name: Expanded Toolbelt
Expanded Toolbelt.descriptionpublic:
An expanded toolbelt in the form of a utility belt, a bandolier, or an array of pockets stitched into your equipment.

This item provides a number of additional Toolbelt slots according to its quality tier:

  • Standard: +1 Toolbelt slot

  • Fine: +2 Toolbelt slots

  • Superior: +3 Toolbelt slots

  • Masterwork: +4 Toolbelt slots

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Sticks.biographyprivate:
NOTE: Sticks intentionally does not have a functional stat-block for Ember Beta. This will be added in a later test phase.

Sticks was born on the sea. Or so he claims. The only survivor of a ship found by pirates in the middle of the ocean, named after the broken remnants of wood found around his body, he often claims that he was "too tough to kill and too ornery to die." At the very least, Sticks has always been lucky. The pirates who rescued him kept him on the ship not out of the goodness of their hearts, but because he seemed to bring fair weather and better luck to their journeys.

While most don't question it, Sticks' luck has often coincided with someone else's misfortune, whether it was the captain's fall from the rigging that got him his first ship, or the fire in a dockside factory in Seawall that his ship was miraculously there to put out, giving him greater notoriety in his new home. (It certainly helped that the captain was brutal and the factory misused its workers - Sticks does not like a bully).

Now, settled into life in Seawall, Sticks continues to build his power base and popularity in the seaside town. As his luck continues to grow, everyone else will simply have to get in line.

Personality

Sticks is fun, with a seemingly impulsive and over-the-top roguish charm. His voice carries and he's great at telling a story or joke, though he often twists his words just enough to put down anyone who he believes should be put in their place. Most don't notice or care, carried through by his bombastic pronouncements, well-known generosity, and spirit of joie de vivre. And while those who have found themselves on his bad side might note the shrewdness of his smile, or how viciously he fights (often with wooden weapons, in a nod to his name), even they would have to acknowledge that Sticks is kind to underdogs, tending to lash out only at those who he perceives as bullies, tyrants, or in his way.

Connections

Sticks has a great disdain for the Ordinate, especially the Trading Houses, for the many regulations that they force traders to adhere to. He sees this as the Ordinate trying to control the rest of the Plateau and become the only city with any real influence on the Arctus Plateau. Due to his sympathy for those who work outside of the rules, he allows members of the Otherhood of Fortune to live in Seawall without being bothered by the authorities, and it has become a strong base for the group.

The Real Sticks

Sticks may claim to want freedom and a good time for all, but the only free world he's truly interested in is one where he gets to make all the decisions and holds all of the cards. Since the day he was first put to work by the pirate ship that found him floating in the water as a child, he has been determined to be the one giving the orders, not the one taking them, and will do whatever he can to move his way into positions of greater and greater power.

Wielding his charisma like a weapon, Sticks makes friends with those who can help him and will never think to challenge him, looking for those who he can buy off with generosity or win over with a story and a smile. Over time, he has built this group of trusted sycophants into the Otherhood of Fortune, a movement that believes that they are in control, free to do what they want, while always getting Sticks exactly what he needs.

Those who stand in Sticks' way as he continues his ascent to power should be wary - often his targets don't know they are in his crosshairs until it is too late. He is skilled at using his stories and friends to shift popular opinion against those he wants to destroy before lashing out, making it all too easy to believe that the captain he shoved from the top of the sails was a brutal leader, or that the supply house he burned to the ground so that he could build his home base in a prime location mistreated its workers.

With his ascent to power in full stride, Sticks has now set his sights on Ordain, hoping that by undercutting the Ordinate's power, he can become the most important figure in the Arctus Plateau.

Phrases

Not a cup dry while I'm nearby!

They think to tell us how to live our lives? What's next, how to live in our shirts and die in our boots?

Follow me, friends! We will find our luck, or make it!
Sticks.biographypublic: Once a pirate famed for having risen in the ranks of the ship that rescued him from a shipwreck as child (surrounded by "no more than sticks," which soon became his name), Sticks has retired from life on the waves and settled in the seaside town of Seawall, determined to make a better life for the people of the Arctus Plateau. Positioning himself and his city as an alternative to the control and strict demands of Ordain and its trading houses, Sticks is a popular figure on the plateau, seen as someone who has not forgotten his roots but has the leadership capacity to make the lives of the people he cares about better. Someone who takes care of his own and lets others live how they see fit, even if he has to bend the rules to do it.
Sticks.biographyappearance: You hear the retired pirate before you see him. As he talks, he throws his shoulders back, voice roaring and white fur gleaming underneath a uniform that is both casually rumpled and meticulously fitted. If he knows he is charming, which he almost certainly does, it doesn't detract from the charm, and there's a sense of warmth in his smile that makes it easy to see why so many people are ready to bask in it.

Avwynn Taol.name: Avwynn Taol

Human Lineage.name: Human Lineage
Human Lineage.description: When you perform a Reaction which involves a Focus cost, you gain +1 Boon on any associated roll.
Human Lineage.actiondesc: When you become Weakened or sustain damage while Weakened, you can activate a burst of extraordinary adrenaline called Blaze. You immediately replenish your Action and Focus pools to their maximum value.

Leather Armor.name: Leather Armor
Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Primordial Aspen Branch.name: Primordial Aspen Branch
Primordial Aspen Branch.descriptionpublic: This talisman, favored by druidic adherants attuned to the power of the land, aids in the practice of spellcraft or can be used in combat to direct a gout of poisonous spores towards an enemy.

Spellband.name: Spellband
Spellband.descriptionpublic: This ring made of an opaque stone that has been carefully carved with graceful, sweeping layers evoking an ancient aesthetic. The ring serves as a powerful spellcasting focus for the Invested wearer.
Spellband.actiondesc:
In moments of duress you can withdraw an additional reserve of Focus from this band. The amount of Focus restored depends on the enchantment bonus of the ring.

  • Minor enchantment: 4 Focus

  • Major enchantment: 6 Focus

  • Legendary enchantment: 8 Focus

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Rallying Tonic.name: Rallying Tonic
Rallying Tonic.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to gradually fortify the psyche and improve morale.
Rallying Tonic.actiondesc:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Morale dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Morale each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Morale each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Morale each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Morale each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Morale each Round

Rune: Illusion.name: Rune: Illusion
Rune: Illusion.description:
The chaotic force of trickery and whimsy. The illusion rune governs magical manifestations of falsehood or misdirection.

The Illusion rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower defense, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Illumination.
Rune: Illusion.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Illusion allows you to fabricate perception in various simple ways and to manipulate shadow and light to create distraction or entertainment, producing one of the following effects:

  • Modify a single aspect of your own physical appearance. Such alterations might include adjusting the sound of your voice, changing the color of your eyes, gaining illusory horns, or appearing slightly taller or shorter. The alteration persists until you Rest or enact a different alteration and can be verified as illusory by physical inspection.

  • Manifest a convincing recreation of a short sound or single scent that you can clearly recall. The illusion originates from your position and lasts for 10 seconds. You can control the volume of the sound or odorousness of the scent to be perceptible up to a range of 60 feet or shorter.

  • Decouple your shadow from your form, specifically controlling its movements separately from your own. You can maintain this illusion as long as you do not perform any other action that consumes Focus.

Seeming may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Life.name: Rune: Life
Rune: Life.description:
A chaotic force of creation, responsible for living matter. The Life rune governs health and matters relating to biological growth.

The Life rune scales using Wisdom and provides Restoration of Health or inflicts Poison damage opposed by Fortitude. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Death.
Rune: Life.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Life allows you to stimulate biological growth and nourish physical health, producing one of the following effects:

  • Cultivate 1 cubic foot of existing plants or fungus to rapidly grow to a healthy, blossoming, or harvestable state.

  • Identify a negative physical condition that is affecting a creature such as @Condition[diseased], @Condition[poisoned], @Condition[bleeding], or @Condition[weakened].

  • Verify whether a portion of food or drink is free of contamination from bacteria, parasites, or poison.

Bloom may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Soul.name: Rune: Soul
Rune: Soul.description:
An orderly force of creation and spiritual essence. The Soul rune governs the fundamental procession of souls through life and death and relates to matters of sapience, personality, and mental health.

The Soul rune scales using Presence and provides Restoration of Morale or inflicts Psychic damage opposed by Willpower. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Oblivion.
Rune: Soul.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Earth.name: Rune: Earth
Rune: Earth.description:
The orderly force of elemental earth, responsible for physical matter. The Earth rune governs minerals, metals, soils, and other physical compounds.

The Earth rune scales using Wisdom, targets Reflex, and deals Acid damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Lightning.
Rune: Earth.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Earth allows you to manipulate raw forces of rock, mineral, and soil in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Quickly shape up to one cubic foot of available material into a simple geometric form like a cuboid, ellipsoid, or polyhedron.

  • Precisely copy the physical shape of a held object that is smaller than a 6-inch cube, reproducing it from available clay, stone, or metal. The replica retains no useful properties except for its physical form.

  • Separate and collect earthen particles from the surface of an object, creature, or liquid that you touch, rendering the subject completely cleaned or purified in moments.

Mould may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Control.name: Rune: Control
Rune: Control.description:
The orderly force of discipline and permanence. The Control rune governs thought, reason, and persistence.

The Control rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Kinesis.
Rune: Control.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Control allows you to affect the decision making of others in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Moderately intensify or dampen the primary emotion being felt by a creature you touch. If the creature is intelligent enough to be aware of the laws governing spellcraft, they are aware of your actions.

  • Understand the abstract motivations of another living creature which allows you to touch it. You are able to intuit their immediate goals expressed in the form of a single verb.

  • Intensely focus on your current objective and the means of achieving it. You receive a brief hint or reminder from the Gamemaster about that objective containing only information which you have previously learned.

Motivate may only affect a creature or object which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Illusion Proficiency.name: Illusion Proficiency
Illusion Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Illusion. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Seeming action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Control Proficiency.name: Control Proficiency
Control Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Control. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Motivate action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Life Proficiency.name: Life Proficiency
Life Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Life. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Blossom action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Earth Proficiency.name: Earth  Proficiency
Earth Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Earth. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Mould action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Soul Proficiency.name: Soul Proficiency
Soul Proficiency.description:
You have fluency in weaving spellcraft using the Rune of Soul. You gain a +1 Skill Bonus for spells cast using this Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent will eventually also provide an upgrade to the Evoke action, expanding its effectiveness or including new options for how to use it.

Mender.name: Mender
Mender.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Life. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[mending] condition on Critical Hits.

The Mending effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Wisdom score as additional Restoration to Health.

Mesmer.name: Mesmer
Mesmer.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Illusion. Spells which use this Rune cause @Condition[confused] on Critical Hits.

The Confused effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half your Intellect score as Psychic damage to Morale, and applies the @Condition[disoriented] condition.

Inflection: Quicken.name: Inflection: Quicken
Inflection: Quicken.description: Enhance a spell by hastening the speed with which it can be cast, at the expense of increased Focus. The Quicken inflection reduces the Action cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Focus cost by 1 in exchange.

Inflection: Compose.name: Inflection: Compose
Inflection: Compose.description: Enhance a spell by taking extra time in its formation, reducing other resource costs in exchange. The Compose inflection reduces the Focus cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Action cost by 1 in exchange.

Inflection: Elude.name: Inflection: Elude
Inflection: Elude.description: Enhance a spell to make it more difficult for an enemy to retaliate against its casting. This spell does not provide any opportunity to make reactions that involve Strike attacks, regardless of the results of the spell.

Gesture: Arrow.name: Gesture: Arrow
Gesture: Arrow.description:
You hurl a projectile imbued with the magical power of a Rune at a distant target.

The Arrow gesture scales using Intellect and targets a single creature up to a distance of 60 feet, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Aspect.name: Gesture: Aspect
Gesture: Aspect.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect, casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Influence.name: Gesture: Influence
Gesture: Influence.description:
You intensify the arcane power of a Rune into a concentrated direct contact which is generally a more powerful evolution of the basic Touch gesture.

The Influence gesture scales using Presence and targets a single adjacent creature. It deals 10 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Ward.name: Gesture: Ward
Gesture: Ward.description:
You shape the arcane power of a Rune into a protective barrier used to shield yourself from harm.

The Ward gesture scales using Toughness and provides +6 Resistance against the damage type of the Rune used in the spell. This resistance lasts for 1 Round and you may only have a single Ward at a time. Casting another spell using the Ward gesture replaces your prior Ward. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Aura.name: Gesture: Aura
Gesture: Aura.description:
You concentrate the arcane power of a Rune to create a maintained field of energy that washes over allies and enemies near to you.

The Aura gesture scales with Presence and produces an emanation with 20 feet radius centered on the spellcaster. The center of this Aura moves with the spellcaster.

Depending on the Rune used, the Aura deals damage or provides healing to any creature which begins its turn inside the Aura. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast, has a base cost of 5 Action and 1 Focus, and must be Maintained costing an additional 1 Focus every subsequent round.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Emanation templates which are linked to the Token and move when the Token moves are a feature coming in Foundry VTT version 14. Automation of the Aura gesture will occur once Crucible depends on Foundry VTT version 14.

Gesture: Cone.name: Gesture: Cone
Gesture: Cone.description:
You focus the arcane power of a Rune into a narrow cone that projects outwards from your location.

The Cone gesture scales with Intellect and produces a 60 degree cone with a 30 foot radius originating from the spellcaster. The Cone deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Surge.name: Gesture: Surge
Gesture: Surge.description:
You channel the arcane power of a Rune into a rushing wave of energy that surges forward from your current position.

The Surge gesture scales with Wisdom and produces a line that is 10 feet wide and 15 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Rune: Illumination.name: Rune: Illumination
Rune: Illumination.description:
The orderly force of light and energy. The Illumination rune governs light and radiance.

The Illumination rune scales using Presence, targets Reflex, and deals Radiant damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Illusion.
Rune: Illumination.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Illumination allows you to create light and exert basic control over its radiance, producing one of the following effects:

  • Create a ball of light called a "tosslight" which sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius. The light can hover near your body, be affixed to an item or surface, or be thrown up to a distance of 30 feet. You may dismiss your tosslight at any time and may only have a single tosslight at a time, casting this spell again causes your previous tosslight to disappear.

  • Inscribe up to 200 words of invisible text into paper like a scroll, page, or book. The text is written from light itself and hidden from non-magical detection. It can be made visible by yourself or another through use of this spell combined with a spoken passphrase that you define at the time of inscription.

  • Touch a physical object that produces dim light, causing it to become bright light for as long as you maintain physical contact. Only one light source may be intensified in this way at a given time.

Reveal may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description: A sophisticated use of Illusory magic, the Invisibility spell allows the caster to wrap light and shadow around themselves like donning a cloak, reflecting the world about them as if they were not standing there. What person wouldn't believe it when their own eyes tell them that there is nothing to see?
Invisibility.actiondesc: You become @Condition[invisible] and cannot be detected using sight-based perception. You cannot be directly targeted by any action. This spell must be Maintained in order to remain in effect.

Protective Mirage.name: Protective Mirage
Protective Mirage.description: You Aspect yourself in a mirage of shifting Illumination and Shadow which mask your current position and allow you to Elude incoming blows.
Protective Mirage.actiondesc: You become surrounded by three illusory duplicates which last up to 10 Rounds. Any incoming Strike against you is made with a number of Banes equal to two times your number of duplicates remaining. Each time a Strike misses you, one of your duplicates disappears.

Avwynn Taol.biographyprivate:
Avwynn Taol is the iron heart of the Sanguinaries, a mystic-scholar whose power and presence command attention wherever she goes. Exceptionally well-read and insatiably curious, she has spent her life chasing the truths buried in Ember’s histories, cultures, and legacies, piecing together patterns others overlook.

Equal parts academic, theologian, spellcaster, and diplomat, Avwynn embodies each role with conviction. Tireless and iron-willed, she treats half-measures with disdain, forging herself into a living example of her philosophy: anything worth doing is worth doing with excellence. Yet she is far from humorless as her sharp wit and playful barbs disarm others as often as her magic does, and she delights in puncturing the pride of those who underestimate her.

Avwynn has traveled the breadth of Ember, from its highest spires to its sunless Pathways, learning firsthand how the world’s life-force shapes those who live within it. This experience has hardened her belief that the Cindaric Sages were wrong to suppress the truth of Ember’s failing heart. To her, the danger lies not in spreading fear, but in denying people the chance to rally, resist, and act. Still, she avoids the pitfall of alarming the general populations and peoples of the world, knowing that to be branded a doomsayer is to doom her cause.

As leader of the Sanguinaries, Avwynn is no tyrant; her leadership is guiding rather than commanding. Yet none doubt her power. She is as likely to parley with kings as she is to incinerate an undead army, and her presence alone makes the scattered Sanguinaries feel less like fragments and more like a movement. Whispers also follow her—rumors of a romantic bond with the Casia Nimaelle, a connection that would entwine her destiny even more deeply with ancient powers.

Personality

Avwynn is an insightful and careful person who has spent years learning to read, understand, and predict others around her. She rarely speaks about herself, and often prefers to ask others their views and opinions, attempting to figure out their motives and intentions in any given situation.

She is independent, iron-willed, and confident in most every situation, prizing her ability to be adaptable to any situation that arises. If she can't talk her way out of a situation she probably has a piece of knowledge or a spell that will do the trick, making her appear to always have a plan, even when she's making it up on the fly.

Connections

Avwynn is the current head of the Sanguinaries, and though the position is more symbolic than anything, she takes the position seriously, and works tirelessly to see the needs and interests of her organization met. Beyond this, she has connections with the various sub-factions of the sanguinaries, and even has links to the Cindaric Sages, with several secret sympathizers and allies in their ranks helping her to keep abreast of things as they develop in the main faith.

Phrases

Adaptability is strength as powerful as any wisdom.

Never trust an answer that begs no further questions.

Predicting people is learning to pit them against themselves.

You should listen to what is said, then look behind it to find what is not.
Avwynn Taol.biographypublic: Avwyn is a keen and canny sort with the curiosity of an academic, the wisdom of an ancient sage, and the charm of a diplomat. Her true motives seem to be a closely guarded secret, and there is more mystery wrapped around her than most Veiled Chain agents have.
Avwynn Taol.biographyappearance: Tall, regal, and confident, this human woman carries herself with certainty and exudes a powerful confidence back with a steely, unwavering calm. Her icy blue eyes glimmer sharply against black sclera, betraying some hint of non-human ancestry, or perhaps magical twisting in her blood.

Corvana Vortest.name: Corvana Vortest

Spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
Spellcasting.description:
[[lookup @name]] is a [[lookup @attributes.spell.level]]th level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]], +[[lookup @attributes.spell.attack]] to hit with spell attacks).

[[lookup @name]] knows and has prepared the spells presented on the Spells tab of her character sheet. She automatically satisfies the material component requirements to cast these spells, if any.

Ethereal Appendages.name: Ethereal Appendages
Ethereal Appendages.description:
You have two ethereal arms in addition to your corporeal limbs.

  • These arms may not wield weapons or carry shields.

  • You may perform the Use an Object action for free twice on your turn, instead of only once.

  • You can perform the somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or other objects in your physical hands.

Scholar's Pack.name: Scholar's Pack
Scholar's Pack.description: A backpack can hold one cubic foot or 30 pounds of gear. You can also strap items, such as a bedroll or a coil of rope, to the outside of a backpack.

Parchment.name: Parchment
Parchment.descriptionprivate: A single sheet of heavier parchment paper.

Book of Lore.name: Book of Lore
Book of Lore.descriptionprivate: A book containing historical accounts, information pertaining to a particular field of lore, myth, or legend.

Small Knife.name: Small Knife
Small Knife.descriptionprivate: A blunt knife used by the scholarly to open letters and correspondence.

Bag of Sand.name: Bag of Sand
Bag of Sand.descriptionprivate: A small bag of sand used by the scholarly to dry freshly inked letters and correspondence quickly and safely for quick dispatch.

Ink Bottle.name: Ink Bottle
Ink Bottle.descriptionprivate: A small bottle of ink for writing upon parchment.

Ink Pen.name: Ink Pen
Ink Pen.descriptionprivate: A deviced used in combination with ink to write or draw on a sheet of paper.

Light.name: Light
Light.description:
You touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.

Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

Mage Hand.name: Mage Hand
Mage Hand.description:
A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.

As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.

The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

Prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
Prestidigitation.description:
You create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time.

Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.

Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire.

Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot.

Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.

Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour.

Minor Creation. You create a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.

Ray of Frost.name: Ray of Frost
Ray of Frost.description:
A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
Detect Magic.description:
For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.

The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.

Magic Missile.name: Magic Missile
Magic Missile.description:
You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart strikes a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The spell creates one more dart for each spell slot level above 1.

[[2 + @item.level]]{Level [[lookup @item.level]] darts}

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.description: An imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile}.

Misty Step.name: Misty Step
Misty Step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Suggestion.name: Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
You suggest a course of activity—described in no more than 25 words—to one creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. The suggestion must sound achievable and not involve anything that would obviously deal damage to the target or its allies. For example, you could say, "Fetch the key to the cult's treasure vault, and give the key to me." Or you could say, "Stop fighting, leave this library peacefully, and don't return."

The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration or until you or your allies deal damage to the target. The Charmed target pursues the suggestion to the best of its ability. The suggested activity can continue for the entire duration, but if the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends for the target upon completing it.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

Dispel Magic.name: Dispel Magic
Dispel Magic.description:
Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You automatically end a spell on the target if the spell's level is equal to or less than the level of the spell slot you use.

Lightning Bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description:
A stroke of lightning forming a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3.

Banishment.name: Banishment
Banishment.description:
One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn't return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (DM's choice) associated with its creature type.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.

Greater Invisibility.name: Greater Invisibility
Greater Invisibility.description: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends.

Contact Other Plane.name: Contact Other Plane
Contact Other Plane.description:
You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other knowledgeable entity from another plane. Contacting this otherworldly intelligence can break your mind. When you cast this spell, make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a successful save, you can ask the entity up to five questions. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. The DM answers each question with one word, such as "yes," "no," "maybe," "never," "irrelevant," or "unclear" (if the entity doesn't know the answer to the question). If a one-word answer would be misleading, the DM might instead offer a short phrase as an answer.

On a failed save, you take 6d6 Psychic damage and have the &Reference[Incapacitated] condition until you finish a Long Rest. A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Greater Restoration} spell cast on you ends this effect.

Glyphspeak.name: Glyphspeak
Glyphspeak.description:
[[lookup @name]]'s spellcasting ability is [[lookup @attributes.spell.abilityLabel]] (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]], +[[lookup @attributes.spell.attack]] to hit with spell attacks). [[lookup @name]] can cast the following spells, requiring no components:

At Will: [[/item .2wGTUU4sYwDXK6LU]]{Message}
