Each time a creature hits you with an attack roll during the spell's duration, roll a [[/r (@flags.dnd-players-handbook.mirrorImages)d6kh1cs>2#Duplicate destroyed]]{d6 for each} of your remaining duplicates. If any of the d6s rolls a 3 or higher, one of the duplicates is hit instead of you, and the duplicate is destroyed. The duplicates otherwise ignore all other damage and effects. The spell ends when all three duplicates are destroyed.

A creature is unaffected by this spell if it has the &Reference[blinded apply=false] condition, &Reference[blindsight], or &Reference[truesight].

Sleet Storm.name: Sleet Storm
Sleet Storm.description:
Until the spell ends, sleet falls in a 40-foot-tall, 20-foot-radius Cylinder centered on a point you choose within range. The area is &Reference[heavilyobscured], and exposed flames in the area are doused.

Ground in the Cylinder is &Reference[difficultterrain]. When a creature enters the Cylinder for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the &Reference[prone] condition and lose &Reference[concentration].

Water Breathing.name: Water Breathing
Water Breathing.description: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

Muscle Machinery.name: Muscle Machinery
Muscle Machinery.description:
Your maximum carrying capacity is doubled for your size.

You have advantage on Constitution saving throws to avoid Exhaustion when going without rest.

Foundry Note

This feature includes an Active Effect which automatically upgrades your size when determining carrying capacity.

Net.name: Net
Net.descriptionprivate:
When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a Net. Target a creature you can see within 15 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or have the &Reference[Restrained] condition until it escapes. The target succeeds automatically if it is Huge or larger.

To escape, the target or a creature within 5 feet of it must take an action to make a [[/skill ath 10]] check, freeing the Restrained creature on a success. Destroying the Net (AC 10; 5 HP; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage) also frees the target, ending the effect.

Regulated Rhythm.name: Regulated Rhythm
Regulated Rhythm.description:
Your mind and your body work in harmony to solve problems and withstand physical strain. On your turn you may spend a Bonus Action to enter a trance-like state. While in this state you have the following benefits:

  • You have advantage to Insight, Investigation, Perception, and Athletics skill checks.

  • You have advantage on Concentration checks to maintain a spell.

  • If in combat, you recover your Constitution modifier in hit points at the start of each turn. If used outside of combat you instead gain 10 times your Constitution modifier in hit points over the course of 1 minute.

Casting a spell or making an attack roll immediately ends the trance. Once you have used this feature you may not use it again until you finish a long rest.

Kendral Lowd.biographyprivate:
Physically, Kendral has several scars across his face and body. None appear to have cut deep enough to stop him from having full range of motion with his body, though he moves very precisely and cautiously. He is also rarely seen without either fish or fishing gear, and is usually passing through Storsa's Strand either on his way to or from the banks of Lake Mithra.

Personality

Kendral tends to be very matter-of-fact, saying what he means and meaning what he says. He is friendly, if not warm, always ready to lend a hand if things need doing, but preferring to work out any problems he's having on his own. The only exceptions to his generally kind but terse interactions with others are questions and conversations about monsters, which he warns everyone against, and discussions of fish catches, which bring out his competitive nature. He also can be a bit rough on adventurers, as they remind him of what he's lost, but earnestly wants to help them succeed and avoid danger.

Connections

Kendral was once a wizard of the Anaechranum, devoted to the goddess of Magic, Spectra. He fell in love with a fellow Anaechraenum member, Paravi, an acolyte of Lantyr. Together, they traveled the Arctus Plateau as a team in search of rare artifacts, often using Storsa's Strand as a base because of the town's devotion to Lantyr and his family's connection to the place.

Even after Kendral and Paravi had children, they continued on their hunt for important artifacts, training their son and daughter as adventurers, until a chance encounter with a malevolent being caused Kendral to become obsessed with finding and protecting a tower of light hidden somewhere beneath the surface of Ember. This obsession torn apart his life - Paravi left him for a life in Ordain, his daughter was lost and presumed dead during a disastrous trip into the Pathways beneath Ember's surface, and his son devoted himself to finding out exactly what happened to her, driving himself mad trying to reach the Pathways in the process.

Phrases

Set the line, catch the fish. Simple. Like things should be.

Wandering only leads to pain.
Kendral Lowd.biographypublic:
For a Kivahr, descended from the giants of old, the scarred fisher before you seems small, somehow, dwarfed by the fishing pole he carries across his back. He hunches his shoulders, as if trying to fold the top half of his body into the bottom, and takes small steps as he moves forward, each one carefully placed, following some set path that no one else can see.

Kendral Lowd is a fisher who lives in Storsa's Strand and spends most of his time alone, bringing in catch and staring out into the water. Once an adventurer who traveled with his family, he blames himself for letting his obsession with finding and protecting a tower of light in the Pathways beneath Ember's surface cost him everything — his marriage, the life of his daughter, and the sanity of his son. Now, scarred not just by his adventures but by the guilt and loss that he feels, he focuses on the small things - set the line, reel in the fish, sell the fish, eat the meal. Survive.

Agraband Swift.name: Agraband Swift

Leather Armor.name: Leather Armor
Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.descriptionprivate: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Dagger.descriptionpublic: Small, swift, and deadly, the dagger slips between ribs or into gaps in armor with ease, its wicked edge favored by assassins, thieves, and those who prefer a silent kill.

Shortsword.name: Shortsword
Shortsword.descriptionprivate: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Shortsword.descriptionpublic: Tthe shortsword is a straight-bladed weapon which is nimble to wield and quick to strike in close combat. It features a crossguard ideal for parrying incoming blows.

Human Lineage.name: Human Lineage
Human Lineage.description: When you perform a Reaction which involves a Focus cost, you gain +1 Boon on any associated roll.
Human Lineage.actiondesc: When you become Weakened or sustain damage while Weakened, you can activate a burst of extraordinary adrenaline called Blaze. You immediately replenish your Action and Focus pools to their maximum value.

Bard.name: Bard
Bard.description:
You practice the oral and musical traditions of heroic storytelling to inspire courage in your allies, demoralize your foes, and be quick with unconventional solutions to problems.

You learn Rune: Soul if you do not already know it. When restoring the morale of allies using the Rune of Spirit you gain +2 Boons to your roll.
Bard.actiondesc:
When an enemy uses an attack that fails to affect you or any ally, you construct a cutting jest or pantomime which makes a fool of their feeble effort.

You make an Performance skill attack against the target's Fortitude, dealing Psychic damage to Morale upon a success. Furthermore, upon a success, the target suffers 1 Bane to all rolls until the start of their next turn.

The target must be able to see and understand you to be affected by this ability.

Inspire Heroism.name: Inspire Heroism
Inspire Heroism.description: Your courageous presence inspires your nearby allies to strike with confidence.
Inspire Heroism.actiondesc: Each ally, excluding yourself, within 10 Feet gains +1 Boon to actions performed until the end of their next Turn.

Extoll Deeds.name: Extoll Deeds
Extoll Deeds.description: You inspire courage within your allies by extolling the heroic deeds of a companion. You may react by composing a verse, making a quip, or shouting a battle cry when an ally you can see Incapacitates or achieves a Critical Hit against an enemy creature. The celebration of these heroic deeds restores the Morale of your allies within 6 spaces.
Extoll Deeds.actiondesc: You compose a verse, make a quip, or shout a battle cry to extoll the heroic deeds of one of your allies. All allies near to you regain Morale equal to half your Presence score.

Inspirator.name: Inspirator
Inspirator.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Soul. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[inspired] condition on Critical Hits.

The Inspired effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Presence score as additional Restoration to Morale.

Performance Journeyman.name: Performance Journeyman
Performance Journeyman.description: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Performance skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.

Gesture: Pulse.name: Gesture: Pulse
Gesture: Pulse.description:
Expel the arcane power of a Rune in a radius that travels outward with you at its center.

The Pulse gesture scales using Presence and produces an emanation with 10 foot radius, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Agraband's Kithara.name: Agraband's Kithara
Agraband's Kithara.descriptionprivate: This Kithara is one of the first things Agraband purchased with his inherited wealth as an adolescent, a story the bard is fond of telling.
Agraband's Kithara.descriptionpublic: This lacquered six-stringed acoustic instrument has a curved body crafted from patinated mahogany. Moonstone sigils are inlaid throughout its fine rosewood fretboard, which has seen countless years of wear from the nimble fingers of a talented player.

Agraband's Lunar Charm.name: Agraband's Lunar Charm
Agraband's Lunar Charm.descriptionprivate: Pulled from the pirate trove his late father left behind, this Lunar Charm has served Agraband as a trusted springboard for countless tales about its origins (tall or otherwise). Whether or not Agraband's charm provides a real element of supernatural luck, he trusts the coin's fortuitousness all the same.
Agraband's Lunar Charm.descriptionpublic: The circumference of this silver coin is marked with the curious symbols of a dead or unknown language, and a small round hole is cut out of its center. One side of the coin is embossed with the image of a strange vessel caught in a tempest, while the other is decorated with a latticed, eight-pointed star: the insignia of Orbis, the Spirit Moon.

Healing Tonic.name: Healing Tonic
Healing Tonic.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to gradually close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Tonic.actiondesc:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Health dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Health each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Health each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Health each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Health each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Health each Round

Rune: Soul.name: Rune: Soul
Rune: Soul.description:
An orderly force of creation and spiritual essence. The Soul rune governs the fundamental procession of souls through life and death and relates to matters of sapience, personality, and mental health.

The Soul rune scales using Presence and provides Restoration of Morale or inflicts Psychic damage opposed by Willpower. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Oblivion.
Rune: Soul.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Illusion.name: Rune: Illusion
Rune: Illusion.description:
The chaotic force of trickery and whimsy. The illusion rune governs magical manifestations of falsehood or misdirection.

The Illusion rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower defense, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Illumination.
Rune: Illusion.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Illusion allows you to fabricate perception in various simple ways and to manipulate shadow and light to create distraction or entertainment, producing one of the following effects:

  • Modify a single aspect of your own physical appearance. Such alterations might include adjusting the sound of your voice, changing the color of your eyes, gaining illusory horns, or appearing slightly taller or shorter. The alteration persists until you Rest or enact a different alteration and can be verified as illusory by physical inspection.

  • Manifest a convincing recreation of a short sound or single scent that you can clearly recall. The illusion originates from your position and lasts for 10 seconds. You can control the volume of the sound or odorousness of the scent to be perceptible up to a range of 60 feet or shorter.

  • Decouple your shadow from your form, specifically controlling its movements separately from your own. You can maintain this illusion as long as you do not perform any other action that consumes Focus.

Seeming may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Light Weapon Training.name: Light Weapon Training
Light Weapon Training.description: You know how to wield light weapons fluidly with a high degree of maneuverability and grace in combat. You are Trained with all weapons in the Light and Balanced categories.
Light Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You dart forward nimbly, making a strike with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a Finesse weapon against a single target with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is Difficult, but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke Disengagement.

Agraband Swift.biographyprivate:
The bard and wayfarer known as Agraband Swift serves as a trusted leader and mentor to the dozens of drivers and patrons under his stead as captain of the Strayhearth Caravan company. Agraband's reputation as an experienced pathfinder of Ember is unparalleled, and his financial support from Ordain's notorious Trading Houses is no small testament to this esteem.

Agraband is always eager to recount a tale pertaining to any geographic region Ember has to offer. Some of his favorite stories include the tale of Sir Prestyn and the Gemstone Queen, the faerie legends of the Lowland Kingdoms, and many an anecdote regarding his own journeys across the northwestern continent of Ember (like that one time he survived a slime-infested slog through the Strider Swamplands without a full set of wheels, or the madcap outcome of Jeth Salva’s nerve-racking ride-along to deliver volatile spark salts to the Kingdom of Swords).

Personality

Impressionable in his adolescence, young Agraband delighted in his father’s accounts of far-off places, with their strange new sights and interesting new people; and while he’d wait at home for these delightful stories, Agraband would also come to learn about the industriousness of his mother’s craft, her passionate resilience and her bittersweet pride. The bard would adopt these traits as part of his own gregarious personality, which has served him well as a professional storyteller and caravaner to this day.

The Strayhearth Caravan itself has an unblemished reputation, and – despite his penchant for tall tales – Agraband Swift is a man not to be trifled with. He takes his work seriously, and treats his cargo and passengers with respect. While his good nature has been tempered by unspoken hardship and familial responsibility, he'll never let go of a certain boyish charm that drives his every step. The songs he sings are the stuff of legends, and an inspiration to all who hear them.

  • Ideals: To chronicle the most interesting tales Ember has to offer and pass them on to future generations of storytellers.

  • Bonds: Aims to provide emotional and financial support for his younger sister Selena and her son Jorey, who dwell in Ordain.

  • Flaws: His intense curiosity for an exceptional, untold tale can outweigh his better judgement.

Connections

Born six decades ago in Ordain’s Docks district, Agraband came of age as the eldest son of a sailor and a seamstress. However, tragedy was always close to home: Agraband’s mother was struck down by the Red Cough when he was only eleven years old; and his father perished at sea less than a year later – but not before sequestering a cache of pirate gold beneath the floorboards of his family’s ramshackle shanty. With the makings of a small fortune and a younger sister Selena in his stead, Agraband vowed to build a better life for them both. The years since have been equally full of mystery, marvel, and mirth — and alliances with organizations from Ordain to the edges of known civilization.

While most of the Strayhearth Caravan’s contracts originate from within or around the Arctus Plateau alongside the various needs of each of Ordain's @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrganizatio.JournalEntryPage.JOQCjyaSIPRhrEd6]{Trading Houses}, Agraband has traveled far and wide during his storied career. He's no stranger to the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrganizatio.JournalEntryPage.lRAxRZ4doNSLC6zw]{Anachraenum} and their allies, and is known to serve as an ace courier from time to time for transport of the organization's most sensitive artifacts. Furthermore, his extensive travels and noteworthy acclaim have earned him friends and associates in every backwater town and bustling metropolis the continent over.

Phrases

May the roads lead you to those unseen places your heart still yearns to find.

This reminds me of a peculiar yarn I used to spin…

Anyone can tell a good story. You need only find yourself within it.
Agraband Swift.biographypublic: Agraband Swift is a wizened raconteur who captains a prestigious trading convoy known as the Strayhearth Caravan. This storied traveler has grayed and mellowed with age, but remains a celebrated bard whose days of daring adventure are far from behind him.
Agraband Swift.biographyappearance: A lute is slung across the back of this aged human clad in an odd yet practical assortment of clothing and jewelry. The seasoned bard wears the salt-and-pepper locks of his long hair pulled back into a high half ponytail. His wide smile and calm demeanor lend him an air of experienced confidence, and a certain glint in his eye evokes the mirthful spirit of a beloved uncle. It's clear this man could spin a worthy tale at a moment’s notice.

Ankarist.name: Ankarist

Draconfang.name: Draconfang
Draconfang.descriptionprivate:
This greatsword was granted to Ankarist many years ago by his patron, Alar. It is paradoxically ancient, and brand new. Draconfang is forged from the shard of a much older blade, one which she granted to a different champion in an age long passed.

This ancient blade, the "Fang of the Horned Mother" shattered in a fateful battle, and marked the loss of Alar's most beloved champion. In the wake of that loss Alar vowed to never reforge the blade, not until she found someone worthy of it.

It has been thousands of years since, and finally, another has been chosen. Though Draconfang looks nothing like the blade it came from, their power is one and the same, and now it is Ankarist's to wield.
Draconfang.descriptionpublic: Longer and heavier than a standard longsword, the greatsword is a two-handed blade meant for powerful sweeping strikes, its length commanding both reach and awe.

Bound to The First.name: Bound to The First
Bound to The First.description:
Ankarist is a Warlock with a rare bargain struck with the ancient goddess Alar. He gains boons and power that mirror her mastering over creation and guardianship.

  • Ankarist is trained in the use of Heavy Weapons.

  • Ankarist knows Rune: Kinesis, Gesture: Strike, and Inflection: Pull.

  • Ankarist knows the iconic spell Bind Armament.

Drakon Lineage.name: Drakon Lineage
Drakon Lineage.description:
You are extraordinarily resistant to the influence of Necromancy and death magic. Spells using the Rune of Death have +2 Banes to their spell attack rolls against you.

You instinctually know the Rune of Flame and can use it for basic spellcraft.
Drakon Lineage.actiondesc:
During moments of great duress, you can harness this power to expel flame in a cone, searing all creatures in your path. You expel draconic flame in a conical area.

This Deadly attack scales using your Toughness and targets the Reflex defense of affected creatures. This action counts as a Natural weapon with which the Drakon is, at least, trained.

Spellblade.name: Spellblade
Spellblade.description:
You are an arcane warrior who can weave together Strike and Spell relying on both martial and arcane techniques in battle. The physical strikes of your weaponry partially substitute for the somatic gestures of traditional spellcraft.

While wielding a Melee weapon as your mainhand weapon, spells you cast using Gesture: Strike benefit from your weapon's damage bonus.

Immediately after performing a Strike with a melee weapon, you may cast a spell with its Action cost reduced by 1.

Opportunistic Spellcraft.name: Opportunistic Spellcraft
Opportunistic Spellcraft.description: Your quick thinking can weave magic to exploit brief windows of opportunity. You may make a Disengagement Attack using the Touch Gesture instead of a melee weapon attack.

Scale Mail.name: Scale Mail
Scale Mail.descriptionpublic: Overlapping metal plates sewn or riveted onto a leather or cloth backing, scale mail resembles the hide of a dragon and protects well against cuts and stabs—though it's noisy and inflexible.

Swipe.name: Swipe
Swipe.description: You perform a broad swipe with your weapon, hitting two adjacent targets within your weapon range.
Swipe.actiondesc: You perform a Strike against two adjacent enemies, attacking both of them using a single swing of your great weapon.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.descriptionpublic: Small, swift, and deadly, the dagger slips between ribs or into gaps in armor with ease, its wicked edge favored by assassins, thieves, and those who prefer a silent kill.

Meteoric Star-Taker.name: Meteoric Star-Taker
Meteoric Star-Taker.descriptionprivate:
A masterwork of of a tool, even the lunar elements bear special attention, with each moon being marked with a appropriately colored gem, save for Akon, which is marked with a piece of dark stone which may well be a piece of the moon itself. This handheld marvel of Tayan engineering can be used as Navigator's Tools, and its impeccable design gives Ankarist advantage on any such actions.

When Ankarist was first fleeing the Tayan Empire, this device was loaned to him by a friend to help him chart his course toward a meeting point. Unfortunately, said ally never turned up at the meeting point, and never reclaimed the Star-Taker. Ankarist has kept it with him ever since as a reminder of the sacrifices others made to help him. Some foolish part of him hopes that one day his friend will reappear, asking for his tool back.
Meteoric Star-Taker.descriptionpublic: Crafted from meteoric steel, this astronomical instrument bears a star chart and model of Ember's sky etched in excruciating detail. The rotating dials, arms and measures are precise, and embellished in Tayan fashion, making no mystery of its origin.

Strong Grip.name: Strong Grip
Strong Grip.description: Your grasp of your weaponry is firm and unyielding. You can perform Actions which require a free hand while wielding a two-handed melee weapon. Attempts to Disarm you are made with +2 Banes.

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Rune: Control.name: Rune: Control
Rune: Control.description:
The orderly force of discipline and permanence. The Control rune governs thought, reason, and persistence.

The Control rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Kinesis.
Rune: Control.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Control allows you to affect the decision making of others in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Moderately intensify or dampen the primary emotion being felt by a creature you touch. If the creature is intelligent enough to be aware of the laws governing spellcraft, they are aware of your actions.

  • Understand the abstract motivations of another living creature which allows you to touch it. You are able to intuit their immediate goals expressed in the form of a single verb.

  • Intensely focus on your current objective and the means of achieving it. You receive a brief hint or reminder from the Gamemaster about that objective containing only information which you have previously learned.

Motivate may only affect a creature or object which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Kinesis.name: Rune: Kinesis
Rune: Kinesis.description:
The chaotic force of space and physical movement. The Kinesis rune governs all things related to the act of movement and physicality.

The Kinesis rune scales using Presence, targets Physical defense, and deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Control.
Rune: Kinesis.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Inflection: Pull.name: Inflection: Pull
Inflection: Pull.description: Empower a spell to attract affected creatures toward the caster. Creatures affected by a spell with the Pull inflection move 1 space closer towards the spellcaster if that destination space is unoccupied.

Gesture: Arrow.name: Gesture: Arrow
Gesture: Arrow.description:
You hurl a projectile imbued with the magical power of a Rune at a distant target.

The Arrow gesture scales using Intellect and targets a single creature up to a distance of 60 feet, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Strike.name: Gesture: Strike
Gesture: Strike.description:
You empower a direct close-range attack with the arcane essence of a Rune, performing a Strike with your equipped weapon.

The Strike gesture scales using Strength and deal damage based on your used weapon but with the damage type of the incorporated Rune. This gesture does not require any free hand and has a base cost of 1 Focus in addition to the cost of your weapon Strike.

Bind Armament.name: Bind Armament
Bind Armament.description:
You bind the weapon currently equipped in your main-hand as your Bound Armament.

While bound, you may conjure the weapon into a free hand without any resource cost. You can conjure the weapon across any distance including if it has been Disarmed.
actiondesc: You bind the weapon currently equipped in your main-hand as your Bound Armament.
You call your bound armament back into your grasp. As long as you have sufficient free hands to hold it, the weapon returns instantaneously to you and is no longer Disarmed.

Heavy Weapon Training.name: Heavy Weapon Training
Heavy Weapon Training.description: You know how to use a heavy weapon to deliver punishing blows, putting your entire strength behind every swing. You are Trained with all weapons in the Heavy and Balanced categories.
Heavy Weapon Training.actiondesc: You unleash a powerful Strike with your mainhand weapon. The attack is slower to execute, but is Empowered to deliver additional damage.

Ankarist.biographyprivate:
The Drakon known simply as Ankarist is a fledgeling warlock of the Elder God Alar and a seasoned investigator within the ranks of the Veiled Chain, the protectorate of the great city of Ordain. An expatriate of the Tayan Empire, Ankarist is a reserved and stolid individual who is loathe to discuss his mysterious past with anyone other than his closest intimates — of which there are extremely few.

Ankarist has served the Veiled Chain for nearly a decade, and occasionally serves as an Ordani envoy to western cities like Casla Brava and beyond. Within the confines of the city, Ankarist's duties are varied and never-ending, and his assistance with any investigation is considered a potent asset. Many Ordani citizens know tales of the "Drakon investigator," whose storied reputation for achieving results is as impressive as the blade he wields.

Personality

Ankarist is an intense individual, often quiet and brooding, but only because he often is lost in thought about whatever issue is foremost in his mind. Serious, reserved, and focused, the investigator is a closed book to all but his closest friends, and he has very few of those in the world.

Despite his standoffish nature, Ankarist is a good sort, aiming to do the right thing where and when possible. When torn between his quest or assignment and his morals, he may err on the side of his orders, though it rarely sits well with him when he does.

As a first generation Drakon from the Tayan empire, he has sought to put as much distance between himself and his homeland as possible. He rarely speaks about why, preferring the topic be dropped when raised.

  • Ideals: There is good in most people, and true evil is rare.

  • Bonds: He serves the greater good through the Veiled Chain and his otherworldly pact with Alar.

  • Flaws: He never hesitates to confront villainy or injustice, even if the moment is unfavorable.

Connections

He reports directly to @UUID[Actor.m7bwxaSeiblzYyJw]{Shaar}, but is usually given ample leeway to pursue investigations he wants to undertake. He is also also a potent Warlock with a pact binding himself to @UUID[JournalEntry.emberDeities0000.JournalEntryPage.gyNN8Hkjc23LRqsn]{Alar}.

Much of Ankarist's past remains the mystery even to him. His memories begin in the midst of the Night of Swords, a bloody purging of a government he had never even known. With his only choices being act or die, his instincts took over, and allowed him to narrowly escape dire ends. The rest of the night was a blur of unresolved questions, barked orders, and desperate decisions that left him in the company of a murderers and seditionists. None of this sat well with him, but what choice did he have?

In the weeks to follow his new allies continued to lay the groundwork for a new government, the Tayan Empire, and at its head, a Queen of unrivaled power. With nowhere else to go, no other options before him, and still grappling with the questions of who and what he was, Ankarist was given the offer to join the young Empire, and become part of its foundation. His uncertainty was great, however, and he wondered if perhaps there was another option.

As time went on, the prospects for his kind grew more dubious, and the foundations of the new empire being laid concerned him greatly. Uncertain what to do and where to go, Ankarist was on the verge of letting himself become a pawn to a queen that sat on a throne drenched in blood.

Thankfully, a powerful stranger helped him change his course. The Elder Goddess Alar in disguise spoke to him, gave him insights into coming events, and urged him to choose a different path. Though she spoke to many others, as far as Ankarist knows, he was the only one to commit to escaping the empire, and the only one to make it out. As thanks, he agreed to serve Alar was a champion, making him as a Warlock of the elder goddess.

In the time since he traveled far from the empire, settled in Ordain, and slowly made a new life for himself. Now he's a respected member of the Ordani goverment in their Veiled Chain organization.

Phrases

There is always more in play than we are aware of. The trick is to keep that in mind without letting yourself become distracted looking for what you missed.
Ankarist.biographypublic: Ankarist is a seasoned investigator and martial protector of Ordain. His accent, mannerisms, and bearing betray a Tayan heritage, although it's clear he no longer considers himself part of that fold. The masterwork greatsword at his side has an air of the abstruse about it, and he often wields the massive weapon as one might hold a sacred relic or cherished instrument. Ankarist is a serious fellow, full of grit and resolve.
Ankarist.biographyappearance: You observe a stern Drakon warrior with a determined expression and piercing golden eyes. Clad in leather armor reinforced with steel, his martial prowess is immediately apparent in the way he handles the hefty greatsword at his side — a hulking blade with a wide, flared tip. This two-handed brand is obviously venerated by the Drakon, who regards the blade with marked discipline. A cloak pin on his breast bears the symbol of the Veiled Chain, the city of Ordain's noble protectorate.

Clipper.name: Clipper

Merchant's Messenger.name: Merchant's Messenger
Merchant's Messenger.descriptionpublic:
A small brass coin with a broad, grinning face and little red garnet eyes. The coin is stamped with a specific sequence of sigils that link it with a sibling coin, allowing the two holders to communicate over vast distances.

If you hold the coin and speak to it, the coin immediately connects its sibling and begins speaking loudly, relaying what you're saying and what is said back. The connection lasts for up to 1 minute before the connection breaks. Each coin can be used once per long rest.

The coin may be used 5 times after which its magic fades, becoming nearly worthless.

Clipper's Endless Scroll.name: Clipper's Endless Scroll
Clipper's Endless Scroll.descriptionprivate:
This mystic scroll is designed to be functionally limitless, always able to extend itself to add more writing room. Clipper can even stretch the scroll, creating new space in between lines in case she wants to add onto an existing thought.

The origin of this scroll is the Starsworn Academy, though Clipper is quick to point that they've never been to the academy (yet), and this particular scroll was traded off of a wandering Star Mage for a hefty price.

The specific limitations of the scroll are unknown even to Clipper, but they keep the scroll in their bag of holding since it's the only container big enough to handle the ever growing volume of the roll.
Clipper's Endless Scroll.descriptionpublic: A magically enhanced roll of vellum covered in hundreds of inscrutable notes penned in Clipper's own shorthand.

Signborn Lineage.name: Signborn Lineage
Signborn Lineage.description:
You have two ethereal arms in addition to your corporeal limbs. These arms may not wield weapons, shields, or other equipment. They can be used, however, to quickly manipulate items in addition to your regular limbs. Once per Round you may equip an Item from your inventory without spending any Action points to do so.

Using special Signborn language and physiology, you synchronize your ethereal limbs into the weaving of spellcraft to effortlessly perform feats of magic. You know the unique Glyphspeak inflection which can be added to spells. A spell augmented with Glyphspeak costs +1 Heroism to cast, but can be performed at a reduced cost of -2 Action.

Enchanting Novice.name: Enchanting Novice
Enchanting Novice.description:
You have received training in the fundamentals of Enchantment and are capable of working with most common charms and enchantments.

You still need to reference recipes and books to identify sympathetic materials and their properties.

Mnemonic Realization.name: Mnemonic Realization
Mnemonic Realization.description:
Your sharpened mind is full of secrets and techniques to remember them. Once per Day you may focus your thoughts and attempt to recall a word that sparks your memory.

The Gamemaster must provide you with a one-word clue that is appropriate for your direction of inquiry. It is left to Gamemaster discretion how direct or vague to be with the clue they provide.
Mnemonic Realization.actiondesc: You survey your memories attempting to recall a clue for your current situation.

Preparedness.name: Preparedness
Preparedness.description: You seem to always be prepared for the moment at hand. You may sacrifice your free movement for the Round to instead equip an Item from your inventory without spending any Action points.

Diversionist.name: Diversionist
Diversionist.description: You specialize in using subterfuge to distract or trick your opponent during combat.
Diversionist.actiondesc: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.

Provocateur.name: Provocateur
Provocateur.description: You specialize in barbed repartee crafted to highlight your opponent's shortcomings. In combat you can launch quips which provoke your foes.
Provocateur.actiondesc: You exaggerate your opponent's shortcomings with a scathing bon mot, performing a Diplomacy skill attack against your target's Willpower. On a success they suffer modest Psychic damage to Morale and become Enraged for 1 Round.

Gesture: Arrow.name: Gesture: Arrow
Gesture: Arrow.description:
You hurl a projectile imbued with the magical power of a Rune at a distant target.

The Arrow gesture scales using Intellect and targets a single creature up to a distance of 60 feet, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Inflection: Quicken.name: Inflection: Quicken
Inflection: Quicken.description: Enhance a spell by hastening the speed with which it can be cast, at the expense of increased Focus. The Quicken inflection reduces the Action cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Focus cost by 1 in exchange.

Padded Armor.name: Padded Armor
Padded Armor.descriptionpublic: Consisting of quilted layers of cloth stuffed with rags or wool, padded armor cushions the body against blunt force and serves as the foundation beneath heavier gear.

Healing Tonic.name: Healing Tonic
Healing Tonic.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to gradually close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Tonic.actiondesc:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Health dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Health each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Health each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Health each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Health each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Health each Round

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Bag of Holding.name: Bag of Holding
Bag of Holding.descriptionpublic: This spectacularly worked satchel features elaborate ornamentation that makes it clear it is no simple pack. While Equipped and Invested, your carrying capacity is tripled.

Ortarec Wand.name: Ortarec Wand
Ortarec Wand.descriptionprivate: Commonly seen in the hands of Cascilian mage-hunters, this one hangs from Clipper's belt in case it might ever come in handy. Clipper claims they won it from a Cascilian sea captain a few years ago in a card game, though the story is never quite consistent enough to feel like the whole truth.
Ortarec Wand.descriptionpublic: This finely crafted wooden wand features a varnished and polished handle and elegantly swooping crest that bears Cascilian magical symbols. Suspended inside the head of the wand is an orb of Ortarec infused stone which helps to siphon magic into the wand, recharging it, and assists in the detection of magic when active.

Aedir Spellband.name: Aedir Spellband
Aedir Spellband.descriptionprivate: Whether this ring is authentic, or simply designed to mimic the style is a mystery not even Clipper knows the answer to.
Aedir Spellband.descriptionpublic: This ring made of an opaque stone that has been carefully carved with graceful, sweeping layers evoking an ancient Aedir aesthetic. The ring serves as a powerful spellcasting focus for the Invested wearer.
Aedir Spellband.actiondesc:
In moments of duress you can withdraw an additional reserve of Focus from this band. The amount of Focus restored depends on the enchantment bonus of the ring.

  • Minor enchantment: 4 Focus

  • Major enchantment: 6 Focus

  • Legendary enchantment: 8 Focus

Rune: Kinesis.name: Rune: Kinesis
Rune: Kinesis.description:
The chaotic force of space and physical movement. The Kinesis rune governs all things related to the act of movement and physicality.

The Kinesis rune scales using Presence, targets Physical defense, and deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Control.
Rune: Kinesis.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Illusion.name: Rune: Illusion
Rune: Illusion.description:
The chaotic force of trickery and whimsy. The illusion rune governs magical manifestations of falsehood or misdirection.

The Illusion rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower defense, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Illumination.
Rune: Illusion.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Illusion allows you to fabricate perception in various simple ways and to manipulate shadow and light to create distraction or entertainment, producing one of the following effects:

  • Modify a single aspect of your own physical appearance. Such alterations might include adjusting the sound of your voice, changing the color of your eyes, gaining illusory horns, or appearing slightly taller or shorter. The alteration persists until you Rest or enact a different alteration and can be verified as illusory by physical inspection.

  • Manifest a convincing recreation of a short sound or single scent that you can clearly recall. The illusion originates from your position and lasts for 10 seconds. You can control the volume of the sound or odorousness of the scent to be perceptible up to a range of 60 feet or shorter.

  • Decouple your shadow from your form, specifically controlling its movements separately from your own. You can maintain this illusion as long as you do not perform any other action that consumes Focus.

Seeming may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Talisman Weapon Training.name: Talisman Weapon Training
Talisman Weapon Training.description: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft. You are Trained with weapons in the Talisman categories.
Talisman Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a Harmless Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a critical success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.

Dagger.name: Dagger
Dagger.descriptionpublic: Small, swift, and deadly, the dagger slips between ribs or into gaps in armor with ease, its wicked edge favored by assassins, thieves, and those who prefer a silent kill.

Glyphweaving Novice.name: Glyphweaving Novice
Glyphweaving Novice.description:
You have received training in the fundamentals of Glyphweaving and are capable of working with most common glyphs and engravings.

You still need to reference recipes and books to identify particular glyphs and their properties.

Clipper.biographyprivate:
Clipper eagerly operates a small, wandering storefront from the confines of a bag of holding strapped to their waist, and maintains a proud inventory of the items contained within on a long parchment scroll. This includes a modest array of mundane equipment, an assortment of curious trinkets, and a few common magic items.

Originally from the coastal city of Stake, this far-traveled vendor spent an adventurous youth in the good-natured company of their parents: a famed duo of Maziran circus performers named The Fabulous Funambulists of New Pharos. Among this carnival’s motley troupe of entertainers and an endless sea of crowds, Clipper learned the street-wise ways of the urban trickster, and became a canny if cordial businessperson while honing their innate sorcerous talents.

Personality

Feisty, bright-eyed, and full of pep, Clipper is a somewhat unpredictable companion to Agraband Swift and his famed Arcturian caravan. Clipper rarely sits still, and can be seen fidgeting with trinkets, bouncing from foot to foot, constantly surveying their surroundings for anything interesting. Even when engaged with a customer, Clipper is always in motion — juggling their inventory, using broad gestures to communicate, and peppering their negotiations with small magical flourishes.

Clipper is an ambitious peddler of curious goods for anyone with appropriate coin to spare (or interesting trinkets to trade). At any given point in time, Clipper is ready to produce an item from their trusty bag of holding, or manifest a simple illusion to describe an item in riveting detail. Ultimately, Clipper wishes see the wide world of Ember, experience all of its interesting people and places, and gather up valuable items for trade along the way. One day, perhaps, they'll set up a proper shop somewhere; but not today.

  • Ideals: Exploration is the foundation of commerce!

  • Bonds: Loyal to Agraband Swift and the Strayhearth Caravan.

  • Flaws: Values wealth and treasure more than stability.

Connections

Many of Clipper's most enduring connections stem from their earliest days. Clipper treasures their Signborn parents, Caira and Cade (aka The Fabulous Funambulists of New Pharos), and the other circus performers of their famed troupe in Tempest. Clipper also owes a vague debt to “Badhand” Borios, the eccentric Aster owner of the Arcanist’s Emporium in Toraga, but details about this obligation are scarce.

Since leaving the Maziran Kingdoms, Clipper has been allied with @UUID[Actor.IsfSfKd2S9mIJsyw]{Agraband Swift}’s Strayhearth Caravan, and is eager to repay the kindness they've received from the old caravaner himself. Indeed, Agraband serves as an ersatz uncle to Clipper, who loves to share eccentric stories of home with the aged storyteller.

Phrases

The right purchase can make all the difference!

Your ol' pal Clipper has just what we need…

If you can dream it, we can scheme it!
Clipper.biographypublic: Clipper is an exuberant young merchant who frequents Arcturian trade routes with Agraband Swift and the Strayhearth Caravan.
Clipper.biographyappearance:
You hear the sound of jingling bells as a purple-skinned Signaran with a slight build draws your attention. Crowned in a feathered mop of cerulean- and lavender-streaked hair, this young merchant's bright cobalt eyes and wide, sharp-toothed smile reveal an unmistakable affability.

Their clothing suggests origins the world over; hints of Maziran style clash with various accents of places from Old Carinth to Ordain. A sash of hand-written parchment coupons hangs around their neck, and a string of curious, multi-colored stones adorns their waist. Tassels and coins also hang from their ostentatious garments, and two tiny bells chime and jingle upon each ankle.

Lyla Cevher.name: Lyla Cevher

Hand Crossbow.name: Hand Crossbow
Hand Crossbow.descriptionprivate: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Hand Crossbow.descriptionpublic: This palm-sized crossbow trades power for concealability, perfect for close-quarters surprise shots or the desperate last bolt of a cornered rogue.

Rapier.name: Rapier
Rapier.descriptionprivate: Melee Weapon Attack:+4 to hit, 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Rapier.descriptionpublic: Long, slender, and exquisitely balanced, the rapier is a fencer’s weapon of choice, its needle-point tip perfect for lightning-fast thrusts and deadly duels.

Ditchdigger.name: Ditchdigger
Ditchdigger.descriptionprivate: This well-polished parrying dagger is one of several items that is believed to have been carried by one of the original founders of Trading House Cevher, Lottie Cevher. Often given to a promising new star in the upcoming generation of the house, it was willed to Lyla by her grandmother Jelena and added to her pack by her father when she departed Ordain. She's never let it out of her sight since.
Ditchdigger.descriptionpublic: Small, swift, and deadly, the dagger slips between ribs or into gaps in armor with ease, its wicked edge favored by assassins, thieves, and those who prefer a silent kill.

Leather Armor.name: Leather Armor
Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Human Lineage.name: Human Lineage
Human Lineage.description: When you perform a Reaction which involves a Focus cost, you gain +1 Boon on any associated roll.
Human Lineage.actiondesc: When you become Weakened or sustain damage while Weakened, you can activate a burst of extraordinary adrenaline called Blaze. You immediately replenish your Action and Focus pools to their maximum value.

Lyla's Lucky Lantern.name: Lyla's Lucky Lantern
Lyla's Lucky Lantern.descriptionprivate:
This miner’s lantern holds a secret compartment in its base, which Lyla has filled with pieces of rock and ore from successful mining operations as a way to bring herself luck.

In addition to its sentimental value, the lantern has a practical use - it shifts slightly in color and intensity to indicate nearby mining conditions, including lack of breathable air, the presence of hazardous fumes, or the presence of a particular ore. These changes are only apparent to Lyla when she is attuned to the lantern, though she believes its mere presence gives her a sense of when danger or opportunity are near.
Lyla's Lucky Lantern.descriptionpublic: This miner's lantern bears some distinctive markings that suggest it may be more than a simple light source.

Operator.name: Operator
Operator.description:
You have ice in your veins and remain cool under pressure. Your physical toughness and mental acuity allow you to hone the danger of your situation to achieve the greatest results when the stakes are highest.

While in combat and not Incapacitated, you gain +1 Boon to all checks when you have less than 50% of your maximum Health remaining. You gain +2 Boons to all checks when you have less than 25% of your maximum Health remaining.

Strategic Repositioning.name: Strategic Repositioning
Strategic Repositioning.description:
You are always thinking ahead about where to position yourself should danger loom. Before Turn 1 of a Combat encounter, provided that you are not Unaware, you may immediately move 4 feet in any permitted direction.

If multiple combatants have this feature, repositioning occurs in reverse order of Initiative.

Subtle Extrication.name: Subtle Extrication
Subtle Extrication.description: You understand how to move away from an opponent without exposing yourself to the worst attacks in return. Any Disengagement Attack against you is performed without the 2 Boons that would ordinarily apply to such an attack.

Weak Points.name: Weak Points
Weak Points.description: You identify moments of opportunity to strike at an enemy's weak points. When attacking a target that is Unaware, Flanked, or Exposed using Finesse weaponry, you gain +2 damage to any Strike.

Dual Wield.name: Dual Wield
Dual Wield.description: You are adept at fighting with two weapons simultaneously. You can weave attacks together to strike more rapidly than possible with a single weapon.
Dual Wield.actiondesc: Immediately after you perform a basic Strike with your mainhand weapon, you make a reduced-cost fullow-up Strike with your offhand weapon.

Perspicacity.name: Perspicacity
Perspicacity.description: You have heightened insight into aspects of your surroundings. You gain +2 Boons to any Awareness skill test which does not rely upon eyesight.

Feinting Strike.name: Feinting Strike
Feinting Strike.description: A two-weapon technique which makes a feint with your primary weapon, exposing your target for an off-hand attack.
Feinting Strike.actiondesc:
You feint with your mainhand weapon, making a Deception attack against the target's Reflex defense. You immediately make a Strike with your offhand weapon.

If your Deception was successful, you gain +2 Boons to your Strike and it deals an additional +6 Damage.

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Light Weapon Training.name: Light Weapon Training
Light Weapon Training.description: You know how to wield light weapons fluidly with a high degree of maneuverability and grace in combat. You are Trained with all weapons in the Light and Balanced categories.
Light Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You dart forward nimbly, making a strike with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a Finesse weapon against a single target with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is Difficult, but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke Disengagement.

Wilderness Novice.name: Wilderness Novice
Wilderness Novice.description:
You have received training in the basics of wilderness survival and traversal. You gain the Novice rank in the Wilderness skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know how to find and construct safe shelter from the elements, to start a fire for warmth, to keep cool in hot environments. You can find safe, drinkable water in most places, and how to identify which plants and animals can serve as safe food sources.

Athletics Novice.name: Athletics Novice
Athletics Novice.description:
You have received training in basic athletics. You gain the Novice rank in the Athletics skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know whether a surface can support your weight or not, how to find handholds while climbing, and how to distribute your weight for buoyancy when swimming. You know how to run for distance, and how to pace yourself to avoid exhaustion.

Lyla Cevher.biographyprivate:
Lyla is the daughter of Ralton Cevher, once head of House Cevher, who recently died, and now she is rushing home to deal with the ensuing chaos. Caught in the middle of her family's expectations for her, and her own ambitions. As one of many children in House Cevher, Lyla has been elevated to become an important figure in the Arcturian economy and political structure, and in time will likely wield great influence and power.

Lyla was raised in lap of luxury, sent to the finest schools available, and studied under world-class tutors who prepared her for a life as a Trade House emissary. From outset she strained against this life, and yearned to find her own path. This put her at odds with most of her family, most of all her father. Though they never become wholly estranged, their relationship was certainly strained and at times borderline hostile.

Lyla would never bring herself to accept the yoke of tradition, and much to the chagrin of her teachers and tutors, always sought to question the methods and reasons behind everything. By the time she was made an emissary she was already notorious for trying to fix what many thought was not broken.

If you asked her, she just saw the cracks and breaks others were blind to.

Lyla keeps diverse company, with all manner of odd contacts and strange friends that one would never expect a Trade House noble to have. These carefully-kept connections give her insight and perspective into worlds to which she would otherwise be a stranger. One of the many lengths Lyla goes to in the delicate game of balancing family expectations with personal goals.

Personality

A little cheeky and headstrong at times, she is a born and bred Ordani filled with ideals of individualism and ambition but shackled to a massive political and economic machine without any say of her own.

From birth Lyla has struggled with the burden of her place in the world and the demands placed on her. She has to care about status quo, and tow the line or risk ruining more lives than just her own.

At the end of the day though, Lyla is determined to make her fate her own, and works to steer the machine from the inside. She knows it's a big task, and not one she is guaranteed to succeed at, but the alternative is letting someone else determine her whole life, and she'll never accept that.

Broadly speaking she is earnest, and even-handed, but reserved, always trying to think out situations before acting. She'll kill if she has to, but only if she has no other options. She often struggled with being her own, independent person and being part of the family business.

  • Ideals: It's always worth seeing the big picture.

  • Bonds: I am loyal to my family, and my house. I would do anything they need.

  • Flaws: If push comes to shove, family comes first, house second, everything else third.

Connections

Lyla is an emissary to @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrganizatio.JournalEntryPage.h9ObbNZE3wenJ4pu]{House Cevher}, and responsible for overseeing operations and holdings around Casla Brava. She is also an influential political figure in Ordain.

She is also an old friend of the god @UUID[JournalEntry.emberDeities0000.JournalEntryPage.q1ZQkDuvlTY1lzaE]{Sigil}, having met and struck of a friendship with them years ago.

Phrases

Things only look simple if you refuse to see the big picture. Mining gems out of a mountain starts with buying wagons and ends with finding someone who wants the gems they'll eventually carry.
Lyla Cevher.biographypublic: Lyla is a well-connected and influential noble from Ordain. She is the daughter of the prestigious Cevher family, which itself commands the great mining trade house of the same name, and holds the position as one of its emissaries.
Lyla Cevher.biographyappearance: A Human who is sharply dressed in a beautiful and richly decorated coat that proudly displays her wealthy background. It's clear from an initial glance at her overall bearing and clothing style that she is from the city of Ordain itself and while she holds herself with a confident air, she is also friendly and welcoming with a slight smile and small laughter lines appearing around her eyes.

Sin Marmot.name: Sin Marmot

Leather Armor.name: Leather Armor
Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Sin's Pyrefly Staff.name: Sin's Pyrefly Staff
Sin's Pyrefly Staff.descriptionprivate:
The caged crystal lantern atop this gnarled elderwood quarterstaff is actually a small topiary that houses a living pyrefly, which is capable of shedding bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. At the cost of 1 Action, you can reduce the light to Dim Light in a 5-foot radius, or raise it again.

During combat, the staff's pyrefly may leave its lantern to remain safe from harm. When the life cycle of the lantern’s pyrefly expires, a new pyrefly arrives to take its place. A traditional Strider implement, this particular staff was a gift from Sin's father when she first set out from Sirewood, and seems remarkably shatterproof due to latent Corebright magic.
Sin's Pyrefly Staff.descriptionpublic: A simple wooden staff around six to eight feet long, the quarterstaff is a deceptively balanced weapon that can be deadly in trained hands.

Sling.name: Sling
Sling.descriptionprivate: A flexible lash of leather affixed to a wooden handle which is capable of flinging rocks or metal bullets with deadly velocity.
Sling.descriptionpublic: A deceptively simple length of cord or leather used to hurl stones at high velocity, the sling is one of the oldest weapons in history—requiring skill, but deadly in trained hands.

Keth Lineage.name: Keth Lineage
Keth Lineage.description:
You thrive on unpredictability and you have a penchant for turning a bad situation into an advantageous one.

  • If you fail using a Skill action, your next action gains the benefit of +1 Boon until the start of your next Turn.

  • If you miss on an Attack action, your next action gains the benefit of +1 Boon until the start of your next Turn.
Keth Lineage.actiondesc: In extraordinary or desperate circumstances, you can make a vicious attack with your sharp teeth. You gnash viciously with your extended jaw of sharp teeth, making a Natural weapon attack with the Deadly property which deals Piercing damage.

Shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
Shapeshifter.description:
You possess supernatural ability to transform your body into the shapes of beasts.

You undergo a transformation where you assume the form of a beast that you are familiar with and which is half your level or less. While transformed you have the exact attributes and abilities of the chosen beast.

Your equipment is magically incorporated into the form that you take, however you gain no benefit from that equipment while transformed.

If your bestial form becomes Incapacitated you revert back to your normal form with any excess damage becoming Wounds. If your Morale is Broken while in beast form your transformation ends and any excess damage becomes Madness.
actiondesc: You assume the form of a beast that you are familiar with of one-half your level or less.
You end your bestial transformation, returning to your normal form.

Natural Weapon Training.name: Natural Weapon Training
Natural Weapon Training.description: You have a developed familiarity with using features of your own body as a natural weapons including claws, jaws, tails, or other mechanisms of self-defense. You are Trained with weapons in the Natural category.
Natural Weapon Training.actiondesc: Immediately after you perform a basic Strike, you perform a reduced-cost follow-up Strike against the same target using a different Natural weapon that you have access to.

Assess Strength.name: Assess Strength
Assess Strength.description:
You take a moment to observe a creature which you can see and develop intuition about its areas of strength.

Perform a Knowledge Test using a Skill chosen by the Gamemaster. On a success, you learn which Defense type of Physical, Fortutude, Willpower, or Reflex is highest for the creature. On a Critical Success you learn the two highest defense types.
Assess Strength.actiondesc: You observe a creature you can see to assess it's notable areas of strength.

Steadfast.name: Steadfast
Steadfast.description: Your patient resolve allows you to endure psychologically grueling ordeals with steadfast determination.
Steadfast.actiondesc: You harden yourself against demoralization. Your Morale is increased by your Wisdom score and you temporarily gain the Resolute condition.

Gesture: Influence.name: Gesture: Influence
Gesture: Influence.description:
You intensify the arcane power of a Rune into a concentrated direct contact which is generally a more powerful evolution of the basic Touch gesture.

The Influence gesture scales using Presence and targets a single adjacent creature. It deals 10 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Ray.name: Gesture: Ray
Gesture: Ray.description:
You funnel the arcane power of a Rune into a point and project it outwards in a beam.

The Ray gesture scales using Wisdom and produces a line that is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Inflection: Compose.name: Inflection: Compose
Inflection: Compose.description: Enhance a spell by taking extra time in its formation, reducing other resource costs in exchange. The Compose inflection reduces the Focus cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Action cost by 1 in exchange.

Sin's Mask.name: Sin's Mask
Sin's Mask.descriptionprivate: While equipped and Invested, you gain +2 Boons against any form of air-borne Poison. You also gain +2 Boons to any Deception check made to conceal your identity.
Sin's Mask.descriptionpublic: The silken fabric of this half-mask is woven to resemble a Canopy Moth of the Corebright forest.

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Wildspeaker.name: Wildspeaker
Wildspeaker.description: You have a preternatural knack for communicating with animals. Through body language and sounds, you are capable of interpreting and communicating in the language of the wilderness.
Wildspeaker.actiondesc:
If you succeed on a [[/skillCheck wilderness 14]] check, you may pose simple questions to a Beast which can perceive you. As long as the creature is not hostile it will respond accurately within the limits of its own knowledge.

  • Beasts with an Intellect score of zero are incapable of understanding you.

  • Beasts with an Intellect score of 1 can only respond with "yes" or "no" responses.

  • Beasts with an Intellect score greater than 1 can provide simple multi-word responses.

Rune: Life.name: Rune: Life
Rune: Life.description:
A chaotic force of creation, responsible for living matter. The Life rune governs health and matters relating to biological growth.

The Life rune scales using Wisdom and provides Restoration of Health or inflicts Poison damage opposed by Fortitude. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Death.
Rune: Life.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Life allows you to stimulate biological growth and nourish physical health, producing one of the following effects:

  • Cultivate 1 cubic foot of existing plants or fungus to rapidly grow to a healthy, blossoming, or harvestable state.

  • Identify a negative physical condition that is affecting a creature such as @Condition[diseased], @Condition[poisoned], @Condition[bleeding], or @Condition[weakened].

  • Verify whether a portion of food or drink is free of contamination from bacteria, parasites, or poison.

Bloom may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Frost.name: Rune: Frost
Rune: Frost.description:
The orderly force of water and cold. The Frost rune governs the creation of water or other fluids and their transfer between liquid and frozen states.

The Frost rune scales using Wisdom, targets Fortitude, and deals Cold damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Flame.
Rune: Frost.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Frost allows you to manipulate liquids and their thermal properties, producing one of the following effects:

  • Draw up to one quarter gallon of fresh water from the atmosphere into a container or upon a surface you touch. The created water may be affected by relevant atmospheric properties of your current location.

  • Manipulate the temperature of up to 1 gallon of water, causing it to immediately freeze or thaw. The water need not be in a container; this technique can be used to coat a surface or join two objects together via regelation. Ice created in this way remains frozen for as long as the ambient temperature of the environment allows.

  • Gather up to a six-foot cube of nearby snow, forming it into a solidified sculpture, shape, or shelter.

Condense may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Sin Marmot.biographyprivate:
A native of the @UUID[JournalEntry.xqx0clu8pT4kRxAz.JournalEntryPage.ntef4M02D50Y8BlE]{Corebright Forest}, Sin grew up in and around the Striders of Sirewood in the Briar Peaks hinterlands, where she quickly distinguished herself as talented young druid among circles there.

She exhibited an ability to connect with the Core of the World and the energies of nature far sooner than most, and wielded the magic with great, natural skill. In short order she was a fully fledged druid of the wilds and mentored under a well respected elder for deeper education in ceremony and magics.

However, Sin found the druid explanations for nature, growth, and the core wanting. She couldn't explain why, or how, but she knew there was more to understand about Ember, and her elders wouldn't be the ones to teach her. Fortunately for her, the circle she was a part of was playing host to a traveling scholar from the distant Arctus Plateau, and she was chosen to be his escort.

The pairing was a perfect one, as the scholar wanted to learn all about the views and beliefs of the Striders, and Sin got access to a trove of knowledge about the world beyond. Through this Sage she learned that the Striders weren't the only people with a deep connection to Ember, and there were others who possibly had a deeper, stronger understanding of it. The people of the Arctus Plateau, she learned, had a powerful faith that centered around understanding and connecting with the true Heart of Ember — the Cindaric Sages.

Over several months she learned all that she possibly could from this visiting Sage, and when it was time for him to carry on his travels, she packed up her belongings, and set off in the opposite direction, on her truest path. Now she wants nothing more than to join the Sages of Ordain, and learn what they know about Ember and the power deep within it.

Personality

Sin is a bright-eyed, chipper sort who is traveling through the world with altruistic purpose and unflappable drive. She believes that helping people and unity is the key to happiness and peace, and always does her best to leave a place better than when she found it.

Idealistic to the core, and wanting to believe the best of everyone, there is an air of naivety about her that tends to blind her to people's more unsavory sides, or blind her to truths if they don't align with what she believes. However, she is no fool, and will rapidly adjust her understanding of situations as the need arises, no matter how painful it might be.

Always eager to help, and believing that her magic is a gift from Ember meant for that express purpose, Sin throws herself headlong into any tasks that she believes will improve the state of things. Whether they do or not is beside the point.

While not a pacifist, Sin avoids violence as best able, and rarely fights to kill.

  • Ideals: I want to use my powers to help others, and to protect Ember itself.

  • Bonds: I will do anything to become a member of the Cindaric Sages.

  • Flaws: My devotion to the sages can blind me to the truth.

Connections

Sin is connected to the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCultures000.JournalEntryPage.VHQNztu45XEHuvtY]{Striders} of her homeland. She was raised in this culture, and learned to be a druid through them.

Phrases

If you can help someone, you should. A little sacrifice of yourself can mean the world to another!
Sin Marmot.biographypublic: Sin Marmot is a seasoned traveler and skillful druid of the Striders. She is driven forward by her desire to help people and learn more about her connection to Ember and it's chaotic life energies.
Sin Marmot.biographyappearance: A Keth with a friendly demeanor and wide blue eyes and a strange half-mask that covers her mouth. She seems to view everything around her with an air of wondrous innocence but her keen glances also suggest the ability to read any given situation quickly and she may be more capable than she appears at first glance.
