Gang Grappler.name: Gang Grappler
Gang Grappler.description: The [[lookup @name]] has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature that is Grappled by it or one of its allies within 5 feet.

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: [[lookup @name]] makes three attacks using [[/item .rMFRvxQdVU7rGj7l]] or [[/item .dx2ultd9nRLKteSV]].

Command Scalemaw.name: Command Scalemaw
Command Scalemaw.description:
The [[lookup @name]] speaks a command in Wyrdic to a Scalemaw within 20 feet that can hear it, directing the creature to attack a specific target.

The Scalemaw gains Advantage to the first attack it makes against that target until the end of its next turn.

Spinebite.name: Spinebite
Spinebite.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. See @UUID[Actor.WgXxUcogizL8D5Rh.Item.xREXwthThbqpCwSi]{Brutal Blow} for additional information.

The signature weapon of Raster Thorn, the Toothbreaker gang boss, this maul is fashioned from the spinal column of a giant Scalemaw, and embedded along its shaft are vicious teeth and dorsal spines that make the weapon unpredictably vicious.

Brutal Blows.name: Brutal Blows
Brutal Blows.description:
[[lookup @name]] is trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

Additionally, [[lookup @name]] has weapon mastery with his Maul, Spinebite, allowing him to use it's Graze action when he misses with an attack roll.

Trap Weapon.name: Trap Weapon
Trap Weapon.description:
Trigger: [[lookup @name]] is hit by a melee attack.

Response: [[lookup @name]] traps the weapon using the hooked spikes of Spinebite. The attacker cannot make further attacks using that same weapon for the rest of their turn nor can they move away from [[lookup @name]] without dropping their trapped weapon.

Raster Thorn.biographyprivate:
Raster Thorn is a cunning and brutal Waerd fighter who was displaced from the Lowland Kingdoms several years ago and has migrated to Ordain to establish himself as a ruthless gang boss of the Toothbreakers, an emerging criminal organization based in the Concourse district of Ordain.

Personality

Raster is cruel and calculating, he sees opportunity in the pain of others and views his own strength as the self-entitled permission — if not mandate — to take what he wants by force. Raster respects strength in others whether it be physical or mental toughness. He appreciates tactical acumen, and is susceptible to the suggestions of others if they are based on sound logic or shrewd reasoning.

Raster Thorn has a special fondness for Scalemaws, the great reptilian creatures that he shipped to Ordain from his homelands. He has identified the waterworks in the Concourse as an ideal urban habitat for the creatures and takes great care to nurture and train them.

Raster develops skills in his organization, viewing it as an important investment in success. He genuinely cares about other Toothbreakers, although not enough that he would ever sacrifice his own freedom or life for them. He will do what is within his power, though, to further the development of the group and he provides generously for his gang, spending the material wealth the Toothbreakers acquire on investments that benefit the entire group.

Connections

Raster has few connections in Ordain, which makes him especially difficult for the Veiled Chain to track and leverage. His autonomy is his strength, but it also leaves him isolated. There are no allies who would come to his aid, at least, not until recently.

Raster Thorn struck up a deal with @UUID[Actor.0XaohuZ6O3yijRTb]{Serethus} and @UUID[Actor.8jqTLAW121XrQiTN]{Kaftor Brenk}, arranging mutually beneficial exchange between the Mutagists and the Toothbreakers. Raster knows little of the Mutagists true goals, nor does he particularly care, but he is willing to do business with them. The Toothbreakers have been recently engaging in human trafficking; providing Kaftor with a supply of healthy test subjects in exchange for valuable goods and samples of their blaze-infused mutagen.

Raster has some old allegiances and enemies from his time in the Lowland Kingdoms. He bears an especially deep grudge against Tayans, having been betrayed by them leading to his downfall and exile.

Phrases

When attacked:

It's your move, and you'd better not waste it because it's the last one you've got.

When wounded:

Yes, that will leave a beautiful scar to help me remember you long after your bones are dust.

When dealing damage:

Taste Spinebite and know what it feels to be hunted by Raster Thorn!
Raster Thorn.biographypublic:
This hulking man grins with a sinister smirk that suggests confidence and a capacity for sudden and brutal violence. He is a human who stands 6 and a half feet tall. He wears tightly fitted scaled armor and across his shoulders is dramed a magnificent scaled cloak of cured leather and ornamental bone fastenings.

His meaty hands carry a brutal looking maul, its central metal haft covered in bone fragments which give it a wicked bite. You sense that the the residual bloodstains on many of these teeth are genuine. The man's helm is the skull of a particularly large Scalemaw that has been hollowed out and fashioned into a protective headdress.

The man stares at you, his eyes locked on yours and waiting for you to flinch or make the first move.

Raster Thorn is the vicious gang boss of the Toothbreakers, a lawless organization of fighters who have taken control of the Concourse district of Ordain and operate from within their fortified stronghold in the waterworks of that district.

Toothbreaker Thug.name: Toothbreaker Thug

Gang Grappler.name: Gang Grappler
Gang Grappler.description: The [[lookup @name]] has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature that is Grappled by it or one of its allies within 5 feet.

Toothbreaker Thug.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

Toothbreaker Thugs may hail from any humanoid ancestry, although the majority are Human. To thrive within the gang's competitive environment requires strength and toughness, which are valued in prospective recruits above other attributes by Raster's ringleaders. Consequently the most common non-human ancestries among the gang are Kivahr, Cor'ak, and Drakon.

Behavior

Most Toothbreakers are not Waerds, but cultural traditions of the Waerds run strong throughout the gang. Raster Thorn runs the operation according to a clearly regimented set of rules and expectations that emphasizes tactical discipline and unflinching strength.

Many of the Toothbreakers were cast-offs or criminals who had no secure home, and Raster's oversight has created a place where they feel belonging and revel in their own power. The Toothbreakers are fiercely loyal and will die for each other and follow Raster's commands without question.

Lore

The Toothbreakers were created six years ago after Raster Thorn arrived in Ordain. Originally they operated throughout the city, but in the past years Raster has tightened the scope of his operation to focus specifically on the Concourse and the adjacent waterfront distrinct. Their territory is limited in size, but ironclad in their control. The Toothbreakers have no rivals to speak of and run roughshod over any attempt by the Veiled Chain to restrict or combat their operations in the Concourse.
Toothbreaker Thug.biographypublic:
A brutish figure clad in banded leather adorned with bone fragments stands before you. Their posture suggests that not only are they prepared for a fight, but they would relish the opportunity should your actions invite conflict.

Toothbreaker Thugs form the majority of Raster Thorn's lawless gang. They are a motely band of Arcturian mercenaries, Ordani castoffs, and displaced Waerds who have established a criminal family within the Concourse district of Ordain. They are fiercely loyal to the group and quick to violence whenever anyone stands in their way.

Del Kalais.name: Del Kalais

Veiled Presence.name: Veiled Presence
Veiled Presence.description: While moving through the streets of Ordain, [[lookup @name]] can utilize crowds as cover, gaining &reference[advantage] on &reference[stealth] checks while doing so. While hidden, he is indistinguishable from @UUID[Actor.pxvrzj4uE4tVFzYL]{Ordani Cityfolk}.

Manacles.name: Manacles
Manacles.description:
As a Utilize action, you can use Manacles to bind an unwilling Small or Medium creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the &Reference[Grappled], &Reference[Incapacitated], or &Reference[Restrained] condition if you succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. While bound, a creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls, and the creature is Restrained if the Manacles are attached to a chain or hook that is fixed in place. Escaping the Manacles requires a successful DC 20 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check as an action. Bursting them requires a successful DC 25 Strength (Athletics) check as an action.

Each set of Manacles comes with a key. Without the key, a creature can use Thieves' Tools to pick the Manacles' lock with a successful [[/tool thief dex 15]] check.

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description: If [[lookup @name]] is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the save and only half damage if he fails. He can't use this trait if he has the Incapacitated condition.

Del Kalais.biographyprivate:
Del grew up in Ordain, in a house built on the tumultuous crossroads of trade and law. With a father working the Trading House as a guard and a mother who made and upheld laws within the Hallows, as a result, Del watched worlds clash from an early age.

As a young man he studied law, to became a barrister in the bustling courts, but was pressured into his father's line of work as a guard. Unable to tell his father no, he ended up patrolling the docks, bored out of his mind but bound by familial expectation. As he grew up he continued to grapple with the ideals of security vs justice and profit vs ethics.

This inner debate didn't last long though, as he soon found and began unraveling a long-running smuggling ring. Guided by instinct and finding success in stubborn legwork, he soon had collected enough information and evidence to shut the whole thing down. However, when he tried to take it to his superiors, they wanted to hear nothing of it. Confused, he kept digging, and learned that his own people were involved.

Without any other option, he began raising the case to anyone in the Hallows that would listen, but each inspector the Hallows sent came back holding a bag of coin, having seen nothing amiss. However, someone else did see him: the Veiled Chain. Before long he was contacted by interested parties who wanted his collected information, and wanted to do something about what he'd found. In that moment his fate was sealed, and he joined the Veiled Chain.

Personality

Del is a chatty sort, always ready with an off-kilter joke or observation, always pointing out oddities in the environment as he sees them. It's easy to mistake this for pointless noise, but in truth, it reveals how dangerously observant Del truly is. He’s thoughtful, deliberate, and always watching, with a mind that leaps sideways to unusual connections.

He rarely trusts at first, pushing people away out of habit and a hard-earned caution. He constantly doubts himself, worrying about crossing lines in the pursuit of justice. He’s highly perceptive, loves puzzles and riddles, and his sense of humor is dry, if a little odd.

Connections

Del is a well-respected senior member of the Veiled Chain, Ordain’s secret order of investigators and watchers. He maintains friendships with a handful of Hallows barristers, Trading House guards, and a few loyal dockworkers, but keeps his real work close and compartmentalized. He distrusts official enforcers and corrupt officials, always taking care that his dealings are on the up and up.

Phrases

Sometimes it’s not about what you see, but what everyone else missed.

The truth isn’t always kind, but it’s all we’ve got.

Trust is a commodity you earn and spend, and you’d better be ready to earn it, cause it spends easy.
Del Kalais.biographypublic:
You see a tired-looking Signborn man with dusky purple-gray skin and curved violet horns, dark stubble covers his jaw, threatening to become a beard any day, and his eyes are sharp despite the clear fatigue in them. Two extra, spectral arms flow from his shoulders, swirling with strands of violet, blue and white light. He is not openly armed, but hardly seems defenseless.

[[lookup @name]] is an investigator for the Veiled Chain who often talks more than he listens, but misses nothing though his patter and small talk. Though his methods can be odd, bordering on flippant, he genuinely tries to do good with his authority.

Precise.name: Precise

Hypervigilant.name: Hypervigilant

Potion of Superior Healing.name: Potion of Superior Healing

Potion of Clairvoyance.name: Potion of Clairvoyance

Evasion.name: Evasion

Cunning Action.name: Cunning Action

Sneak Attack.name: Sneak Attack

Desham \"Shaar\" Phos.biographyprivate:
[[emberCharacterDetails]]

Desham's journey began in earnest as an Anachraenum explorer, delving into the forgotten ruins and ancient mysteries of Ember. They were drawn to the thrill of uncovering lost knowledge and testing their abilities in as many different treacherous landscapes as they could find. With a keen eye for detail and a sharp mind, Desham quickly established themselves as the sort of person you wanted to hire if there was something you wanted found or investigated but knew the path would be too dangerous for most.

As their reputation grew, Desham's expertise caught the attention of the Veiled Chain, and they were hired on to assist with finding evidence, help with investigations, and extract materials from generally dangerous places. Over time these jobs came with increasing frequency until eventually the Veiled Chain recruited them as a full-time agent.

Through years of dedication, determination, and exceptional performance, Desham rose through the ranks of the Veiled Chain, demonstrating unmatched leadership, intelligence, intuition and loyalty to the organization and its mission. More than any adventuring capacity, it was their ability to navigate the intricate web of political intrigue and backroom dealings in Ordain that set them apart, and ultimately earned them the top spot in the organization.

Personality

Shaar is a quiet, calculating, calm and stoic individual. They always say less than they are thinking, and are quick to revise any working theories they have. They believe that good investigators adhere to a never ending cycle of assume-then-verify, always replacing predictions and educated guesses with verifiable information.

Shaar is exacting, a perfectionist who demands excellence not only from herself but their agents. Anything less than her people's best puts the whole city and thousands upon thousands of lives at risk.

Though Shaar believes, perhaps rightly, perhaps smugly, that the Veiled Chain is the first and last line of protection for the city of Ordain. The organization and its people are vital, and sometimes that work needs to happen unhindered by the powers that be. As a result, Shaar feels sometimes the Veil's actions are best kept clandestine. While they do their best to keep the Ordinate appraised, not everything needs to make it into the formal reports that leave the Hall of Mirrors…

Connections

As the head of the Veiled Chain, Shaar received direct reports from numerous agents and teams across Ordain and beyond. They spend most of their time orchestrating operations, sifting through information and working to support the city and uphold its safety. Beyond this, they are liaise directly with the Ordinate and Hallows, making sure that the city's leadership is not only appraised of ongoing issues, but that they do not become too wary of the powerful intelligence agency that exists just at the edges of their perception.

Phrases

The individual is handicapped by coming face to face with a conspiracy so monstrous they cannot believe it exists. The Ordani mind simply has not come to the realization of the evil which has been introduced into our midst.
Desham \"Shaar\" Phos.biographypublic:
An air of authority and stillness surrounds Shaar, their gray skin and charcoal hair clashing with the colorful Ordani clothing they wear. Their burning blue eyes fix with an intense, calculating stare, and seem to bore into whatever is under their scrutiny, getting under its surface to find whatever secrets rest below.

Clearly Fej background mixed with their human descent, but save for their skin and eyes, one could easily mistake them for an aster human. Though age may have dimmed some of their physical prowess, Desham carries themselves with a grace that one can only develop as a seasoned adventurer.

[[lookup @name]] is the current leader of the Veiled Chain. Once they were among the organization's best agents, and before that, an accomplished adventurer. Though age may have dimmed some of their physical prowess these days, they remain formidable in many other ways.

Serethus.name: Serethus

Cor'ak Lineage.name: Cor'ak Lineage
Cor'ak Lineage.description: Your thick and partially-metallic hide provides natural protection from blows. While you are unarmored, you gain an Armor bonus equal to your Toughness ability score.
Cor'ak Lineage.actiondesc: When you become Weakened or suffer damage while Weakened, a crystalline carapace forms over your body. For a short period of time you gain resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage equal to your Toughness modifier. You also immediately gain an amount of Health equal to two times your Level.

Gesture: Fan.name: Gesture: Fan
Gesture: Fan.description:
You shape the essence of a Rune into a sweeping or splintered arc to strike multiple targets in close proximity.

The Fan gesture scales using Intellect and targets a 120 degree arc with 6 foot radius. It deals 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Arrow.name: Gesture: Arrow
Gesture: Arrow.description:
You hurl a projectile imbued with the magical power of a Rune at a distant target.

The Arrow gesture scales using Intellect and targets a single creature up to a distance of 60 feet, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description:
You immediately react to a spell being cast and compose a rune and gesture designed to unravel and negate the spellcraft of an enemy mage.

Playtest Notes

This action can now be used in playtesting, but it is not yet fully automated. The Counterspell can be performed, but it is up to the Gamemaster to manually reverse a previously applied spell and to manually deduct its Action and Focus cost. These steps of the overall Counterspell workflow will be automated in a subsequent update such that a confirmed Counterspell will also confirm the spell that was countered, but with its effects removed.
Counterspell.actiondesc:
You form arcane energy into a countervailing spellcraft, targeting a spellcaster you can see within 30 feet.

Designate a Rune and Gesture which you know to attempt to counter the spell. Choosing a Rune which is opposed to one used in the spell grants +2 Boons to your attempt. Selecting the identical Gesture as the one being cast also adds +2 Boons to your attempt.

Perform a harmless Spell Attack against your target's Willpower defense. If your roll exceeds their defense, the spell is countered and its magic is nullified, producing no effects.

Recognize Spellcraft.name: Recognize Spellcraft
Recognize Spellcraft.description: You can interpret the arcane incantations of others to discern the nature of their spellcraft. When an enemy within 40 feet that you can see and hear begins casting a spell, you can identify its Rune if you also know that Rune.

Padded Armor.name: Padded Armor
Padded Armor.descriptionpublic: Consisting of quilted layers of cloth stuffed with rags or wool, padded armor cushions the body against blunt force and serves as the foundation beneath heavier gear.

Ceremonial Dagger.name: Ceremonial Dagger
Ceremonial Dagger.descriptionpublic: This blade is less functional and more ornamented than a regular dagger. Its inscriptions and craftsmanship are purposeful for use as a tool for spellcraft. In combat, it projects piercing blasts of arcane energy.

Arcane Orb.name: Arcane Orb
Arcane Orb.descriptionpublic: A sphere of crystal or glass that — in the palm of a capable spellcaster — becomes a conduit for their power. It gathers voltaic energy within its orb before blasting a target with electrifying force.

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Rallying Elixir.name: Rallying Elixir
Rallying Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly fortify the psyche and improve morale.
Rallying Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Morale dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Morale.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Morale.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Morale.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Morale.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Morale.

Spellband.name: Spellband
Spellband.descriptionpublic: This ring made of an opaque stone that has been carefully carved with graceful, sweeping layers evoking an ancient aesthetic. The ring serves as a powerful spellcasting focus for the Invested wearer.
Spellband.actiondesc:
In moments of duress you can withdraw an additional reserve of Focus from this band. The amount of Focus restored depends on the enchantment bonus of the ring.

  • Minor enchantment: 4 Focus

  • Major enchantment: 6 Focus

  • Legendary enchantment: 8 Focus

War Mage.name: War Mage
War Mage.description: Your spellcraft is honed as a weapon of war to thwart the incantations of other magi. You may ask the Gamemaster if you know a Rune capable of countering an enemy spell, even if you do not recognize the spell being cast. You gain +2 Boons to any Counterspell attempt.

Inflection: Push.name: Inflection: Push
Inflection: Push.description: Empower a spell to repel affected creatures away from the caster. Creatures affected by a spell with the Push inflection move 4 feet away from the spellcaster if that destination is unoccupied.

Inflection: Negate.name: Inflection: Negate
Inflection: Negate.description:
Invert the effect of a spell. An Inverted Life Touch spell which normally heals a target deals Poison damage instead. An Inverted Death Ward spell inflicts vulnerability to Corruption damage upon an adjacent enemy.

The effects of the Negate inflection are not yet automated for Playtest 1. This inflection is included as an example of the intended direction for the Spellcraft system.

Inflection: Reshape.name: Inflection: Reshape
Inflection: Reshape.description:
Enhance a Spell by carefully reshaping and controlling its area of effect at the cost of 2 Focus.

Offensive spells which use a template target only target enemies within the area. Healing spells which use a template target only target allies within the area.

Single target spells do not incur any Banes due to intervening creatures.

Inflection: Quicken.name: Inflection: Quicken
Inflection: Quicken.description: Enhance a spell by hastening the speed with which it can be cast, at the expense of increased Focus. The Quicken inflection reduces the Action cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its Focus cost by 1 in exchange.

Gesture: Ward.name: Gesture: Ward
Gesture: Ward.description:
You shape the arcane power of a Rune into a protective barrier used to shield yourself from harm.

The Ward gesture scales using Toughness and provides +6 Resistance against the damage type of the Rune used in the spell. This resistance lasts for 1 Round and you may only have a single Ward at a time. Casting another spell using the Ward gesture replaces your prior Ward. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Pulse.name: Gesture: Pulse
Gesture: Pulse.description:
Expel the arcane power of a Rune in a radius that travels outward with you at its center.

The Pulse gesture scales using Presence and produces an emanation with 10 foot radius, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Ray.name: Gesture: Ray
Gesture: Ray.description:
You funnel the arcane power of a Rune into a point and project it outwards in a beam.

The Ray gesture scales using Wisdom and produces a line that is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Rune: Control.name: Rune: Control
Rune: Control.description:
The orderly force of discipline and permanence. The Control rune governs thought, reason, and persistence.

The Control rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Kinesis.
Rune: Control.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Control allows you to affect the decision making of others in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Moderately intensify or dampen the primary emotion being felt by a creature you touch. If the creature is intelligent enough to be aware of the laws governing spellcraft, they are aware of your actions.

  • Understand the abstract motivations of another living creature which allows you to touch it. You are able to intuit their immediate goals expressed in the form of a single verb.

  • Intensely focus on your current objective and the means of achieving it. You receive a brief hint or reminder from the Gamemaster about that objective containing only information which you have previously learned.

Motivate may only affect a creature or object which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Earth.name: Rune: Earth
Rune: Earth.description:
The orderly force of elemental earth, responsible for physical matter. The Earth rune governs minerals, metals, soils, and other physical compounds.

The Earth rune scales using Wisdom, targets Reflex, and deals Acid damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Lightning.
Rune: Earth.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Earth allows you to manipulate raw forces of rock, mineral, and soil in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Quickly shape up to one cubic foot of available material into a simple geometric form like a cuboid, ellipsoid, or polyhedron.

  • Precisely copy the physical shape of a held object that is smaller than a 6-inch cube, reproducing it from available clay, stone, or metal. The replica retains no useful properties except for its physical form.

  • Separate and collect earthen particles from the surface of an object, creature, or liquid that you touch, rendering the subject completely cleaned or purified in moments.

Mould may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Oblivion.name: Rune: Oblivion
Rune: Oblivion.description:
A chaotic force of destruction and annihilation of existence. The Oblivion rune governs unmaking of matter or decoherence of spirit.

The Oblivion rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower, and deals Void damage to Morale. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Soul.
Rune: Oblivion.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Oblivion allows you to unravel tiny holes in the fabric of existence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Disintegrate a non-magical object you hold smaller than a 6-inch cube, sundering it to a fine particulate dust of its component elements.

  • Anesthetize the ability to feel emotion from yourself or a willing target that you touch, causing it to enter a placid, stoic, or dispassionate state. This effect can be maintained as long as you make no further Action.

  • Subdue the potency of a light source, causing its visible radius to be reduced by half for as long as you maintain physical contact with it. Only one light source may be dampened in this way at a given time.

Erase may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Cone.name: Gesture: Cone
Gesture: Cone.description:
You focus the arcane power of a Rune into a narrow cone that projects outwards from your location.

The Cone gesture scales with Intellect and produces a 60 degree cone with a 30 foot radius originating from the spellcaster. The Cone deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Blast.name: Gesture: Blast
Gesture: Blast.description:
You hurl the arcane power of a Rune into an intense explosion of energy at a nearby point you can see.

The Blast gesture scales with Intellect and produces a blast with 6 feet radius centered on a point within 60 feet of the spellcaster. The blast deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Serethus.biographyprivate:
Born into a Cor'ak family from Akazea, Serethus was afforded every opportunity for scholarly pursuit, diving deep into metaphysical and alchemical studies, eventually dabbling in medical topics that carried with them considerable social taboos which saw him exiled for. His relentless curiosity, and pursuit of knowledge couple with his ignoble exile drove him east to the Arctus Plateau, where he continued to study, and sought to build new inroads with locals.

It was here that he become part of the Veiled Chain, lending his knowledge to their investigations, and continued to gather knowledge both fantastic and forbidden, the latter remaining hidden from prying eyes.

It was during this time he was discovered by and formed a dark alliance with the dragon Zerranyss who saw great potential in Serethus. This unholy partnership soon turned to reverence and worship as Serethus was overawed by the power, majesty, knowledge, and ambitions of this ancient being. Proving ruthlessly loyal and effective at clandestine work, Serethus rose to become the head of the Mutagists, a group working on forbidden alchemical experiments meant to elevate the vile dragon to godhood.

Personality

Serethus is a charming conversationalist, adept at engaging others with his scholarly insights and captivating wit. However, beneath this charisma is a mind wholly devoted to his own advancement and the pursuit of forbidden knowledge. His enthusiasm for his craft borders on obsession and is paired with a cruel sense of humor that he heavily tempers when necessary. His patience allows him to play the long game, maneuvering people and events to align with his sinister plans. Despite his often pleasant demeanor, Serethus, when unmasked, is openly dismissive of others' moralities, seeing conventional ethics as hurdles to his ultimate goals.

  • Ideals: Knowledge and power are the keys to ultimate freedom.

  • Bonds: There is no line that cannot be crossed in service to Zerranyss. The Mutagists will succeed, or else.

  • Flaws: Obsession with experimentation and dragons is a growing sink of his time. His macabre sense of humor can put people off at times.

Connections

Serethus' primary allegiance is to Zerranyss, for whom he leads the Mutagists in crafting the Abyssal Mutagen. Within the Veiled Chain, he operates under false pretenses, gathering intelligence useful both to Zerranyss and his own ends. Serethus also has dealings with the Otherhood of Fortune, providing them with arcane innovations they eagerly finance. Though exiled from the Mazira Kingdoms, he maintains connections with other rogue elements who share his disregard for ethical boundaries.

Phrases

"The mind is a tool, but my tools redefine the mind."

"Ethics? A quaint notion for quaint times. I prefer results."

"Ah, but where others see the macabre, I see truth. Grim, yes, but true all the same."
Serethus.biographypublic: Serethus is a publicly known and celebrated spellcaster, academic, and investigator. Astute and gregarious, it is hard not to like the man, or at least come away with a favorable first impression. Sometimes macabre in his humor, most see him as a dedicated academic with a penchant for the mystic and alchemical.
Serethus.biographyappearance: Tall and imposing, with a strong, bulky frame typical of the Cor'ak, this man's brown and tan are accented by splashes of vibrant purple. Long, purple horns that frame his head in a regal yet intimidating manner. His teal eyes are striking and seem to pierce through those he engages with. His robes are bright and vibrant, in Ordani fashion, and draped with glittering gems of all shapes and sizes.

Jasper.name: Jasper

Spiritual Recuperation.name: Spiritual Recuperation
Spiritual Recuperation.description:
You can commune with the essence of Ember when you rest. If you are resting upon solid ground, you do not require sleep and can remain conscious during a long rest. You may not engage in any strenuous activity in order to gain the benefits of the rest.

Additionally, magical effects cannot cause you to fall asleep.

Living Stone.name: Living Stone
Living Stone.description:
Your stone form temporarily calcifies, providing enhanced protection against physical blows. Until the end of your next turn you gain resistance to bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage which is not magical or adamantine. During this time you cannot be moved or knocked prone.

Once you have used this feature you may not do so again until after you finish a short rest.

Hulg'run Lineage.name: Hulg'run Lineage
Hulg'run Lineage.description:
You are immune to the Asleep condition.

You can commune with the essence of Ember when you Rest. If you are resting upon solid ground, you do not require sleep and can remain conscious. You may not engage in any strenuous activity in order to gain the benefits of the rest.
Hulg'run Lineage.actiondesc:
Your form temporarily calcifies, providing enhanced protection against physical blows.

  • You gain resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage equal to your Level + 1.

  • Your Stride is reduced by -2.

  • You are immune to the Prone condition and cannot be involuntarily moved.

Operator.name: Operator
Operator.description:
You have ice in your veins and remain cool under pressure. Your physical toughness and mental acuity allow you to hone the danger of your situation to achieve the greatest results when the stakes are highest.

While in combat and not Incapacitated, you gain +1 Boon to all checks when you have less than 50% of your maximum Health remaining. You gain +2 Boons to all checks when you have less than 25% of your maximum Health remaining.

Strategic Repositioning.name: Strategic Repositioning
Strategic Repositioning.description:
You are always thinking ahead about where to position yourself should danger loom. Before Turn 1 of a Combat encounter, provided that you are not Unaware, you may immediately move 4 feet in any permitted direction.

If multiple combatants have this feature, repositioning occurs in reverse order of Initiative.

Subtle Extrication.name: Subtle Extrication
Subtle Extrication.description: You understand how to move away from an opponent without exposing yourself to the worst attacks in return. Any Disengagement Attack against you is performed without the 2 Boons that would ordinarily apply to such an attack.

Weak Points.name: Weak Points
Weak Points.description: You identify moments of opportunity to strike at an enemy's weak points. When attacking a target that is Unaware, Flanked, or Exposed using Finesse weaponry, you gain +2 damage to any Strike.

Leather Armor.name: Leather Armor
Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Claw Hammer.name: Claw Hammer
Claw Hammer.descriptionpublic: A seemingly humble tool with a flat striking face and curved claw, the claw hammer can become a savage weapon in determined hands.

Blast Flask.name: Blast Flask
Blast Flask.descriptionprivate: Primarily used to break apart large pieces of ore, these alchemical flasks pack a concentrated punch. If combined in a large enough quantity, they can also be used to create a chain reaction that results in larger explosions.
Blast Flask.descriptionpublic: A flask filled with a reddish liquid explodes when it breaks open, creating a small explosive fire that quickly dissipates.
Blast Flask.actiondesc:
You light and throw the @ref[name], dealing Fire damage to all enemies in the radius of the explosion. The radius of the Blast depends on the quality of the bomb:

  • Shoddy - 3 feet

  • Standard - 4 feet

  • Fine - 6 feet

  • Superior - 8 feet

  • Masterwork - 10 feet

Healing Tonic.name: Healing Tonic
Healing Tonic.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to gradually close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Tonic.actiondesc:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Health dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Health each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Health each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Health each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Health each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Health each Round

Torch.name: Torch
Torch.descriptionpublic: Able to be used as either a light source or as an improvised weapon, a torch can illuminate dark places and ward off the foes that lurk there.

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.descriptionpublic: An oil-burning or magically illuminated lantern that sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius.

Jasper.biographyprivate:
Jasper has always been ambitious, and joined the Yakoshta mining concern because he believes that taking risks now will put him on the fast track to power and wealth. Frustrated by how slowly the mine has been developing, he's begun making trips into Helkas to try to find investors in the mine, and spending the money he believes he will one day get from it in advance, leaving him in debt to a Helkas jeweler. His recent discovery of a way to use the oozes to get large amounts of refined metal quickly (even if it kills them in the process) has led him to believe his time has come.

Personality

Though he works hard, Jasper is proud and a bit arrogant - he has always believed that he was meant for more than the tedium of minework. In his dealings with others, he always wants to seem as if he is an expert, and will bury a listener in random information if he's nervous or doesn't know what he's doing. He also has a habit of touching the jewels embedded in his face as he talks, partly to call attention to them and partly to make sure they're still there.

  • Ideals - The finer things in life are what make it worth living.

  • Bonds - Treat those who work for you fairly. Then they won't mind when you outshine them.

  • Flaws - Nothing's more important than getting what I want when I want it.

Connections

Jasper has tied his fate to that of the Yakoshta miners, at least for now. He hopes to take over leadership of the Yakoshta mine as a first step towards creating a chain of mines that will make him wealthy and disdains the slow and steady approach favored by the mine project's leader, Sellen. Among the miners, he is liked well enough, as he is fair and rewards hard work. Though some think of him as being a bit affected, and he doesn't have the popularity of mine leader Sellen, he could potentially take over leadership of the group under the right circumstances.

Phrases

Listen up now. And remember, one day, you'll be able to say you knew me when.

Life's always better with something a little bit sparkly.

Nothing comes to those who wait.
Jasper.biographypublic: Jasper is a middle-aged Hulg’run in charge of ore processing at the Yakoshta mine – he’s ready to do whatever it takes to make the mine more profitable and cover his growing debts.
Jasper.biographyappearance: The hulg'run man steps carefully, as if he is assessing everything around him with sharp eyes and careful determination. He wears a slight scowl on his face, as if he is above whatever is around him, but the severity of his expression is somewhat undercut by the brilliance of the gems embedded in his face, arms, and legs, which have been carefully polished to a sparkling shine.

Sellen.name: Sellen

Studded Leather Armor.name: Studded Leather Armor
Studded Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: A base of leather reinforced with small metal studs or riveted plates, this armor strikes a balance between mobility and modest protection against slashes.

Chain Hook.name: Chain Hook
Chain Hook.descriptionpublic: A sturdy and flexible chain affixed with a barbed hook at its end. In the hands of a skilled combatant the chain can be thrown towards a target, tearing at their flesh or equipment.

Pickaxe.name: Pickaxe
Pickaxe.descriptionpublic: A crescent spike mounted atop a sturdy haft, the pickaxe is conventionally a mining implement, but can be wielded in combat to deliver dangerous piercing blows.

Hulg'run Lineage.name: Hulg'run Lineage
Hulg'run Lineage.description:
You are immune to the Asleep condition.

You can commune with the essence of Ember when you Rest. If you are resting upon solid ground, you do not require sleep and can remain conscious. You may not engage in any strenuous activity in order to gain the benefits of the rest.
Hulg'run Lineage.actiondesc:
Your form temporarily calcifies, providing enhanced protection against physical blows.

  • You gain resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage equal to your Level + 1.

  • Your Stride is reduced by -2.

  • You are immune to the Prone condition and cannot be involuntarily moved.

Mnemonic Realization.name: Mnemonic Realization
Mnemonic Realization.description:
Your sharpened mind is full of secrets and techniques to remember them. Once per Day you may focus your thoughts and attempt to recall a word that sparks your memory.

The Gamemaster must provide you with a one-word clue that is appropriate for your direction of inquiry. It is left to Gamemaster discretion how direct or vague to be with the clue they provide.
Mnemonic Realization.actiondesc: You survey your memories attempting to recall a clue for your current situation.

Preparedness.name: Preparedness
Preparedness.description: You seem to always be prepared for the moment at hand. You may sacrifice your free movement for the Round to instead equip an Item from your inventory without spending any Action points.

Diversionist.name: Diversionist
Diversionist.description: You specialize in using subterfuge to distract or trick your opponent during combat.
Diversionist.actiondesc: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.

Provocateur.name: Provocateur
Provocateur.description: You specialize in barbed repartee crafted to highlight your opponent's shortcomings. In combat you can launch quips which provoke your foes.
Provocateur.actiondesc: You exaggerate your opponent's shortcomings with a scathing bon mot, performing a Diplomacy skill attack against your target's Willpower. On a success they suffer modest Psychic damage to Morale and become Enraged for 1 Round.

Claw Hammer.name: Claw Hammer
Claw Hammer.descriptionpublic: A seemingly humble tool with a flat striking face and curved claw, the claw hammer can become a savage weapon in determined hands.

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.descriptionpublic: An oil-burning or magically illuminated lantern that sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius.

Rallying Tonic.name: Rallying Tonic
Rallying Tonic.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to gradually fortify the psyche and improve morale.
Rallying Tonic.actiondesc:
Immediately, and at the beginning of each of the next 5 Rounds, recover an amount of Morale dependent on the quality of the tonic.

  • Shoddy - Heals 2 Morale each Round

  • Standard - Heals 4 Morale each Round

  • Fine - Heals 8 Morale each Round

  • Superior - Heals 16 Morale each Round

  • Masterwork - Heals 32 Morale each Round

Healing Elixir.name: Healing Elixir
Healing Elixir.descriptionpublic: This potion contains a specialized alchemical formula to rapidly close wounds and improve bodily health.
Healing Elixir.actiondesc:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.

Sellen.biographyprivate:
Sellen has always wanted to run her own mining concern and worked towards that goal from an early age, taking her first job at a mine when she was technically too young for the job by lying about her age and making slight alterations to the curvature of her face to make herself appear a bit older. As part of her training, she briefly spent time in Ordain with the Cevher Trading House learning the business side of things, and liked their slow and steady approach, which she has taken on as her own. Still, she is willing to take risks when she needs to, including taking her miners to a remote mine that she believes has the potential to be immensely productive and profitable once it is fully up and running.

Personality

Sellen is driven and ambitious, but wants her achievements not just for herself but for all those who follow her - her dream is a safe and self-sufficient community that grows generation after generation. She speaks and acts with authority - she is good humored about it, but generally expects folks to do what she asks them to, and in return, gives her people a lot of latitude to work the way that fits them best. While her brashness occasionally catches people off-guard, she is kind, and will always work with one of her miners to find a way for them to succeed in the community (or give them what they need to go another way).

Connections

Sellen is both popular and respected by the Yakoshta miners that she leads, though some think that her more methodical approach to mining will keep them in the area for too long and would prefer a big risk and reward. Others sometimes say that she is too lenient with her brother @UUID[Actor.QazTcy7eZuSYcDmN]{Tauric}, who prefers wandering the area with his ooze Squish than working in the mine. To keep the miners entertained and engaged despite the long hours and slow progress, she gives out small tokens when anyone does something above and beyond their duties - they are worthless outside of Yakoshta, but are used within the mine as currency to buy things like a shift switch or an extra day off - and gives her an opportunity to good-naturedly rib those who are way behind or ahead in the token tally.

Phrases

A long day doesn't have to mean a long face. Not if you don't want it to.

Don't you worry - I've got a plan.

Steady work makes for steady reward.
Sellen.biographypublic: Sellen is a Hulg'run Arcturian in her late forties who led a group of miners looking for new opportunity to the Forest of Stone and has built Yakoshta into a working mine that she wants to slowly grow into a major financial success. She believes in hard work, but tries to bring a spirit of lightheartedness to the community to keep her people happy.
Sellen.biographyappearance: Between the light from the candles perched on her shoulders, the large pickaxe in one hand, and the clipboard in another, the woman before you seems nothing if not prepared for whatever faces her. The weathering on the carved stone of her body gives the sense that she's got more than a few stories to tell about what has gotten her this far along her journey, but whatever her past has brought her, she hasn't lost either the smile on her face or the determination in her eyes.

Tauric.name: Tauric

Hulg'run Lineage.name: Hulg'run Lineage
Hulg'run Lineage.description:
You are immune to the Asleep condition.

You can commune with the essence of Ember when you Rest. If you are resting upon solid ground, you do not require sleep and can remain conscious. You may not engage in any strenuous activity in order to gain the benefits of the rest.
Hulg'run Lineage.actiondesc:
Your form temporarily calcifies, providing enhanced protection against physical blows.

  • You gain resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage equal to your Level + 1.

  • Your Stride is reduced by -2.

  • You are immune to the Prone condition and cannot be involuntarily moved.

Preparedness.name: Preparedness
Preparedness.description: You seem to always be prepared for the moment at hand. You may sacrifice your free movement for the Round to instead equip an Item from your inventory without spending any Action points.

Assess Strength.name: Assess Strength
Assess Strength.description:
You take a moment to observe a creature which you can see and develop intuition about its areas of strength.

Perform a Knowledge Test using a Skill chosen by the Gamemaster. On a success, you learn which Defense type of Physical, Fortutude, Willpower, or Reflex is highest for the creature. On a Critical Success you learn the two highest defense types.
Assess Strength.actiondesc: You observe a creature you can see to assess it's notable areas of strength.

Precision Shot.name: Precision Shot
Precision Shot.description: You take time to steady your aim and target the weakest point of a foe. You may only get one shot, but you make it count.
Precision Shot.actiondesc: You steady your aim and fire a single accurate shot.

Claw Hammer.name: Claw Hammer
Claw Hammer.descriptionpublic: A seemingly humble tool with a flat striking face and curved claw, the claw hammer can become a savage weapon in determined hands.

Leather Armor.name: Leather Armor
Leather Armor.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Squish.name: Squish
Squish.descriptionprivate: While Tauric has Squish equipped, he cannot be @Condition[unaware].

Light Weapon Training.name: Light Weapon Training
Light Weapon Training.description: You know how to wield light weapons fluidly with a high degree of maneuverability and grace in combat. You are Trained with all weapons in the Light and Balanced categories.
Light Weapon Training.actiondesc:
You dart forward nimbly, making a strike with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a Finesse weapon against a single target with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is Difficult, but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke Disengagement.

Tauric.biographyprivate:
Tauric has always been a bit of a free-spirited dreamer, but accompanied his sister to Yakoshta mine when she established the mining settlement 3 years ago because he had no other concrete plans and then fell in love with the oozes in the area and decided to begin studying them. He believes that through poetry and art he will eventually communicate with Squish the ooze and is always up for reciting his latest attempts at verse.

Personality

While Tauric is soft-spoken, he is very passionate, especially about oozes, and does not care if others view him as odd. Though the miners are kind to him, and he tries to use his poetry to relate to them, he feels a bit more at home among the oozes than the miners. He often talks to Squish the Ooze as if it was a rambunctious puppy, often reporting on the events around him to Squish out loud as a way of getting his point across.

  • Ideals - The world is out there for exploring.

  • Bonds - I won't go anywhere without my ooze Squish.

  • Flaws - I'm sure things will work out in the end, whether I prepare for them or not.

Connections

Tauric is the younger sibling of @UUID[Actor.0w10EA6SDwRS3VK8]{Sellen}, who runs the Yakoshta mining group, and deeply attached to his pet ooze Squish. His sister indulges him somewhat, and while the miners often complain about him, they also see him as the little brother of the group and try to look out for him. In return, he often crafts poems about major mine events and key personalities in between trying to use his poetry to communicate with Squish.

Phrases

Don't you worry about Squish - he's just a little curious!

I'm working on a poem about just that very thing. Squish thinks it's my best one yet.

We'd better go check it out, Squish - I'm sure we won't get in too much trouble.
Tauric.biographypublic: Tauric is a young adult Hulg'run who cares more about being a self-proclaimed "oozethusiast" than working in the mine and often wanders around the Forest of Stone accompanied by his pet ooze Squish.
Tauric.biographyappearance: The young man's gray body appears to be carved from rock, with lines of blue agate running through the stone like veins. His color is matched by the gelatinous body of the small blueish-green ooze that sits on his shoulder, nestled into a hollow that seems to have been carved for the purpose.

Abyssal Echo.name: Abyssal Echo

Inscrutable.name: Inscrutable
Inscrutable.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is an unknowable abyssal entity. It is immune to any effect or spell that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts. Any skill check to ascertain this creature's intentions is made with +4 Banes.

Sight Without.name: Sight Without
Sight Without.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has no eyes, ears, or mouth. It cannot be @Condition[blinded], @Condition[silenced], or @Condition[deafened]. It has 60ft of blindsight and can speak telepathically to any one or all creatures within 120 feet of it.

Abyssal Remains.name: Abyssal Remains
Abyssal Remains.description: Upon death, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} dissolves into a thick liquid often described as a "melted shadow," which spreads in an oozing pour from the place where it died, soaking the area around it in abyssal corruption.
Abyssal Remains.actiondesc:
Upon death, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} spreads into a melted pool of shadow spreading in a 4 foot radius from its position. This residue remains in place for one month or unless otherwise cleansed.

Any creature within the area or who enters it upon a subsequent turn must withstand an attack against their Reflex defense or suffer Corruption damage which also afflicts them with Cursed Vision.

While affected by Cursed Vision, they cannot perceive sources of dim light and sources of bright light appear dim.

Playtest Notes: Cursed Vision is not yet automated, but will be some time after Foundry VTT version 14 becomes stable.

Pack Hunter.name: Pack Hunter
Pack Hunter.description:
This creature is a pack hunter, relying on its allies to flank and harrass a target to render it exposed to further harm.

This creature doubles number of Boons awarded from attacking a Flanked enemy.

Void Absorption.name: Void Absorption
Void Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is no stranger to the orderly force of darkness. Its Void resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Swallowed Screams.name: Swallowed Screams
Swallowed Screams.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} fixates upon a specific target, removing their ability to speak or hear.
Swallowed Screams.actiondesc: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks the Willpower defense of a single target within 30 feet, unless the attack is resisted the target becomes @Condition[silenced] for 1 minute.

Shadow Talons.name: Shadow Talons
Shadow Talons.descriptionpublic: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has shadowy talons that rend and slash at their prey, dealing Void damage.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} may move through a space as narrow as 1 inch in diameter without any penalty to its Stride. It gains a bonus to Dodge equal to half its Toughness score and is immune to the @Condition[restrained] condition.

Abyssal Echo.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

Abyssal Echoes are terrifying hunters of the Abyss. While comparatively weak individually, they are almost never found alone and roam across areas of Abyssal influence in large packs or even hordes numbering in the hundreds. They possess rending claws that slash at creatures around them, tearing them apart with savage glee. As entities from the Abyss, Abyssal Echoes are nothing like other life forms and exist without internal organs; they are immune to various effects and do not require food, water, or sleep.

Behavior

Abyssal Echoes are not natural creatures; they are composed of concentrated Abyssal Energy and exist solely to destroy the life around them. They are among the weakest Abyssal monsters with basic intelligence and can sometimes study and hunt creatures carefully rather than attacking immediately. They will even leave their quarry to gather more of their kind for a stronger attack, and they are capable of complex tactics to bring down their foes when required. However, like other Abyssal beings, they cannot be reasoned with and desire nothing more than the annihilation of life itself.

Lore

Abyssal Echoes appeared in Ember during the Abyssal Shear, and while they are not powerful, they can cause unimaginable destruction to environments and areas if left unchecked.
Abyssal Echo.biographypublic: Abyssal Echoes are monsters of pure evil, beings of twisted hatred from beyond the world of Ember. They possess a cruel basic intelligence that enables them to seek out and hunt natural creatures of Ember, ambushing them in the darkness and tearing them apart.
Abyssal Echo.biographyappearance: Emerging from the darkness is a terrifying eldritch apparition composed of dark smoke and malice, with prominent rows of gleaming sharp teeth. Its softly glowing eyes radiate spiteful hatred and cunning as it glides through the air with measured movements. Grasping hands, as if yearning to escape its form, materialize and vanish instantly, while its two enormous clawed hands seem to appear and disappear at will.

Abyssal Eel.name: Abyssal Eel

Abyssal Monster.name: Abyssal Monster
Abyssal Monster.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]] is an unknowable alien entity. It is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the [[lookup @name lowercase]]'s intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]] and all Abyssal creatures are opposed by Life and Light, making them vulnerable to radiant damage.

Frenzied Swarm.name: Frenzied Swarm
Frenzied Swarm.description: Any [[lookup @name lowercase]] can occupy another entity's space and vice versa. The [[lookup @name lowercase lowercase]] can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

Abyssal Remains.name: Abyssal Remains
Abyssal Remains.description:
When the [[lookup @name]] dies, it dissolves into a thick liquid often described as “melted shadow,” which spreads in an oozing pour from the place where it died, soaking a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=0CtCrqPc5KbnIvoc]]-foot radius around it in viscous corruption.

Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=0CtCrqPc5KbnIvoc]], each creature within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=0CtCrqPc5KbnIvoc]] feet of the [[lookup @name]] when it dies.

Failure: The target is cursed with Cursed Vision until the end of its next long rest.

Cursed Vision. Shadowy film clings to the creature’s eyes. While afflicted, the creature has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, and attack rolls against the creature have advantage. In addition, the creature can’t benefit from darkvision.

Note: After Alpha, Abyssal Residue may remain on the ground and/or be found in locations where an abyssal creature died, affecting anyone who moves through its space. When this feature is active, the residue will remain in place for 1 week before fading away. If located in an area without direct light from Lantyr, the residue will remain for 1 month.

Abyssal Eel.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

Abyssal eels are thin, snake-like monsters with small, sharp teeth in surprisingly powerful jaws. They have no eyes, ears, or any organs of any kind. Along their bodies, thin, glowing lines of energy flicker and pulse as they move, becoming more intense when they are attacking living entities.

Behavior

Abyssal Eels are not natural creatures; they are mainly composed of small amounts of concentrated Abyssal Energy, devoid of thoughts and existing solely to destroy life around them. They swim languidly through the air and ignore objects and materials, but once a living entity, such as a creature, plant, or mortal, enters their senses, they stop at nothing to destroy it.

Abyssal Eels are not particularly strong monsters on their own, but they tend to gather into frenzied swarms around Abyssally corrupted areas and locations.

Lore

Abyssal Eels appeared in Ember during the Abyssal Shear, and while they are not powerful, they can cause unimaginable destruction to environments and areas if left unchecked.
Abyssal Eel.biographypublic:
A gliding serpentine monster with numerous razor sharp teeth invoke instinctual fear and revulsion as they swim unnervingly through the air without any apparent biological trait that would allow them to stay airborne. With no visible eyes nor ears, they seem to sense the environment around them through unknown means.

These softly glowing monster eels are extremely aggressive when a living creature comes within range of their limited senses. They will continue to bite and viciously rip through flesh until they are destroyed and have no survival instincts.

Eye Blast.name: Eye Blast

Abyssal Eye.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

Abyssal Eyes are strange, predominantly ethereal creatures. Their only physical features are their large, dark red eyes, which possess exceptional perception, enabling them to see in complete darkness or even when blinded. As entities from the Abyss, Abyssal Eyes are nothing like other life forms and exist without internal organs; they are immune to various effects and do not require food, water, or sleep.

Behavior

Abyssal Eyes are not natural creatures; they are composed of concentrated Abyssal Energy, devoid of thought, and exist solely to destroy the life around them. They are typically found in areas corrupted or suffused with Abyssal energy and spend the vast majority of their existence dormant. They hover silently, like statues in the darkness; only when disturbed do they actively try to destroy beings around them with their powerful eye blasts.

Lore

Abyssal Eyes appeared in Ember during the Abyssal Shear, and while they are not powerful, they can cause unimaginable destruction to environments and areas if left unchecked.
Abyssal Eye.biographypublic:
A large red eye glows in the center of a swirl of darkness, hovering in the air as it turns its terrible gaze towards you. A floating mass of red and black smoky tendrils twist in the air around it, shifting in the space around the creature's unrelenting stare.

Abyssal Eyes are extremely destructive monsters that lie in wait for centuries, floating silently in the darkness. Upon being disturbed, their eyelids open to reveal their burning gaze and instinctual hatred for life.

Corrupted Kezus Jelly.name: Corrupted Kezus Jelly

Special Adaptation.name: Special Adaptation
Special Adaptation.description: The Kezus Jelly has incredible resistance to high temperatures and fire damage. Additionally, the jelly is resistant to bludgeoning damage, and without a mind to speak of, is immune to psychic damage.

Freedom of Movement.name: Freedom of Movement
Freedom of Movement.description: The jelly ignores magical effects that would reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

Confusing Patterns.name: Confusing Patterns
Confusing Patterns.description:
The jelly begins to pulse and flash in wild patterns of color and light. Whenever a creature that can see the jelly and isn’t incapacitated starts its turn within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=dnd5eactivity000]] feet of the jelly, it must make the following saving throw.

Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=dnd5eactivity000]].

Failure: The creature can’t take reactions until the start of its next turn, and it has disadvantage on the next attack roll, saving throw, or ability check it makes before then.

Debilitating Tendrils.name: Debilitating Tendrils
Debilitating Tendrils.description:
Trigger: A creature within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=dnd5eactivity000]] feet of the jelly makes an attack against it.

Response: The jelly recoils and whips its tendrils at the attacker.

Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=dnd5eactivity000]], the attacker.

Failure: The attacker has the &Reference[poisoned] condition for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, it also has the &Reference[paralyzed] condition. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Reactive.name: Reactive
Reactive.description: The jelly can take one &Reference[Reaction] on every turn of combat, but only to use Debilitating Tendrils.

Contact Hazard.name: Contact Hazard
Contact Hazard.description: Creatures attempting to grapple, grab, carry, push, or otherwise make physical contact with the jelly automatically trigger its Debilitating Tendrils reaction.

Blindsense.name: Blindsense
Blindsense.description: The Kezus Jelly cannot see, hear, taste or smell, and perceives its environment through a natural blindsense, allowing it to perceive creatures even if they are hidden or invisible.

Scintillating Agony.name: Scintillating Agony
Scintillating Agony.description:
The jelly turns blood red and pulses with waves of darker and lighter crimson as it inflicts psychic harm on multiple targets. Each creature within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=dnd5eactivity000]] feet of the [[lookup @name]] must make the following saving throw.

Charisma Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=dnd5eactivity000]], each creature in the area.

Failure: The creature takes [[/damage average]] damage.

Success: Half damage.

Corrupted Kezus Jelly.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

Kezus Jelly are bioluminescent jellyfish ith long tendrils and tails that swirl behind them as they propel themselves through water by pulsing their heads. Kezus Jelly are uncomfortable in bright light and seek to avoid illumination.

Behavior

Kezus Jelly are generally gentle creatures, favoring evasion over confrontation. Unless provoked or threatened, these creatures tend to not be menacing to other species. Kezus Jelly are uncomfortable in bright light and seek to avoid illumination.

Even provoked, the jelly tends to be defensive, using its tendrils to inflict horrible pain on would-be attackers, and utilizing a special bioluminescent pattern to confuse and disrupt would-be attackers. If pressed, it can utilize powerful psychic attacks, but only does so as a last resort.

Lore

For centuries, the Kezus Jelly has been a part of the vibrant Kadisos ecosystem, having long adapted to the super heated waters of the caldera. They are considered one of the more beautiful creatures to live in the caldera lake, but a beauty which should be enjoyed from a distance.

Rarely, Kezus Jelly are found in the Pathways in large underwater lakes where darkness allows them to exist comfortably at all hours.
Corrupted Kezus Jelly.biographypublic:
You behold an ethereal display of bioluminescence and elegant fluidity. Its bulbous, umbrella-shaped body pulses with a translucent glow, revealing a mesmerizing dance of colors within its soft structure. Usually, a soft pink and calming blue light emanates from its organism, accentuated by a constellation of star-like points, shimmering in sync with the creature's rhythmic pulses. Delicate tentacles, stretching several feet in length, trail its body in an exquisite ballet, leaving a mesmerizing trail of luminary discharge in their wake.

[[lookup @name]] are generally gentle creatures, favoring evasion over confrontation. Unless provoked or threatened, these creatures tend to not be menacing to other species. These jellies spend their days in deep and dark waters, only emerging into shallows once the sun has set.
