Pallid Drake.biographyappearance: This large drake boasts a long, coiling body adorned with olive-green scales that shimmer in the light, culminating in a flared tail with pristine teal frills. More of these elegant teal frills adorn its neck and back, complementing the long, gleaming teal horns that fan out gracefully from the back of its head. Its amber-orange eyes gleam with acute awareness and intelligence. Its maw is filled with rows of razor sharp teeth.

Pallid Drakeling.name: Pallid Drakeling

Drakeling Scales.name: Drakeling Scales
Drakeling Scales.descriptionpublic: The drakeling has a smooth hide of fine-grained scales.

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.descriptionpublic: The drakeling features a dangerous bite of vicious teeth.

Pouncing Strike.name: Pouncing Strike
Pouncing Strike.description: This creature lunges forward, putting its whole weight behind a leaping strike.
Pouncing Strike.actiondesc:
This attack may be used after a Move that brings the @ref[actor.name]{creature} at least 10 feet closer to its target. If the creature was above the target, this attack gains +1 Boon per 10 feet of elevation decrease in that movement.

If this attack is a Critical Hit, the target of the attack is immediately knocked @Condition[prone].

Pack Hunter.name: Pack Hunter
Pack Hunter.description:
This creature is a pack hunter, relying on its allies to flank and harrass a target to render it exposed to further harm.

This creature doubles number of Boons awarded from attacking a Flanked enemy.

Blood Sense.name: Blood Sense
Blood Sense.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can precisely sense any blooded creature within 20 feet which does not have all its hit points. Any weapon or skill attack against a wounded creature does not suffer Banes that would normally apply if the creature were @Condition[blinded].

Glider.name: Glider
Glider.description:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can control its movement while falling and may perform the Move action up to a maximum distance of its Stride for each 20 feet that it falls.

If it spends Action to Move in this way, it does not suffer falling damage upon landing.

Lightning Spit.name: Lightning Spit
Lightning Spit.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is able to produce and expel minor voltaic discharge.
Lightning Spit.actiondesc:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} spits a small bolt of lightning at a target creature within 20 feet, attacking its Reflex and dealing Electricity damage.

On a Critical Hit the attack causes the @Condition[shocked] condition for 3 Turns.

Pallid Drakeling.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

Drakes bear a striking resemblance to the Vile Dragon, with long, thin bodies, two fore-legs and no other limbs. They often have horns and frills, and maws lined with thin, razor sharp teeth.

Drakes are capable of flight, though they lack wings, indicating their capacity for flight comes from some other means, likely magic. The precise nature of this ability is not known. Drakelings lack this ability, only developing it in adulthood.

Drakes are covered in robust scales which help protect their bodies from harm, though they rely more on their dexterity to evade attacks, rather than natural armor. This hide is similar to snake skin in texture and composition.

All drakes have intensely sharp eyesight and strong low-light vision.

Behavior

The newness of these creatures precludes the development of academic knowledge of drake behavior, so little is known beyond what direct observation may provide.

That said, drakes quickly assert themselves as apex predators in any biome they inhabit, and are naturally territorial, attacking anything that dares to enter the territory they've claimed.

Drakes are intelligent, capable of complex reasoning, and coordination in groups, even with humanoid allies despite being incapable of speech. However, since drakes are territorial and extremely willful, training them is difficult, if not impossible. Though not social by nature, drakes can and will hunt and nest together, with all members of that nest bowing to the will of largest among them.

Lore

There is little known about Drakes, as they are not naturally occurring on Ember and only began appearing in recent years. To the wider world of academics, they appear to be a chimerical blend of snake and dragon with an unknown but possibly magical origin.

The truth about them is that they were created in secret by the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrganizatio.JournalEntryPage.frzH0bjzUvkqliSn], grown in a hidden blood forge, their forms patterned after @UUID[JournalEntry.FYP2Af9bY4B9lSqi.JournalEntryPage.v6lXjfETDkrt0J7E]{Zerranyss}, a powerful @UUID[JournalEntry.emberBestiary000.JournalEntryPage.EhQnCUxkJyxOSbf7]{Vile Dragon}. They were made to serve as a resources for Mutagists and their experiments, forced to become test subjects for the mutagenic compounds their numerous underground labs produce.

The ultimate goal of the mutagists was to find serums and alchemical treatments that would enhance, transform, and empower the draks, with the expectation that any such discoveries would also be applicable to the Vile Dragon they were spawned from.
Pallid Drakeling.biographypublic: Pallid Drakelings are the juvenile form of a newly discovered draconic monster that appears to be descended from or related to dragons, though the true nature of their origin is presently unknown.
Pallid Drakeling.biographyappearance: The Pallid Drakeling’s body is long and serpentine, adorned with olive-green scales that glimmer brightly as it moves. Its body is marked by large, vibrant teal frills jutting from its side. Atop its draconic head, small horns fan out, each tipped with a faint teal coloring. Its amber-orange eyes are sharp and curious, constantly surveying its surroundings.

Ketral.name: Ketral

Surprise Attack.name: Surprise Attack
Surprise Attack.description: If the ketral surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra [[/damage average]] damage from the attack.

Dust to Dust.name: Dust to Dust
Dust to Dust.description:
When the [[lookup @name lowercase]] dies, it crumbles into elemental dust. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a [[/save format=long]] or be affected by Choking Dust.

Choking Dust. The creature has the &Reference[Suffocation apply=false]{Suffocation} condition, and it takes [[/damage average]] at the start of each of its turns. While the creature is conscious, it repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Pack Tactics.name: Pack Tactics
Pack Tactics.description: The [[lookup @name lowercase]] has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]'s allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

Of The Earth.name: Of The Earth
Of The Earth.description:
The ketral has the following abilities due to its affinity with the Earth Moon, Cora:

  • it can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing the material it moves through and move through any space large enough for a Tiny creature without squeezing

  • it can climb any rocky surface, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check

  • it has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain and can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on any turn it ends within rocky terrain

Lunar Attack.name: Lunar Attack
Lunar Attack.description: Cora's power makes ketral more dangerous. When Cora is at its zenith, all ketral attacks do an additional 2 (1d4) damage.

Ketral.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

Ketral are made at least partly out of rock, allowing them to meld with and move through tight spaces within rocky walls and burrow in the way that a snake might, Nearly indistinguishable from the rocks around them, they can strike out without warning, taking limbs or digits from whatever passes nearby. When they die, they crumble into earth, reinforcing the belief that they are somehow outgrowths of the rock itself, given teeth and life.

Behavior

Like many predators of the Splinter Canyons, ketral are lurkers, using their sharp teeth and claws to make quick work of creatures that don't see them lurking just inside the surface of the rock face. They often feast on gumtoads, in particular, grabbing onto the amphibians as they rest on the canyon's rise. Once prey is injured, any ketral in the area will swarm it, following the scent of blood to find and finish off the unfortunate target.

Lore

Ketral are found anywhere there is a cliff face for them to burrow into, and they often thought of as the bane of climbing explorers. Seeing them outside of their lairs is relatively rare; they are so much a part of the cliffs and canyons that they are thought to be the origin of rumors about living canyons on Ember that bite those who try to climb them.

More than one climbing adventurer has lost a finger to a stealthy and sudden ketral attack, with any gems or rings that they were wearing swallowed whole. The stories that have developed over the years about priceless magic gems that can be found in ketral rock piles and burrows are likely exaggerated, but gems can occasionally be found in the pile of earth left as a ketral's remains.
Ketral.biographypublic:
The small creature has a dark rocky skin and mane, barely distinguishable from a pile of rocks or sodden earth beyond its glowing yellow eyes and sharpened claws. Its teeth, though small, seem to crowd its mouth, bared and ready to strike at anything that comes within their reach.

These vicious predators use their affinity for and attunement to the earth moon Cora as a weapon – they can pass through rock as if it barely exists, lurking in the tiniest crevices within rocky walls as they wait for an opportunity to strike, as if the rock itself had grown teeth and claws. While they live in packs in caves, most spend their days snugly ensconced in their private nest, jaws or claws at the opening, darting their heads and hands out to take a chunk out of any passing creature they encounter.

Fire Sprite.name: Fire Sprite

Fiery Strike.name: Fiery Strike
Fiery Strike.descriptionpublic: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} swipes with a blazing sweep of concentrated flame.

Rune: Flame.name: Rune: Flame
Rune: Flame.description:
The chaotic force of elemental, thermal energy. The Flame rune governs fire and heat.

The Flame rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Fire damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Frost.
Rune: Flame.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Flame allows you to manipulate fire and thermal energy in creative ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Manifest a burst of elemental flame in one inch sphere which can ignite a candle, torch, or other flammable materials.

  • Imbue your body with momentary thermal shielding which provides you with immunity to fire damage on an immediately subsequent action that costs 1 Action or less.

  • Control the movement of flames within a small area, causing them to flicker, dance, or shift in an animated performance of light and shadow.

Enkindle may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Fire Absorption.name: Fire Absorption
Fire Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to thrive within scorching environments. Its Fire resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

False Appearance.name: False Appearance
False Appearance.description: While it remains motionless, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is indistinguishable from some other object or material.

Gesture: Fan.name: Gesture: Fan
Gesture: Fan.description:
You shape the essence of a Rune into a sweeping or splintered arc to strike multiple targets in close proximity.

The Fan gesture scales using Intellect and targets a 120 degree arc with 6 foot radius. It deals 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Elemental Armor.name: Elemental Armor
Elemental Armor.descriptionpublic: The @ref[name] is enveloped by a fortified shell of elemental carapace which provides a degree of protection against physical harm.

Fire Sprite.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

Fire elementals are energetic, hungry manifestations of pure, animated magical fire. They manifest with bright burning cores and long tails of flame that can be a vaporous wisp, or a long, coiling tongue of flames. They are constantly in motion, and tend to be highly erratic, moving in short bursts.

As they gain power they grow in size, complexity, and intelligence. The fire sprite is among the first to exhibit any sort of intelligence, with lesser elementals doing little more than collecting around sources of fire and basking in the heat.

At their largest and most powerful, these fire elementals can take on humanoid forms and exhibit terrifying capacity for intelligence. However, such elementals are exceedingly rare on Ember, only appearing after rituals to summon them, or during rare lunar events where Ragen is empowered and great fires burn on Ember.

Behavior

Fire elementals are drawn to large sources of flame and heat, specifically those suffused with magical energy or notably receiving lunar influence from the fire moon, Ragen. They tend to appear in the wakes of forest fires, or in underground lava tubes where residual heat can be absorbed.

While primarily non-hostile, fire elementals are a paradoxical mixture of predictable and unpredictable. Most fire elementals, especially the smaller ones, can be relied upon to seek out materials to catch fire, or existing fires to fuel into larger conflagrations. They love spreading fire, as it gives them more heat to bask in, and more power to draw from.

The larger, much rarer elementals tend to be more reserved, careful not to burn all their fuel at once, and are often fiercely protective of their habitats and fire sources. All fire elementals tend to gather around fires and interact during lunar phases when the influence of Ragen is at its peak, and are relatively rare encounters otherwise.

Lore

As descendants of the elemental moon Ragen, fire elementals have existed since the dawn of Ember's history. As a result, they are a well known, if not well understood aspect of the cosmos and the world.

It is not well understood how any elementals appear on Ember, or by what means the come from their host moons. Theories range from them riding the light and magical energy pouring off the moons to spontaneous creation on Ember as a result of coalesced energies.

In the past, the ancient Shent culture revered the moons of Ember, and built many temples to them, many of which were built to exalt Ragen, and still serve as gathering points for fire elementals to this day.

Ancient Arcturians were also known to forge pacts and alliance with fire elementals, offering them fuel and lighting bonfires in exchange for knowledge, magic, and protection. Though the practice has all but vanished from modern Arcturian communities, there still exist ruins and burial sites marked with symbols depicting Ragen and its elementals.
Fire Sprite.biographypublic: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is a small, swirling fire elemental that is often encountered in places where fires burn with magical energy, or consume fuels infused with the essences of the moon Ragen. While generally harmless if left alone, they often set fires wherever they go, causing great collateral damage with their presence.
Fire Sprite.biographyappearance: A cohesive orb of flame swirls through the air before you, leaving a long trail of lingering sparks and embers as its wake. The movements of this little sprite are erratic and each swish through the air or sudden burst of movement is punctuated with the rushing sound of a fire being swiftly fed air.

Temple Invader.name: Temple Invader

Frigid Swipe.name: Frigid Swipe
Frigid Swipe.descriptionpublic: The @ref[actor.name] swipes with an aqueous pseudopod that is frigid with cold.

Elemental Surge.name: Elemental Surge
Elemental Surge.description:
While connected to and empowered by the torrent of magical energy that flows through the Shent Moon Temple, the Temple Invader can perform certain exceptional actions by drawing upon and directing that power.

The Temple Invader is surrounded by an impenetrable shield that stops all objects, projectiles, spells, and attacks from passing through it in either direction, making the elemental immune to attacks and spells. While this shield is active the elemental is also @Condition[restrained]. While protected in this way, the Invader is immune to all damage types except Psychic and Void.

This shield is provided by six magical orbs that are rotating on the temple's machinery overhead. On their turn, the Elemental can deplete one of these orbs to immediately gain a point of Heroism which it can spend on other powerful abilities. Once all six orbs have been depleted, the shield upon the Invader expires and the elemental is rendered vulnerable to attack.
actiondesc: The @ref[actor.name] draws upon the torrent of energy from the Astrolabe Shield and expels a massive wave of magical water that is 20 feet wide and 60 feet long. This wave targets the Reflex defense and deals Weakened Cold damage. Enemies that fail to resist the effect are pushed backwards 30 feet in the direction the wave is traveling and are rendered @Condition[prone].

The @ref[actor.name] draws upon and depletes the elemental energy from one of the six orbs which rotate about the Temple Lunarium. Drawing upon an orb in this way destroys it but immediately grants the @ref[actor.name] a point of Heroism.

The @ref[actor.name] conjures an sphere with 15 foot radius at a point of their choosing inside the temple. This fog targets the Fortitude defense of all creatures contained within it, dealing Weakened Cold damage. Targets which fail to resist the effect become @Condition[slowed] until the end of their next Turn.

Cold Absorption.name: Cold Absorption
Cold Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to thrive within frigid environments. Its Cold resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} may move through a space as narrow as 1 inch in diameter without any penalty to its Stride. It gains a bonus to Dodge equal to half its Toughness score and is immune to the @Condition[restrained] condition.

Aqueous Transmission.name: Aqueous Transmission
Aqueous Transmission.description: The @ref[name] is able to move instantaneously through water.
Aqueous Transmission.actiondesc: When the @ref[name] is within water, it can instantaneously transport itself to any unoccupied space within the same body of water up to 120 feet away. It does not need to be able to see the destination to make this Move.

Gesture: Aspect.name: Gesture: Aspect
Gesture: Aspect.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect, casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Step.name: Gesture: Step
Gesture: Step.description:
You infuse runic power into a movement, crossing physical and spatial boundaries.

The Step gesture scales with Dexterity and allows you to move up to 20 feet in a straight line with width equal to your Size. It deals 2 Base Damage to targets along that line which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture does not require any free hands to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

The movement aspect of this talent is not yet automated and must be manually performed as a consequence of the spell.

Gesture: Strike.name: Gesture: Strike
Gesture: Strike.description:
You empower a direct close-range attack with the arcane essence of a Rune, performing a Strike with your equipped weapon.

The Strike gesture scales using Strength and deal damage based on your used weapon but with the damage type of the incorporated Rune. This gesture does not require any free hand and has a base cost of 1 Focus in addition to the cost of your weapon Strike.

Gesture: Pulse.name: Gesture: Pulse
Gesture: Pulse.description:
Expel the arcane power of a Rune in a radius that travels outward with you at its center.

The Pulse gesture scales using Presence and produces an emanation with 10 foot radius, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Frigid Projection.name: Frigid Projection
Frigid Projection.descriptionpublic: The @ref[actor.name] flings a focused blast of frigid elemental energy.

Elemental Ice.name: Elemental Ice
Elemental Ice.descriptionprivate:
A piece of ice taken from the body of a slain water elemental. It has numerous sharp edges, and is supremely cold. It is melting more slowly than natural ice would, and reflects the light oddly.

In cold environments, this ice will remain solid almost indefinitely. In warmer climates it will take several days to melt unless left in the sun or placed near a heat source.
Elemental Ice.descriptionpublic: A strange piece of ice with numerous sharp edges. It appears to be melting more slowly that most ice would.

Elemental Armor.name: Elemental Armor
Elemental Armor.descriptionpublic: The @ref[name] is enveloped by a fortified shell of elemental carapace which provides a degree of protection against physical harm.

Rune: Frost.name: Rune: Frost
Rune: Frost.description:
The orderly force of water and cold. The Frost rune governs the creation of water or other fluids and their transfer between liquid and frozen states.

The Frost rune scales using Wisdom, targets Fortitude, and deals Cold damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Flame.
Rune: Frost.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Frost allows you to manipulate liquids and their thermal properties, producing one of the following effects:

  • Draw up to one quarter gallon of fresh water from the atmosphere into a container or upon a surface you touch. The created water may be affected by relevant atmospheric properties of your current location.

  • Manipulate the temperature of up to 1 gallon of water, causing it to immediately freeze or thaw. The water need not be in a container; this technique can be used to coat a surface or join two objects together via regelation. Ice created in this way remains frozen for as long as the ambient temperature of the environment allows.

  • Gather up to a six-foot cube of nearby snow, forming it into a solidified sculpture, shape, or shelter.

Condense may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Elemental Summoning.name: Elemental Summoning
Elemental Summoning.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} is able to call forth other lesser elementals to join them as allies.
actiondesc:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} summons a @UUID[Actor.sVnMPbEj5P18Yo8V]{Water Sprite} in a space it can perceive within 60 feet which contains or is adjacent to water.

The @ref[actor.name]{creature} may only have one Sprite summoned in this way at a given time.

The @ref[actor.name]{creature} summons a @UUID[Actor.cIX3WXHAZ0gAXCNS]{Water Visitor} in a space it can perceive within 60 feet which contains or is adjacent to water.

The @ref[actor.name]{creature} may only have one Visitor summoned in this way at a given time.

Temple Invader.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

Water elementals are curious manifestations of pure, animated magical water with a vibrant turquoise color. They shimmer with an inner luminescence that gives them an almost ethereal appearance, and they are constantly in motion.

As they gain power they grow in size, complexity, and intelligence. The most basic and least powerful of these creatures, known as motes, are little more than harmless blobs of water, barely sentient and often collecting around sources of water.

At their largest and most powerful they can appear to be made partially of ice, with humanoid forms resembling upper bodies, heads, and two or more limbs. Large water elementals also begin to manifest sheets, spikes, and blades of ice which are suspended in the water but capable of moving around as the elemental needs.

Behavior

Water elementals are drawn to large bodies of water, specifically those rich with magical energy or notably receiving lunar influence from the water moon, Mayis. They tend to inhabit lakes, rivers, and ocean shores where they blend seamlessly into their surroundings. In these locales, they often go unseen for the entirety of their existence, preferring to bask in and absorb the energy.

While primarily non-hostile, water elementals can still be unpredictable. Smaller, weaker elementals like motes and sprites are often curious and playful, investigating travelers and sometimes trickling toward settlements during downpours simply out of fascination. The larger, much rarer elementals—visitors, wanderers, and colossi—are more reserved but become fiercely protective when they sense a threat to their magically charged habitats.

Water elementals typically gather and interact during lunar phases when the influence of Mayis is at its peak. This is the time when they are most active and likely to be encountered at all, becoming relatively rare otherwise.

Lore

As descendants of the elemental moon Mayis, water elementals have existed since the dawn of Ember's history. As a result, they are a well known, if not well understood aspect of the cosmos and the world.

In the past, the ancient Shent culture revered the moons of Ember, and built many temples to them, as a result there exist numerous ancient ruins in the world where water elementals can be found gathering, and basking in the latent lunar energies these temples harnessed.

It is not well understood how the water elementals appear on Ember, or by what means the come from Mayis. Theories range from them riding the light and magical energy pouring off the moon to the notion that they are created spontaneously on Ember and only arrive on Mayis once they have collected enough energy to bridge the distance somehow.
Temple Invader.biographypublic: The Temple Invader is a unique form of the Water Wanderer which has become infused with magical energy flowing through an magical temple dedicated to the moon of Mayis.
Temple Invader.biographyappearance: Towering over its peers, and even that of lesser wanderers, this invader's form is both graceful and intimidating. Enhanced by energy flowing through an ancient stone machine, this elemental appears much more powerful and cunning than most. Its movements are fluid and deliberate, exuding an air of lethal precision and purpose.

Cold Absorption.name: Cold Absorption
Cold Absorption.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has an exceptional ability to thrive within frigid environments. Its Cold resistance is doubled and if that resistance would reduce an amount of damage below zero, the negative amount is received as Healing instead.

The largest of them are harmless, and in rare cases may collect into swarms that swirl around some source of elemental energy like moths around a lamp.
Water Mote.biographyappearance: This tiny elemental is a glob of animated water roughly the size of a tiny animal. Its form is simple and amorphous, and it constantly shifts and ripples. They shimmer with an inner luminescence that gives them an almost ethereal appearance, and they are constantly in motion.

Amorphous.name: Amorphous
Amorphous.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} may move through a space as narrow as 1 inch in diameter without any penalty to its Stride. It gains a bonus to Dodge equal to half its Toughness score and is immune to the @Condition[restrained] condition.

False Appearance.name: False Appearance
False Appearance.description: While it remains motionless, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is indistinguishable from some other object or material.

Gesture: Fan.name: Gesture: Fan
Gesture: Fan.description:
You shape the essence of a Rune into a sweeping or splintered arc to strike multiple targets in close proximity.

The Fan gesture scales using Intellect and targets a 120 degree arc with 6 foot radius. It deals 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Elemental Armor.name: Elemental Armor
Elemental Armor.descriptionpublic: The @ref[name] is enveloped by a fortified shell of elemental carapace which provides a degree of protection against physical harm.

Aqueous Transmission.name: Aqueous Transmission
Aqueous Transmission.description: The @ref[name] is able to move instantaneously through water.
Aqueous Transmission.actiondesc: When the @ref[name] is within water, it can instantaneously transport itself to any unoccupied space within the same body of water up to 120 feet away. It does not need to be able to see the destination to make this Move.

Rune: Frost.name: Rune: Frost
Rune: Frost.description:
The orderly force of water and cold. The Frost rune governs the creation of water or other fluids and their transfer between liquid and frozen states.

The Frost rune scales using Wisdom, targets Fortitude, and deals Cold damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Flame.
Rune: Frost.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Frost allows you to manipulate liquids and their thermal properties, producing one of the following effects:

  • Draw up to one quarter gallon of fresh water from the atmosphere into a container or upon a surface you touch. The created water may be affected by relevant atmospheric properties of your current location.

  • Manipulate the temperature of up to 1 gallon of water, causing it to immediately freeze or thaw. The water need not be in a container; this technique can be used to coat a surface or join two objects together via regelation. Ice created in this way remains frozen for as long as the ambient temperature of the environment allows.

  • Gather up to a six-foot cube of nearby snow, forming it into a solidified sculpture, shape, or shelter.

Condense may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Water Sprite.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

Water elementals are curious manifestations of pure, animated magical water with a vibrant turquoise color. They shimmer with an inner luminescence that gives them an almost ethereal appearance, and they are constantly in motion.

As they gain power they grow in size, complexity, and intelligence. The most basic and least powerful of these creatures, known as "motes", are little more than harmless blobs of water, barely sentient and often collecting around sources of water.

At their largest and most powerful they can appear to be made partially of ice, with humanoid forms resembling upper bodies, heads, and two or more limbs. Large water elementals also begin to manifest sheets, spikes, and blades of ice which are suspended in the water but capable of moving around as the elemental needs.

Behavior

Water elementals are drawn to large bodies of water, specifically those rich with magical energy or notably receiving lunar influence from the water moon, Mayis. They tend to inhabit lakes, rivers, and ocean shores where they blend seamlessly into their surroundings. In these locales, they often go unseen for the entirety of their existence, preferring to bask in and absorb the energy.

While primarily non-hostile, water elementals can still be unpredictable. Smaller, weaker elementals like specks and sprites are often curious and playful, investigating travelers and sometimes trickling toward settlements during downpours simply out of fascination. The larger, much rarer elementals—visitors, wanderers, and colossi—are more reserved but become fiercely protective when they sense a threat to their magically charged habitats.

Water elementals typically gather and interact during lunar phases when the influence of Mayis is at its peak. This is the time when they are most active and likely to be encountered at all, becoming relatively rare otherwise.

Lore

As descendants of the elemental moon Mayis, water elementals have existed since the dawn of Ember's history. As a result, they are a well known, if not well understood aspect of the cosmos and the world.

In the past, the ancient Shent culture revered the moons of Ember, and built many temples to them, as a result there exist numerous ancient ruins in the world where water elementals can be found gathering, and basking in the latent lunar energies these temples harnessed.

It is not well understood how the water elementals appear on Ember, or by what means the come from Mayis. Theories range from them riding the light and magical energy pouring off the moon to the notion that they are created spontaneously on Ember and only arrive on Mayis once they have collected enough energy to bridge the distance somehow.
Water Sprite.biographypublic: The @ref[name] is a small, swirling water elemental that is often encountered in places where water is infused with magical energy, especially when drawn from the water moon Mayis. They are generally harmless unless the source of their interest is tampered with.
Water Sprite.biographyappearance: This small, energetic elemental is a cohesive globule form with small orbiting teardrops of water that it seems to control. It is surprisingly agile, moving in quick bursts and leaps that are graceful yet unpredictable. They shimmer with an inner luminescence that gives them an almost ethereal appearance, and they are constantly in motion.

Water Visitor.name: Water Visitor

Elemental Ice.name: Elemental Ice
Elemental Ice.descriptionprivate:
A piece of ice taken from the body of a slain water elemental. It has numerous sharp edges, and is supremely cold. It is melting more slowly than natural ice would, and reflects the light oddly.

In cold environments, this ice will remain solid almost indefinitely. In warmer climates it will take several days to melt unless left in the sun or placed near a heat source.
Elemental Ice.descriptionpublic: A strange piece of ice with numerous sharp edges. It appears to be melting more slowly that most ice would.

Gesture: Aspect.name: Gesture: Aspect
Gesture: Aspect.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect, casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Frigid Swipe.name: Frigid Swipe
Frigid Swipe.descriptionpublic: The @ref[actor.name] swipes with an aqueous pseudopod that is frigid with cold.

Elemental Armor.name: Elemental Armor
Elemental Armor.descriptionpublic: The @ref[name] is enveloped by a fortified shell of elemental carapace which provides a degree of protection against physical harm.

Frigid Projection.name: Frigid Projection
Frigid Projection.descriptionpublic: The @ref[actor.name] flings a focused blast of frigid elemental energy.

Water Visitor.biographyappearance: Nearly humanoid in appearance, this elemental has the shape of a torso and a head with the vague shape of a face, along with limbs that vary from appearing like a tail or arms, each tipped with shards of ice. Gesture: Step.name: Gesture: Step
Gesture: Step.description:
You infuse runic power into a movement, crossing physical and spatial boundaries.

The Step gesture scales with Dexterity and allows you to move up to 20 feet in a straight line with width equal to your Size. It deals 2 Base Damage to targets along that line which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture does not require any free hands to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

The movement aspect of this talent is not yet automated and must be manually performed as a consequence of the spell.

Gesture: Strike.name: Gesture: Strike
Gesture: Strike.description:
You empower a direct close-range attack with the arcane essence of a Rune, performing a Strike with your equipped weapon.

The Strike gesture scales using Strength and deal damage based on your used weapon but with the damage type of the incorporated Rune. This gesture does not require any free hand and has a base cost of 1 Focus in addition to the cost of your weapon Strike.

Gesture: Pulse.name: Gesture: Pulse
Gesture: Pulse.description:
Expel the arcane power of a Rune in a radius that travels outward with you at its center.

The Pulse gesture scales using Presence and produces an emanation with 10 foot radius, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Frigid Projection.descriptionpublic: The @ref[actor.name] flings a focused blast of frigid elemental energy.

Water Wanderer.biographypublic: The @ref[name] is a large, dangerously cunning elemental that is capable of manifesting deadly shards of sharp, dense elemental ice. It is not to underestimated, fortunately it is a rare sight on Ember.
Water Wanderer.biographyappearance: Larger than most humanoids, the wanderer is an imposing creature, both graceful and intimidating. Its movements are fluid and deliberate, exuding an air of intelligence and precision that lesser elementals lack. Its limbs are tipped with collections of large, razor-sharp pieces of prismatic ice that could make exceptionally effect bludgeons and even more dangerous blades for piercing and stabbing.

Mythspire Guardian.name: Mythspire Guardian

Nearing Death.name: Nearing Death
Nearing Death.description: The @ref[actor.name] is dying, and engaging in combat hastens the effect. At the end of every turn it suffers 6 Poison damage which will eventually cause it to become @Condition[dead].

Bound.name: Bound
Bound.description: The Mythspire Guardian is magically bound to the Mythspire Observatory. As long as the guardian lives, it cannot leave the observatory for any reason. If it is forcibly removed, such as by banishing or being dragged out, it can teleport back to the ruins within 10 minutes of time.

Cosmic Gems.name: Cosmic Gems
Cosmic Gems.description:
On each of its turns, the @ref[actor.name] fires a beam of light using its Luminous Sting towards one of the gems that encircle the chamber, charging it and directing it towards a specific target location in the room. Place a template marker the gem's target location.

At the beginning of the subsequent round, before any other creature acts, the charged gem activates its effect at or towards the point of the marker that was placed. The @ref[actor.name] must be alive to charge a gem, but the gem's effect will occur even if the creature is @Condition[incapacitated].

It is possible to disable a charged gem before its effect is activated by interacting with the stone and pressing the runes on the floor in the correct sequence, requiring a successful [[/skillCheck arcana 13]] check.
actiondesc: The @ref[actor.name] targets one of the Cosmic Gems around the chamber and projects a beam of light into it and directing the crystal's energy towards a particular location within the chamber.

The Gem of Akon creates a wall of shimmering force projected from itself towards its target location. The wall is 120 feet long and 60 feet high and prevents anything from moving through it. The wall remains for 3 rounds, or until the Gem of Akon is activated again.

The gem projects a 80ft cone of wind from itself toward its target location. All creatures caught within the cone face an attack against their Fortitude or they are rendered @Condition[prone]. If the @ref[actor.name] is caught within the cone, it may immediately fly up to 30 feet upwards without expending any Action using the powerful updraft created by the blast.

The gem creates a swirling vortex of gravitational energy 30ft in diameter at a random point in the lower part of the arena. All creatures other than the @ref[actor.name] face an attack against their Fortitude or they are pulled up to 20 feet towards the epicenter of the surge. Upon a Critical Success the target of this effect is also @Condition[staggered] until the end of their next turn.

The gem fires a beam of radiant energy which the @ref[actor.name] can harness and redirect towards any creature that it can see. The targeted creature faces an attack on its Reflex which deals Radiant damage. On a Critical Success the target is @Condition[blinded] until the end of their next turn.
The gem projects a circle with 15 foot radius of shimmering blue energy on the battlefield. Creatures within the area benefit from Restoration of their Health.
The Gem projects a beam of energy directly towards its target location. Any creatures along its path benefit from Restoration of their Morale.

The gem creates four shimmering fields of fire scattered across the battlefield, each one spawning a @UUID[Actor.tP8zyPS9cBHhJYBT]{Fire Sprite} which joins the fray to aid the @ref[actor.name]{creature}.

Elusive Flight.name: Elusive Flight
Elusive Flight.description: This @ref[actor.name]{creature} is especially elusive while in flight, able to swoop in and out of combat without provoking any Disengagement. It can be engaged if it lands upon the ground and Disengagement may apply if it attempts to return to flight.

Swooping Strike.name: Swooping Strike
Swooping Strike.description: This @ref[actor.name]{creature} swoops from high above into a diving attack.
Swooping Strike.actiondesc:
This attack may be used after a Move which descended at least 10 feet towards the target. The attack gains +1 Boon per 10 feet of elevation decrease in that movement.

If this attack is a Critical Hit, the target of the attack is immediately knocked @Condition[prone].

Pouncing Strike.name: Pouncing Strike
Pouncing Strike.description: This creature lunges forward, putting its whole weight behind a leaping strike.
Pouncing Strike.actiondesc:
This attack may be used after a Move that brings the @ref[actor.name]{creature} at least 10 feet closer to its target. If the creature was above the target, this attack gains +1 Boon per 10 feet of elevation decrease in that movement.

If this attack is a Critical Hit, the target of the attack is immediately knocked @Condition[prone].

Magical Sight.name: Magical Sight
Magical Sight.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has otherworldly sight that makes it especially aware of dangers or opportunities. It gains +2 Boons to any Awareness check and can see @Condition[invisible] creatures.

Rune: Illumination.name: Rune: Illumination
Rune: Illumination.description:
The orderly force of light and energy. The Illumination rune governs light and radiance.

The Illumination rune scales using Presence, targets Reflex, and deals Radiant damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Illusion.
Rune: Illumination.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Illumination allows you to create light and exert basic control over its radiance, producing one of the following effects:

  • Create a ball of light called a "tosslight" which sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius. The light can hover near your body, be affixed to an item or surface, or be thrown up to a distance of 30 feet. You may dismiss your tosslight at any time and may only have a single tosslight at a time, casting this spell again causes your previous tosslight to disappear.

  • Inscribe up to 200 words of invisible text into paper like a scroll, page, or book. The text is written from light itself and hidden from non-magical detection. It can be made visible by yourself or another through use of this spell combined with a spoken passphrase that you define at the time of inscription.

  • Touch a physical object that produces dim light, causing it to become bright light for as long as you maintain physical contact. Only one light source may be intensified in this way at a given time.

Reveal may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Illusion.name: Rune: Illusion
Rune: Illusion.description:
The chaotic force of trickery and whimsy. The illusion rune governs magical manifestations of falsehood or misdirection.

The Illusion rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower defense, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Illumination.
Rune: Illusion.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Illusion allows you to fabricate perception in various simple ways and to manipulate shadow and light to create distraction or entertainment, producing one of the following effects:

  • Modify a single aspect of your own physical appearance. Such alterations might include adjusting the sound of your voice, changing the color of your eyes, gaining illusory horns, or appearing slightly taller or shorter. The alteration persists until you Rest or enact a different alteration and can be verified as illusory by physical inspection.

  • Manifest a convincing recreation of a short sound or single scent that you can clearly recall. The illusion originates from your position and lasts for 10 seconds. You can control the volume of the sound or odorousness of the scent to be perceptible up to a range of 60 feet or shorter.

  • Decouple your shadow from your form, specifically controlling its movements separately from your own. You can maintain this illusion as long as you do not perform any other action that consumes Focus.

Seeming may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description:
You immediately react to a spell being cast and compose a rune and gesture designed to unravel and negate the spellcraft of an enemy mage.

Playtest Notes

This action can now be used in playtesting, but it is not yet fully automated. The Counterspell can be performed, but it is up to the Gamemaster to manually reverse a previously applied spell and to manually deduct its Action and Focus cost. These steps of the overall Counterspell workflow will be automated in a subsequent update such that a confirmed Counterspell will also confirm the spell that was countered, but with its effects removed.
Counterspell.actiondesc:
You form arcane energy into a countervailing spellcraft, targeting a spellcaster you can see within 30 feet.

Designate a Rune and Gesture which you know to attempt to counter the spell. Choosing a Rune which is opposed to one used in the spell grants +2 Boons to your attempt. Selecting the identical Gesture as the one being cast also adds +2 Boons to your attempt.

Perform a harmless Spell Attack against your target's Willpower defense. If your roll exceeds their defense, the spell is countered and its magic is nullified, producing no effects.

Rune: Kinesis.name: Rune: Kinesis
Rune: Kinesis.description:
The chaotic force of space and physical movement. The Kinesis rune governs all things related to the act of movement and physicality.

The Kinesis rune scales using Presence, targets Physical defense, and deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Control.
Rune: Kinesis.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Gesture: Ray.name: Gesture: Ray
Gesture: Ray.description:
You funnel the arcane power of a Rune into a point and project it outwards in a beam.

The Ray gesture scales using Wisdom and produces a line that is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Influence.name: Gesture: Influence
Gesture: Influence.description:
You intensify the arcane power of a Rune into a concentrated direct contact which is generally a more powerful evolution of the basic Touch gesture.

The Influence gesture scales using Presence and targets a single adjacent creature. It deals 10 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Aspect.name: Gesture: Aspect
Gesture: Aspect.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect, casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Protective Mirage.name: Protective Mirage
Protective Mirage.description: You Aspect yourself in a mirage of shifting Illumination and Shadow which mask your current position and allow you to Elude incoming blows.
Protective Mirage.actiondesc: You become surrounded by three illusory duplicates which last up to 10 Rounds. Any incoming Strike against you is made with a number of Banes equal to two times your number of duplicates remaining. Each time a Strike misses you, one of your duplicates disappears.

Unshakeable Poise.name: Unshakeable Poise
Unshakeable Poise.description: You demonstrate exceptional poise in stressful circumstances, your cool head prevailing when others around you lose their composure.
Unshakeable Poise.actiondesc: You expend Heroism to instantly recover your Wisdom in Focus. You may perform this action outside of your turn in Combat before making a Reaction.

Conserve Effort.name: Conserve Effort
Conserve Effort.description: You find calmness and focus in conserving your effort in battle. When you end your Turn with un-spent Action you gain +1 Focus.

Inflection: Elude.name: Inflection: Elude
Inflection: Elude.description: Enhance a spell to make it more difficult for an enemy to retaliate against its casting. This spell does not provide any opportunity to make reactions that involve Strike attacks, regardless of the results of the spell.

Strike First.name: Strike First
Strike First.description: Shoot first, ask questions later. You gain +1 Boon on any Strike or Spell attack against an enemy whose initiative score is lower than your own.

Planned Defense.name: Planned Defense
Planned Defense.description: You exert strong battlefield judgment to prepare your defenses against the attacks of your foes. Any enemy which acts after you in Initiative order suffers 1 Bane to their spell or weapon attacks against you.

Skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
Skirmisher.description: You are adept at entering and exiting the fray. When moving out of the Engagement radius of an enemy, that enemy has 2 Banes to any Disengagement Strike against you.

Ferocious Leap.name: Ferocious Leap
Ferocious Leap.description: You leap powerfully into battle to deliver a punishing blow to a nearby enemy with your mainhand weapon.
Ferocious Leap.actiondesc: You leap up to 10 feet and perform a Strike against an enemy within melee range of where you land. Your movement ignores difficult terrain and is not blocked by enemy creatures.

Luminous Sting.name: Luminous Sting
Luminous Sting.descriptionprivate: Ranged Weapon Attack:+8 to hit, 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) radiant damage.

Luminous Feather.name: Luminous Feather
Luminous Feather.descriptionpublic: A glowing feather filled with magical energy stemming from Primordis.

Mythspire Guardian.biographyprivate:
Offshoots of the Casia of Primordis, these guardians were created to be the ultimate protectors of knowledge. Among the beings of Primordis, they are broadly considered to have the keenest minds, sharpest senses, and most sound of judgement. While less openly inquisitive and prone to flights of fancy as other Casia, they are no less hungry for knowledge, and often learn all they can about whatever place they are asked to protect, becoming an expert in the site's layout and history.

Anatomy

The Mythspire Guardian blends the power and grace of a large predatory cat with the speed and unparalleled mobility of a raptor. Its fur is interspersed with feathers that exhibit vibrant, hypnotic colors that are constantly shifting. The luminous streaks it bears are not just for show; they resonate with latent magical energies that course through the creature’s body.

The Guardian’s constantly glowing eyes grant it sight that pierces the physical realm, detecting disturbances in magical fields and sensing presences otherwise hidden.

Its wings are not only for flight; they also serve as conduits of its magical powers, enabling it to create bursts of light to blind or disorient potential threats, or waves of energy to knock foes back.

Behavior

These ancient Primordis Guardians are highly intelligent and keenly perceptive creatures, and exceedingly rare on Ember. They are fiercely protective of the spaces they guard, keeping both the knowledge of the place, as well as its physical form safe from raiders and despoilers. In combat, these guardians are agile and formidable, using their glowing wings for swift, unpredictable assaults and to throw their foes off balance. Their magical nature also gives them the ability to manipulate light and magic, creating illusions or dazzling displays to confuse and overpower adversaries. Despite their protective nature, they can be benevolent to those who seek knowledge or protection, often granting insights to individuals they deem to be worthy seekers of knowledge.

Lore

Vanexis are immortal, and chosen to protect places of great knowledge and importance to Primordis. Though they are mostly used on their home plane, they are sometimes found on Ember, placed to keep watch over a ruin or location that mortals must be barred from. Should they fall in battle, they immediately reappear in their home plane, reincarnated.

The Mythspire Guardian was chosen to help guide the Giants that emerged from the Pathways. Making the Mythspire Observatory its home, protecting this sacred site and teaching the Shent knowledge of the Cosmos. Unfortunately, the guardian long outlived the Shent civilization and has had to watch the site fall into ruin over the last two millennia. Undeterred, it sits in peaceful solitude, gladly assisting any explorers and historians that pass through the observatory, so long as they do not mean it harm.
Mythspire Guardian.biographypublic: The Mythspire Guardian is a radiant, magical creature from the realm of Primordis. It has served as the stalwart and unflinching guardian of the Mythspire Observatory for as long as the ancient structure has existed. Unfortunately, recent events have brought an ignoble end to its watch.
Mythspire Guardian.biographyappearance:
This luminescent creature moves with predatory grace, each step leaving a faint radiant trail. Its large, glowing eyes seem to peer into the very essence of what it observes. Streaks of radiant color pulse rhythmically through its partially feathered fur, and up its two sets of wings.

The first pair extends from its forelegs, connecting to its sides, while the second, larger set fans out from its back. Both sets of wings are intricately patterned with luminous feathers that ripple like living stardust with the slightest motion.

This is a creature also appears to have been wounded, with raw burns cast across its face, neck and shoulders. The wounds are covered in swollen pustules and the fur and feature has been burned way to show raw, bubbled flesh.

Elusive Flight.name: Elusive Flight

Swooping Strike.name: Swooping Strike
Swooping Strike.description: This @ref[actor.name]{creature} swoops from high above into a diving attack.
Swooping Strike.actiondesc:
This attack may be used after a Move which descended at least 10 feet towards the target. The attack gains +1 Boon per 10 feet of elevation decrease in that movement.

If this attack is a Critical Hit, the target of the attack is immediately knocked @Condition[prone].

Pouncing Strike.name: Pouncing Strike
Pouncing Strike.description: This creature lunges forward, putting its whole weight behind a leaping strike.
Pouncing Strike.actiondesc:
This attack may be used after a Move that brings the @ref[actor.name]{creature} at least 10 feet closer to its target. If the creature was above the target, this attack gains +1 Boon per 10 feet of elevation decrease in that movement.

If this attack is a Critical Hit, the target of the attack is immediately knocked @Condition[prone].

Magical Sight.name: Magical Sight
Magical Sight.description: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has otherworldly sight that makes it especially aware of dangers or opportunities. It gains +2 Boons to any Awareness check and can see @Condition[invisible] creatures.

Rune: Illumination.name: Rune: Illumination
Rune: Illumination.description:
The orderly force of light and energy. The Illumination rune governs light and radiance.

The Illumination rune scales using Presence, targets Reflex, and deals Radiant damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Illusion.
Rune: Illumination.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Illumination allows you to create light and exert basic control over its radiance, producing one of the following effects:

  • Create a ball of light called a "tosslight" which sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius. The light can hover near your body, be affixed to an item or surface, or be thrown up to a distance of 30 feet. You may dismiss your tosslight at any time and may only have a single tosslight at a time, casting this spell again causes your previous tosslight to disappear.

  • Inscribe up to 200 words of invisible text into paper like a scroll, page, or book. The text is written from light itself and hidden from non-magical detection. It can be made visible by yourself or another through use of this spell combined with a spoken passphrase that you define at the time of inscription.

  • Touch a physical object that produces dim light, causing it to become bright light for as long as you maintain physical contact. Only one light source may be intensified in this way at a given time.

Reveal may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Illusion.name: Rune: Illusion
Rune: Illusion.description:
The chaotic force of trickery and whimsy. The illusion rune governs magical manifestations of falsehood or misdirection.

The Illusion rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower defense, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Illumination.
Rune: Illusion.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Illusion allows you to fabricate perception in various simple ways and to manipulate shadow and light to create distraction or entertainment, producing one of the following effects:

  • Modify a single aspect of your own physical appearance. Such alterations might include adjusting the sound of your voice, changing the color of your eyes, gaining illusory horns, or appearing slightly taller or shorter. The alteration persists until you Rest or enact a different alteration and can be verified as illusory by physical inspection.

  • Manifest a convincing recreation of a short sound or single scent that you can clearly recall. The illusion originates from your position and lasts for 10 seconds. You can control the volume of the sound or odorousness of the scent to be perceptible up to a range of 60 feet or shorter.

  • Decouple your shadow from your form, specifically controlling its movements separately from your own. You can maintain this illusion as long as you do not perform any other action that consumes Focus.

Seeming may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description:
You immediately react to a spell being cast and compose a rune and gesture designed to unravel and negate the spellcraft of an enemy mage.

Playtest Notes

This action can now be used in playtesting, but it is not yet fully automated. The Counterspell can be performed, but it is up to the Gamemaster to manually reverse a previously applied spell and to manually deduct its Action and Focus cost. These steps of the overall Counterspell workflow will be automated in a subsequent update such that a confirmed Counterspell will also confirm the spell that was countered, but with its effects removed.
Counterspell.actiondesc:
You form arcane energy into a countervailing spellcraft, targeting a spellcaster you can see within 30 feet.

Designate a Rune and Gesture which you know to attempt to counter the spell. Choosing a Rune which is opposed to one used in the spell grants +2 Boons to your attempt. Selecting the identical Gesture as the one being cast also adds +2 Boons to your attempt.

Perform a harmless Spell Attack against your target's Willpower defense. If your roll exceeds their defense, the spell is countered and its magic is nullified, producing no effects.

Rune: Kinesis.name: Rune: Kinesis
Rune: Kinesis.description:
The chaotic force of space and physical movement. The Kinesis rune governs all things related to the act of movement and physicality.

The Kinesis rune scales using Presence, targets Physical defense, and deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Control.
Rune: Kinesis.actiondesc:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.
