@ref[name]s are attracted to areas rich in magical light energy or notably influenced by celestial forces from the Inner Realm of Luxarum. They often inhabit ancient ruins where the Aedir once ruled, flickering in and out of existence depending on the amount of light energy present.

Lore

@ref[name]s are incredibly similar to elemental creatures in many ways, except they are actually tiny celestials and can be found in colossal storms and clouds upon Luxarum.
Light Mote.biographypublic: The @ref[name] possess no discernible features other than a small, almost intangible mass of pure light. They are nearly completely harmless, and many different types of motes float through Embers' skies on a daily basis. In rare cases, they may gather into swarms that swirl around some source of elemental energy, like moths around a lamp.
Light Mote.biographyappearance: This tiny elemental is a tiny coalesced amount of light that floats slowly through the air. They shine with an inner luminescence that gives them an almost ethereal appearance, and they are constantly in motion.

Chiaroscuran Beast.name: Chiaroscuran Beast

Multiattack.name: Multiattack
Multiattack.description: The [[lookup @name]] makes two @UUID[Actor.hDGMA97hjsiEszDf.Item.ZH8Zlr7RdgTjDN7K]{Scratch} attacks.

Merge Surface.name: Merge Surface
Merge Surface.description:
The [[lookup @name]] can merge with any flat, hard surface such as stone, tile, glass, brick, or similar and move along its surface without regard for gravity or terrain difficulty.

While merged with a surface, the [[lookup @name]] doesn't disturb the material it moves across, cannot attack or be attacked, and cannot be targeted directly by spells. It can still be damaged by area effects which would scour the surface it is on, however, such as the blast of a fireball or splash of acid from a flask.

The [[lookup @name]] requires a Bonus Action to merge with or emerge from a surface.

Quick Sketch.name: Quick Sketch
Quick Sketch.description: While merged with a surface via @UUID[Actor.hDGMA97hjsiEszDf.Item.zPtkhxg2m4xurlhR], the [[lookup @name]] magically teleports, along with anything it's currently carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space connected to the surface it is merged with.

Redraw Form.name: Redraw Form
Redraw Form.description: While the [[lookup @name]] is using its @UUID[Actor.hDGMA97hjsiEszDf.Item.zPtkhxg2m4xurlhR] ability, it can use its Action to restore 3d10 + 4 Hit Points.

Pounce.name: Pounce
Pounce.description:
The [[lookup @name]] moves up to half its Speed, and makes one @UUID[Actor.hDGMA97hjsiEszDf.Item.ZH8Zlr7RdgTjDN7K]{Scratch} attack.

On hit, Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=mNFD5tdCvtKYADLv]]

Failure: The target is pushed 10 feet in the opposite direction and left &Reference[Prone].

Chiaroscuran Beast.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

These elementals are constructed entirely of chalk and charcoal that has been infused with elemental energy from Cora. Since they are animated artwork driven by a trapped elemental, they have no internal anatomy of note, and can collapse its three-dimensional form to lay flat against surfaces, like a two-dimensional piece of art, but remains capable of moving across that surface.

When slain, the earth elemental within escapes, its energies dissipating rapidly, while the chalk and charcoal body crumbles into inert dust.

Behavior

Chiaroscuran Beasts are cunning predators that prefer hit-and-run attacks against weaker targets when possible, avoiding direct, pitched battles where they are likely to face more than foe at a time. As they contain a modestly powerful elemental spirit trapped inside of Falar's magical binding, they are intelligent enough to understand spoken commands and complex orders, but lack any ability to communicate on their own.

Lore

Created by the mage @UUID[Actor.rOAkdqKDnEYnAKih]{Falar}, these elementals are a mixture of magical binding created from infused minerals and carefully designed spellwork hidden inside of a highly artistic representation of a quadrupedal beast. These creatures are unique, hand-made, and powerful, containing an intelligent elemental that would be quite formidable on its own normally, but is bound to follow Falar's commands.
Chiaroscuran Beast.biographypublic:
This creature before is uncanny, an illustration given physical form and capacity for action. It is no kind of beast you recognize, a sleek and deadly amalgamation of feline and canine features exaggerated into deadly excess. It's maw of curved teeth jut out of its mouth, while huge retractable claws scrape across the ground. It's long, tufted tail swishes back and forth, and whenever it brushes against the ground, it merges with it, becoming flat as a drawing for but a moment.

The [[lookup @name]] is a rare form of earth elemental created from a combination of elementally infused charcoal and chalk given from by an artist's hand. They are swift and dangerous, able to glide over surfaces as two-dimensional art before leaping out to attack.

Paint Globlin.name: Paint Globlin

Glob Lob.name: Glob Lob
Glob Lob.description:
Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=B6xM8C2pABIb5o7y]], one creature the [[lookup @name]] can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=B6xM8C2pABIb5o7y]] feet.

Failure: The target is splattered in a layer of colorful paint and has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] condition until the start of its next turn.

Success: The target is splattered in paint but otherwise unaffected.

Paint Form.name: Paint Form
Paint Form.description: The [[lookup @name]] can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. It can also merge itself with any painted surface, becoming impossible to detect through mundane methods. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic} will reveal the presence of the [[lookup @name]] on the surface of the paint, however.

Death Burst.name: Death Burst
Death Burst.description:
The [[lookup @name]] explodes [[lookup @activation.condition activity=1SfqWSp7RSyHgG4b]]. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=1SfqWSp7RSyHgG4b]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=1SfqWSp7RSyHgG4b]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=1SfqWSp7RSyHgG4b]]-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name]].

Failure: The creature is coated in a layer of colorful paint and &reference[blinded] until the start of its next turn. All [[lookup @name]] are immune to the death bursts of each other.

Success: The creature is splattered with paint, but suffers no ill effect otherwise.

Paint Roller.name: Paint Roller
Paint Roller.description:
The [[lookup @name lowercase]] moves its Speed in a straight line without provoking &Reference[OpportunityAttacks] and can move through the spaces of [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=FG9rAj3Q8UTxbGLF]]. Each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=FG9rAj3Q8UTxbGLF]] whose space the [[lookup @name lowercase]] enters is targeted once by the following effect.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=FG9rAj3Q8UTxbGLF]].

Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

Paint Globlin.biographyprivate:
Anatomy

The [[lookup @name]] is made entirely of liquid paints suspended in a field of elemental magic. It is non-Newtonian in nature, becoming solid only when it needs to and remaining liquid in all other situations. It resembles a bipedal humanoid in form, though only barely, with most of its mass taken up by a stout body with stubby limbs attached.

Behavior

While most Globlins are inherently chaotic, they are rarely outright malevolent. The [[lookup @name]] is no different, and delights in the creation of chaos. However, unlike more naturally formed ilk, like mud, dirt globlins, these brightly colored elementals especially enjoy making messes, knocking over things, and abhor neat, tidy environments.

Lore

Globlins are one of a multitude of elementals that can be found on @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.5pD8lxiilJJXOgoa]{Cora}, and most are comprised of loose dirt, mud, or gravel held together by elemental magic. They are among the weakest of Cora's host, but their tendency to form large packs means they should never be underestimated.

The [[lookup @name]] in particular is the result of magically infused paint using a large measure of minerals and pigments infused with elemental energies from Cora. It is entirely possible for them to be created intentionally, or wholly by accident, and in neither case can the creators control the elementals once they are set loose.
Paint Globlin.biographypublic:
This stout creature has stubby legs and arms, and a body made entirely of differently color paints swirling around each other and refusing to blend. Two crazed eyes peer around, actively looking for trouble to get into, its whole form sloshing about but held together by some unseen force.

The [[lookup @name]] is a curious type of elemental formed from the blending of Cora infused pigments into paint, creating a chaotic, oily, creature that makes a mess of anything it touches.

Arcturian Alchemist.name: Arcturian Alchemist

Human Lineage.name: Human Lineage
Human Lineage.description: When you perform a Reaction which involves a Focus cost, you gain +1 Boon on any associated roll.
Human Lineage.actiondesc: When you become Weakened or sustain damage while Weakened, you can activate a burst of extraordinary adrenaline called Blaze. You immediately replenish your Action and Focus pools to their maximum value.

Common Clothing.name: Common Clothing
Common Clothing.descriptionpublic: A shirt, pair of pants, undergarments, socks and shoes or boots suitable for menial labour or travel, cannot be worn with armor.

Firestarter.name: Firestarter
Firestarter.descriptionpublic: A small waxed-leather pouch containing dry shredded plant fibre and wood shavings, with a little clasp inside for securing a piece of flint and a steel striking ring for the purposes of starting fires.

Lantern.name: Lantern
Lantern.descriptionpublic: An oil-burning or magically illuminated lantern that sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius.

Club.name: Club
Club.descriptionpublic: A crude yet effective weapon, the club is a blunt length of wood or bone designed to crush rather than cut. It can be a dangerous implement in the hands of even untrained fighters.

Quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
Quarterstaff.descriptionpublic: A simple wooden staff around six to eight feet long, the quarterstaff is a deceptively balanced weapon that can be deadly in trained hands.

Wilderness Novice.name: Wilderness Novice
Wilderness Novice.description:
You have received training in the basics of wilderness survival and traversal. You gain the Novice rank in the Wilderness skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know how to find and construct safe shelter from the elements, to start a fire for warmth, to keep cool in hot environments. You can find safe, drinkable water in most places, and how to identify which plants and animals can serve as safe food sources.

Arcturian Alchemist.biographyprivate:
Arcturians are covered in more detail here: @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCultures000.JournalEntryPage.8cGPxMRewkagoIvc]{Arcturian}

Personality

The Arcturians are friendly to everyone and greet outsiders as if they were friends and family. They are not martial and possess few martial traits because the plateau they have inhabited for generations is largely peaceful and serene.

Connections

The Arcturians have a close relationship with the Ordani, who reside in Ordain, the large metropolis located on the northeastern shores of the Arctus Plateau.

Phrases

"Hello there, friend!"

"Creativity is the heartbeat of our community."
Arcturian Alchemist.biographypublic: @ref[name]s are skilled apothecaries who ply their trade of agrarian pharmacology for the people of the Arctus Plateau. These intrepid specialists are trained in matters of the natural world as well as the arcane, and are known far and wide for their timely problem-solving abilities and the potency of their curious decoctions.
Arcturian Alchemist.biographyappearance: Clad in protective leathers and a quaint respirator made of natural materials, this wily Arcturian adventurer wears the telltale clothes and bearing of an alchemist or scholar.

Paralyzing Bolt.name: Paralyzing Bolt
Paralyzing Bolt.description:
This ammunition is used for all varieties of crossbow and is tipped with a specialized hollow piercing tip that has reduced wounding potential but features a small canister of toxin meant to break and inject itself when striking a target.

This bolt only deals 1 Piercing damage on hit, but the target must succeed on a [[/save format=long]] or be &reference[Paralyzed] for 1 minute. At the end of each of the target's turns, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

The poison is an unknown type that defies identification.

Bottle of Shadowcap Wine.name: Bottle of Shadowcap Wine
Bottle of Shadowcap Wine.descriptionpublic: A bottle of fine red wine from the sinkhole town of Arcturel, infused with an intoxicating Pathways fungi known as Shadowcap.

Seawall Brandy.name: Seawall Brandy
Seawall Brandy.description: A bottle of brandy from the coastal town of Seawall, infused with driftwood and apricots.

Blast Flask.name: Blast Flask
Blast Flask.description:
Primarily used to break apart large ore pieces, these alchemical flasks pack a concentrated punch (sold individually or by the crate). If combined in sufficient quantity, they can also trigger a chain reaction leading to larger explosions.

You throw the flask at a point you can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=3haDw9AOt8O8baV3]] feet of yourself. The flask shatters on impact, creating a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=3haDw9AOt8O8baV3]]-foot-radius sphere centered on that point.

Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=3haDw9AOt8O8baV3]]

Failure: A creature in the area takes [[/damage average]] damage per blast flask detonated.

Success: Half damage.

When you use the Throw action, you can detonate up to three blast flasks simultaneously at the same location. For each additional flask beyond the first, the damage increases by an additional 1d6 fire damage. Additionally, the blast radius increases by 5 feet for each extra flask used.

Unattended objects in the area are damaged. Flammable materials may ignite at the GM’s discretion.

Foundry Note

Scaling can be configured to adjust damage and area of effect using up to three flasks in a single action. After you drag this item into your character sheet for the first time, ensure that it is set to consume Blask Flask as a target in the Throw activity (Throw > Activation > Consumption).

Crate of Blast Flasks.name: Crate of Blast Flasks
Crate of Blast Flasks.descriptionprivate: Primarily used to break apart large pieces of ore, these alchemical flasks pack a concentrated punch. If combined in a large enough quantity, they can also be used to create a chain reaction that results in larger explosions.
Crate of Blast Flasks.descriptionpublic: A sturdy crate with carefully partitioned slots to hold up to 12 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.KdlUUFhAnpv6YIHT]{Blast Flasks}.

Inkaro Pearl, Blue.name: Inkaro Pearl, Blue
Inkaro Pearl, Blue.description:
This enchanted nacreous orb, harvested from the gullet of a subterranean Mootap, is roughly half an inch wide. If you are within [[lookup @range.value activity=HwFNnZFYXeVklpVX]] feet of the pearl, you can take a Magic action to command it to actively absorb heat in an area.

While active, the pearl consumes enough heat to make a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=HwFNnZFYXeVklpVX]] area around it cool, (roughly 60°F or 15°C), in enclosed spaces this effect is more pronounced, and in smaller areas it can even generate dangerous levels of cold (32°F or 0°C).

It takes about 30 minutes for the pearl to affect the space it's in, and once activated, the power of the inkaro pearl fades after 24 hours. The resulting inert pearl is worthless.

Inkaro Pearl, Red.name: Inkaro Pearl, Red
Inkaro Pearl, Red.description:
This enchanted nacreous orb, harvested from the gullet of a subterranean Mootap, is roughly half an inch wide. If you are within [[lookup @range.value activity=Wo0X0nPYq4O74wX4]] feet of the pearl, you can take a Magic action to command it to actively emit heat in an area.

While active, the pearl generates enough dry heat to make a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=Wo0X0nPYq4O74wX4]] area around it warm, (roughly 80°F or 26°C), in enclosed spaces this effect is more pronounced, and in smaller areas it can even generate dangerous levels of heat (roughly 100°F or 37°C).

It takes about 30 minutes for the pearl to affect the space it's in, and once activated, the power of the inkaro pearl fades after 24 hours. The resulting inert pearl is worthless.

Inkaro Pearl, White.name: Inkaro Pearl, White
Inkaro Pearl, White.descriptionpublic:
A magical orb harvested from the gullet of a subterranean Mootap, roughly half an inch in width.

This enchanted nacreous orb, harvested from the gullet of a subterranean Mootap, is roughly half an inch wide. If you are within 10 feet of the pearl, you can activate the pearl to emanate 40 feet of light (20 bright, 20 dim). Once used, the power of the inkaro pearl fades in 24 hours.

Blood Fever Cure.name: Blood Fever Cure
Blood Fever Cure.description: This medicine halts the progression of the @UUID[JournalEntry.98KNrGKYnmTiWuw5.JournalEntryPage.mLdpWlTaEh0nIV94]{Blood Fever} disease when consumed. This doesn't remove the effects of any accrued steps, however.

Caldera Curative.name: Caldera Curative
Caldera Curative.description:
This Kadisos specialty, designed to withstand the island's heat, provides healing and fire resistance.

When you drink this liquid, you regain [[/heal average]] and gain resistance to fire damage for 1 hour.

Graven's Rest Refresher.name: Graven's Rest Refresher
Graven's Rest Refresher.description:
This clear, tasteless liquid, which finds its way into many commonly-sold Graven's Rest beverages, leaves whoever consumes it refreshed.

When you drink this liquid, it reduces your level of exhaustion by 1, and you regain [[/heal average]].

Kezus Ointment.name: Kezus Ointment
Kezus Ointment.description: The rare refined ointment from the biological remains of Kezus jellies, it provides a small amount of magical healing when consumed but also cures a single disease at random.

Potion of Alertness.name: Potion of Alertness
Potion of Alertness.description:
This bottle contains a golden potion that assaults the senses with it's potent smell and taste. It radiates with a sharp, warming scent akin to that of roots freshly unearthed, tingling the nostrils with its earthy, spicy heat, and acidic bite. The aftertaste is sharp, and inescapable, but supremely good at clearing one's sinuses.

Drinking this potion wakes the user up, making them alert and focused. While under the effects of this potion the user has advantage on saves versus sleep effects, cannot fall asleep naturally, and doesn't suffer any ill effects from exhaustion, though it doesn't stop them from accruing more levels while under its effects.

The potion lasts for 6 hours normally, minus one hour for every level of exhaustion the user has at the time of consumption.

Potion of Climbing.name: Potion of Climbing
Potion of Climbing.description:
The potion is separated into brown, silver, and gray layers resembling bands of stone. Shaking the bottle fails to mix the colors.

When you drink this potion, you gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed for 1 hour. During this time, you have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks you make to climb.

Potion of Healing.name: Potion of Healing
Potion of Healing.description:
The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

You regain [[/heal]] when you drink this potion.

Potion of Pass Without Trace.name: Potion of Pass Without Trace
Potion of Pass Without Trace.description:
This dark gray liquid roils with an umbral shadow that fully envelops the solution whenever the potion is shaken.

When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPasswithou]{Pass Without Trace} spell.

Drakonbane Poison.name: Drakonbane Poison
Drakonbane Poison.descriptionpublic:
This small vial contains murky liquid that is noticeably thicker than water. It emits a disconcerting scent that evokes a sense of wrongness.

This poison is augmented with the Drakonbane enchantment, making it especially dangerous for Drakon characters.
actiondesc:
When this toxin is ingested or otherwise enters the bloodstream of a creature, it is initially Harmless, but the target must defend an attack against its Fortitude or become @Condition[poisoned].

The amount of poison damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[name]. This poison has +3 Boons against Drakon and also inflicts the @Condition[diseased] condition for its duration.

  • Fine - 6 damage for 8 rounds

  • Superior - 8 damage for 10 rounds

  • Masterwork - 10 damage for 12 rounds

This action should be used when the poison is ingested rather than when it is first applied.

The contents of this vial can be added to food, drink, smeared upon a bladed weapon, or combined with some alternative delivery mechanism.

This action, which consumes the available usage of the poison, should be used when it is first applied.

Firebug's Leather.name: Firebug's Leather
Firebug's Leather.descriptionprivate: This leather armor has been alchemically treated with compounds that make it practically immune to fire. It provides +5 Fire Resistance while equipped.
Firebug's Leather.descriptionpublic: Crafted from thick, boiled leather hardened into panels or a cuirass, leather armor offers lightweight protection ideal for scouts, rogues, and lightly armed skirmishers.

Shent Breastplate.name: Shent Breastplate
Shent Breastplate.descriptionprivate: Shent Malleability: This armor is lightly enchanted by ancient Shent magic, and was originally crafted for Large-sized creatures. While Invested, the owner can change the size of this breastplate by one size category, ranging from Large to Small.
Shent Breastplate.descriptionpublic: This giant-sized armor consists of a fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather. Although it leaves the legs and arms relatively unprotected, this armor provides good protection for the wearer's vital organs while leaving the wearer relatively unencumbered.

Shent Amulet.name: Shent Amulet
Shent Amulet.descriptionprivate: Shent Malleability. This holy symbol is lightly enchanted by ancient Shent magic, and was originally crafted for Large-sized creatures. While Invested, the owner can change the size of this amulet by one size category, ranging from Large to Small.
Shent Amulet.descriptionpublic: An amulet of Shent origin inscribed with long faded and untranslatable symbols.

Shent Shield.name: Shent Shield
Shent Shield.descriptionprivate: Shent Malleability. This shield is lightly enchanted by ancient Shent magic, and was originally crafted for Large-sized creatures. While Invested, the owner can change the size of it by one size category, ranging from Large to Small.
Shent Shield.descriptionpublic: A shield similar to a common Heater shield, but crafted of a more lightweight metal common in Shent construction.

Bloodletter Limbs.name: Bloodletter Limbs
Bloodletter Limbs.descriptionprivate: Sharp, misshapen limbs pulled from a bloodletter drinker or broodmother.

Bloodletter Nest Fiber.name: Bloodletter Nest Fiber
Bloodletter Nest Fiber.descriptionprivate: Mulched wood and plant fiber mixed with bloodletter saliva and blood, bloodletter nest fiber is rare, but can be used to make a sturdy, rust-colored parchment.

Bloodletter Wings.name: Bloodletter Wings
Bloodletter Wings.descriptionprivate: Tattered and horrible bloodletter wings taken from a once living specimen.

Cheliceraeth Eye.name: Cheliceraeth Eye
Cheliceraeth Eye.descriptionprivate: This bright cerulean gemstone can be consumed as a supplementary spell component that heightens the potency of certain spells or as an ingredient used in particular crafting schematics.
Cheliceraeth Eye.descriptionpublic: The crystal eye of a monstrous cheliceraeth.

Crag Raptor Feather.name: Crag Raptor Feather
Crag Raptor Feather.description:
The iridescent feather of an adult crag raptor. Crag raptor feathers possess the following arcane properties:

  • The duration of your invisibility spells is increased by [[/r 1d10]] minutes when at least 5 crag raptor feathers are used as a supplementary material component for the spell.

  • Creatures have disadvantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks to disbelieve your illusions when at least 5 crag raptor feathers are used as a supplementary material component for spells like @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHallucinat]{hallucinatory terrain}.

Dreth Sap.name: Dreth Sap
Dreth Sap.descriptionprivate: This strange viscous fluid is harvested from the numerous liquified brains of the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberBestiary000.JournalEntryPage.OPfBWA2N4EY974Wi]{Leviathan} in @UUID[JournalEntry.ForestStoneGazet.JournalEntryPage.QdZoGPgl1gEGFcQ2]{Helkas} during the Dusktide conjunction of Mayis and Orbis. Dreth Sap is a powerful ingredient for alchemists and smiths who seek to enhance the potency of their wares.
Dreth Sap.descriptionpublic: A thick viscous fluid with a distinct biological odor. An incredibly rare ingredient useful to alchemists and smiths.

Garganthus Hide.name: Garganthus Hide
Garganthus Hide.descriptionprivate: The vaguely reptilian hide of a primeval Garganthus. Can be used to fashion a dark leather armor that absorbs light, providing a +2 bonus to the wearer's Dexterity (Stealth).
Garganthus Hide.descriptionpublic: A primeval reptilian scale from the hide of a Garganthus.

Giant Crab Meat.name: Giant Crab Meat
Giant Crab Meat.description:
The meat taken from a giant crab. It will keep for about 2 days without being preserved, stored in a cold place, or magically treated.

This meat can be cooked up during a long rest, and can feed up to 4 people. It can also be sold.

Gray Hydroxol Hide.name: Gray Hydroxol Hide
Gray Hydroxol Hide.descriptionprivate: The gelatinous hide of the massive gray Hydroxol, when properly treated, produces a durable, flexible material that remains waterproof, making it rare but sought after material for waterproof packs, water repellent cloaks, and similar.

Hunter's Bounty.name: Hunter's Bounty
Hunter's Bounty.description:
A mixture of fresh meats taken from tidal pool crabs, eels, fish, and similar. The meat is fresh and ample. It will keep for about 2 days without being preserved, stored in a cold place, or magically treated.

This meat can be cooked up during a long rest, and can feed up to 8 people. Any creature that completes a long rest where this food is served regains 2 additional hit dice, and gains [[/heal]].

Hydroxol Bioluminescence.name: Hydroxol Bioluminescence
Hydroxol Bioluminescence.descriptionprivate: A Hydroxol's raw, harvested bioluminescent markings. When properly processed, this can be used to create radiant inks, dyes, and paints favored by artists, mages, tailors, and scribes alike.
Hydroxol Bioluminescence.descriptionpublic: Gelatinous bioluminescent material harvested from an adult Hydroxol.

Hydroxol Gills.name: Hydroxol Gills
Hydroxol Gills.descriptionprivate: A set of large, spongy, glowing external gills taken from a Hydroxol. Hydroxol gills are highly prized as an ingredient used in alchemical concoctions, specifically those that grant underwater breathing.
Hydroxol Gills.descriptionpublic: A set of large, spongy, faintly luminescent gills harvested from a fully-grown Hydroxol.

Hydroxol Hide.name: Hydroxol Hide
Hydroxol Hide.descriptionprivate: The gelatinous hide of the Hydroxol, when properly treated, produces a durable, flexible material that remains waterproof, making it rare but sought after material for waterproof packs, water repellent cloaks, and similar.
Hydroxol Hide.descriptionpublic: Hydroxol hide is rubbery and fortified with a layer of blubber.

Kezus Jelly.name: Kezus Jelly
Kezus Jelly.descriptionprivate: The slimy innards of the Kezus Jelly are notoriously hard to refine and purify. Naturally, the bodies of Kezus Jellies are highly toxic and dangerous to handle and can be used in the creation of several poisons and acids. However, it can also be refined into a material that has extensive healing properties.

M’abb Salts.name: M’abb Salts
M’abb Salts.descriptionprivate: This psychoactive crystalline mineral can only be harvested beneath the zenith of @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.zkmWSB32y8Fbc4UL]{Orbis} (the Spirit Moon) and is known to appear in a variety of locations where arcane potential is the greatest — places like forgotten reaches of the subterranean @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.FurLgJBcqG4ILqMO]{Pathways}, the famed scattered fragments of @UUID[JournalEntry.xqx0clu8pT4kRxAz.JournalEntryPage.kpLyA8T7vbOvn35H]{Ruined Towir}, or the transmogrified remains of legendary creatures.
M’abb Salts.descriptionpublic: A coarsely ground crystalline mineral with a pale green hue. A very rare arcane alchemical ingredient.

Snail Stone.name: Snail Stone
Snail Stone.description: This emerald-hued precious stone is harvested from the crystalized mucous glands of a Kadisoan Tidal Snail. A snail stone provides a +2 arcane bonus to any ability checks made using Alchemist's Supplies.

Suarrok Eye.name: Suarrok Eye
Suarrok Eye.descriptionprivate: The eye obtained from a Juvenile Suarrok has a Minor enchantment, while the eye obtained from an Adult Suarrok provides a Superior enchantment.
Suarrok Eye.descriptionpublic: The singular eye of a formidable Suarrok.

Elemental Ice.name: Elemental Ice
Elemental Ice.descriptionprivate:
A piece of ice taken from the body of a slain water elemental. It has numerous sharp edges, and is supremely cold. It is melting more slowly than natural ice would, and reflects the light oddly.

In cold environments, this ice will remain solid almost indefinitely. In warmer climates it will take several days to melt unless left in the sun or placed near a heat source.
Elemental Ice.descriptionpublic: A strange piece of ice with numerous sharp edges. It appears to be melting more slowly that most ice would.

Kaleidoscope Crystal.name: Kaleidoscope Crystal
Kaleidoscope Crystal.descriptionprivate:
This hunk of crystal taken from one of the Kaleidoscope cavern can be used as a source of illumination. After being charged with an hour of exposure to the sunlight, it sheds dim light for 20 feet for 10 hours. Each time the crystal is recharged, it has a chance to mesmerize the person carrying it as follows:

When the crystal is recharged, roll a [[/roll d6]]. If the result is a 1 or a 2, the light in the crystal begins to pulse and the person holding the crystal takes a kaleidoscope crystal effect (roll on @UUID[RollTable.CW4O54YLtXBarVjz] to determine).

If broken, the crystal has a mesmerizing effect on Luminous Oozes of all varieties, but automatically triggers the kaleidoscope crystal effect.

Tidemoss.name: Tidemoss
Tidemoss.description:
A clump of rare turquoise-colored lichen with a briny smell. Often found growing on the rocky shoals of Kadisoan tide pools.

Can be fed to a @UUID[Actor.VvGqzQaD39ft0SOV]{Tidal Snail} as bait.

Aediri War Knife.name: Aediri War Knife
Aediri War Knife.descriptionprivate:
This appears to be a typical Aediri War Knife issued to imperial soldiers during the height of the lost empire's power. The weight and balance make it very easy to use. It would be worth a lot to a collector.

The short sword seems to have been modified at some point, bearing transmutation symbols designed to preserve the unsettling sharpness of its edge and enhance its resilience.

You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic short sword weapon.

Spellwrought Pen.name: Spellwrought Pen
Spellwrought Pen.descriptionprivate: Developed by the Aedir for fieldwork in harsh environments, this pen protects writing from damage during disastrous situations. Any words written by the pen, including in a spellbook, cannot be damaged by fire or by being submerged by water.
Spellwrought Pen.descriptionpublic: A well-crafted dip pen of the sort a well trained scribe might use.

Heroic Portrait.name: Heroic Portrait
Heroic Portrait.description:
After spending 1 minute looking at your portrait, you gain +2 to a single ability score for 1 hour, as determined by the type of portrait. If your score in this ability is above 20, the portrait has no effect.

The portrait can be used 3 times in this way. After the third use, it becomes a mundane, if beautiful, portrait of you, with no magical effect.

Portrait Types

  • Portrait of Strength: The portrait shows you easily lifting an impossibly heavy object. Your strength score is affected by the portrait's use.

  • Portrait of Motion: The portrait shows you seemingly in motion, weaving your way through all obstacles in front of you. Your dexterity score is affected by the portrait's use.

  • Portrait of Endurance: The portrait shows you walking through fire unfazed. Your constitution score is affected by the portrait's use.

  • Portrait of Learnedness: The portrait shows you reading a tome, excited by the new knowledge it contains. Your intelligence score is affected by the portrait's use.

  • Portrait of Mindfulness: The portrait shows you in the midst of a larger scene, carefully observing all around you. Your wisdom score is affected by the portrait's use.

  • Portrait of Popularity: The portrait shows you in the middle of a conversation, with those around you entranced by your words. Your charm score is affected by the portrait's use.

Scrimshaw Dagger.name: Scrimshaw Dagger
Scrimshaw Dagger.descriptionpublic: A short antique blade carved from humanoid bone, adorned with ancient carvings from a bygone age.

Big Spinel.name: Big Spinel
Big Spinel.descriptionprivate: A big red oval spinel taken from the crossguard of an ancient Shent greatsword. The giant gemstone is flawless and polished smooth as glass, with no blemishes to be found. It is one of the largest of its kind ever seen, and likely worth quite a lot.

Bronze Ingot.name: Bronze Ingot
Bronze Ingot.descriptionprivate: An ingot of bronze, coveted by blacksmiths and quartermasters based on its military usefulness.
Bronze Ingot.descriptionpublic: An ingot of bronze, coveted by blacksmiths and quartermasters based on its military usefulness.

Chipped Spinel.name: Chipped Spinel
Chipped Spinel.descriptionprivate: A big, chipped red spinel and shards pried from the crossguard of an ancient Shent greatsword. The large gemstone is badly damaged and cracked, greatly reducing its value. Despite this, it's one of the largest you've ever seen and likely still worth a fair bit to somebody.

Gem-Encased Petals.name: Gem-Encased Petals
Gem-Encased Petals.descriptionprivate: Bright flower petals are captured within the facets of these gems, giving each a unique beauty.

Iolite.name: Iolite
Iolite.descriptionprivate: A faceted nugget of semi-precious purple gemstone, cut and polished to perfection by a professional lapidary.

Signaran Opal.name: Signaran Opal
Signaran Opal.descriptionprivate: This iridescent gemstone from the Inner Realm of Signara scintillates with a dazzling array of otherworldly colors.

Exquisite Jeweled Ring.name: Exquisite Jeweled Ring
Exquisite Jeweled Ring.descriptionprivate: An exquisite engraved ring adorned with gleaming precious gemstones.

Fine Jeweled Ring.name: Fine Jeweled Ring
Fine Jeweled Ring.descriptionpublic: A fine ring adorned with tiny semiprecious gemstones.

Masterwork Jeweled Ring.name: Masterwork Jeweled Ring
Masterwork Jeweled Ring.descriptionpublic: A ring of masterwork quality adorned with flawlessly cut, dazzling precious gemstones.

Simple Jeweled Ring.name: Simple Jeweled Ring
Simple Jeweled Ring.descriptionpublic: A simple ring adorned with a small semiprecious gemstone.

Obsidian Blade Flat.name: Obsidian Blade Flat
Obsidian Blade Flat.descriptionprivate:
The flat of an Obsidian Blade, polished to a sharp edge. This can be used to create a bladed weapon with a +1 bonus.

There is only enough obsidian to make a single item.

Obsidian Blade Hilt.name: Obsidian Blade Hilt
Obsidian Blade Hilt.descriptionprivate:
The hilt of an Obsidian Blade, glinting in the light. This can be used to fashion a melee weapon with a +1 bonus.

The hilt can only be attached to one weapon and may only be used once.

Ancient Aediri Coin.name: Ancient Aediri Coin
Ancient Aediri Coin.descriptionprivate:
This ancient coin has been worn smooth from untold years of existence, robbing it of its finest details. Despite this, the face bears the symbol of the ancient Aedir empire.

Made of pure silver, the coin itself has limited inherent value unless sold to a collector.

Shard of Mind Grounding.name: Shard of Mind Grounding
Shard of Mind Grounding.descriptionprivate:
While wearing and invested in this pendant, you have a bonus to Psychic Resistance and you are immune to the @Condition[disoriented] condition. The amount of resistance provided is determined by the enchantment tier of this item:

  • Minor: +2 Psychic Resistance

  • Major: +5 Psychic Resistance

  • Legendary: +10 Psychic Resistance
Shard of Mind Grounding.descriptionpublic: A piece of ancient Shent machinery that still holds usable abjuration warding. It has been fashioned into a wearable pendant, allowing it to provide the wearer some protection.

Shent Artifacts.name: Shent Artifacts
Shent Artifacts.descriptionprivate: A small collection of gathered Shent artifacts taken from a battlefield found in the Forest of Stone. The items are all badly damaged, corroded, and utterly useless. They could be valuable to a collector or seller of antiquities, however.

Shent Machine Shards.name: Shent Machine Shards
Shent Machine Shards.descriptionprivate: A collection of shattered stone discs extracted from the core of a Shent machine. They are potentially valuable to a collector or historian, but are otherwise useless and worthless.

Shent Signet Ring.name: Shent Signet Ring
Shent Signet Ring.descriptionpublic: An ancient signet ring marked with the seal of some unknown faction of the fabled Shent Sages.

Chasm Candle.name: Chasm Candle
Chasm Candle.descriptionpublic: The flame of this candle is not extinguished when subjected to strong winds, lack of air, or great depths. It gives off light and heat like a normal candle.

Heart-Shaped Clasp.name: Heart-Shaped Clasp
Heart-Shaped Clasp.descriptionprivate: This exquisitely detailed and hand-crafted wooden clasp resembles a heart made out of vines and metal and includes a pin intended to fasten fabric together. Those who know craftsmanship well may note that each half of the heart uses slightly different carving techniques, as if two different carvers came together, each making one half of the item.

Mining Guild Cloak Pin.name: Mining Guild Cloak Pin
Mining Guild Cloak Pin.descriptionpublic: A silver cloak pin that serves as a badge for members of the Ordani Mining Guild.

Platinum Scroll Tube.name: Platinum Scroll Tube
Platinum Scroll Tube.description:
This cylindrical platinum tube can hold up to ten rolled-up sheets of paper or five rolled-up sheets of parchment.

Contains the following Spell Scrolls:

@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.zPGohqJRir6MyQ3U]{Expeditious Retreat}

@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.3OZnNhunvRtPOQmH]{Identify}.

Platinum Tooth.name: Platinum Tooth
Platinum Tooth.descriptionpublic: A humanoid tooth made of solid platinum.

Shock Rocks.name: Shock Rocks
Shock Rocks.description:
Often used by children for handshake pranks, these stones are charged with lightning power, dealing a mild shock to those who touch them.

Any creature that comes in contact with shock rocks must succeed on a [[/save format=long]] or take [[/damage average]] damage.

Silver Scroll Tube.name: Silver Scroll Tube
Silver Scroll Tube.description: This cylindrical silver tube can hold up to ten rolled-up sheets of paper or five rolled-up sheets of parchment.

Aedir Longsword.name: Aedir Longsword
Aedir Longsword.descriptionprivate: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]] or [[/damage twoHanded average]] damage if used with two hands.
Aedir Longsword.descriptionpublic: A lengthy stright blade designed for slashing foes, the longsword is a highly versatile weapon that may also be wielded with two hands for more punishing strikes.

Aedir Shortsword +1.name: Aedir Shortsword +1
Aedir Shortsword +1.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

Whether through demonic blessing, celestial bequeathment, crazed experiment, or skillful craft, this weapon has been enhanced to bring more bloodshed by the bearer.

You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Captain's Scimitar.name: Captain's Scimitar
Captain's Scimitar.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

This sword appears to be made of high-quality Tayrean bronze, renowned for its sharpness and sturdiness. The captain surely won't miss it.

You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Construct Carver.name: Construct Carver
Construct Carver.descriptionprivate:
Designed to fend off the metal constructs favored by the Aedir Empire, the forging of this weapon uses exceptional steelcraft that is effective in striking their iron frames.

Strikes made with this weapons against creatures of the Construct type benefit from +1 Boon.
Construct Carver.descriptionpublic: This scimitar is heavier than expected, but well balanced. Its slightly curved blade gleams under the light revealing a swirling pattern imbued into the metal itself.

Duskmaw's Bite.name: Duskmaw's Bite
Duskmaw's Bite.descriptionprivate: Strikes with this weapon while Mayis is full deal an additional 2 Cold damage to Morale. Strikes with this weapon while Orbis is full deal and additional 2 Psychic damage to Morale.
Duskmaw's Bite.descriptionpublic: This magical pickaxe was crafted from the gloamstone remains of the Duskmaw leviathan.

Duskmaw's Gavel.name: Duskmaw's Gavel
Duskmaw's Gavel.descriptionprivate: Strikes with this weapon while Mayis is full deal an additional 2 Cold damage to Morale. Strikes with this weapon while Orbis is full deal and additional 2 Psychic damage to Morale.
Duskmaw's Gavel.descriptionpublic: This magical war hammer was crafted from the gloamstone remains of the Duskmaw leviathan.

Net.name: Net
Net.descriptionprivate:
These thickly woven fibers are reinforced for use in combat to entrap and entangle even the most dangerous foes, rendering them vulnerable for assault with other weaponry.

Special. A Large or smaller creature hit by a net is restrained until it is freed. A net has no effect on creatures that are formless, or creatures that are Huge or larger. A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) also frees the creature without harming it, ending the effect and destroying the net. When you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to attack with a net, you can make only one attack regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

Obsidian Blade of Scoris.name: Obsidian Blade of Scoris
Obsidian Blade of Scoris.descriptionprivate:
Requires attunement

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

This black blade is made of obsidian glass and is razor sharp. It can cut through nearly anything with horrible efficiency. This is far too small to have been Scoris' personal weapon, but may have belonged to one of her champions.

When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 4d6 slashing damage. Then roll another d20. If you roll a 20, you lop off one of the target's limbs, with the effect of such loss determined by the GM. If the creature has no limb to sever, you lop off a portion of its body instead.

Ortarec Wand.name: Ortarec Wand
Ortarec Wand.descriptionprivate: Commonly seen in the hands of Cascilian mage-hunters, this one hangs from Clipper's belt in case it might ever come in handy. Clipper claims they won it from a Cascilian sea captain a few years ago in a card game, though the story is never quite consistent enough to feel like the whole truth.
Ortarec Wand.descriptionpublic: This finely crafted wooden wand features a varnished and polished handle and elegantly swooping crest that bears Cascilian magical symbols. Suspended inside the head of the wand is an orb of Ortarec infused stone which helps to siphon magic into the wand, recharging it, and assists in the detection of magic when active.

Scoris' Fury.name: Scoris' Fury
Scoris' Fury.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]] or [[/damage twoHanded average]] damage if used with two hands.

This sword, left behind in Kadisos from the time of Scoris' crusade against the demonic forces of her fellow shard-god Bale, was forged to help Scoris' forces strike quickly and decisively. While it had a tendency to shatter during battle, most of Scoris' forces didn't believe they'd be at war long enough for it to matter.

Electrified. This weapon deals an extra 1d4 lightning damage to any target it hits.

Fragile. If a natural 1 is rolled on an attack roll with Scoris' Fury the sword shatters and is broken permanently. A player may spend Inspiration if available to avoid the sword breaking.
Scoris' Fury.descriptionpublic: A lengthy straight blade designed for slashing foes, the longsword is a highly versatile weapon that may also be wielded with two hands for more punishing strikes.

Shent Shortsword.name: Shent Shortsword
Shent Shortsword.descriptionprivate: Shent Malleability. This weapon is lightly enchanted by ancient Shent magic, and was originally crafted for Large-sized creatures. While Invested, the owner can change the size of this shortsword by one size category, ranging from Large to Small.
Shent Shortsword.descriptionpublic: A medium sized blade with a firm crossguard and a leather-wrapped handle. A versatile weapon which makes up in versatility what it lacks in reach.

Silvered Aedir Warhammer.name: Silvered Aedir Warhammer
Silvered Aedir Warhammer.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]] or [[/damage twoHanded average]] damage if used with two hands.

A heavy hammer of silvered steel capable of being wielded with a single hand with a shield or in two hands to deliver crushing concussive blows.

Obsidian Glaive +1.name: Obsidian Glaive +1
Obsidian Glaive +1.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

This weapon has been enhanced by Ashkan magic to bring more bloodshed by the bearer.

You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Aedir Construct Fluid.name: Aedir Construct Fluid
Aedir Construct Fluid.descriptionprivate: This alchemical contaminant, created from the runoff of a metal construct, holds a small amount of power, which appears to have been used as some sort of power source by the Aedir scientists in the lookout post in the hills of the Forest of Stone.
Aedir Construct Fluid.descriptionpublic: A strange alchemical compound with swirls with a yellow-orange color. The exterior of its canister gives you the sensation of electrical charge that causes your hair to stand on end.

Alchemical Silver.name: Alchemical Silver
Alchemical Silver.descriptionprivate:
In addition to its uses as an alchemical ingredient, Alchemical Silver can also be added to food as a counteracting agent to alchemical poisons, giving whoever consumes it +2 boons to checks related to the resistance of poisons.

Alchemical Silver also sticks to the hands and makes them slippery - any character who touches with their bare hands has +2 Banes on athletics or performance checks related to manual dexterity for the next hour.
Alchemical Silver.descriptionpublic: This silver powder serves as a cleanser and neutralizing agent for other alchemical agents.

Elevator Glyphstone.name: Elevator Glyphstone
Elevator Glyphstone.descriptionprivate: This glyphstone bears a glyph upon its surface that translates loosely in Common as "Below".
Elevator Glyphstone.descriptionpublic: An elliptical glyph-stone found within the Aedir Signalpost in the Forest of Stone.

Jasper's Diary.name: Jasper's Diary
Jasper's Diary.descriptionprivate:
The entries cover many of the boring things that Jasper has been doing from day to day while supervising the mine, but they give the general impression that he is unhappy with the slow pace of the mine's profits.

One page has a corner folded down, while another has a scrap of paper inside of it that is being used as a bookmark.

The page with the folded-down corner is a list of debts owed to a speculator in Helkas. It includes the following note:

Sellen promised we would be doing well out here, but it has taken forever to get the mining tracks set up and the profits have yet to begin rolling in. My friend grows impatient. Perhaps I should not have borrowed quite so much, but when a jewel speaks to you, you have to have it, and that is that.

The bookmarked page has a drawing of a large circular container of some kind, almost resembling a small well, with oozes trapped inside of it and a skull and crossbones drawn on its side. There are several notes on the side of the drawing, including the following:

Oozes + contaminant = more metal than we are ever going to be able to recover on our own. Now I just have to convince Tauric that it's for the oozes' own good…
Jasper's Diary.descriptionpublic: A small leather-bound notebook with an embossed J on the cover.

Vial of Luminous Goo.name: Vial of Luminous Goo
Vial of Luminous Goo.descriptionprivate: This substance, a byproduct created when a luminous ooze creature ingests and expels the wrong alchemical compound, is acidic to the touch. Luminous oozes are immune to this substance.
Vial of Luminous Goo.descriptionpublic: This substance seems to have a mix of ooze remains and something alchemical, combined to create something new and dangerously acrid.
Vial of Luminous Goo.actiondesc:
You fling the @ref[name], dealing Weakened immediate damage but causing the @Condition[corroding] condition to all enemies in a 4 foot radius Blast who fail to avoid the attack.

The amount of burning damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the bomb:

  • Shoddy - 2 damage for 2 rounds

  • Standard - 3 damage for 3 rounds

  • Fine - 4 damage for 4 rounds

  • Superior - 6 damage for 5 rounds

  • Masterwork - 8 damage for 6 rounds

Yakoshta Blue Track Lever.name: Yakoshta Blue Track Lever
Yakoshta Blue Track Lever.descriptionprivate: The Blue Track Lever is necessary for the operation of the @UUID[JournalEntry.rycatIw6IR9KlRhK.JournalEntryPage.hAcz3Hbyw8ZZQfv3#the-missing-lever]{Blue Track} in @UUID[JournalEntry.rycatIw6IR9KlRhK]{Yakoshta Mine}. It was found encircled by oozes in the mine's @UUID[JournalEntry.rycatIw6IR9KlRhK.JournalEntryPage.OVPUBZvPbZpksFnS]{Ooze Pool}.
Yakoshta Blue Track Lever.descriptionpublic: An elongated lever with a peculiar K-shaped joint at its base that seems designed to fit into a socket or device.

Yakoshta Junction Wheel.name: Yakoshta Junction Wheel
Yakoshta Junction Wheel.descriptionprivate: This wheel was found within Yakoshta Mine and can be used in the repair of the rotating platform at the @UUID[JournalEntry.rycatIw6IR9KlRhK.JournalEntryPage.8RAoBSwmaWf2ZT8h]{Junction}.
Yakoshta Junction Wheel.descriptionpublic: A circular metal wheel fitted with a peculiar and specific joint.

Yakoshta Mine Maps.name: Yakoshta Mine Maps
Yakoshta Mine Maps.descriptionprivate:
Pocket maps have a general layout of the mine and indicate the rooms of the mine using symbols. Party members with the pocket map can attempt to decipher the meaning of each symbol on it with a successful [[/skillCheck society 13]] to identify commonly used mining symbols, a [[/skillCheck awareness 15]] to use what they have seen in other rooms to determine the unknown symbols. For each symbol they know the meaning of, characters can add +1 Boon to the roll. If they know [[/language pathward]], the check is made with +2 Boons.

Annotated maps have a more detailed layout, including the locations of levers, and indicate the rooms of the mine by their name or function, with no symbol attached. No work is needed to decipher them or use them to find locations.
Yakoshta Mine Maps.descriptionpublic: Maps of Yakoshta mine are found in two varieties - pocket maps and annotated maps.

Shent Planisphere.name: Shent Planisphere
Shent Planisphere.descriptionprivate: Each disc denotes the movement of stars and moons in the sky of Ember.
Shent Planisphere.descriptionpublic:
An ancient star chart composed of multiple notched discs made using different types of metal. Unfortunately, it has suffered severe damage, and has some gaps and marring that make it less effective at charting the movement of stars and moons.

It looks as through it could have once slotted into some sort of machine, as the discs are rather cog-like, though several of them have missing teeth and cracks that would prevent it from being used.

Merchant's Messenger.name: Merchant's Messenger
Merchant's Messenger.descriptionprivate:
The sigils on the coin link it with a sibling coin, allowing those that hold one of the paired coins to communicate over vast distances.

If you hold the coin and speak to it, the coin immediately connects its sibling and begins speaking loudly, relaying what you're saying and what is said back. The connection lasts for up to 1 minute before the connection breaks. Each coin can be used once per long rest.

The coin may be used 5 times after which its magic fades, becoming nearly worthless.
Merchant's Messenger.descriptionpublic: A small brass coin with a broad, grinning face and little red garnet eyes. The coin is stamped with a specific sequence of sigils.

Shent Scroll Case.name: Shent Scroll Case
Shent Scroll Case.descriptionpublic:
This metallic cylinder is strange and arcane - it seems to have a multitude of locked compartments and many moving parts that can be individually manipulated.

The Shent Scroll Case is an arcane puzzle box for spellcraft, allowing its user to more easily remember, recall, and perform Iconic Spells stored within.

While equipped and Invested, this trinket provides its bearer with +2 Iconic Spell slots. Additionally, the bearer can ignore one missing prerequisite spellcraft component that would otherwise be required to know or perform an Iconic Spell.

Bleak Archive Relic.name: Bleak Archive Relic
Bleak Archive Relic.descriptionprivate:
Curse. This relic is cursed.

Possessing the relic for 24 hours curses you until the effect is removed by a [[/counterspell rune=life gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]]; removing the relic from your possession fails to end the curse.

While you are cursed by the relic, you are sensitive to sunlight and are @Condition[exhausted].
Bleak Archive Relic.descriptionpublic: This abstruse antique hails from a bygone age before The Shattering, and was discovered in the aftermath of an Abyssal incursion on the surface of Ember. In the hands of a mortal humanoid, this inscrutable item is relatively useless, but nevertheless serves as a valuable art object. It would command a handsome price from an unsuspecting (or unscrupulous) collector.

Darkflame Circlet.name: Darkflame Circlet
Darkflame Circlet.descriptionpublic:
This circlet is crafted from a dark silver alloy and adorned with a single gemstone of otherworldly opalescence.

Under Development

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.

While Invested, the wearer gains access to a special version of @Spell[death.ray] that can strike up to 3 targets.
Darkflame Circlet.actiondesc: At your command, the circlet casts @Spell[death.ray] at up to 3 of your chosen targets.

Darkstride Amulet.name: Darkstride Amulet
Darkstride Amulet.descriptionprivate:
This amulet is cursed.

Investing in this amulet curses you until the effect is removed by a [[/counterspell rune=life gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]]; removing the relic from your possession fails to end the curse.

While you are cursed, you have a 5% chance each time you Rest to experience a @UUID[RollTable.Vl44RuVdUgscbv2r]{Dream of Nethehepticas}, if that occurs you gain a sensitivity to sunlight and are @Condition[exhausted] until your next Rest.
Darkstride Amulet.descriptionpublic:
This amulet made of volcanic glass glistens with an odd nacreous sheen.

Under Development

While invested in and wearing this amulet, you are hidden from divination magic. You cannot be the subject of such magic or perceived through magical scrying.
Darkstride Amulet.actiondesc: You may not be observed by scrying magics. Instead, the viewer receives a vision of silent darkness.

Dereth's Journal.name: Dereth's Journal
Dereth's Journal.descriptionprivate: In addition to private accounts of personal life, this dog-eared diary of the young bard Dereth Erekos is scrawled with transcriptions of strange dreams and ambling reflections on nightmarish thoughts.
Dereth's Journal.descriptionpublic: This dog-eared diary of the young bard Dereth Erekos features private accounts of his personal life.

Dereth's Notes.name: Dereth's Notes
Dereth's Notes.descriptionpublic: A collection of notes on folded parchment pages, including several drafts of song lyrics, a grocery list from Mrs. Erekos, and a bill of sale from Liestra Grann for the new lute.

Finger of Nethehepticas.name: Finger of Nethehepticas
Finger of Nethehepticas.descriptionprivate:
Requires investment by a character with spellcasting ability and Abyssal Attunement.

Having this talisman equipped and invested grants +1 Boon to any action with the Spell tag for each Finger of Nethehepticas in your possession, up to a maximum of +3.

Attempting investiture to this item, regardless of whether you meet the criteria for attunement, increases your degree of Abyssal Attunement by 1 and decreases your degree of all other attunements by 1.
Finger of Nethehepticas.descriptionpublic: This glassy wand of ink-black stone resembles the petrified finger of a fiendish outsider, and it functions as an arcane talisman.
actiondesc: While holding the wand, you can use an action to target the corpse or remains of a creature of size 4 or larger. A Corrupted Cadrithor rises in the space the remains occupied or in the nearest unoccupied space.

When you damage a creature that you can see with a Spell, you can subsequently make an Arcana skill attack against their Fortitude defense to steal a portion of their vital essence. On a success you recover the amount of damage dealt by the spell as Health.

You can force each enemy you can see within 30 feet to defend against an Arcana skill attack targeting their Willpower defense. If successful, the target suffers the @Condition[frightened] and @Condition[entropy] conditions for 3 Turns.

Heretic's Skull.name: Heretic's Skull
Heretic's Skull.descriptionpublic: This rune-marked humanoid skill serves as a talisman, helping the practitioner to channel arcane energies.

Liestra's Bracer of Appraisal.name: Liestra's Bracer of Appraisal
Liestra's Bracer of Appraisal.descriptionprivate: An invested user of this bracer can activate its enchanment to cause it to unfold into a fully functional @UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.jewelersPortable]{Jeweler's Portable Workbench}, and gain @Advantage[2] while using these tools for the purposes of appraising the value of an item.
Liestra's Bracer of Appraisal.descriptionpublic: This enchanted bracer is fitted with implements like clockwork calipers and tweezers, arcane spectroscopes, and a phantasmal scale.

Moon Blossom.name: Moon Blossom
Moon Blossom.descriptionpublic:
This small blue flower resembles a pale cerulean anemone. It glows with soft iridescence whenever the light of one of Ember's full moons shines upon the surface of the planet.

The buds of these curious plants are known to grow amidst the Skybrush hinterlands, and their appearance is actually a surreptitious indication of otherworldly influences.

Painting: Corpselike Prisoner.name: Painting: Corpselike Prisoner
Painting: Corpselike Prisoner.descriptionprivate: This gruesome illustration depicts a masculine figure clutching the bars of a jail cell. You recognize the face of this man as Qory Hult of Skybrush, but his unhinged countenance is corpselike and hideous.
Painting: Corpselike Prisoner.descriptionpublic: This gruesome illustration depicts a masculine figure clutching the bars of a jail cell.

Regarding Ebbok Zhùr.name: Regarding Ebbok Zhùr
Regarding Ebbok Zhùr.descriptionprivate: Written by a Shent artificer named Vadrus Vereth, it describes the early history of the Abyssal repository known as the Bleak Archive, along with its enduring mission: to hide away a collection of accursed Abyssal relics so their eldritch power might fade into obscurity throughout the long course of time.
Regarding Ebbok Zhùr.descriptionpublic: This archaic book is scribed in Pathward with annotations in Common.

Rune-Marked Arrowhead.name: Rune-Marked Arrowhead
Rune-Marked Arrowhead.descriptionprivate:
Curse of the Bewilderment

When this item is Invested it curses its user.

At the start of each hour, the character faces [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{Creeping Confusion}, and if they do not pass the hazard they enter a brief state of delusion as described in @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}.

Additionally, each time the bearer of this curse awakes from a Rest they must face [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{Lost Dreams}. The third time this hazard deals damage, the GM should reference the article above for additional effect.

Once cursed, this curse may only be removed with a [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]].
Rune-Marked Arrowhead.descriptionpublic:
This ancient rune-marked blade is an arrowhead in name only, large enough to serve as a dagger in medium-sized hands.

Forged long ago by Varùn giants, this ancient rune-marked blade is an arrowhead in name only, large enough to serve as a dagger in medium-sized hands. The light enchantments on this archaic @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact} have faded over time.

Under Development

When Invested, this weapon grants you the ability to mark a target, making it easier to attack.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.
Rune-Marked Arrowhead.actiondesc: Choose a target, the next attack you make with the @ref[name] against that target has @Advantage[2].

Rune-Marked Band.name: Rune-Marked Band
Rune-Marked Band.descriptionprivate:
Curse of the Bewilderment

When this item is Invested it curses its user.

At the start of each hour, the character faces [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{Creeping Confusion}, and if they do not pass the hazard they enter a brief state of delusion as described in @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}.

Additionally, each time the bearer of this curse awakes from a Rest they must face [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{Lost Dreams}. The third time this hazard deals damage, the GM should reference the article above for additional effect.

Once cursed, this curse may only be removed with a [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]].
Rune-Marked Band.descriptionpublic:
Crafted long ago by Varùn giants, this ancient rune-marked band is a ring in name only, large enough to serve as a bracelet in medium-sized hands. The light enchantments on this archaic @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact} have faded over time.

Under Development

While Invested, this band increases resistance to Cold by 2.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.

Rune-Marked Knife.name: Rune-Marked Knife
Rune-Marked Knife.descriptionprivate:
Curse of the Bewilderment

When this item is Invested it curses its user.

At the start of each hour, the character faces [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{Creeping Confusion}, and if they do not pass the hazard they enter a brief state of delusion as described in @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}.

Additionally, each time the bearer of this curse awakes from a Rest they must face [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{Lost Dreams}. The third time this hazard deals damage, the GM should reference the article above for additional effect.

Once cursed, this curse may only be removed with a [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]].
Rune-Marked Knife.descriptionpublic:
This ancient rune-marked blade is a knife in name only, large enough to serve as a broadsword in medium-sized hands.

Forged long ago by Varùn giants, this ancient rune-marked blade is an arrowhead in name only, large enough to serve as a dagger in medium-sized hands. The light enchantments on this archaic @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact} have faded over time, but it retains enough magic for the purposes of overcoming damage immunities and resistances.

Under Development

When Invested, this weapon grants you the ability to mark a target, making it easier to attack.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.
Rune-Marked Knife.actiondesc: Choose a target, the next attack you make with the @ref[name] against that target has @Advantage[2].

Rune-Marked Sash.name: Rune-Marked Sash
Rune-Marked Sash.descriptionprivate:
Curse of the Bewilderment

When this item is Invested it curses its user.

At the start of each hour, the character faces [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{Creeping Confusion}, and if they do not pass the hazard they enter a brief state of delusion as described in @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}.

Additionally, each time the bearer of this curse awakes from a Rest they must face [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{Lost Dreams}. The third time this hazard deals damage, the GM should reference the article above for additional effect.

Once cursed, this curse may only be removed with a [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]].
Rune-Marked Sash.descriptionpublic:
Crafted long ago by Varùn giants, this ancient garment is woven with glittering threads of curious runic symbols. The light enchantments on this archaic @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact} have faded over time.

Under Development

While Invested, this band grants @Advantage[1] to Wilderness checks.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.

Rune-Marked Vial.name: Rune-Marked Vial
Rune-Marked Vial.descriptionprivate:
Curse of the Bewilderment

When this item is Invested it curses its user.

At the start of each hour, the character faces [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{Creeping Confusion}, and if they do not pass the hazard they enter a brief state of delusion as described in @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}.

Additionally, each time the bearer of this curse awakes from a Rest they must face [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{Lost Dreams}. The third time this hazard deals damage, the GM should reference the article above for additional effect.

Once cursed, this curse may only be removed with a [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]].
Rune-Marked Vial.descriptionpublic:
Crafted long ago by Varùn giants, this ancient vial made of solid crystal is etched with curious runic symbols, and can hold up to 8 ounces of liquid. The light enchantments on this archaic @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact} have faded over time.

Under Development

While Invested, this vial can be used during a Rest to transmute any liquid contents into the same volume of potable alcohol.
Rune-Marked Vial.actiondesc: During a Rest, the Rune-Marked Vial can transmute its contents from any liquid into equal amounts of consumable alcohol of a type of its users choosing.

Sage's Grimoire.name: Sage's Grimoire
Sage's Grimoire.descriptionpublic:
Bound in the primordial hide of some unknown Leviathan, this arcane spellbook is an archaic Shent tome with the following wizard spells recorded upon its crystal-inked pages.

Under Development

While Invested, this Tome grants the wielder access to @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.gesturecreate000]{Gesture: Create} and @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.inflectionReshap]{Inflection: Reshape}.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.

Skybrush Constable's Key.name: Skybrush Constable's Key
Skybrush Constable's Key.descriptionpublic: This simple bronze key opens the locked cells of the Blockhouse gaol in Skybrush, as well as the evidence locker.

The Dirgewood Papers.name: The Dirgewood Papers
The Dirgewood Papers.descriptionpublic: This collection of Inner Realms lore written in Primordial with Pathward annotations details an eponymous stretch of Primordis that has been notoriously tainted by Abyssal scourge.

Tome of Eldritch Symbols.name: Tome of Eldritch Symbols
Tome of Eldritch Symbols.descriptionpublic:
This book — bound in the skin of a tenebrous Wyrm — contains esoteric lore about the eldritch Abyss, and its words are charged with magic.

Under Development

While Invested, this tome grants @Advantage[1] to Arcana checks. In addition, it grants its wielder access to @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.inflectionnegate]{Inflection: Negate}.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.

Wraith Bane.name: Wraith Bane
Wraith Bane.descriptionpublic:
This large Shent blade is adorned with hastily inscribed runic markings that celebrate its original owner's triumph against an Abyssal monster. The weapon acts as a greatsword in the hands of a medium-sized creature.

Under Development

While Invested, attacks made with this blade gain @Advantage[1] to attack rolls.

When you hit an Undead creature with this greatsword, the target faces [[/hazard 4 fortitude health severe]] damage.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.

A Message To Tantrin.name: A Message To Tantrin
A Message To Tantrin.descriptionpublic:
Written in precisely lettered block print, the message reads:

Tantrin,

I have discovered yet another failure of House Cevher. According to the records I have found, it is possible that their digging in the failed mine could cause an entire collapse of part of Arcturel. I hope I am wrong, but if I am not, I want someone to know what has happened here.

Your friend,

Concerned Miner

Arcturel Playing Cards.name: Arcturel Playing Cards
Arcturel Playing Cards.description: A set of specialty playing cards themed around the people and places of Arcturel, with suits for Waterborne, Cevher, Silverbeam, and the Lamplighters. The face cards of each suit showcase luminaries, including Zodi Trask. Characters gain advantage on charisma checks made while it is actively being used as a tool if they are within Arcturel.

Cloak of Kindly Visage.name: Cloak of Kindly Visage
Cloak of Kindly Visage.descriptionprivate:
While equipped and Invested, its wearer gains the Kindly Visage action and a benefit to all Diplomacy checks depending on the enchantment tier of the item.

  • Minor enchantment: +1 Boon

  • Major enchantment: +2 Boons

  • Legendary enchantment: +3 Boons
Cloak of Kindly Visage.descriptionpublic: A nondescript black cloak that seems as if it would match with almost any outfit.
Cloak of Kindly Visage.actiondesc:
You assume an illusory appearance once per rest which alters your appearance as well as your attire. The illusion cannot alter your ancestry, but can change other aspects of your anatomy including your apparent gender. The cloak itself does not change in appearance and remains visible.

The illusion persists indefinitely and can be dismissed at-will. Once activated, the cloak cannot produce another illusion in this way until 24 hours have passed.

Coded Bandit Instructions.name: Coded Bandit Instructions
Coded Bandit Instructions.descriptionpublic: This set of instructions is written in a code that you have not yet deciphered.

Concentrated Ore Dust.name: Concentrated Ore Dust
Concentrated Ore Dust.descriptionprivate: If consumed directly, the target suffers [[/hazard 6 fortitude health poison]]{Acute Heavy Metal Toxicity} and is @Condition[poisoned].
Concentrated Ore Dust.descriptionpublic: A byproduct of ore mining, ore dust can be hazardous to humanoids when consumed in large quantities, creating a lingering feeling of discomfort, nausea, and unease. Concentrated ore dust is created by using alchemy to distill this substance into something even more toxic.

Decoded Bandit Instructions.name: Decoded Bandit Instructions
Decoded Bandit Instructions.descriptionprivate:
This set of instructions, written in shifting ink, has been fully decoded, It reads as follows:

It is time for Helkas to pay the price for their unfortunate association with House Cevher. The drakes will attack first - if you can procure items to make your clothing more resistant to the flames while on the road, it will be to your advantage. The cloaked man may be able to assist before he heads to Arcturel.

When the Dusktide Festival draws near, follow close behind the drakes and strike while the town's guard is down. They will learn who their friends really are soon enough.

When finished, report back to the Captain in Seawall. He will have further instructions.

PS - Do not be fooled by imitators! Remember the "two hands" phrase to identify your brethren.
Decoded Bandit Instructions.descriptionpublic: A series of notes detailing instructions for Otherhood Bandits.

Forged Recruitment Papers.name: Forged Recruitment Papers
Forged Recruitment Papers.descriptionpublic:
The note, written on a piece of dirt-smudged paper, reads:

Yeah, these are the ones I was telling about. Perfect recruits for the Otherhood. I've seen them fight in action and we definitely want them on our side. The only problem is, their tempers are kind of short — don't spend too much time questioning them at the gate or you'll have a problem on your hands. For Other Fortunes, my friend!

It is signed at the bottom with an illegible signature. Below the squiggly line, it reads:

PS - Lost a game of darts to Juro Wandren in Nain and promised to pay him back. I'm thinking a 20% discount on any sales and no fees for any ships he lists for us at port, but do what you think is best. Love that guy.

Kilner Notes.name: Kilner Notes
Kilner Notes.descriptionprivate:
Includes the following entries:

  • Received the goods from Wandren. Ready to embark. Otherhood members have their instructions and have been instructed to speak the code phrase to reveal the message. They have it tattooed on their arm, so hopefully they won't forget.

  • Encountered a performance troupe. Underwhelming for recruitment, but they have alchemical supplies to repel fire. I will give to the Helkas-bound group, though I doubt they will survive even with assistance.

  • Arrived at Arcturel and scouted a good location for the device. The skither are slowly scavenging what they need from the town. Side benefit: many of the machines are now in a somewhat precarious state and will need repair. With the right "assistance" this could be another "Cevher disaster."

  • The plan continues well. The device is almost ready - it can trigger whenever Sir is ready to give it his commands. I wonder if Sir will have me assigned elsewhere. Seawall, maybe, where the otherhood has begun to make a name for itself - the skithers can monitor the device here and I grow somewhat tired of passing notes to locals and causing small problems. I itch for a battle, but Sir knows best.
Kilner Notes.descriptionpublic: A series of detailed notes kept by Kilner.

Lazing Lamp.name: Lazing Lamp
Lazing Lamp.descriptionprivate:
Often used by insomniacs, the lazing lamp appears no different than other lamps when it is inactive, but once activated, it triggers a simple [[/talent Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeControl00000]] effect that induces sleep.

While most choose to trigger the lamp for themselves, it can also be set to trigger at a specific time or under a specific set of conditions, and can be targeted at a particular individual or type of creature.

When active, anyone who touches the lazing lamp directly suffers [[/hazard 6 fortitude health fire]].
Lazing Lamp.descriptionpublic: A seemingly standard lantern, The surface of its handle etched with some simple dials. A single word etched above them: "Lazing".

Lyla's Letter.name: Lyla's Letter
Lyla's Letter.descriptionprivate:
Adventurers,

I hope your journey treats you well. I have been able to uncover some information about what might have brought the bandits to Helkas, but to figure out my next steps, I need to track down a bit of information here in Nain. If your journey brings you this way, I would welcome the help in untangling all of the threads I have managed to pick up so far - I feel that I am close to a breakthrough!

Best,

Lyla Cevher

Metal Crumbler.name: Metal Crumbler
Metal Crumbler.descriptionprivate: When applied to a metal object, Metal Crumbler weakens it at the edges, causing them to dissipate into dust. Once applied, it decreases the Quality of the object by 1 degree per application until it reaches Shoddy, after which it is Broken and then destroyed.
Metal Crumbler.descriptionpublic: A powdered abrasive alchemical compound often used in metal working for disposal of waste material, smells vaguely cupric.

Recruitment Flyer.name: Recruitment Flyer
Recruitment Flyer.descriptionpublic:
The flyer is on crinkled paper that has been splashed with dirt and dust, and a few of the words are missing. The message ends abruptly where the bottom section has been torn off.

Looking for something new? Want to _____ a difference? If your fortunes aren't what you want them to be, the ______ can help you find another____ forward.

Make your way to _____ and ask _____ about ________.

May other fortunes ______ your way!

PS - If you're interested, talk to the cloaked merchant. When he asks about other fortunes, just say "with…"

Sharpened Pickaxe.name: Sharpened Pickaxe
Sharpened Pickaxe.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].
