  • Kellan Lorde had only been working in the mines for six months or so. He kept to himself a lot, and was a bit of a rolling stone, but he seemed like a decent guy. Rumor had it that he was offered a higher paying gig with Silver Beam shortly before the accident happened, but didn't have the guts to put in his notice with Trask.

  • Eolas was working in the Mine Office when the accident happened. Kellan Lorde exited the Mine a few moments before the incident, so Eolas heard more than he saw. Kellan could be heard shouting — something like "Put that down!" — and by the time Eolas ran outside to investigate, Kellan and the "Renegade" Chessman were already tumbling off the ledge.

  • According to those in the know, when the search party went down to investigate Rock Bottom, all they found was a liquified splatter of Kellan Lorde's corpse, with no sign of the Chessman.

  • A lamplighter named Calandra was the closest eye witness to the crime, and she's conveniently lighting lamps in the district at this very moment. If the characters speak with Eolas outside, he'll point directly to Calandra, who can be seen making her rounds (see The Lamplighter's Plight below).

  • Apparently, yet another accident involving a Chessman occurred in the past day or two. Word on the street is that a Silver Beam worker was swallowed alive by a Mootap after a construct pushed him into an @UUID[JournalEntry.emberPathwaysGaz.JournalEntryPage.iciVMv0WWYPKkp97]{Inkaro Pool}. Ask for the foreman Zirca if you make it down there.

If a character succeeds on one of these Charisma skill checks by more than 5 (or offers to double the previously offered bribe to 30 gp) , Eolas also offers the following details:

  • House Cevher's operations in Arcturel have suffered a great deal of late, whether the result of faulty equipment, natural and supernatural disaster, or aggressive Silver Beam buy outs.

  • Zodi Trask is very competent foreman, and is a gregarious leader of the local community. He seems to be under a lot of stress lately, even more than usual.

The Lamplighter's Plight

The party has arrived in Lower Arcturel at a convenient time for their investigation, as the empathic lamplighter Calandra (Neutral Good, Arcturian Nir'ae, she/her) is currently making her daily rounds. According to locals, Calandra was the only eye-witness to Kellan Lorde's death.

When the party decides to approach the thoughtful lamplighter or catch her attention, read the following:

You regard the attentive Nir'ae woman near the catwalk railing, clad in loose robes marked by the dirt and grime of the Dives. She places something at the end of her staff — a small nacreous orb that alights with enchanted luminance as she extends it towards a sconce on the catwalk railing. Just then, an untimely incident occurs as you approach …

An erratic swarm of tatterwing moths flutters up from the shadows below to swirl chaotically around the sconce and the woman herself. The lamplighter loses her balance, and the newly-lit inkaro pearl tumbles from the lamp fixture into the steel grating below the catwalk. She drops to her knees and starts frantically searching for the orb beneath the steel grating.

Aiding the Lamplighter

The characters are free to approach Calandra as they see fit, but they have an opportunity here and now to help her out an ill-timed predicament. The lamplighter is willing to provide some resources and additional information if the party comes to her aid.

Any character who succeeds on a[[/skill perception 14]] [[/skillCheck awareness 14]] check is able to help Calandra locate the fallen inkaro pearl.

  • Alternately, a character who uses the @UUID[Actor.MJfOzwa6uawHDhHA.Item.iCaiYRPxSxowvFJa]{Detect Magic} spell can locate the inkaro pearl more directly.

A successful [[/skill sleightofhand 13]] [[/skillCheck stealth 13]] check is necessary to retrieve the inkaro pearl from the crisscrossed underbelly of the steel grating.

  • Alternately, a character can usethe @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.Utk1OQRwYkMkFRD3]{Mage Hand} spell @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeKinesis00000] or Spell[kinesis.influence] to retrieve the pearl can grab it with relative ease, avoiding a skill check as long as they do the activity unhindered.

A Conversation with Calandra

As the characters help her search for the missing inkaro pearl, Calandra eagerly shares a bit of lore about this arcane commercial resource and its importance in Arcturel's livelihood.

I must admit, it's been quite some time since a swarm of tatterwings caused me to lose my balance. Those fussy little things love the light of inkaro pearls more than anything, and tend to swarm lamplighters who work the lower reaches of the sinkhole.

Losing a pearl is a little tougher on us these days … supplies are short lately, and I'd wager the accident has something to do with it as well. It's a bit hard to trust constructs with pearl farming if they can't be trusted at all …

If the characters assist Calandra, she gifts the party an @UUID[Item.KjpBoF2y1cl2Yptz]{inkaro pearl} of their own. Either way, she shares the following observations and rumors about the matters at hand:

  • She was the only one on the catwalk other than Kellan Lorde and the Chessman when the accident happened. The construct was apparently fiddling with the inkaro lantern outside the Mine Office near Hob Korell's, and Kellan tried to stop it. As soon as the miner put his hands on the construct, the Chessman erupted into a fit. She heard Kellan yell: "Put that down. Do your job." And after a short struggle, they both went over the ledge.

  • She's quick to point out the specific location of the accident to the players, an inkaro lantern outside @UUID[JournalEntry.PWK8ADZy5RgbwBAu.JournalEntryPage.yXmLKvQfWjY5Nf9d]{Hob Korell's Unconventional Steeds} along the southern section of the catwalk. (The details of this area are featured below in "Surveying the Crime Scene").

  • Calandra and a few of her lamplighter associates have seen Silver Beam workers toiling in their headquarters in Upper Arcturel during odd hours. It seems innovation never sleeps for that group.

  • According to rumors, yet another accident involving a Chessman occurred in the past day or two, a fatality involving a Mootap in the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberPathwaysGaz.JournalEntryPage.iciVMv0WWYPKkp97]{Inkaro Pools} down in the Sinkhole Depths. The poolside foreman Zirca Bronzebellow is a reasonable person to speak with about the incident.

Although she teeters on the edge of hesitation, a successful [[/skill persuasion 15]] [[/skill persuasion 15]] [[/skillCheck diplomacy 15]] check (or a small bribe of 5 gp 5 sp or more) compels Calandra to relate anecdotal evidence suggesting that the Silver Beam Consortium has also been withholding some of their inkaro pearls from public consumption.

Surveying The Crime Scene

The party can inspect the scene of the crime itself: the catwalk outside Hob Korell's Unconventional Steeds, where a solitary inkaro lantern sits opposite the door to Korell's stables.

Searching the Catwalk

Any character who succeeds on a [[/skill perception 15]] [[/skillCheck awareness 15]] check is able to spot the following (characters with [[/knowledge subterranea]] have @Advantage[2] on this check):

  • Crude gouging and scratches on the inkaro lantern.

  • The railing is bent and buckled beneath the weight of something heavy that leaned off the edge.

  • A modest blood spatter stains the grating near the inkaro lantern, no larger than a waterskin.

Any character who succeeds on a [[/skill investigation 16]] [[/skillCheck science 16]] or [[/skillCheck wilderness 16]] check is able to determine the following (characters with [[/knowledge crime]], [[/knowledge forensics]], or [[/knowledge machines]] have @Advantage[2] on this check):

  • The gouging and scratches on the inkaro lantern were likely caused by the hands of a Chessman construct.

  • The construct was heavy enough to cause the buckling on the rail.

  • The blood splatter could have easily been the result of the physical conflict between Kellen Lorde and the construct. Perhaps a wrist, head, or collarbone injury, where the bone is close to the skin's surface.

Investigating the Dives

The party can investigate other areas in Lower Arcturel for clues, although efforts to gather additional information inevitably point the characters in the same direction: towards whatever evidence might remain at the bottom of the sinkhole, where the construct and the deceased victim presumably fell.

Other Denizens of the Dives

Rumors abound in Lower Arcturel, if the characters want to seek them. Most of the local superstition is fruitless, but a few citizens have some adequate information to share. Helpful locations and individuals include:

@UUID[JournalEntry.PWK8ADZy5RgbwBAu.JournalEntryPage.yXmLKvQfWjY5Nf9d]{Hob Korell's Unconventional Steeds}. The friendly lizard trader Hob Korell (Chaotic Good, Waerd Keth, he/him) can also be a source of information.

  • Hob's most trusted Chessman, a construct named Rider, disappeared a few weeks ago along with one of the @UUID[Actor.T6YcptpxcCLx4yLx]{Jobri}. All accounts suggest that Rider stole the reptilian mount and rode off into the Depths, but that kind of behavior deviates from his normal commands and protocol.

  • Although the accident with Kellan Lorde happened right in front of Hob's stables, nobody from Unconventional Steeds saw the accident. He and others rushed outside to the catwalk, but it was too late.

  • Hob provides exotic steeds like Jobri and giant frogs for all of Arcturel, including itinerant adventurers and established businesses like the Silver Beam Consortium.

  • Sales have been up recently, and Hob’s supply of Jobri is relatively short. The Silver Beam Consortium is responsible for a lot of new purchases (although, somewhat suspiciously, there hasn’t been a matching influx of mine and pool workers to necessitate them).

@UUID[JournalEntry.PWK8ADZy5RgbwBAu.JournalEntryPage.yObJp4josnr70zog]{Arvoda's Elixirs}. The erudite alchemist Emelyn Arvoda (Neutral Good, Arcturian Ashka, she/her) didn't witness anything, but the following rumors have been on the lips of her customers of late:

  • Silver Beam recruiters have recently been trying to headhunt various miners and other laborers throughout Arcturel, and a lot of them seem to be getting caught up in accidents or unsavory assignments.

  • House Cevher seems to be under a lot of pressure. Emelyn sees Zodi Trask more than most, since his apartment is right next door to her shop, and it seems like the whole world's on his shoulders lately.

  • Larissa Toth of the Silver Beam consortium stops by from time to time in search of rare ingredients and alchemical reagents, and she overshares when she's feeling more confident. It sounds like production of Silver Beam constructs is on the rise in the wake of the accidents with Chessman models.

Primordis Attunement: Gathered All Three Clues

If the party manages to find all three clues during the course of this event (Hathwick's Account, Calandra's Account, and The Damaged Lantern), each character advances their [[/attunement emberPrimordis +1 arcturelSideCrimeClues]] at the conclusion of the event.

Concluding the Event

Next Steps

The party must journey further down to the neighborhood known as Rock Bottom, where they'll find evidence of the Renegade Construct's passage. Subsequently, these @UUID[JournalEntry.m6P3pXWB3ssdG7o3.JournalEntryPage.7PPMXNrnTB7ojZUM]{Rumors in Rock Bottom} will propel the characters onward to explore the Sinkhole Depths for themselves.
Scene of the Crime.soverview: The party journeys to Lower Arcturel to investigate the scene of the Renegade Construct's purported crime. While exploring the Dives district, the characters encounter witnesses to the accident, including agitated House Cevher miners and an intuitive inkaro lamplighter.
Scene of the Crime.sexposition:
If you hadn't been sent here on a mission to investigate the murder of Kellan Lorde, you might think nothing of what seems to be another average day in the Dives. Although commerce is much slower here than in Upper Arcturel, there's still a low buzz of urban activity, and more than a couple residents along the catwalk regard you with relative indifference.

As you step off of the wrought iron elevator, you spy a Wirrun commoner exiting a nearby edifice with a newly-repaired pickaxe in his hands. Clad in the telltale garb of a miner, this middle-aged Arcturian male wears a cloak with a House Cevher insignia emblazoned on the pin, and casually nods at your group as he passes by.

You also notice a wizened Nir'ae woman near the railing of the catwalk to the south, equipped with an interesting array of tools including a long catch-pole tipped in a mechanical pincer. She appears to be searching the ground beneath the lightless shadow of a lantern-like sconce at the catwalk's edge, focused on the unseen matter at hand with regard for little else.
Scene of the Crime.ssummary: We ventured into the Dives district of Lower Arcturel, where we met with various locals who claimed to have seen the accident involving the Renegade Construct. According to witnesses, the construct and its victim both plummeted off the edge of a catwalk outside the mine. Perhaps we can locate some further evidence by searching the floor of Arcturel's infamous sinkhole below, amidst the rough-and-tumble neighborhood known as Rock Bottom.

Junkyard Cogs.name: Junkyard Cogs
Junkyard Cogs.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

This combat and exploration event pits the party against agents of the Silver Beam Consortium who operate a suspicious forge at the Scrapyard, a few miles west of Rock Bottom in the Sinkhole Depths. Here, they'll uncover the presence of a clandestine operation to turn Chessmen constructs into @UUID[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU]{Silver Beam Servitors}. In this event, the party can:

  • Surveil the Scrapyard and its inhabitants, which include @UUID[Actor.vyN7FNbPEw6KsuGw]{Silver Beam Engineers} and their celestial allies — a half-dozen @UUID[Actor.ZMLyUZaK76soqKx0]{Skither} and a @UUID[Actor.eOeEoqatnUz1TOVR]{Vorg}.

  • Engage the Scrapyard's inhabitants, featuring a quartet of @UUID[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU]{Silver Beam Servitors}, in combat.

  • Examine the local area for evidence that contributes to their investigation of the Renegade Construct.

Entering the Scrapyard

Unowned Site

A character with [[/skill perception 14 passive]] or a successful [[/skill perception 12]] check [[/skillCheck awarness 14 passive]] from afar reveals that — while the site is being operated by someone — there are no signs indicating precisely what the location is or who runs it. Defenses seem scarce, as there aren't any fences surrounding the location's perimeter. All the same, there's a sense that this is not a place that will be welcoming to visitors.

Entering the scrapyard is relatively easy, as there are no exterior guards; the remote, hidden nature of this forge is expected to be its best defense. However, once they breach the area's perimeter, the party will need to take care to stay unseen (or commit to fighting their way through the locals).

Two Silver Beam Engineers work here at the forge, and appear to be scrapping and sorting Chessmen parts. Characters can attempt to sneak, lie, or storm their way in.

@Embed[Actor.vyN7FNbPEw6KsuGw count=2]

Talking Their Way In

The party can attempt to deceive their way into the Scrapyard's inner areas. Any appropriately-disguised character who succeeds on a [[/skill deception 16]] [[/skillCheck deception 16]] check is able to convince the Silver Beam Engineers of the their false identity as Silver Beam personnel.

Appropriate disguises can be achieved via the following:

  • @UUID[Item.LZAFIWKck47hrjRt]{Silver Beam Uniforms}, which can be acquired at the Silver Beam HQ in Upper Arcturel and at the Inkaro Pools.

  • Casting the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.A3q2gTNqG6fvNGrv]{Disguise Self} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.X4c8xCkmF8U9HUMz]{Major Image} spells.

  • Alternately, a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.IBhDAr7WkhWPYLVn]{Disguise Kit} can be used, but the character has @Advantage[-2] on the Deception check.

  • @UUID[Item.LZAFIWKck47hrjRt]{Silver Beam Uniforms}, which can be acquired at the Silver Beam HQ in Upper Arcturel and at the Inkaro Pools.

  • Use of illusionary magic or items to mask a character's appearance and clothing.

  • Alternately, a Disguise Kit can be used , but the character has @Advantage[-2]on the Deception check.

If the characters manage to talk their way in, they still won't be fully trusted by the Engineers and their allies, and must remain careful.

Under Scrutiny

Since this location is hidden, and its operation largely a secret to the company, anyone coming here will be under higher scrutiny. If the party is caught taking hostile or suspicious actions, or speaking in a way that causes doubt to arise about the party's credentials the engineers will signal a floating construct to verify the party's identity.

This results in the floating constructs coming to examine the party up close. If they do this, the party will only have about ten minutes before the Skithers are warned that the party is not with the company and combat breaks out.

Talking to the Engineers

As long as the party doesn't raise any suspicions, they can glean information about the operation from the engineers, learning the following:

If the party would prefer to observe the camp from the relative safety of cover and high ground, they may do so by climbing the rocks that surround the area.

Scouting From Above

The stony ridges and high places around the scrapyard can be used as vantage points to scout the surrounding scrapyard and move around without being seen. The presence of cover allows for a modicum of concealment, as well.

Reaching the high spaces requires the party to climb the stone faces which have plenty of handholds and perches to do so, posing no real difficulty to accomplish.

Whether the party chooses to sneak in, or stay hidden on the rocks above, the party will need to be careful not to be spotted.

Remaining Unseen

To remain unseen characters must make successful [[/skill stealth 14]] [[/skillCheck stealth 14]] checks to remain unseen by the denizens of the scrapyard. If a character is spotted, one of the wandering Skithers moves toward that location and investigate.

Characters may have a brief window to relocate and hide. If they can get out of sight and successfully use the &reference[Hide] action against the Skither use the terrain to prevent line of sight to the Skither, they can retain their stealth.

Otherwise, combat will break out, and the Skithers will alert the rest of the scrapyard instantly. If this occurs, refer to Fighting Through below for the tactics utilized by the denizens of the scrapyard.

Observing the Operation

@embed[Actor.ZMLyUZaK76soqKx0 count=6]

Scrutinizing the Scrappers

From this location they should be able to spot the following things:

  • There are about four constructs that was working the forge, moving materials, and shifting around inert constructs.

  • There are six strange winged mechanoids, three of them are using their sharp metal claws to shear parts of inert constructs off their frames, which the constructs take to the forge. The other three float around the scrapyard, watching things.

  • There are two humanoids wearing Silver Beam uniforms, they are making modifications to the central frames of constructs that are brought to them.

  • Once the work is done, the core and quenched metal pieces are piled into crates likely bound for Arcturel.

The party will likely want to try and make sense of what they are seeing, they can do this through various skill checks and knowledges listed below:

Making Sense of This

Any character who succeeds on a [[/skill arcana 15]] or [[/skill nature 15]] [[/skillCheck arcana 15]] or [[/skill wilderness 15]] check is able to recognize these strange winged creatures as outsider entities from one of the Inner Realms of the cosmos.

  • Characters with [[/knowledge celestials]] have advantage on this check.

  • Rangers whose favored enemy type is Celestials also have advantage on this check.

  • Result of 20+ Critical Success: The character can recognize these creatures as Skithers, which often serve as couriers and spies for more powerful celestial entities of their native Inner Realm.

Any character who succeeds on a [[/skill investigation 13]] [[/skill investigation 13]] [[/skillCheck science 13]] check is able to recognize that the Silver Beam workers are effectively converting Chessmen into other constructs, but this primarily seems to entail a change to an automaton's outer structure. If internal augmentations exist, they must be examined more closely to understand.

  • Characters with [[/knowledge machines]] and [[/knowledge forensics]] have advantage on this check.

Any character who succeeds on a [[/skill insight 13]] [[/skill insight 13]] [[/skillCheck diplomacy 13]] check is able to surmise that Silver Beam's blatant conversion of Chessmen designs might cause a significant controversy among the denizens and trade alliances of Arcturel, least of all Vartholomew Chess himself.

  • Characters with [[/knowledge trade]] and [[/knowledge politics]] have advantage on this check.

What's Happening Here?

This is a Silver Beam operation where Chessmen worker constructs are cut apart. Their parts are reshaped into Silver Beam pieces, and their cores are modified to accept entropic pearls without suffering severe stability issues. Once done, the parts are transported back to the Silver Beam headquarters.

Gathering Evidence: Skither Remains

Important evidence can be gathered here that can be used in support of Hew the Renegade Construct's exoneration. If the characters loot the Skither's Celestial Remains, record the appropriate Event Outcome. This physical clue plays a major role in the forthcoming @UUID[JournalEntry.m6P3pXWB3ssdG7o3.JournalEntryPage.Vc4ocR8zdKM8wO7i]{Presenting the Evidence} event.

Eavesdropping on the Engineers

If the party manages to stay unseen but gets within 20 feet of the engineers, they can listen in on their conversation, this doesn't require a perception check to accomplish.

One of the engineers, while working on the core of a construct, faintly complains:

The mechanical eyeballs keep watching me.

The second engineer, clearly the senior of the too, looks unbothered as they work.

I know, they watch me too. Just be glad they haven't tried talking to you.

The junior engineer's work pauses as they look over.

They can do that?

The senior engineer nods, their hands and tools never stopping.

Yeah but it doesn't sound like words, more like someone taking a hacksaw to an empty acid drum inside your head. Gave me headaches for a week. Just do the work and don't draw attention to yourself. Focus on that layer of evocation and divination channels. We need to get this next load of materials sent back to HQ.

The pair lapse into silent work, the neither of them looking terribly happy about their assignment.

Fighting Through

@Embed[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU count=4]

@Embed[Actor.vyN7FNbPEw6KsuGw count=2]

@Embed[Actor.ZMLyUZaK76soqKx0 count=6]

@Embed[Actor.eOeEoqatnUz1TOVR]

Scrapping in the Scrapyard

The fight in the scrapyard includes 4 @UUID[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU]{Silver Beam Servitors}, 2 @UUID[Actor.vyN7FNbPEw6KsuGw]{Silver Beam Engineers}, 6 @UUID[Actor.ZMLyUZaK76soqKx0]{Skither}, and a lone @UUID[Actor.eOeEoqatnUz1TOVR]{Vorg}. The Vorg remains hidden for the first few round of combat, but emerges dramatically from one of the junk piles mid-fight.

Construct Tactics

The Silver Beam constructs prefer to get close, utilizing their @UUID[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU.Item.glj95eRlM5lIDQYE]{Charged Claw} and @UUID[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU.Item.UZMTD9JjMM9SsAfL]{Arm Blade} to do most of the work subduing foes. It they need they can launch nets at targets to slow and restrain them with their @UUID[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU.Item.SxFwLo6u8W2vmDzG]{Net Thrower}.

The Silver Beam constructs explode on death thanks to their @UUID[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU.Item.7ciZsYOM4obvXOq7]{Dying Burst} feature, which looks nearly identical to when Skither's detonate, hinting at some similarities between them. The constructs are not aware that they explode on death, and don't make any efforts to avoid collateral damage when nearing death.

Engineer Tactics

The two @UUID[Actor.vyN7FNbPEw6KsuGw]{Silver Beam Engineers} use their @UUID[Actor.vyN7FNbPEw6KsuGw.Item.gWWQ4TOhfdeNMmEX]{Field Repairs} ability to quickly repair Silver Beam constructs, keeping them in the fight.

They also utilize their @UUID[Actor.vyN7FNbPEw6KsuGw.Item.cmFrkAX2J7vvX2hY]{Fire Restraining Bolt} actions to shoot specially made bolts capable of shocking and briefly restraining enemies, leaving them vulnerable to attack.

Neither engineer is willing to die for this fight, and attempt to surrender if they fall below half their maximum hit points. If they have no chance to give up, or it looks like they won't be spared, they'll try to flee instead.

Skither Tactics

The 6 @UUID[Actor.ZMLyUZaK76soqKx0]{Skither} minions attempt to group up and swarm targets, focusing on one at a time until they are incapacitated. They prefer to target easier to hit enemies, leaving heavily armored targets for bigger combatants to deal with.

Whenever a Skither's Hit Points are reduced to half their maximum, it begins looking for ways to use its @UUID[Actor.ZMLyUZaK76soqKx0.Item.hZGnt69Mp5meOQlq]{Self Sacrifice} to deal as much damage to as many enemies as possible to turn the tide of battle. If at all possible, a Skither avoids harming allies with its @UUID[Actor.ZMLyUZaK76soqKx0.Item.bXttKphal9Z1FHk5]{Dying Burst} feature.

Construct Tactics

The Silver Beam constructs prefer to get close, utilizing their @UUID[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU.Item.chargedClaw00000]{Charged Claw} and @UUID[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU.Item.UZMTD9JjMM9SsAfL]{Iron Claw} to do most of the work subduing foes. It they need they can launch nets at targets to slow and restrain them with their @UUID[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU.Item.Nor3GNdILjRXPnXG]{Nets}.

The Silver Beam constructs explode on death thanks to their @UUID[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU.Item.radiantDeathBurs]{Radiant Death Burst} feature, which looks nearly identical to when Skither's detonate, hinting at some similarities between them. The constructs are not aware that they explode on death, and don't make any efforts to avoid collateral damage when nearing death.

Engineer Tactics

The two @UUID[Actor.vyN7FNbPEw6KsuGw]{Silver Beam Engineers} use their @UUID[Actor.vyN7FNbPEw6KsuGw.Item.fieldRepairs0000]{Field Repairs} ability to quickly repair Silver Beam constructs, keeping them in the fight.

They also utilize their @UUID[Actor.vyN7FNbPEw6KsuGw.Item.restrainingBolt0]{Fire Restraining Bolt} actions to shoot specially made bolts capable of shocking and briefly restraining enemies, leaving them vulnerable to attack.

Neither engineer is willing to die for this fight, and attempt to surrender if they are @Condition[broken] or @Condition[weakened]. If they have no chance to give up, or it looks like they won't be spared, they'll try to flee instead.

Skither Tactics

The 6 @UUID[Actor.ZMLyUZaK76soqKx0]{Skither} minions attempt to group up and swarm targets, focusing on one at a time until they are incapacitated. They prefer to target easier to hit enemies, leaving heavily armored targets for bigger combatants to deal with.

Whenever a Skither is @Condition[weakened] or @Condition[broken], or if it otherwise senses its defeat and destruction is imminent, it begins looking for ways to use its @UUID[Actor.ZMLyUZaK76soqKx0.Item.sacrificeSelf000]{Sacrifice Self} ability to deal as much damage to as many enemies as possible to turn the tide of battle. If at all possible, a Skither avoids harming allies with this action or its @UUID[Actor.ZMLyUZaK76soqKx0.Item.radiantDeathBurs]{Radiant Death Burst} feature.

The Vorg Appears!

After two combat rounds, a malicious @UUID[Actor.eOeEoqatnUz1TOVR]{Vorg} emerges from one of the large piles of inconspicuous detritus scattered around the Scrapyard.

Once the Vorg appears in combat, read the following aloud:

A nearby pile of metal junk and scrap shudders, a golden light glowing within. A terrible, metallic roar pieces the air as a large creature made of dark metal erupts from the pile rusting metal and discarded material!

@Embed[Actor.eOeEoqatnUz1TOVR]

Vorg Tactics

The Vorg thrives in close combat, where attacking and being attacked forces enemies to suffer the effect of its @UUID[Actor.eOeEoqatnUz1TOVR.Item.64qGZX2Y4t7nVbi0]{Heated Body} feature.

When possible it @UUID[Actor.eOeEoqatnUz1TOVR.Item.QwM0QfEeSuZ8437H]{Slam} its enemies first, stunning them, before attacking with its @UUID[Actor.eOeEoqatnUz1TOVR.Item.eT9EKoiU9M2e3s5f]{Rend} attacks.

As the Vorg is a mindless machine that wants nothing but violence and destruction, it fights to the death and refuses to retreat no matter how dire its situation is.

Vorg are opportunistic predators that work the terrain of their hunting territory to their advantage. They will harry and herd their prey toward narrower passageways in order to make escape more difficult, and so they can better use their ability to burrow.

A Vorg will typically initiate combat by either:

  • Emerging from a borrow very close to its prey to take advantage of its @UUID[Actor.eOeEoqatnUz1TOVR.Item.burrower00000000] feature.

  • Dropping on its from above with a @UUID[Actor.eOeEoqatnUz1TOVR.Item.clingingGrip0000]

A Vorg will attempt to flee if it is @Condition[weakened] or @Condition[broken], but if it cannot escape, it will attempt to position itself as close to as many enemies as possible to ensure its @UUID[Actor.eOeEoqatnUz1TOVR.Item.radiantDeathBurs] is effective.

Important evidence can be gathered here that can be used in support of Hew the Renegade Construct's exoneration. If the characters loot the Vorg's Celestial Remains, record the appropriate Event Outcome. This physical clue plays a major role in the forthcoming @UUID[JournalEntry.m6P3pXWB3ssdG7o3.JournalEntryPage.Vc4ocR8zdKM8wO7i]{Presenting the Evidence} event.

[[/outcome evidenceRemains]]

Exploring the Scrapyard

There is nothing left in this scrapyard that has any inherent value.

Sorting the Scrap

All of the scrap metal and parts have begun to rust and rot, and the empty barrels have long been emptied of whatever useful fuels they contained. Only the forge's tools are of any value, and even then, it's minimal.

The modified frames of the constructs are too big and too heavy to carry, coming in at over 250 lbs, but there are a few damning pieces of evidence the party can find:

  • @UUID[Item.VOsnsStt2vkRPce0]{Chessman Scrap Metal} consisting of Outer panels meant for the Chessmen constructs, bearing Vartholomew Chess' trademark and model numbers.

  • A copy of the @UUID[Item.ZQs3ejY6m150wKs7]{Silver Beam Schematics}.

  • A @UUID[Item.IcaaecvWdzTXxXz5]{strange inkaro pearl}, which appears to have been used for testing the frames to make sure they still powered up.

Examining the Schematics

Characters who succeed on a successful [[/skill arcana 12]] [[/skill arcana 12]] [[/skillCheck arcana 12]] check recognize that the schematics detail a change to some of the existing power regulation runes to account for a higher amount of power variance from the source (the inkaro pearl). This is atypical since inkaro pearls have a fairly predictable, linear power output when used as a battery.

  • Characters with [[/knowledge machines]] have advantage on this check.

Examining the Inkaro Pearl

At first glance, the inkaro pearl looks strange, its color a pale green.

A successful [[/skill perception 12]] [[/skillCheck awareness 12]] check reveals that this inkaro pearl is inscribed with tiny markings. Characters with [[/knowledge celestials]] recognize the markings to be partially connected to the inner realm of Luxarum.

Characters who succeed on a [[/skill arcana 15]] [[/skillCheck arcana 15]] check notice that the pearl's magic has been externally altered, resulting in a more unpredictable nature. Transmutation magic has augmented the latent spirit energy in the pearls to foster stronger, more chaotic flows of power than a normal pearl.

  • Characters with [[/knowledge artifacts]] and [[/knowledge subterranea]] have advantage on this check, thanks to their familiarity with inkaro pearls.

  • Characters with [[/knowledge machines]] might suspect this magical augmentation could be damaging to constructs if used as a power source.

Important evidence can be gathered here that can be used in support of Hew the Renegade Construct's exoneration. If the characters loot the @UUID[Item.VOsnsStt2vkRPce0]{Chessman Scrap Metal}, mark the following outcome:

[[/outcome evidenceScrap]]

If the characters find the @UUID[Item.ZQs3ejY6m150wKs7]{Silver Beam Schematics}, record the following outcome:

[[/outcome evidenceSchematics]]

These physical clues play an important role in the forthcoming @UUID[JournalEntry.m6P3pXWB3ssdG7o3.JournalEntryPage.Vc4ocR8zdKM8wO7i]{Presenting the Evidence} event.

Concluding the Event

The party is free to explore the rest of the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberPathwaysGaz.JournalEntryPage.SZq6RXsfxKownAN6]{Sinkhole Depths} for clues or to head back towards Arcturel.

Milestone

Completing this event earns the party a @UUID[JournalEntry.emberPlayerGuide.JournalEntryPage.jK1PXextPwuJuSnr]{Milestone Point}, potentially advancing them in level.

Next Steps

If the party has not yet investigated all possible leads, they may track down more clues in [[/eventState arcturelSidePool]].

Once they've gathered enough clues, the party must return to Arcturel to trigger the [[/eventState arcturelSideEvidence]] event during which they can provide proof that either absolves or condemns the Downsiders for their so-called crimes.
Junkyard Cogs.soverview: The party discovers a remote scrapyard where members of the Silver Beam Consortium are covertly deconstructing Chessmen constructs, bundling the spare parts, and shipping them off to Arcturel. Even more curiously, this secluded forge operates under the watchful eyes of celestial creatures from Luxarum — suggesting an alliance between Silver Beam and the inscrutable Inner Realm.
Junkyard Cogs.sexposition: Up close you can smell the stink of rusting metals and forge smoke mingled with the ever present scent of the sinkhole's fungal rot. Somewhere ahead you can hear the echoing rings of a hammer on steel, but the natural terrain of the area blocks the origin of the noise from sight.
Junkyard Cogs.ssummary: We located a clandestine forge where Silver Beam engineers were scrapping Chessmen and converting their raw materials into Silver Beam constructs. Furthermore, we spotted a small contingent of celestial creatures who appeared to be allied with Silver Beam, raising some profound questions about the Consortium's covert aims and allegiances.

Chessmen Homecoming.name: Chessmen Homecoming
Chessmen Homecoming.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

This social event affords the party a final meeting with Zodi Trask and Varholomew Chess in Lower Arcturel, who eagerly await evidence of Silver Beam's illicit activity in the sinkhole city. In this event, the characters can:

  • Present the evidence they collected during the raid on the Silver Beam Headquarters, notably @UUID[Item.otPv3LhRyg5KHh1u]{Larissa Toth's Memory Shard}, and receive the agreed-upon reward for their efforts.

  • Learn about the hopeful futures of the four Downsiders.

  • Learn about the future of Silver Beam operations in Arcturel.

Mission Accomplished

When the characters reach @UUID[JournalEntry.PWK8ADZy5RgbwBAu.JournalEntryPage.rh4RdGCvghwWvPgR]{Zodi Trask's Apartment} in Lower Arcturel, they'll encounter @UUID[Actor.Rh7z2eruwwhFlG58]{Zodi Trask} himself alongside @UUID[Actor.nnTbrW4RdzudxxMT]{Vartholomew Chess}, who are eager to discuss matters with the party.

The FInal Evidence

In order to conclude their investigation for Zodi Trask, the party must present him with substantial evidence of Larissa Toth's machinations against Arcturel. This is accomplished via presentation of @UUID[Item.otPv3LhRyg5KHh1u]{Larissa Toth's Memory Shard}, which details her devious plans.

In addition to the Memory Shard, the characters may choose to present the following information taken from the raid:

  • @UUID[Actor.r1L9EyeHna2sm8tE]{Silver Beam Sentinel} scraps.

  • @UUID[Item.hylrY3sQm3ubSLIx]{Larissa Toth's Grimoire}, which details her esoteric ritual for The Diagram Transcendent.

Upon delivery of this final evidence, Zodi Trask awards the characters the agreed-upon payment of [[/award 200gp]] [[/award 20gp]], and extends an invitation to stay in Arcturel as long as they'd like.

  • If one of the characters managed to persuade Zodi to throw in some extra payment, he also awards them the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.ytlsBjYsZ7OBSEBs]{Potion of Healing} @UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.rallyingTonic000] and a @UUID[Item.Pxu2HNJreTBnqI5w]{Bottle of Shadowcap Wine} as promised.

  • Vartholomew Chess is overwhelmed with gratitude as well, and offers the characters a 25% discount on any future purchases of Chessmen automatons.

Heart Attunement: Downsiders Absolved

If the party successfully delivers enough evidence to Zodi Trask to implicate Silver Beam and absolve Hew and the Downsiders of their alleged crimes, each character advances their [[/attunement emberHeart +1 arcturelSideHomecomingEvidence]] at the conclusion of the event.

Regarding Silver Beam

Repercussions of the Raid

With the matter of the investigation settled, Zodi has a few updates to share with the party regarding the future of Silver Beam's enterprises in Arcturel:

Arcturel's gonna need a couple days to react, but expect whoever is left after kicking around town after the raid to get rounded up and put on trial for their part in murder, sabotage, coverups and so forth. I don't expect Arcturel to be lenient with Silver Beam or its leadership.

There may be jail time, exile from the town, seizing of assets and materials, loss of awarded work contracts… not to mention the complete erosion of any trust or good will they built up in the town.

They'll be lucky if the consortium can even operate in Arcturel after this.

Characters with [[/knowledge politics]] or [[/knowledge intrigue]] suspect that the Trading Houses will do anything they can to take out Silver Beam's reach in Ordain. Zodi agrees:

Oh yeah, House Cevher's absolutely going to drag this in front of the Ordinate. They won't take Silver Beam encroaching into their markets with grace, and I would expect them to push for a blanket ban on most Silver Beam products in Ordani markets. Extreme, but, don't mess with the Trading Houses.

Regarding the Chessmen

Once the discussion of Silver Beam has concluded, Zodi shifts the conversation to the Chessmen and other constructs of Arcturel. Read or paraphrase the following section:

Zodi snaps his fingers and turns to Vartholomew.

Right, about the Silver Beam constructs, Chess. Expect the town council to ask you to look at all of the existing Silver Beam constructs, verify they are safe, and undo any sabotage you find. You up for that?

Vartholomew faintly winces at the question.

That's a lot of work. Undoing the modifications is pretty straightforward, but there are quite a few of them to look at. Just tell me they aren't going to be given back to Silver Beam afterward.

Zodi shrugs in response.

It's possible, but I doubt it. Will ultimately depend on higher powers than us, though. Once Arcturel draws up a formal response to all this there will be questions of design theft, ownership rights, and you might end up with a bunch of consortium constructs that need to be fixed in the near future.

Chess grimaces.

I guess I should put up some help wanted flyers then...

Second Chances for Shepp

If the party mentions Ifton Shepp and his guilt and efforts, or has mentioned it, Vart will say:

Funny you'd mention him. He came by to formally apologize for what he did. I've been considering bringing him back into the shop to lend a hand. He knows more about what the Silver Beam constructs than I do, and he is a fine artisan.

I might not be able to forgive him for the betrayal, but Arcturians always bond over a project, and whatever was broken can be fixed. So who knows…

Regarding the Downsiders

Finally, Zodi and Vartholomew have some words to share about the fate of Hew and the Downsiders:

Zodi snaps his fingers and looks over at Chess.

That reminds me, I'm going to need to drag you before the town's merchant council and explain what happened to Chamberlain. I'm hoping we can get him full autonomy from Silver Beam and extend that to the rest of the Chessmen. I don't want any of them getting relegated to construct status if someone gets tired of paying them their fair share.

Vartholomew nods:

You have my word I'll do anything I can in that regard, Zodi. They are more like the Hulg'run now than mere constructs, we have to recognize that and make sure they are treated fairly on that grounds.

Zodi looks pleased by that and then turns his attention your way again.

But yes, about the Chessmen. We're working on getting them sorted out. Was there one you wanted to know about specifically?

Chamberlain's Freedom

Vartholomew speaks on the current state and future of Chamberlain:

For now, Chamberlain's been helping me at Arcturian Automatons and accompanying me around town. It's all under the pretenses of his repair and rehabilitation work to keep him from ending up back in Silver Beam hands. He's technically still their property, but he understandably doesn't want to go back.

Hew's Promotion

Zodi says the following about Hew:

Since Hew was still keen to mine, I got him a position within House Cevher's mining operations here in Arcturel. They will be starting next week, and I wouldn't be shocked if I have them running their own crew inside of a month.

Rider's Alliance

Zodi has the following update to share on Rider:

I talked to Hob Korell and got him to take Rider on as a new hire. It took some convincing, but since Rider is good with animals, and a bit harder to injure than the average person, he's going to be handling breaking and training some of the more unconventional steeds coming out of the Sinkhole Depths.

Lucent's Return

Zodi helped get Lucent their job back, and says:

Nodrick Stolas was happy to have Lucent come back, and made a deal to pick up the construct as Glimmer's security specialist. I'm not privy to the particulars of their agreement, but both parties seemed to be agreeable to whatever deal was struck.

Concluding the Event

Next Steps

This quest is now concluded, but the party may have further interactions with some of the characters encountered here during other quests:

  • In @UUID[JournalEntry.CHLiPiU0Bx9Pdevu]{An Old Friend}, the players will work with Zodi Trask to further investigate the Luxaran influence in Arcturel.

  • In @UUID[JournalEntry.emberNainSide000]{The Book of Tales}, the party can help Zodi Trask uncover the cause of a strange arcane affliction.
Chessmen Homecoming.soverview: The characters returs to Lower Arcturel for a final meeting with Zodi Trask and Vartholomew Chess, who eagerly await the party's findings in the wake of their assault on the Silver Beam Headquarters. After presenting Trask and Chess with an update, the characters will learn about the fate of the Downsiders and the future of all Chessmen in Arcturel.
Chessmen Homecoming.sexposition:
As you near the door to Trask's apartment you can hear the faint sound of voices inside in the midst of discussion. Once through the door you immediately spot Zodi sitting at the small table in the center of his haphazard living space with Vartholemew Chess stood beside it. They glance your way, but Chess doesn't stop speaking:

I've given them all a thorough once-over, Chamerblain needs some deeper repairs, but nothing that I can't handle. The rest are fine, no strange modifications. We've also collected all the corrupted pearls we could find and destroyed them, so there won't be any more issues.

Trask nods at Chess, but waves you in before turning his attention back to the crafter:

So that's the Chessmen, I want to discuss the raid first, then we can get back to the rest of the constructs in town?

Vartholomew nods, and goes silent, his eyes shifting you.

Zodi asks:

How'd things go? What'd you find?
Chessmen Homecoming.ssummary: Following our raid on the Silver Beam Headquarters, we returned to Lower Arcturel to present our latest evidence to Zodi Trask — clues that incriminate Larissa Toth and Silver Beam for the sabotage of the Chessmen, the accidental death of Kellan Lorde, the defamation of Vartholomew Chess, and other unscrupulous activity in Arcturel. The Downsiders are free to incorporate themselves into local society as emancipated citizens, with the same rights as every free-willed denizen of Arcturel. Meanwhile, the Silver Beam Consortium — exposed for the threat it poses to the Arctus Plateau — is expected to shut down operations in the sinkhole city.

In League with Silver Beam.name: In League with Silver Beam
In League with Silver Beam.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

This social event allows the party to reach a conclusion of the quest's narrative by reporting their success at Aberin's Folly to Larissa Toth. In this event, the party can:

  • Journey to the Silver Beam Headquarters in Upper Arcturel for a meeting with @UUID[Actor.gGNpwLWttuHPZF1W]{Larissa Toth} in her executive office.

  • Present evidence of their victory against the Chessmen at Aberin's Folly, including @UUID[Actor.XK20zaizyZOLGmsl]{Hew}'s physical remains — aka the @UUID[Item.Upqcc59WF78a86BR]{Renegade Construct Scraps} — if not the Renegade himself captured alive.

  • Receive a reward from Larissa Toth for their efforts.

  • Acclimate themselves to the Silver Beam Consortium's headquarters, which they can use as a resource going forward.

A Warm Welcome

Once the characters have been welcomed into the Silver Beam antechamber, they have a few moments to examine their surroundings before @UUID[Actor.gGNpwLWttuHPZF1W]{Larissa Toth} arrives. Refer to the Area Walkthrough for the precise details about this area and what information the characters can glean through observation.

After roughly 5 or 10 minutes, Larissa arrives to escort the party back to her office. Read the following:

The relative tranquility of this front room is interrupted by clangorous rumble of industry and machination, as the large door at the rear of the antechamber opens to reveal Larissa Toth, who emerges from the huge production warehouse of the Silver Beam facility. The comely bureaucrat steps forward with satisfaction in her stride as she regards your group:

I trust my champions were chosen well … Tell me, how did you fare against the Renegade and his Chessmen cohorts?

Her eyes scan your belongings, eager to spot evidence of some triumph at the construct camp.

The party is expected to show some evidence at this time of their success at Aberin's Folly during @UUID[JournalEntry.m6P3pXWB3ssdG7o3.JournalEntryPage.mQ5njChi8ZdTvRSN]{Checkmate for Chessmen}. If the characters didn't escort Hew in with them, they'll need to present the @UUID[Item.Upqcc59WF78a86BR]{Renegade Construct Scraps}. As long as the evidence is sincere, Larissa will thank the party and escort them further into the Silver Beam facility towards her office.

Deceiving Larissa

Alternately, the party could attempt to falsify evidence of a successful raid at the construct camp. If the characters attempt to present false evidence to Larissa (like a facsimile of the Renegade Construct Scraps), each character participating in the conversation must succeed on a [[/skill deception 18]] [[/skillCheck deception 18]] check in order to convince her of its legitimacy.

  • [[/ancestry emberAltyra]] characters and characters with [[/knowledge machines]] have advantage on this check.

  • Alternately, any character who successfully targets Larissa with the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.eS7XnnApoxRxYXPs]{Charm Person} spell has @Advantage[2] on this check.

  • [[/ancestry emberAltyra]] characters and characters with [[/knowledge machines]] have advantage on this check.

  • Alternately, any character who successfully charms Larissa through use of @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeControl00000] magic has @Advantage[2] on this check.

After a brief exchange in the Silver Beam antechamber, read the following:

The Railen executive escorts you northward, deeper into the Silver Beam facility, offering a glimpse at what the people of Arcturel can only imagine: a full-blown production facility for Silver Beam constructs, which are scattered throughout the area in various stages of completion.

After a few moments, you find yourselves at the threshold of Larissa's executive office, which she enters without delay. She speaks to you without looking back, slowly making her way to an austere desk at the opposite end of the room:

Thanks to your efforts, the Consortium can sustain its endeavors here in Arcturel unhindered. As you can see, Chessmen will soon be a thing of the past, and our Aedir-inspired Silver Beam automatons will carry the load for the next phase of our expansions here in the Arctus Plateau. The Consortium is most grateful for your assistance with this matter, and I'm sure the people of Arcturel will be happy to know that justice has been done — justice in the name of progress. But I digress … A job well done deserves a just reward.

Larissa reaches into a drawer beneath the edge of her desk, and produces a small pearl that gleans with a dull amber light, which she holds out towards you with an overt gesture of gratitude.

This is our latest innovation: a Pearl of Power, which should prove useful to the spellcasters among you. I trust it will serve as a suitable gratuity for your accomplishments, and will serve you will in your ventures to come.

I hope you've come to regard the Silver Beam Consortium as allies. We look forward to maintaining a profitable relationship with you in the seasons to come. Should you ever need my counsel, you know where to find me. Now, if you'll excuse me, I do have other matters to attend to. Oh, and you can leave the Shard of Sending with the receptionist on your way out. Good day, heroes.

Larissa Toth dismisses you with a wry grin as she sits behind the desk, immediately absorbed in the accoutrements splayed out upon it. The door to the north slides open, where a Silver Beam Construct awaits, ready to escort your party back to the lobby.

Toth's Reward

Larissa provides the party with their reward at this time: a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.44XNWmMGnwXn7bNW]{Pearl of Power}.

The party can attempt to continue their conversation with Larissa, but it goes nowhere fast, as she's eager to not only get back to her work — but to see the characters go about their own business as well. Larissa will entertain a few quick exchanges as the characters idle and leave, but a protracted conversation will be met with snide derision followed by an overt request to them to depart.

Luxarum Attunement: Silver Beam Allies

If the party accepts Larissa'a reward and embraces their new role as allies of the Silver Beam Consortium, each character advances their [[/attunement emberLuxarum +1 arcturelSideSilverBeamAllies]] at the conclusion of the event.

Concluding the Event

Next Steps

This quest is now concluded, but the party may have further interactions with some of the characters encountered here during other quests:

  • In @UUID[JournalEntry.CHLiPiU0Bx9Pdevu]{An Old Friend}, the players will work with Zodi Trask to further investigate the Luxarum influence in Arcturel.

  • In @UUID[JournalEntry.emberNainSide000]{The Book of Tales}, the party can help Zodi Trask uncover the cause of a strange arcane affliction.
In League with Silver Beam.soverview: After bringing the Renegade Construct to justice for the murder of Kellan Lorde, the party is welcomed into the fold of the Silver Beam Consortium. Larissa Toth comes to regard the characters as skilled allies, and rewards them accordingly for their successful mission.
In League with Silver Beam.sexposition:
The sleek front doors to the Silver Beam headquarters slide open with timely grace as you ascend the front steps, as if in anticipation of your arrival. An overt pleasantness greets you, mirrored on the polite face of the Silver Beam receptionist that sits behind the front desk. She smiles warmly, a young Altyran dressed in a sleek white tunic dress that matches your sterile surroundings, and speaks:

We've been expecting you. Please, make yourselves comfortable. Mistress Toth will be with us shortly.

With a delicate glance downward, shifts her gaze back to the work at hand upon her desk — writing your names with quill and ink on the pages of a large, silver-bound ledger.
In League with Silver Beam.ssummary: We visited the Silver Beam offices in Upper Arcturel to claim our reward for a job well done. Larissa Toth and the Silver Beam Consortium have come to regard us as skilled allies in the wake of our investigation.

The Story So Far.name: The Story So Far
The Story So Far.text:
8 Months Ago

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.emberDeities0000.JournalEntryPage.illZO15u6gbz338u]{Pyix} arranges for the purchase of land and mine holdings in/around @UUID[JournalEntry.emberArctusGazet.JournalEntryPage.9jlnhyRR3otAltgs]{Arcturel}, and instructs @UUID[Actor.gGNpwLWttuHPZF1W]{Larissa Toth} to plan a new consortium branch the sinkhole city. The plan: establish dominance over @UUID[Item.KjpBoF2y1cl2Yptz]{inkaro pearl} trade and destabilize @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrganizatio.JournalEntryPage.h9ObbNZE3wenJ4pu]{House Cevher}, at the behest of @UUID[JournalEntry.FYP2Af9bY4B9lSqi.JournalEntryPage.v6lXjfETDkrt0J7E]{Zerranyss}.

5 Months Ago

  • The @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrganizatio.JournalEntryPage.y7o8dKT1yxdnh2Pz]{Silver Beam Consortium} begins overt construction of their HQ in Arcturel, utilizing Chessmen purchased from their creator as well as a skilled labor force of Silver Beam immigrants from @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCultures000.JournalEntryPage.y4WHE3TEr6Of13SL]{Railen}.

  • Larissa Toth begins clandestinely deconstructing Chessmen in an effort to analyze the relationship of inkaro pearls to Chessman creation, and develop a rival construct that harnesses the power of inkaro pearls to a greater magnitude.

  • Using various rare arcane materials sourced from the Arctus Plateau, Toth also begins working on a transmutation ritual that might alter a standard inkaro pearl with the magic of @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCosmos00000.JournalEntryPage.pPU6VZV7WFubtcSR]{Luxarum}. She hopes to develop "Argent Pearls" to power her new constructs and mark a new era for the Silver Beam’s prosperity and influence.

3 Months Ago

  • Toth stumbles onto the accidental discovery of a transmutation ritual dubbed “the Diagram Transcendent” while working on her formula for Argent Pearls. Chaotic and somewhat inscrutable, the Diagram Transcendent seems to have a strange effect on inkaro pearls — and Chessmen powered by these tainted @UUID[Item.IcaaecvWdzTXxXz5]{Entropic Pearls} display erratic, often dangerous behavior.

  • Thanks to the magic of an Entropic Pearl, a construct in Silver Beam’s service known as “@UUID[Actor.iOyLbOiGrqMY49QI]{Chamberlain}” is the first Chessman to gain sentience. During the confusing incident, Chamberlain escapes and flees to the Sinkhole Depths — starting off with a brief time in Rock Bottom (a ramshackle tent-and-boardwalk town at the bottom of the sinkhole beneath Arcturel) before ending up at a remote spot called @UUID[JournalEntry.emberPathwaysGaz.JournalEntryPage.6nRFXEspxMJd6AQ8]{Aberin's Folly} a few miles to the east.

  • While in Rock Bottom, Chamberlain meets a grizzled loner named Ifton Shepp — the disgraced former assistant of Vartholomew Chess, who lost destroyed his reputation in Arcturel by taking a job with Silver Beam when they first arrived. Shepp’s search for redemption compels him to aid Chamberlain before the construct seeks more remote hiding.

  • Manufacture of the @UUID[Actor.mGxrffI6CI7Dd5rU]{Silver Beam Servitor} line begins in earnest.

2 Months Ago

  • Toth recognizes the unpredictable qualities of Entropic Pearls (and their negative effects on Chessmen) as a powerful tool in her effort to destabilize House Cevher.

  • Entropic Pearls are seeded throughout Arcturel by Toth and her minions in an attempt to bring them into proximity with Chessmen. Toth is eager to inspire a duplicitous narrative: that Chessmen are unreliable and dangerous to the people of Arcturel.

  • Entropic Pearls are secretly installed in a variety of Chessmen throughout town by Toth’s minions, including constructs located at: the Glimmer crystal shop in Upper Arcturel, the Mine in Lower Arcturel, and Hob Korrel’s stables (among others). The “onset time” of the chaotic transmutation magic stored in the Entropic Pearls is unknown.

1 Month Ago

  • Various anomalies are slowly reported throughout town in regards to Chessmen and their behavior. The constructs seem to be malfunctioning, while in reality they’re being affected by the chaotic magic of the Diagram Transcendent via Entropic Pearls.

  • The Chessman known as “Lucent” is awakened by the Diagram Transcendent. Originally in the employ of the Glimmer crystal shop of Upper Arcturel, Lucent is stirred to action and promptly escapes without major incident. Lucent is categorized as “missing” during the early stages of the investigation.

  • The Chessman known as “Rider” is awakened. Originally in the employ of Hob Korell, Rider hijacks a riding lizard/frog during an incident and slinks off into the sinkhole depths.

  • Both of these constructs find their way to Rock Bottom, where they Ifton Shepp. Shepp recognizes the unique qualities of these Chessmen and directs Lucent and Rider to find Chamberlain at his camp in the East.

2 Weeks Ago

  • The Chessman known as “Hew” is awakened by the Diagram Transcendent, at a most inconvenient time. While working one day in the House Cevher mine, Hew malfunctions. Several witnesses see Hew fight with a House Cevher miner at the edge of the Lower Arcturel catwalk, and they both go over the edge during the struggle — falling to their supposed doom at the bottom of the sinkhole.

  • While authorities were able to find scant evidence of the miner’s liquified corpse, there were no apparent signs of Hew the Construct — who is presumed to have survived the fall. With this so-called automaton killer on the loose, the people of Arcturel grow increasingly nervous.

2 Days Ago

  • Another accident happens at the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberPathwaysGaz.JournalEntryPage.iciVMv0WWYPKkp97]{Inkaro Pools} resulting in the death of a work overseer and destruction of the construct. This leads to the investigation during “@UUID[JournalEntry.m6P3pXWB3ssdG7o3.JournalEntryPage.6RJLzjCAtQqHb8Ox]{Poolside Predicaments}.” What really happened: A Chessman working the Inkaro Pools was the latest construct to malfunction thanks to sabotage via entropic pearl.

Current Day

  • The party arrives and the characters begin their investigation in Arcturel.

Checkmate for Chessmen.name: Checkmate for Chessmen
Checkmate for Chessmen.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

This combat event pits the party against the four Downsiders in their camp at Aberin's Folly. In this event, the characters can:

  • Survey the construct camp at Aberin's Folly to devise a plan.

  • Infiltrate the Downsiders encampment and either capture or kill @UUID[Actor.XK20zaizyZOLGmsl]{Hew}, the Renegade Construct.

  • Repel a counterattack from the awakened Chessmen known as @UUID[Actor.iOyLbOiGrqMY49QI]{Chamberlain}, @UUID[Actor.OYdqWs17RvL7ntbf]{Lucent}, and @UUID[Actor.1ZEi2D4j2RbKDc9x]{Rider} (with his @UUID[Actor.T6YcptpxcCLx4yLx]{Jobri}), along with a small cadre of four regular @UUID[Actor.aXNNESwMlzmcTccK]{Woven Construct} allies.

Raiding the Camp

Even if the party manages to convince Hew to come willingly, this confrontation will inevitably lead to a combat sequence, during which the Downsiders will attempt to flee while fighting defensively.

Avoiding Detection

The party rolls initiative as soon as they arrive at the camp.

Characters can covertly approach the Chessmen or the @UUID[Actor.T6YcptpxcCLx4yLx]{Jobri} by succeeding on a [[/skill stealth 13]] [[/skillCheck stealth 13]] check to avoid detection. If each party member succeeds on this check, the character with the highest initiative order can take their turn during a surprise round, after which the Downsiders and their allies also roll for initiative.

  • Failure results in all four Downsiders immediately jumping into initiative order by grabbing their weapons and taking defensive positions. Rider moves toward and mounts the Jobri.

  • Characters with [[/knowledge subterranea]] have advantage on this check.

Apprehending the Renegade

The party can attempt to subdue Hew through parley, whether via intimidation or otherwise.

Any character who succeeds on a [[/skill deception 18]], [[/skill persuasion 18]], or [[/skill intimidation 18]] [[/skillCheck diplomacy 18]], [[/skillCheck deception 18]], or [[/skillCheck intimidation 18]] check is able to convince Hew and the other Downsiders to stand down willingly. Characters with [[/knowledge crime]], [[/knowledge machines]], or [[/knowledge souls]] have @Advantage[2] on this check.

  • Hew agrees to join the party as they escort him back to Arcturel to face justice, while the other Downsiders agree to stay behind.

  • Result of 23+ Critical Success: Hew, Lucent, and Rider lay down their weapons in an overt display of fealty to the party and their Silver Beam patrons.

Even if the party manages to convince Hew to come with them, the Chessman known as Rider will protest his ally's capture once the characters begin to restrain him. Read the following text after Hew crosses the map to join the party:

The Renegade Construct approaches your party, shoulders stooped in resignation, as the other three Chessmen look on with nervous expectancy.

You take the Renegade into your custody when, out of nowhere, the sleek construct made of blue steel stands up in defiance and shouts:

You have no right! Hew is innocent, and those cads at Silver Beam know it! If your hearts be as cold as your intentions suppose, you have a bit of a problem on your hands …

The steel construct produces a spear tipped in a nimbus of lightning and immediately moves towards the reptilian steed nearby. A battle is at hand!

Chessmen Tactics

If the party decides to attack the Downsiders here and now, they won't hesitate to defend themselves.

@UUID[Actor.1ZEi2D4j2RbKDc9x]{Rider} will mount his @UUID[Actor.T6YcptpxcCLx4yLx]{Jobri} and target any ranged attackers with his Crossbow before closing in for melee with his Shock Spear or War Pick.

@UUID[Actor.XK20zaizyZOLGmsl]{Hew} attempts to flee the conflict, using the Disengage action if necessary. When confronted in melee, he'll arm himself with a War Pick to keep attackers at bay or use the Dodge action to avoid taking damage.

@UUID[Actor.OYdqWs17RvL7ntbf]{Lucent} will utilize a Crossbow in battle, fighting defensively while placing himself directly between Hew and the party on the battlefield.

@UUID[Actor.iOyLbOiGrqMY49QI]{Chamberlain} will summon forth a supplemental force of allied constructs to aid the Downsiders in battle (see below), and will also use his Net to target ranged attackers or enemy spellcasters. When confronted with melee combat, Chamberlain will utilize his personal Rapier.

Automated Reinforcements

On initiative count 20 during the first round of combat, Chamberlain issues a command to call forth a supplemental force of 4 @UUID[Actor.aXNNESwMlzmcTccK]{Woven Constructs}, who dredge themselves out of the detritus strewn throughout the camp.

As the battle begins, the silver-plated Chessman stands erect and emits a strange inhuman sound, as if speaking in some bizarre language made of mechanical blare and electrostatic fuzz. All of a sudden, four aged constructs emerge from the timeworn detritus of the camp to stand beside the other four defenders, with verdigris-crusted chassis covered in mushroom growths and the soot of several decades.

The Woven Constructs attack with no regard for their own safety, using their @UUID[Actor.aXNNESwMlzmcTccK.Item.LTadq8AoL97pXvxd]{Rusty Scythe} and @UUID[Actor.aXNNESwMlzmcTccK.Item.PCrnj0F340h1RehX]{Rusty Trowel}.

Nothing To Lose

The Downsiders and their construct allies will ultimately fight to the death, unless the characters convince one of them to surrender during the course of battle. If the party manages to damage two of the Downsiders by half their total hit points or more, the Charisma skill checks featured above in "Apprehending the Renegade" can be made again with @Advantage[2].

@UUID[Actor.1ZEi2D4j2RbKDc9x]{Rider} will mount his @UUID[Actor.T6YcptpxcCLx4yLx]{Jobri} and target any ranged attackers with his Crossbow before closing in for melee with his Shock Spear or War Pick.

@UUID[Actor.XK20zaizyZOLGmsl]{Hew} attempts to flee the conflict immediately. If cornered or blocked from leaving, he'll arm himself with a War Pick to keep attackers at bay, otherwise using defensive actions to try to avoid any harm.

@UUID[Actor.OYdqWs17RvL7ntbf]{Lucent} will utilize a Crossbow in battle, fighting defensively while placing himself directly between Hew and the party on the battlefield.

@UUID[Actor.iOyLbOiGrqMY49QI]{Chamberlain} will summon forth a supplemental force of allied constructs to aid the Downsiders in battle (see below), and will also use his Net to entangle attackers that close distance to the other constructs. When confronted with melee combat, Chamberlain will utilize his personal @UUID[Actor.iOyLbOiGrqMY49QI.Item.DeDDS9xM0CMx56rs]{Rapier}.

Automated Reinforcements

During the first round of combat, Chamberlain issues a command to call forth a supplemental force of 4 @UUID[Actor.aXNNESwMlzmcTccK]{Woven Constructs}, who dredge themselves out of the detritus strewn throughout the camp.

As the battle begins, the silver-plated Chessman stands erect and emits a strange inhuman sound, as if speaking in some bizarre language made of mechanical blare and electrostatic fuzz. All of a sudden, four aged constructs emerge from the timeworn detritus of the camp to stand beside the other four defenders, with verdigris-crusted chassis covered in mushroom growths and the soot of several decades.

The Woven Constructs attack with no regard for their own safety, using their @UUID[Actor.aXNNESwMlzmcTccK.Item.LTadq8AoL97pXvxd]{Rusty Scythe} and @UUID[Actor.aXNNESwMlzmcTccK.Item.PCrnj0F340h1RehX]{Rusty Trowel}.

Nothing To Lose

The Downsiders and their construct allies will ultimately fight to the death, unless the characters convince one of them to surrender during the course of battle. If they become @Condition[broken], skill checks featured above in "Apprehending the Renegade" can be made again with @Advantage[2].

Abyss Attunement: Downsiders Destroyed

If the party raids the Chessmen camp and destroys the Renegade Construct, each character advances their [[/attunement emberAbyss +1 arcturelSideCheckmateDestroyed]] at the conclusion of the event.

Akon Attunement: Downsiders Captured

If the party raids the Chessmen camp and chooses to capture the Renegade Construct "alive" for additional scrutiny, each character advances their [[/attunement emberAkon +1 arcturelSideCheckmateCaptured]] at the conclusion of the event.

Collecting Evidence

Proof for Larissa Toth

Once the battle is over, the party needs to collect some kind of evidence that proves their victory here at Aberin's Folly. This can include (but is not limited to) the following:

  • @UUID[Item.Upqcc59WF78a86BR]{Renegade Construct Scraps} that identify the construct's model number.

  • Hew, the Renegade Construct, can accompany the party alive as a willing or unwilling hostage.

Looting the Camp

If the party examines the table where the constructs were gathered, they find a crude map of the Sinkhole Depths scrawled upon it — with Rock Bottom, the Scrapyard, and the Inkaro Pools locations noted in somewhat fresh ink. They also find a set of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.fC0lFK8P4RuhpfaU]{Cartographer's Tools} @UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.scrivenersToolki] specifically set up for the task of cartography nearby.

Any character who succeeds on a [[/skill perception 12]] [[/skillCheck awareness 12]] check while searching the camp is also able to locate the following:

  • A set of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.0d08g1i5WXnNrCNA]{Tinker's Tools}.

  • A leather purse containing [[/award 33gp]].

  • A @UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.repairKitSmith00].

  • A leather purse containing [[/award 3gp 3sp]].

Check the Outcome to conclude the event, once the players have collected their evidence for Larissa Toth and had ample time to search the camp.

Concluding the Event

Milestone

Completing this event earns the party a @UUID[JournalEntry.emberPlayerGuide.JournalEntryPage.jK1PXextPwuJuSnr]{Milestone Point}, potentially advancing them in level. This milestone is mutually exclusive with the [[/eventState arcturelSideFinale]] event which cannot be earned.

Next Steps

The party can return to the Silver Beam Headquarters in Arcturel Upper to trigger the events of [[/eventState arcturelSideSilverBeam]], during which they'll be rewarded by Larissa Toth for their efforts here at the Downsiders camp.
Checkmate for Chessmen.soverview: At the behest of Larissa Toth, the party journeys to the construct camp at Aberin's Folly, where they must apprehend or execute the Renegade Construct known as Hew. The other Chessmen are more than ready to defend their comrade, however, and won't go down without a fight.
Checkmate for Chessmen.sexposition: As you stealthily make your way through the ramshackle camp, you spot four Chessian Constructs gathered around a table stacked with various accoutrements. Indeed, the Renegade Construct — your quarry — sits among them. These constructs appear to study something on the table with eager interest, and are currently unaware of your presence here in the camp. A large riding lizard remains hitched to a post nearby, scanning the camp's horizon with its primal reptilian gaze.
Checkmate for Chessmen.ssummary: We raided the encampment at Aberin's Folly where the Renegade Construct and its allies were known to be hiding out. After defeating the constructs, we collected proof of our victory before returning to Larissa Toth.

Overview.name: Overview
Overview.text:
Requirements

This side quest occurs during Chapter 2 and begins when the party discovers some clue about troubles in the town of @UUID[JournalEntry.emberArctusGazet.JournalEntryPage.QpeeUqr3NZMsObnG]{Skybrush}. There are no prerequisites for this quest and it can be undertaken at any time, although it is certain to be encountered if traveling with @UUID[Actor.ehBJkqqxoa7VEwSs]{Ankarist} during the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberChainArc100] quest.

Difficulty

The "A Brush With Death" quest is designed for a party of Level 3 characters, although the final encounter of the quest in @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.mERlrM63Ioo7UrlO]{Where Evil Lurks} may prove difficult for a party that is not yet Level 4.

Milestone Progression

This is a Side Quest quest that awards 2 @UUID[JournalEntry.emberPlayerGuide.JournalEntryPage.jK1PXextPwuJuSnr]{Milestone Points}: 1 Milestone Point each upon completion of the [[/eventState brushWithDeathSkybrush2]] and [[/eventState brushWithDeathArchives]] events.

The remote village of @UUID[JournalEntry.emberArctusGazet.JournalEntryPage.QpeeUqr3NZMsObnG]{Skybrush} has fallen under hard times and grim omens. A mysterious undead curse called @UUID[.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment} plagues its inhabitants, a mixture of stalwart mining folk and proud lumber workers who can't keep pace with The Bewilderment's malefic results… those inevitably slain by the curse rise from the grave as ghoulish undead creatures known as @UUID[Actor.e67w5IOBScYtJKXr]{Horrendors}.

Little do the people of Skybrush know, the Bewilderment originates from the shadows of a forgotten Shent vault buried deep within the hinterlands north of town. There, in a timeworn repository known as @UUID[JournalEntry.skQcdBxw8K0AS7hv]{The Bleak Archive}, a wraithlike warlock named @UUID[Actor.fzbl7UQ5W82mFnbd]{Tethra Shùl} has remained trapped for centuries. From the confines of this ageless place, she utilizes the Bewilderment and its Horrendors to exert the malevolent will of her otherworldly patron, the Abyssal Horror @UUID[JournalEntry.emberDeities0000.JournalEntryPage.VXFOxdzzDefX5dQ8]{Nethehepticas}. And time grows short for the people of Skybrush — who Nethehepticas seeks to claim as foot soldiers in a forthcoming apocalypse.

Once they arrive in Skybrush, the characters must unravel the mystery of the curse's origin and precisely how it came to town. They'll trace the ill-fated steps of a young bard named @UUID[Actor.H0WMbdJx0yELum4z]{Dereth Erekos}, the curse's first victim, and learn how an assortment of five Varùn relics bearing the curse were distributed to the unsuspecting citizens of Skybrush. As the curse spreads further and further, the characters will find themselves in a race against time to not only locate and unseal the Bleak Archive, but to also release the world from Tethra Shùl's evil ambitions by reckoning with her loathsome remains.

Involved Characters

  • @UUID[Actor.BJ0TzuQIdpqKTm5R]{Liestra Grann}

  • Qory Hult

  • @UUID[Actor.cvyDEZu7WvSDLzAo]{Mica Valaston}

  • Mr. Zereth Erekos & Mrs. Demetria Erekos

  • Mrs. Estweather

  • Revelry Wyst

  • Kadrick Pond

  • Kel Kornan

  • Gedron Tath

Dangers & Enemies

  • @UUID[Actor.e67w5IOBScYtJKXr]

  • @UUID[Actor.H0WMbdJx0yELum4z]{Dereth Erekos}

  • @UUID[Actor.oNP6JkB5Me8gYrc1]

  • @UUID[Actor.fzbl7UQ5W82mFnbd]{Tethra Shùl}

  • @UUID[.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}
Overview.soverview:
The remote village of Skybrush in the north-west reaches of the Rustvar Valleys has fallen upon hard times and grim omens. What began as a string of unsettling murders has unveiled itself as a mysterious and malefic curse. The townsfolk who have succumbed to the evils of this curse rise again from the grave as ghoulish undead creatures known as Horrendor.

Precisely how this misfortune happened remains a mystery to the people of Skybrush. Once they arrive in Skybrush, the characters must unravel the mystery of the curse's origin and precisely how it came to town. They'll trace the ill-fated steps of a young bard named Dereth Erekos, the curse's first victim, and learn how an assortment of five Varùn relics bearing the curse were distributed to the unsuspecting citizens of Skybrush.

The first half of this quest is a a sophisticated murder-mystery investigation with countless clues for the party to follow and explore. Once the origin of this evil is discovered, the party must breach and explore The Bleak Archive, a dangerous puzzle-dungeon where an ancient evil has remained trapped for millenia. "A Brush with Death" is a harrowing tale of dread, paranoia, mistrust, and survival — and one that introduces a lasting evil to the lives of our unsuspecting heroes.

Flight from the Dark.name: Flight from the Dark
Flight from the Dark.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

This social event takes place on the region map and brings the party face-to-face with refugees from the nearby treetop village of @UUID[JournalEntry.emberArctusGazet.JournalEntryPage.QpeeUqr3NZMsObnG]{Skybrush}, which (unbeknownst to its residents) has fallen prey an evil curse. In this event, the characters can:

  • Encounter a group of Harrowed Townsfolk from Skybrush, and learn about their exodus following a gruesome murder.

  • Ask the Townsfolk questions about Skybrush or their destination of @UUID[JournalEntry.emberArctusGazet.JournalEntryPage.VmrcB6qB9wLVF9Sk]{Storsa's Strand}.

  • Possibly identify the @UUID[Item.ihthfY7X30HnAVcH]{Moon Blossom} flower which is connected to the plight of Skybrush.

The Harrowed Townsfolk

If the characters maintain their pace and bearing, they'll soon converge with 3 rask-drawn wagons carrying 6 @UUID[Actor.9plFRf3Hurd9r7ol]{Harrowed Townsfolk} who journey along the dusty highland road at a notably swift pace of their own.

  • Each of the 3 wagons is drawn by a single @UUID[Actor.QGpM0XLtyG7zN76l]{Rask}.

  • The caravan journeys southward and/or eastward along the unmarked valley road.

  • The aforementioned elder is a wizened Arcturian carpenter named Valence (Neutral Good, Arcturian Human, 55 years, he/him), and is armed with two Handaxes rather than a single Club.

  • The young girl mentioned below is known as Deera (Lawful Good, Arcturian Human, 6 years, she/her).

@Embed[Actor.9plFRf3Hurd9r7ol label="Harrowed Townsfolk" count=6 readaloud="The downcast demeanor of these Arcturians is at odds with the typically friendly welcome you have come to expect from locals in the region. You observe fidgeting hands and eyes which flicker from side to side as if on alert for some imminent threat. Small children stand warily behind their mother's frocks. A haggard elder steps forward reluctantly to assume the responsibility of speaking with you."]

@Embed[Actor.QGpM0XLtyG7zN76l count=3]

Signs of Strife

Even before a conversation is initiated, the characters may notice certain details on their own pertaining to this troubled caravan of Arcturians:

A [[/skill perception 12 passive]] [[/skillCheck awareness 12 passive]] check allows characters to notice that most of these Harrowed Townsfolk look remarkably tired — as if they haven't slept in days — and that their wagons are almost absurdly overstocked with an abundance of possessions.

A [[/skill insight 15 passive]] [[/skillCheck awareness 15]] passive allows characters to spot a young girl among the arcturians who holds a curious flower that resembles a pale cerulean anemone.

[[/skill nature 15]] [[/skillCheck wilderness 15]] You recognize the young girl's flower to be a @UUID[Item.ihthfY7X30HnAVcH]{Moon Blossom}, and understand its curious properties.

Characters with [[/knowledge warfare]] [[/knowledge undeath]] or with the [[/path emberFlameguardMilitia]] Readily identify the Harrowed Townsfolk as refugees from a mountainside Arcturian settlement, and can size-up the hastily-assembled contents of their wagons with relative ease.

The Trouble with Skybrush

The Harrowed Townsfolk are eager to share their tales of worry and woe, so it doesn't take much effort for the characters to strike up a pointed conversation with the elder Valence.

What the Townsfolk Know

Valence and the other townsfolk are ultimately agreeable people, despite their angst and frustrations, and are happy to oblige the party any information that seems reasonable. Valence and the other Harrowed Townsfolk can readily offer the characters the following information:

  • A young man named Branos Erekos was brutally murdered in cold blood by his brother Dereth. In the wake of this incident, strange nightmares rife with undefinable terrors began afflicting several citizens of Skybrush, including Valence himself.

  • The caravan of refugees rides eastward to Storsa's Strand, on the banks of Lake Mithra, where they hope to escape the ill tidings that came to Skybrush.
