This discussion takes place in @UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.zSpPVloL1lGDom9T]{Veiled Threats}. If they have not yet located Funar, they must complete that task before doing anything further.
The Death of Darius.soverview: The party investigates the murder of Darius Cevher, searching for clues that point towards the identity and motive of his killers.
The Death of Darius.sexposition:
An array of colors and fabrics surround you as you make your way into the heart of the Gossamer district. Some of the outfits are fashion-forward versions of the clothes you've seen elsewhere in the city, while others seem to be impossibilities of craft, held together in fanciful shapes by little more than a button or piece of colorful string. In and around these displays of fashion, humming spinning wheels churn out the threads and clothes that will be tomorrow's fashions, moving so quickly that threads fly into the air and fall on you like rain.

The only place that seems still is Threadforge, Darius Cevher's shop. Bits of thread have collected on the window and door like a mosaic of colorful dust. A sign hangs from a window, also covered in bits of thread, its words barely visible:

Closed until further notice. Investigation pending.
The Death of Darius.ssummary: We investigated Threadforge, Darius Cevher's shop, in a search for clues about who could have killed him there - and any evidence that Funar Cevher isn't the one to blame. We should share what we've found with Lyla to see what she thinks, and figure out what our collective next steps should be.

To Copy a Key.name: To Copy a Key
To Copy a Key.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

In this combat event, the characters can:

  • Meet Janix Mance to recruit him for the heist. (Or meet him again, for those who already met Janix in [[/eventState chain2Burns]]).

  • Retrieve some materials that Janix needs in return for his help, which requires fighting off a pack of aggressive @UUID[Actor.8PiFttcf0tJV0joE]{Ketral}. If the party decides to go this route, using the "Entered Stonework Hollow" outcome will automatically move the event from the region map to the map that represents Stonework Hollow.

Meeting Janix Mance

The party may have met Janix Mance previously, which affects how he greets them.

If they completed [[/eventState chain2Burns]]

I should have known that when Lyla Cevher said she had a set of top-notch adventurers ready to help me out that it would be you lot. Lyla's always had a good head on her shoulders. I'll still need you to do a little something for me before I can help you out though.

If they did not complete [[/eventState chain2Burns]]

There's not many folks I would trust to send folks my way based only on a note, but Lyla Cevher is one of them. Says she's got a bit of a situation and I can maybe help, but I'm gonna need something from you first.

@Embed[Actor.gBXPA4AerLzwSbi6]

A Conversation with Janix

Janix Mance is inclined to help Lyla Cevher, but first he wants to know what he's getting into. With a successful [[/check insight 16]] check, characters know that he's most interested in problem solving - if there's an interesting challenge to be met, he'll automatically be more intrigued.

Janix is willing to talk about any of the following:

  • He knew Lyla before she left Ordain and feels bad about her recent losses.

  • He doesn't trust anything that any of the other Trading Houses say about Darius' death, especially House Wandren, which has increasingly been associated with shady groups around the city.

  • He believes that Hephiss Wandren's keys are attuned keys, only able be used by the person they are attuned to, but can make a mold that will copy the keys and fool them into thinking that anyone holding them is attuned to them.

Janix is reluctant to participate in the heist without getting something in return. Parties can convince him by:

  • Making a successful [[/check persuasion 25]] check. If characters have [[/knowledge machines]] or helped Janix Mance in the event [[/eventState chain2Burns]], they have advantage on the check.

  • Helping Janix retrieve a rare metal, quickmetal, from a vein within the abandoned Stonehollow Quarry, which has become somewhat overrun by local wildlife. The metal will also make the mold work faster.

If he does join the heist, Janix has no interest in attending the Marlstone Gala — he's not a fan of crowds. He'd much rather meet them outside, do what he needs to do, and head home. He needs the party to find him a way in.

How Janix Knows Lyla

I know Lyla's been away a few years, but feels like I saw her grow up and she's always had a good head on her shoulders. Plus she's never boring. If she's into something, it's something worth doing.

The Accusations About Funar

Funar isn't quite as much fun as Lyla, but he's always had a solid head on his shoulders. Not the type to go off and kill anybody. That Hephiss Wandren, on the other hand? Ever since she got control of the house, they've gotten more and more suspicious. I know they've always had their secret ways of getting the best luxuries money can buy, but it feels like when I hear their name these days, it's always alongside some common criminal.

Hephiss' Keys

Attuned keys. I'm sure of it. You attune to them, and only you can use them. If anyone else tries, the shape of the key changes and it won't work. Half the time it also has wards or sets off alarms, if you don't know what you're doing. Luckily for you, I do. And I'm willing to help…if you do me a favor. It's why I had Lyla send you here instead of to my workshop.

What Janix Needs

We should get down to business. I love to help a friend, but I need a bit of help too. There's a vein of metal in the old quarry that's exactly what I need for my next construct - and it'll make creating this mold for you easier too. Only problem is that the place is overrun by creatures. I could use some backup to retrieve it safely.

Primordis Attunement: Janix Persuaded

If the party manages to Persuade Janix to help the party, each character that participates advances their [[/attunement emberPrimordis +1 otherhood2KeyPersuaded]] at the conclusion of the event.

Clearing Stonework Hollow

Note: Scene Transition

If you check the outcome box below, the scene will transition to an area map for the combat noted below.

[[/outcome entered]]

The party must cross the seemingly empty quarry in order to retrieve the quickmetal, which Janix has the tools to remove from the vein in the rock. Once a character comes with 20 feet of any of the ketral hidden within the rocks, all reveal themselves and attack. This attack draws the attention of a juvenile Suarrok, which is drawn down into an attack.

@Embed[Actor.8PiFttcf0tJV0joE count=6]

@Embed[Actor.nJwL6Gxdv9fU7Dh5]

Ketral Tactics

Initially, the ketral attempt to surprise characters and benefit from their @UUID[Actor.8PiFttcf0tJV0joE.Item.1hN2GE3d5Cd2ohIg]{Surprise Attack}, but once engaged, primarily attempt to surround the party, cutting off all avenues of escape and staying close enough to each other to benefit from @UUID[Actor.8PiFttcf0tJV0joE.Item.uRIWxtdOWXqP2oVV]{Pack Tactics}

Suarrok Juvenile Tactics

The suarrok's attention is drawn by the scent and sight of blood. Once one of the party members takes a hit or a ketral is killed, the suarrok joins the attack in the following round. It will attack the party directly with its @UUID[Actor.nJwL6Gxdv9fU7Dh5.Item.6vURSsPqR8UTQan4]{Long Beak}, but often prefers to let the Ketral do the bulk of the work, turning @UUID[Actor.nJwL6Gxdv9fU7Dh5.Item.T2ZNQKTKt3TyWvYg]{Searing Stare} on the strongest member of the party in the hopes that the ketral will wound or kill them.

Once the party has defeated all enemies, Janix is able to collect his quickmetal without incident and agrees to join the group.

Akon Attunement: An Errand for Janix

If the party successfully completes an errand for Janix, each character advances their [[/attunement emberAkon +1 otherhood2KeyErrand]] at the conclusion of the event.

[[/outcome recruited]]

Concluding The Event

Next Steps

If the party has not yet completed all of the preparation events below, they can proceed to any incomplete event to continue with this phase of preparation.

  • Found a hidden route through @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls]{Lantern Roads} into Marlstone Manor [[/eventState otherhood2Lantern]]

  • Spoken to Juro Wandren in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.ThsrAwMhXhmowirO]{The Hallows} in [[/eventState otherhood2Insider]]

  • Scouted the Marlstone Manor in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.uVodk7tLiG3pZMTq]{Marlstone} in [[/eventState otherhood2Casing]]

Once all of the above have been completed, they should proceed to the House Cevher Tradeway in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.D0AAT8TNsytqy7Hm]{Quarry Run} to prepare for the ball in @UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.hUIBGXTjsQrrD1e1]{Set In Motion}.
To Copy a Key.soverview: The party meets up with Janix Mance, an acclaimed alchemist, who will be able to copy Hephiss Wandren's intricate, magically-warded keys.
To Copy a Key.sexposition: While Stonework Hollow may have once been a busy quarry, now wind seems to whistle through its depths and it echoes with a sad emptiness. The artificer Janix Mance appears to be the only one on site, easy to spot as he leans against a rocky quarry wall.
To Copy a Key.ssummary: Lyla provided us an introduction to Janix Mance, the talented artificer whose skills she believes are necessary to our successful rescue of Funar Cevher during the Marlstone Gala. Janix asked us to help solve a problem of his own in return for his services — clearing Stonework Hollow of creatures whose continued presence in the deserted quarry cuts off access to the supplies Janix needs.

Casing the Joint.name: Casing the Joint
Casing the Joint.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

In this exploration event, the party can:

  • Disguise themselves as contracted labor preparing Marlstone Manor for the gala and make their way inside (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.Hg1HjuxWR7BzzXhY#getting-into-marlstone-manor]{Getting into Marlstone Manor}).

  • Scout the mansion for important locations while avoiding suspicion from the other workers (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.Hg1HjuxWR7BzzXhY#scouting-the-manor]{Scouting The Manor}), or try to get info from those workers (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.Hg1HjuxWR7BzzXhY#questioning-the-staff]{Questioning the Staff})

  • Use the rod of locate object to narrow down Funar's location, directly underneath the manor's dining hall. (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.Hg1HjuxWR7BzzXhY#locating-funar-cevher]{Locating Funar Cevher})

  • If caught, get out without affecting their future plans. (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.Hg1HjuxWR7BzzXhY#escorted-out]{Escorted Out}).

There are a few key pieces of information that the party can discover while scouting the manor, each of which will help them in the heist.

  • The Manor Layout: The party immediately receives a rough sketch of the manor layout for their role as temporary staff, but can find more information about the manor, including the location of the hidden staircase in the @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.kwFKceeBEoe8hpwq]{Closet} that leads to the level below by checking out the books in the @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.c2GhJXrnRFVgTp7w]{Library}, notes in @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.FC2cY9KPcKZjHONN]{Hephiss Wandren's Study,} or an old map found in the @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.sx9J8SyOCm8hPi8a]{Servant's Office}.

  • Funar's Location: By using the @UUID[Item.psLBUt4fyHfURaOC]{Locator Rod}, the party can discover that Funar is in a room below the @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.Olsddfzg7LUfXOnG]{Dining Room}. They will receive a result that he is "nearby" in any adjoining rooms (the @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.vBa4qUmlheJi75AL]{Breakfast Room}, @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.v6lk4Gha7PJvqyGr]{Coat Room}, @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.NgXe2ukpymWe1ngw]{Sitting Room,} and @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.pHrKkYmFyw2eWLk8]{Staff Bathroom}).

  • Getting to Funar: Information about how to open the hidden staircase in the @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.kwFKceeBEoe8hpwq]{Closet} can be found in a locked safe in Hephiss Wandren's @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.FC2cY9KPcKZjHONN]{Study}, upstairs in her @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.1W6MgyHIKhQ9m8cz]{Chamber}, or upstairs in her @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.npPq56DCS4tAURkp]{Art Studio}.

  • Making Preparations: Throughout the manor, there are items that the party may find helpful during the heist, from extra sets of clothing to alchemy ingredients that can be used to create smoke to doors that can be propped open to enter from outside. These are noted in each room within the area walkthrough.

Getting into Marlstone Manor

As you enter the manor, footsteps echoing on the stone floor and bouncing off of the finely-carved ceiling above, you are greeted by a woman of middling years, who beckons you in and greets you in a voice that seems used to being heard and obeyed.

Greetings all! I'm Jalla Difae, the event planner for the upcoming Marlstone Gala, to be held in the manor behind me. Now I know that Hephiss has hired enough of you to fill an Arcturian caravan, but we're going to do things in as orderly a process as possible.

Gardeners, you'll head through the Grand Hall behind me to the gardens out back. Decorators, you'll start your cleaning and decoration work in the Grand Hall. Everyone else, you'll be helping with the food in the kitchen - head through the gallery to your left and straight back. Make sure you get the equipment you need and list of tasks before you start, though - if you're not carrying the proper tools, you won't be able to work. No exceptions!

Each member of the party can decide whether they wish to fit in as a gardener, decorator, or cook — and whether they want to split up or scout together.

Choosing Your Role

Different staff have access to different parts of the manor, and are easy identified by some aspect of their uniform. Characters can choose the gardener, decorator, or kitchen staff role by taking one of the following.

  • Gardener (@UUID[Item.VLOb3sWUKIuuWUdG]{Gardener's Toolbelt})

  • Decorating (@UUID[Item.W2XdDc2U3gBjtz1i]{Satchel of Marlstone Decor})

  • Kitchen Staff (@UUID[Item.OddoS1q37rUnCB2P]{Apron of Many Pockets})

Party members can avoid taking the equipment of any role by succeeding on a [[/check stealth 17]] check. If the check fails, a member of staff stops them from going further into the manor until they have the equipment for their role.

  • With a successful [[/check 18 persuasion]] or [[/check 18 deception]] check, the character can claim they have the tools elsewhere, but if it fails, they must either choose a tool or be taken out of the manor.

Party members can take multiple sets of tools by succeeding on a [[/check sleightofhand 17]] check. On a failure, they knock over several tools and are told to proceed to their first task immediately or leave the manor.

Scouting The Manor

This event takes place on the area map. As party members make their way through the map, they will encounter three types of rooms: open, restricted, or forbidden, each of which is handled differently.

Tracking Suspicion

As the party goes about their actions in this event, they may raise the suspicion of the other members of the staff, gaining suspicion. As suspicion accumulates, it is more difficult for the party to accomplish their goals, as follows:

  • No Suspicion: The character can move freely.

  • Low Suspicion: The character is restricted in their movements. Open rooms are treated as restricted and restricted rooms are treated as forbidden.

  • Moderate Suspicion: As above, and all charisma checks are made with disadvantage.

  • High Suspicion: Guards are dispatched to escort the party out of the building, as they seem as if they are up to no good. See @UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.Hg1HjuxWR7BzzXhY#escorted-out]{Escorted Out} below for details.

Exploring Manor Rooms

Access to manor rooms varies by the role the character has decided to take - rooms may be open, restricted, or forbidden. Characters wearing the item associated with their role will not gain suspicion in a room that is open to their role unless they take a specific suspicious action that calls for a check (stealing an item, going through locked drawers, etc.).

For more on accessing rooms, see @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.5MKbu1BthiAQEyaf#manor-access]{Manor Access}.

Questioning the Staff

If characters wish, they may attempt to talk to any of the other workers, though none of these NPCs are particularly eager to chat.

Talking to A Fellow Gardener

The Gardener - Tavro (Ordani human, he/him), an older gentleman with a somewhat bent back but a spry step, can be found trimming flowers in the @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.OLD5SnNvjPB6nOfU]{Gardens}, near the foot of the Eastern stairs

One thing I'll say about the Wandrens - they know how to get plants that I've never seen anywhere else. And half of them don't even get shown out here to the normal folk.

With a successful [[/check insight 17]] check, the party knows that the gardener is interested in new and interesting flowers and plants. With a successful [[/check nature 17]] check or [[/knowledge plants]], the party can get the gardener to speak without a check. Otherwise, they need a [[/check persuasion 16]] check to get him to speak. Tavro will share the following:

  • Hephiss Wandren grows exotic plants on the second story of the house, but won't let the regular gardeners up.

  • One of the vines that Hephiss grows extends down from the second story to outside of the kitchen. Someone recently tried to scale it to reach the second floor, but fell in the process. Tavro sometimes thinks about climbing it himself, but he's sure he wouldn't reach the top.

  • If asked about places to hide in the gardens, Tavro believes the best option would be the fountain away from the guardhouse, which is only lightly patrolled.

Talking to a Fellow Decorator

The Decorator - Erisa Wandren (Ordani human, she/her), a minor cousin of one of the Wandrens who keeps the name in the hopes that it will get her some social status, can be found in the@UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.uNuNIbD8I2MqcRmW]{ Grand Hall}, adjusting a sconce on the mid-eastern pillar

My uncle was important in the Trading House years ago you know - almost became the head of the whole thing. Just think - I could have grown up here instead of worrying about the decor.

With a successful [[/check insight 17]] check, the party knows that Erisa is more curious about what Hephiss is up to than interested in decorating and has taken a look in rooms that don't actually need to be decorated. She's not particularly interested in talking to ordinary staff, but with a successful [[/check history 16]] check to talk about the history of the Wandren house, a successful [[/check persuasion 17]] check, or [[/knowledge politics]], she will share the following:

  • Hephiss is insisting on showing her very mediocre art in the gallery, which is ruining the look. Hephiss apparently paints the art upstairs and works odd messages into the art—there are stairs by the staff room that the right person might be able to use to go up and see.

  • Erisa avoids the kitchen and dining room side of the manor, because she's convinced she's heard thumping sounds from beneath the floor.

  • Erisa tried to take a look at some of the books about the history of the manor in the library, but Hephiss ran her off and insisted she focus elsewhere.

Talking to a Fellow Kitchen Worker

The Kitchen Worker - Tizney Blaine (Ordani Fej, she/her), a would-be chef hoping to pick something up from a visiting chef, can be found in the@UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.NmpNOEEorZTgGAAp]{ Kitchen} by the casks on the Western wall

I don't mind getting my hands dirty if it means working on one of the events of the season. There's always some new culinary wonder being put together, and I get to be a part of it - even if I'm spending most of my time chopping veggies and straightening up rooms.

With a successful [[/check insight 17]] check, the party knows that Tizney is trying to pick up recipes (and pocket ingredients) by working in the manor. With a successful [[/check persuasion 17]] or [[/check intimidation 17]] check, she will share what she's learned along the way.

  • Using the servants' corridor between the @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.NmpNOEEorZTgGAAp]{Kitchen} and the @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.sx9J8SyOCm8hPi8a]{Servants' Office} is a good way to move through the house quickly without being bothered…if characters are interested in picking up anything unexpected along the way. This route also passes by stairs to the second level of the manor.

  • Tizney hoped to find a book in @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.c2GhJXrnRFVgTp7w]{Hephiss' Library} with more information about alchemy, but was called away before she could locate it.

Characters without a role will immediately be asked what their role is - they must succeed on a [[/check 17 persuasion]] check with disadvantage to continue the conversation. On a failure, the NPC worries they are a troublemaker and refuses to speak further.

Locating Funar Cevher

Using the Locator Rod in Marlstone Manor

Within Marlstone Manor, the @UUID[Item.psLBUt4fyHfURaOC]{Locator Rod} functions in Proximity Mode When fully charged, the rod has 10 uses. If activated, the Locator Rod sends a sound to the creature that activated it, indicating one of the following states.

  • Vicinity (steady tone): Funar is in the general vicinity of this room or area. As Funar is located close to Marlstone Manor, any test of Locator Rod will at least indicate this level.

  • Nearby (one note): Funar is within a few rooms of this room or area.

  • Adjacent (double note): Funar is in a room either beside, above, or below this room or area. The party can use a second charge to be pulled in Funar's direction.

  • Here (triple note): Funar is in this room.

The description of each room in the Area Walkthrough notes what the @UUID[Item.psLBUt4fyHfURaOC]{Locator Rod} indicates.

Escorted Out

Optional Event: Character Suspicion is Too High

The following sequence of events occurs only if a member of the party with High Suspicion triggers suspicion again.

Avoiding the Guards

The character or characters who have reached 5+ points of suspicion should immediately make a [[/check perception 18]] check. If it succeeds, they hear all the signs that guards are en route. If it fails, they remain unaware.

Rhythmic footsteps echo down the hallway, and you can make out the faintest scraps of conversation:"went this way" and "pretending to be one of the staff."

Characters who know the guards are coming can hide from them and sneak out with a successful [[/check stealth 19]] check, but if they remain in the Manor, the guards will continue to pursue - each time they enter a room, roll on the @UUID[RollTable.oXUEUdE0Z0lH6QRD]{Guard Investigation} table to determine the results.

Once a character is detained by the guards, they are removed from the manor. If they return and encounter a guard, they are immediately attacked.

Abyss Attunement: Escorted Out

Each character that is caught and escorted out while sneaking through Marlstone Manor advances their [[/attunement emberAbyss +1 otherhood2CasingCaught]] at the conclusion of the event.

Concluding The Event

Next Steps

If the party has not yet completed all of the preparation events below, they should proceed to any remaining incomplete events to continue with this phase of preparation.

  • Found a hidden route through @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls]{Lantern Roads} into Marlstone Manor [[/eventState otherhood2Lantern]]

  • Spoken to Juro Wandren in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.ThsrAwMhXhmowirO]{The Hallows} in [[/eventState otherhood2Insider]]

  • Recruited Janix Mance in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.dNI3A44TwJO1kevp]{Stonework Hollow} in [[/eventState otherhood2Key]]

Once all of the above have been completed, they should proceed to the House Cevher Tradeway in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.D0AAT8TNsytqy7Hm]{Quarry Run} Once all of the above have been completed, they should proceed to the House Cevher Tradeway in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.D0AAT8TNsytqy7Hm]{Quarry Run} to prepare for the ball in @UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.hUIBGXTjsQrrD1e1]{Set In Motion}.
Casing the Joint.soverview: The party masquerades as workers helping to set up Marlstone Gala, giving themselves the opportunity to scout the layout of Marlstone Manor and learn more about where Funar Cevher is being held captive.
Casing the Joint.sexposition: Marlstone Manor draws the eye, even from a distance - not only is it larger and slightly higher up than any of the houses nearby, but it looks like a work of art, with carved stonework that gives it a subtle air of luxury. It is also, at least at the moment, a place abuzz with activity. You easily blend in with the workers making their way into the manor's white stone foyer - some in dirt-stained shirts with weathered hands, others carrying bags that appear to be stuffed with fabrics, and others who smell mildly of spices.
Casing the Joint.ssummary: Disguising ourselves as members of the staff preparing Marlstone Manor for the gala, we took the opportunity to get the lay of the land, figuring out where key items and rooms in the house might be while trying not to draw too much suspicion to ourselves. Hopefully the information we've found will come in handy during the upcoming gala.

Revealed by Lantern.name: Revealed by Lantern
Revealed by Lantern.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

In this exploration event, the party must find a way into Marlstone Manor for Janix Mance, who will need to make a copy of the keys that Hephiss Wandren is holding while at the gala. Any route that the party discovers will be taken by Janix at the start of @UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.jalZUo8LGHwnn7B4]{The Marlstone Gala} without the party's further involvement. In addition, if the party was unable to get on the list for the party through Juro ([[/eventState otherhood2Insider refused]]), they will also take this route, crashing the party and beginning the gala event with a slightly higher level of suspicion.

Traveling Through Lantern Roads

There is a clear barrier between the northern and southern halves of Lantern Roads, and Marlstone adjoins the northern side. To get closer to Marlstone, they will have to find a way past this barrier and into the Northern half of the neighborhood. Three potential options are:

  • Taking the Rooftops: Parties can make their way up to the rooftops and across from the southern section of the neighborhood to the northern. This plays most to the strengths of Strong or Athletic parties, and leads them to the outskirts of the house of Beacon leader Vitt Wandren, who is ready for a fight.

  • Going Through Shadowbox Alley: Parties can make their way through the shops in Shadowbox Alley, most of which have been taken over by Beacon, to find a path through a nervous shopkeeper's house. This plays most to the strengths of Stealthy and Investigative parties. Once through, they can avoid combat with enough stealth.

  • Playing the Part: Parties can pretend to be a courier or prospective Beacon member and attempt to bluff their way in. This plays most to the strength of Persuasive and Deceptive parties. Once through, they will be generally accepted by Beacon and can make their way through with limited combat.

  • Breaking Through the Gate: While ill-advised, parties can take a direct run at the @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.Y6MWQoGsKEkOVBhc]{Gate}. All Beacon members in the area will respond, leading to a large combat. This plays most to the strengths of Combat-Focused parties, though it is not the only opportunity for combat.

Whichever path parties take, once they make it into Beacon territory, they must search for a route through to the @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.9fHLs3vOjSlfTmfQ]{Marlstone Manor Entrance} in the northeastern corner of the neighborhood.

Following the Rooftop Route

Discovering The Rooftop Path

Parties can discover that there is a rooftop path by:

  • Talking to shopkeepers about the Beacon Brigade (at @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.rgFkmJqScjJthA1E]{Just In Time} or @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.HP9hw11vUqeh9Gl0]{Shadowbox Souvenirs}).

  • Noticing places where they could potentially climb up to a higher level (located near @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.4a31pivLSUrZYMtF]{The Terrace Gardens}, @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.sqMiu46682JrLQki]{Terracini's Restaurant}, @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.HP9hw11vUqeh9Gl0]{Shadowbox Souvenirs}, and ).

  • Seeing the rooftop path through the neighborhood while on another rooftop (like @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.JaEG0UmTydMKt0yO]{Lookout Point} or @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.4a31pivLSUrZYMtF]{The Terrace Gardens}).

  • Tracing the path of a courier who disappears into @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.HP9hw11vUqeh9Gl0]{Shadowbox Souvenirs}) only to reappear later in the @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.oAliNrQngO8rEGpg]{Second Light} pawn shop.

Following the Courier

When party members are in the center of the Plaza section of Lantern Roads, or at your discretion, they spot a familiar courier in the distance. Read or paraphrase the following:

As you make your way through the district streets, something catches your eye. Someone, actually. He's carrying a leather satchel now, and moving quickly through the streets, but you're fairly sure it's the courier who first brought you the message to meet with Lyla Cevher. He might know how to get to the other side of Lantern Roads, but he's already a ways away from you and moving fast.

The courier is indeed Hanslo Rey, a courier who initially appeared in the quest in @UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.AqCu9AhqOyEJmqiw]{Introduction}. If the party wishes to see where he goes or follow him, they can use the following checks:

  • With a successful [[/check perception 17]] check, parties keep an eye on him in the crowd of shoppers…until he turns a corner toward @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.HP9hw11vUqeh9Gl0]{Shadowbox Souvenirs}). When the party reaches the same corner he is not there.

    In front of you is a short alley filled with barrels and the entrance to the Shadowbox Souvenirs store. There's no sign of the courier, though you can smell the faintest hint of leather in the air.

  • If the party wishes to ask about the courier in the nearby shop, they can proceed into @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.HP9hw11vUqeh9Gl0]{Shadowbox Souvenirs}), where no one has seen the man. With a successful [[/check persuasion 17]] check with any of the patrons or the shopkeeper, the party learns that while no one came into the shop, someone went by the window before disappearing in the alley.

  • With a successful [[/check 17 perception]] check in the small alleyway, characters see a footprint in the dirt that appears to be recently made.

    • Any character who succeeds on a [[/check nature 16]] check or has [[/knowledge forensics]] can confirm that the footprint is recent.

  • With a successful [[/check investigation 17]] check, characters can tell that the barrels have been recently disturbed - there's signs of scuff marks on the ground and a dirty footprint on top of one of them. It's likely the courier stood on it.

Whether or not the characters choose to follow Hanslo Rey, he appears again after the party first spots him, browsing in the pawn shop @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.oAliNrQngO8rEGpg]{Second Light}.

The Courier's Insights

Hanslo is initially reluctant to say anything about how he managed to get his packages delivered, but greets the party. If they spoke to him about his thoughts in the earlier quest, they have advantage on all checks.

With a successful [[/check insight 16]] check, the party can sense some general guilt and regret, as well as pride in his work. With a successful [[/check persuasion 16]] check, or [[/knowledge intrigue]], Janslo will share the following:

  • He can't reveal how to get into hidden places in the city - it would go against his principles as a courier - but he feels bad about what he's doing for Beacon.

  • He collects money from businesses that Beacon has deals with elsewhere in Ordain, and can see that it’s hurting them.

  • Darius Cevher's shop, Threadforge, wasn't one that Beacon was asking for money, but he did deliver a package there soon before the murder from the Lantern Roads courier station.

With a successful [[/check persuasion 16]] or [[/check intimidation 16]] check, he will also reveal that:

  • The package he delivered to Threadforge had a powder of some type in it.

  • He uses the rooftops to get into Beacon territory, but the path ends in a well-guarded compound, and they only let couriers and initiates through. He doesn’t know how to pass as an initiate, but believes there might be extra courier supplies in the Courier stand in Shadowbox Alley.

Hanslo will not give up his own courier supplies, but the party can always knock him out and take them, acquiring a@UUID[Item.Z0pd4LVjVusTBvqY]{Courier Bag}.

Cora Attunement: Taking the Rooftops

Any character that manages to successfully traverse the rooftops to gain entry to Marlstone Manor advances their [[/attunement emberPrimordis +1 otherhood2LanternRooftops]] at the conclusion of the event.

Sneaking Through Shadowbox alley

The Shadowbox Alley Route

Parties can discover that there is a route through Shadowbox Alley into Brigade territory by:

  • Talking to shoppers who are aware of the area (at@UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.rgFkmJqScjJthA1E]{Just In Time}, @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.sqMiu46682JrLQki]{Terracini's Restaurant}, and@UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.HP9hw11vUqeh9Gl0]{Shadowbox Souvenirs}) or talking to shopkeeper Hettie at @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.3OLRx43NmH9WaSXB]{Hettie's Divinations}.

  • Exploring the Shadowbox Alley area by passing into it through@UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.HktksZed6f7uMqLc]{Shadow Players Theater}.

The Beacon Brigade

While making their way through this section of Lantern Roads, parties will have to watch out for members of the Beacon Brigade. If they are caught, they'll be placed in an impromptu jail (@UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.6N0CDRfhhCbx82lG]{Impromptu Jail}) and need to break or fight their way out.

Primordis Attunement: Going Through Shadowbox Alley

Any character that manages to successfully sneak through Shadowbox Alley to gain entry to Marlstone Manor advances their [[/attunement emberPrimordis +1 otherhood2LanternShadowbox]] at the conclusion of the event.

Bluffing Their Way In

The Bluff

Parties can attempt to bluff their way into Brigade territory by:

  • Eavesdropping on conversations between Brigade members to learn how recruits get through at @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.A0x1R29zmbLYX0QT]{Terracini's Too} or getting information about the process from @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.rgFkmJqScjJthA1E]{Just In Time}.

  • Attempting to replace the current courier by stealing supplies from @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.WtKAS3SaRofvb1Zx]{The Courier Stand}.

  • Learning and executing the proper procedure at the pawn shop Second Light for those in the know by observing at the @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.oAliNrQngO8rEGpg]{Second Light}.

The Pawn Shop Procedure

If the party decides to make it past the pawn shop, Second Light, they'll need to bluff their way through by:

  • Learning that they must bring a light, lamp, or lantern into Second Light to pawn. In addition to any light they have brought with them, the party can acquire lights in @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.HP9hw11vUqeh9Gl0]{Shadowbox Souvenirs} and the @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.HktksZed6f7uMqLc]{Shadow Players Theater}.

  • Using the phrase "Have a Brighter Day" to indicate to the shopkeeper that they are a member of the Brigade.

  • Grab a Brigade Key and use it to exit through the back door.

This route results in the party obtaining a @UUID[Item.NMufWIxDYBCZZQEM]{Brigade Key}, which can be used to open doors and avoid combat within Beacon territory.

Orbis Attunement: Playing the Part

Any character that manages to successfully bluff their way past the Beacon Brigade to gain entry to Marlstone Manor advances their [[/attunement emberPrimordis +1 otherhood2LanternBluff]] at the conclusion of the event.

Moving through Beacon Territory

Once in Beacon Brigade territory north of the gate, the party’s progress depends on whether they have snuck in or have procured a Brigade Key, which marks them as someone who belongs.

  • Parties with a Courier Bag can move freely through Beacon territory.

  • Parties with a Brigade Key can move freely through Beacon territory and can use the key to gain initial entry into Vitt's House and the Weapons Cache.

  • Parties without a Brigade Key will need to continue to deal with Beacon Brigade members as noted in @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.EH0ilpRL8UoqUQQM#the-beacon-brigade]{The Beacon Brigade}.

Ragen Attunement: Breaking Through the Gate

Any character that manages to successfully break through the Gate to gain entry to Marlstone Manor advances their [[/attunement emberPrimordis +1 otherhood2LanternGate]] at the conclusion of the event.

Evidence Against the Beacon Brigade

While moving through Lantern Roads, the party may encounter evidence heavily implicating the Beacon Brigade in the murder of Darius Cevher.

The Evidence Against the Beacon Brigade

Any of the following items can be used as evidence:

  • A Withering Dagger, which can be found in the @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.1DGxNnX1Pcf94J2P]{Barracks} or the @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.CJCd6TJoRdXoI3hG]{Weapons Cache}.

  • Plans for the killing, which can be found in @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.AMOiKTgg2ilXan7f]{Vitt's Office} or @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.VdcXTs0L1h5KTIY4]{Vitt's Back Room}.

Once evidence has been found by the party, mark the outcome below as completed.

[[/outcome dariusEvidence]]

Concluding The Event

Once the party has successfully made their way to the Marlstone Manor Entrance, they know enough to pass their route and information on to Janix Mance, who will follow in their footsteps on the night of the Gala.

Next Steps

If the party has not yet completed all of the preparation events below, they can proceed to any incomplete event to continue with this phase of preparation.

  • Recruited Janix Mance in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.dNI3A44TwJO1kevp]{Stonework Hollow} in [[/eventState otherhood2Key]]

  • Spoken to Juro Wandren in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.ThsrAwMhXhmowirO]{The Hallows} in [[/eventState otherhood2Insider]]

  • Scouted the Marlstone Manor in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.uVodk7tLiG3pZMTq]{Marlstone} in [[/eventState otherhood2Casing]]

Once all of the above have been completed, they should proceed to the House Cevher Tradeway in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.D0AAT8TNsytqy7Hm]{Quarry Run} to prepare for the ball in @UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.hUIBGXTjsQrrD1e1]{Set In Motion}.
Revealed by Lantern.soverview: In preparation for the Marlstone Gala, the party investigates the Lantern Roads district, looking for evidence of a hidden way into Marlstone — the perfect route for anyone who might need to enter the agala without going through the front door.
Revealed by Lantern.sexposition:
Lantern Roads lives up to its name - small shops, lighted windows, locals and tourists walking through the city streets. A lovely place to spend a few hours. But out of the corner of your eye, you see movements in odd places, hear whispers in odd corners, glimpse shadows overhead that seem like they shouldn't quite be where they are.

Beyond them, in the distance, Marlstone Manor's pillars gleam in the light. All you have to do is figure out how to get from here to there.
Revealed by Lantern.ssummary: In order to help any members of our team who can't get into the gala via the guest list, we visited the adjacent district Lantern Roads, uncovering a group of criminals calling themselves the Beacon Brigade. Their home base in the northern section of the neighborhood appeared to block all paths between Lantern Roads and Marlstone, challenging us to find an unconventional route through.

Set in Motion.name: Set in Motion
Set in Motion.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

In this exploration event, the party can:

  • Check in with each other one last time before the heist

  • Learn about any new mechanics being used specifically for the heist

Final Preparations

Lyla surveys the team, looking every bit the self-assured noble in her fancier attire.

As Janix mentioned, he's going in through the path you all found through Lantern Roads. But that's only the beginning of the plan. Does everyone know what they need to do? I'm happy to go over it one last time.

Reviewing the Plan

While Lyla is confident in the team (as confirmed by a successful [[/check 16 insight]] check, she will review any of the following steps of the plan:

  • Janix Mance, using the path identified and tested by the party in @UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.ZPv1VeLAtINtz3gv]{Revealed by Lantern}, will make his way to the outskirts of Marlstone Manor and find a way to hide among the gardens. Parties may have found some suitable spots for him to hide while checking out the manor in@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.Hg1HjuxWR7BzzXhY]{ Casing the Joint}. If not, they will improvise.

  • Lyla and Juro will enter the gala on their own and mingle with the guests, looking for ways to potentially distract Hephiss Wandren.

  • The party will arrive to the gala, either through Juro adding them to the guest list ([[/eventState otherhood2Insider recruited]]) or by using the same path as Janix Mance and sneaking into the party once on site ([[/eventState otherhood2Insider refused]]).

    • If the party was not able to secure Juro's help in getting into the party, they may choose to wear disguises or simply hide among the crowd. If they choose to wear a disguise, they should put it on now.

  • Once the group is all in place, with Janix Mance outside and everyone else at the gala, the group must get the keys from Hephiss, bring them to Janix to be copied, return them to Hephiss, and find the exact location where Funar is being held so that he can be released.

    • Depending on how extensively the party searched the manor during their scouting event, they may or may not already have a route planned or know where Funar is being held.

  • If asked, Lyla is feeling confident. She's fairly sure that everything won't quite go to plan, but she trusts that this group will be able to handle whatever comes next.

In addition to the general planning, characters can briefly chat with the other members of the heist team about their overall feelings and impressions of the heist.

A Chat with Juro

Juro appears confident, but a [[/check insight 16]] check reveals some nerves. He desperately wants to retrieve the ledger that Hephiss Wandren has stored somewhere in the manor and is worried that if it isn't found tonight, it never will be. He'll also share the following:

  • He will go along with Lyla's plan as long as it is working, but if things go wrong, he has his own plan to get the ledger. With a successful [[/check persuasion 18]] check, Juro will reveal that he has brought some fog dust with him, which he can release to try to clear the ballroom, creating enough confusion for the guests to scatter.

  • Juro doesn't want to be on Hephiss' bad side, or have the party shut down and guards remove everyone from the property, but if he has to, he'll prioritize what he needs. He suggests that the party get him the ledger to avoid him accidentally messing with their plans.

A Chat with Janix

Janix is excited to get going and get home safely, and prefers to focus on talking about things related to the mission.

  • Janix has the mold ready to go. While it may look like nothing more than a jar of clay to others, he thinks he can find other uses for it, to create copies of magical items that work almost as good as the original.

  • Janix is thrilled not to set foot in the gala, and does not intend to go inside no matter what happens.

  • If Janix is caught (which he doesn't think he will be), he promises not to rat out the group - he'll claim he wanted to crash the party to see how the other half lives.

New Heist Mechanics

Mechanic: We Already Thought of That

At the beginning of the heist, the party receives 3 total heist points, which they can only spend during the event Marlstone Gala. If something during the event doesn't go to plan, the party spends one of these points to explain how the obstacle has been bypass by something that they planned ahead of time.

Let party members know that they will have three opportunities to call on their previous planning as the heist unfolds, with a single party member rolling a skill check against the feasibility that they could have actually made this plan ahead of time.

Mechanic: Suspicion Levels

As the party moves through Marlstone Manor, they may trigger suspicion among the staff and guards, gaining suspicion with individual actions. As suspicion accumulates, guards may become harder to persuade, doors may be locked where they were previously open, and stealth checks may need to be done under a watchful eye. During the event, you will have outcome boxes that you can use as an internal reminder of the party's current level of suspicion and its consequences.

Concluding The Event

Milestone Progression

Completing this event and agreeing to Lyla's plan awards a @UUID[JournalEntry.emberPlayerGuide.JournalEntryPage.jK1PXextPwuJuSnr]{Milestone} point, potentially enabling the party to advance in level.

Next Steps

The next step is to infiltrate the ball and try to pull off the plan. Once the party has everything they need and feels ready to proceed, head to @UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.jalZUo8LGHwnn7B4]{The Marlstone Gala}.
Set in Motion.soverview: Lyla Cevher and the party meet at House Cevher Headquarters to review the plan one final time and set their meticulously planned caper into action.
Set in Motion.sexposition:
Though House Cevher headquarters doesn't look much different than it has the other times you've visited, in Lyla's office it is clear that a party is in the works. Lyla is dressed to the nines, in a gown meant for a party, and Juro Wandren smells of some faint cologne that has the essence of luxury. Only Janix Mance looks fully out of place, as if he was meant to be in a workshop somewhere instead of with the rest of you. He smirks as you enter and nods his head.

Yes, I know. I don't exactly look the part. That's why we're bringing me in through the side door.
Set in Motion.ssummary: Tonight is the night of the Marlstone Gala. As we prepare to enter the event, dressed in our gala finest, Lyla goes over the plan with us one final time. It may not go exactly as we anticipate, but we're as ready as we can be.

Not All Who Wandren.name: Not All Who Wandren
Not All Who Wandren.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

In this exploration and combat event, the characters can:

  • Find Funar Cevher, locked in a holding cell within Wandren HQ. The party can speak to him, but can't release him - the controls to his cell are located within the Central Chamber of the facility (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.91Ck26XHcgMCo88E#locating-funar]{Locating Funar}).

  • Make their way into the Central Chamber within the HQ by activating torch-lit switches scattered throughout the facility (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.91Ck26XHcgMCo88E#reaching-the-central-chamber]{Reaching The Central Chamber}).

  • Find a @UUID[JournalEntry.emberBestiary000.JournalEntryPage.4lTtZfLS961MjIST]{Tyraphem} caged within the central Control Room, who briefly helps them free Funar before collapsing from their injuries (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.91Ck26XHcgMCo88E#meeting-the-prisoner]{Meeting The Prisoner}).

  • Battle Hephiss, who has been alerted to their entry into the Central Chamber, and meet a simulacrum of the celestial Pyix, revealed to be the mastermind behind Hephiss' plans (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.91Ck26XHcgMCo88E#a-final-battle]{A Final Battle}).

  • Escape Wandren HQ through Lantern Roads (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.91Ck26XHcgMCo88E#leaving-wandren-hq]{Leaving Wandren HQ}).

Locating Funar

If the party is carrying the Locator Rod with them, it reacts as they enter Wandren HQ:

The locator rod you are carrying with you begins to move, swinging itself towards the wall immediately ahead of you.

While within Wandren HQ, the party can get new results from the @UUID[Item.psLBUt4fyHfURaOC]{Locator Rod} - in the room they enter, the @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.DGWkb5NNROklJJ60]{Stairway Entrance}, the Locator Rod indicates that Funar is in an adjacent room.

Indicators of Funar's Presence

In addition to use of the @UUID[Item.psLBUt4fyHfURaOC]{Locator Rod}, the party can learn Funar's location within Wandren HQ from any of the following:

  • If the party learned that Funar was being held beneath the Marlstone Manor dining room, they can triangulate his current position on the floor below with a successful [[/check investigation 16]] check.

  • While within the Central Chamber, party members can potentially hear Funar banging on his prison cell wall, as noted in @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.BMf5Vme1UwrRNa2J]{Central Chamber}.

  • If party members defeat the Aburyx in the @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.H35C2AzPnmV9gxJM]{Training Room} and search its desk, they can find a list of prisoners, which includes Funar Cevher.

  • Once the party has reached the @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.lG34JIEVsTljNQ2S]{Holding Cells Antechamber}, characters can clearly hear Funar yelling for help.

While the door to the@UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.krAbLyAdPcc554Z9]{ Holding Cells} is locked, the party can speak to Funar through the wall.

A Conversation with Funar

Funar is thrilled to have help on the way, but wary of strangers. If Lyla is with the party, he will share everything he knows. If she is not with the party, characters can persuade him that they are friends of Lyla with a successful [[/check persuasion 16]] check or by sharing a piece of information about Lyla that only someone who knows her well would know.

Funar can share the following:

  • He was on his way to see his uncle Darius when he was ambushed and woke up here. He isn't sure who ambushed him, but the guards brought him an article showing that Darius was killed and he is being blamed.

  • He was injured during the ambush. It isn't life-threatening, but he could use some medical assistance once the party has left.

  • The guards who come to see him look human, but something about them is off. They speak as if they aren't used to forming the words they are saying.

  • He is the only prisoner in these cells, but there was another prisoner, who appeared to be made of light - they were briefly in the holding cells while being questioned in some language he does not understand, but almost escaped and were moved elsewhere.

  • He believes the controls to the holding cell doors are somewhere in a central chamber and has heard a grinding or scraping sound in that direction just before the guards appeared in the area.

  • Funar believes the prisoner is still in the facility and wants to rescue them before leaving.

Once Funar is freed from the cells and the party is ready to leave, he focuses on keeping up with the group and delays any conversation until after they escape.

Is Funar okay?

Thank you for the inquiry. In truth, I am not in the best possible state, but my injuries are not life threatening. I will be ok. I would welcome medical attention, but it can wait until we are far away from this place.

How he was imprisoned

Some ruffians grabbed me from the street while I was on the way to see my uncle Darius — may his soul return unburdened — about a business matter. I don't recall much of the attack - one moment I was choking on the air around me, and the next I was here, being given food and information by these very peculiar guards.

Darius' death

I know what happened to uncle Darius. One of the guards brought me a copy of that horrible gossip rag Overheard in Ordain, so that I would know that he was dead and know that I was being blamed for it.

The guards

I have tried to befriend the guards to gain information and better treatment, but there is something odd about them. They move in a somewhat stilted manner, and speak as if their tongues aren't quite used to the words they are saying. Occasionally I have heard them use another language - the same language they used when questioning the other prisoner who was here - and then they seem as if the words are more familiar.

Operating the door/How the facility works

When the other prisoner who was here escaped, I was able to get a little information about how things work - there's some sort of central chamber that holds the controls for the door to this area. I'm not sure how it works, but sometimes I hear a grinding or scraping sound in the distance before they come to bring me food - it may be connected.

Another prisoner

For a while, there was another prisoner back here with me - I didn't really get a full glimpse, but when they were around, it was like the whole area was filled with some sort of glowing light. I wonder if it was a power they had, because there was a huge bang not long after their arrival - I heard some of the guards say the word escape, and I'm pretty sure they dragged the prisoner to somewhere else in this place. I want to make sure we take them with us - no one should be left down here to rot.

To release Funar, the party will need to reach the Holding Cell controls, which are located within the facility's Central Chamber.

Reaching The Central Chamber

The metal domes in the facility's @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.BMf5Vme1UwrRNa2J]{Central Chamber} are set into grooves in the floor and can be rotated. The rotation for each groove is controlled from a wheel attached to a wall elsewhere in the facility, as follows:

Location of Dome Controls

  • The Outer Dome: Controls located in the Training Room. It rotates clockwise, with its opening moving between the 12:00, 3:00, 6:00, and 9:00 positions. When the party arrives, the opening is in the 6:00 position, facing south.

  • The Middle Dome: Controls located in the Construction Room. It rotates counter-clockwise and is mostly northern-facing, with its opening moving between the 10:00 and 2:00 positions. When the party arrives, the opening is in the 10:00 position, facing northwest.

  • The Inner Dome: Located in the Blessing Room. It rotates counter-clockwise, and its opening can stop on any position on the clock, always landing on the hour position. When the party arrives, the opening is in the 9:00 position, facing east.

Work in Progress

In future releases, interacting with the switches within Wandren HQ will rotate the central sections of the chamber as noted above, giving the party the direct challenge of lining them up to reach the chamber inside.

Meeting The Prisoner

Once the party enters the central chamber, they immediately encounter a being encased in a cage of light. If they attempt to cross through into the cage of light, or call out to it, it speaks to them:

The creature inside of the cage of light suddenly speaks. Their voice is raspy and strained, and the words are in a language far different than Ember's common tongue.

A Conversation with the Prisoner

Any character who knows [[/language harmos]] can translate the words being spoken as:

Please, help me. I am being held prisoner here.

If they reply using Harmos, the prisoner acknowledges in Harmos before switching to Common:

You speak to me like someone from my homeland! But your companions seem confused. Let me switch to Ember's common tongue.

Characters who do not know [[/language harmos]] but have [[/knowledge celestials]] or succeed on a [[/check history 16]] check can identify it as Harmos, a language primarily used by creatures from the Inner Realm Luxarum.

If no one in the party replies to the prisoner, they switch languages on their own:

I am sorry. I should speak the common tongue. I am just so tired. Please, I need your help to get free of this place. I am being held prisoner here.

The prisoner is happy to share anything they can with the party, but is faltering physically. Their language is increasingly halting as they go. Any character with [[/check medicine passive 15]] can tell that they are in some sort of physical distress, and a [[/check insight 16]] check reveals them to be exhausted and scared.

They can reveal the following before collapsing:

  • Their name is Yllith and they are a Tyraphem from Luxarum known as one of the Architects of Light for their building skills. They have been captured and held here to help build this facility.

  • The being who holds them here is just a disembodied voice, but whoever it is is trying to create a factory to create celestial creatures here on Ember.

  • To release them, the party must press the glowing panels in the central control room at the same time. This will deactivate the prison and raise the door to the holding cells, where a human is being held captive.

After conveying this information, Yllith collapses and can't say much more, moaning about the glowing panels if asked any further questions.

Who they are

I am Yllith, and I am far from my home, Luxarum. There, among my fellow Tyraphem, I am known as an Architect of the Light, one blessed with the ability to create buildings that honor my allies and destroy my enemies. Now I can go nowhere but this prison. Not without your help.

As Yllith finishes their speech, they breathe heavily, and their body slumps ever so slightly.

Luxarum/The Tyraphem

Luxarum is one of what you call the Inner Realms and I call the Three - three realms of the Weave, far away from this small piece of land. The other two, Primordis and Signara, are of little consequence, but Luxarum is a place of holy light and we Tyraphem who dwell there fight for the right to be the keepers of its glory.

Yllith gasps with a rattling sound, body slightly trembling.

Their Captor

I do not know the name or form of the Tyraphem who bound me here - only their voice and their creatures show up here, trying to force me to build something that will turn the mortals of Ember into something new, fit for a holy war.

Yllith's voice rises in volume as they finish their speech, then dissolves into a fit of coughing.

Releasing Them/Funar

Please — yes, get me out of here. Then I will share anything else I can. I begin by sharing this - you must press all four of the glowing panels at the same to turn off this horrible contraption. Then I can regain my strength and be free of this place.

Yllith's voice is growing weaker, and as they finish answering, they collapse and cannot be roused again.

Heart Attunement: Prisoner Released

If the party manages to successfully free the Tyraphem Yllith from captivity, each character advances their [[/attunement emberHeart +1 otherhood2WandrenFreed]] at the conclusion of the event.

A Final Battle

Once the party has successfully opened the prison and holding cells, Hephiss Wandren enters from the vault stairway.

@Embed[Actor.OOO380zs3xZYG9PI readaloud="Hephiss still wears her fine clothes and look of haughty assessment, but there is new urgency to her movement and eagerness in her eyes."]

Hephiss enters the center chamber with fast steps that echo against the floor, still wearing her gala finery.

You got this open! Though if you found your way down here, I suppose I shouldn't be surprised. And say thank you. All that tromping around my party pretending to be spies and ruining the ambiance - it was all worth it. I've been telling Pyix for ages that I'm more than just some landlord of his facility or procurer of power - I can be a giver of life just like he can! And now I'm going to prove it.

Hephiss steps forward, only to be interrupted by the appearance of a creature that has more in common with the one trapped in the cage than anything you've seen on Ember.

@Embed[Actor.u6ntYVVPwHy97AGH]

The image speaks, its voice seeming to come from everywhere and nowhere at once.

You've been telling me what exactly? Oh child, you really do seek to outstep yourself at every turn. I hate when a tool becomes more trouble than it's worth. Eventually, you have to throw it away. Or do you forget what's beneath that gold you wear so proudly?

The image waves its hands, and the gold on Hephiss' gown begins to glow, not unlike the glowing cage that stood in the center of the chamber. She hisses, in what can only be pain and frustration, gritting her teeth as a wave of something you can't identify seems to pass from her clothes into her body.

A reminder that you made your choice long ago. When you agree to work with Pyix, you don't get to decide the terms. Your life is at my command. And I command you to get rid of these intruders - and the prisoner - or you will live just long enough to regret it. And just in case you think about fleeing? The door behind you is now locked. Whatever happens, it's in your hands.

The projection disappears, and Hephiss' gown is once again nothing more than fabric and gold. She turns towards you and whispers, almost under her voice.

Getting rid of these infiltrators? That, at least, we agree on.

Hephiss Tactics

Hephiss is a deadly but strategic fighter who uses her @UUID[Item.CSqtxnhzvz32o9VK]{Beads of Wonder} to attack from range. She will generally use the Beads of Shadow first, giving her extra strikes from the shadows they generate, and use the other beads as the situation calls for them.

She then moves in to strike with her @UUID[Actor.OOO380zs3xZYG9PI.Item.saRkwdXRMfAutf1I]{Dagger} and @UUID[Actor.OOO380zs3xZYG9PI.Item.iuNfPnxvNGEgSW55]{Radiant Dagger}.

Hephiss will also attempt to call for reinforcements from any Aburyx or Kynryth left in the facility with her Call for Backup feature, which she can use when within 5 feet of one of the consoles in the Center Chamber

Celestial Support Tactics

@UUID[Actor.69yCeDhDktOWW5O0]{Aburyx} that support Hephiss will attack the strongest character they can find with their @UUID[Actor.69yCeDhDktOWW5O0.Item.DZy1UHEEyWgMG04M]{Cleaving Light} and summon Skithers to defend Hephiss with @UUID[Actor.69yCeDhDktOWW5O0.Item.2sV9jgOZ9nL7oT2d]{Beckoning}.

@UUID[Actor.yqcFzCs8eJXXNKiR]{Kynryth} that support Hephiss attack without regard for their own safety, expending their @UUID[Actor.yqcFzCs8eJXXNKiR.Item.MFcSuAhMSQo009S5]{Light Within} to quickly reach the party and do more powerful attacks until they are down to 1 portion, at which point they switch to conventional attacks.

Looting Hephiss' Items

Hephiss' Ash Cloak disintegrates when she dies, and the Beads of Wonder are attuned to her and useless when used by anyone else. The party can collect the Radiant Dagger from her body.

Once the battle is over, the prisoner Yllith may either be dead or alive.

[[/outcome captiveFreed]]

[[/outcome captiveDied]]

If alive, they thank the party before vanishing:

With a cough, the once-imprisoned creature slowly raises its arms, as if summoning what is left of its strength.

Thank you. I must recover from my injuries somewhere…else, but I promise - I will repay you.

The projection of Pyix reappears:

With a flicker, the strange creature of light returns.

Why am I not surprised? Hephiss had her uses, but they were just about at an end. Though I am sad to lose my special guest - I was just starting to get a bit of cooperation out of them. It's all about finding the right motivation.

Luckily, you seem just as interesting. If I were there, of course, you'd be interesting bodies, but as it is, I will keep my eye on you. If you make it out of my facility, that is. There are big things in store for Ember, and I don't intend to let you get in our way.

Kynryrth, rise!

With a gesture, the projection vanishes in a burst of light.

Newly Arisen Kynryth

Any @UUID[Actor.VyWFhpROA1S5Icsg]{Kynryth Husks} in the facility who were previously inactive or in stasis immediately activate and begin pursuing the party, using the tactics noted above. It is likely in the party's best interest to escape rather than fight, as the Kynryth will take time to reach them and the exit is close by.

Leaving Wandren HQ

The best route out of Wandren HQ is for the party to leave from the @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.H35C2AzPnmV9gxJM]{Training Room} through the @UUID[JournalEntry.mGWhbkZnbXZZTu3h.JournalEntryPage.YPxglJqSXdjyn8gv]{Storage Room} and out through Lantern Roads. If Funar has been successfully freed from captivity, note the outcome below.

[[/outcome funarRescued]]

The Beacon Brigade still lurks in this area, behaving as noted in @UUID[JournalEntry.pUGB4qMJlbbVU6ls.JournalEntryPage.EH0ilpRL8UoqUQQM#the-beacon-brigade]{The Beacon Brigade}, and the party may choose to use stealth or combat as they flee the area.

Concluding The Event

The party makes its way away from the immediate dangers of the Marlstone Manor underground facility, though there is still much to discuss.

Next Steps

The party should head to Cevher HQ to reunite with the other members of the heist crew in @UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.rpBrjBuGXmlJBAT4]{Aftermath}.
Not All Who Wandren.soverview: The party breaks into House Wandren Headquarters under the distraction of the Marlstone Gala and uncovers disturbing truths about House Wandren which surpass even their preconceived suspicions.
Not All Who Wandren.sexposition: The spiral stairs open into a tiled hallway, whose walls have the distinctive swirl of marlstone. It is the only thing that looks familiar. Below your feet, the floors have a soft glow with no source you can immediately see, and a low whirring hum fills the silence.
Not All Who Wandren.ssummary: We made our way through the secret Wandren lair beneath Marlstone Manor in an attempt to find Funar Cevher, uncovering a factory filled with otherworldly creatures. Hephiss is the least of our problems — while she craved power, it seems that she was only a pawn in some greater power struggle that we don't yet fully understand.

The Marlstone Gala.name: The Marlstone Gala
The Marlstone Gala.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

In this exploration and social event (with the opportunity for combat as needed), the party embarks upon the plan described in @UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.hUIBGXTjsQrrD1e1]{Set in Motion}. They can:

  • Check in with their allies, Juro and Lyla, throughout the gathering (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.jalZUo8LGHwnn7B4#checking-in-with-the-team]{Checking In With The Team})

  • Socialize with the who's who of Ordain, including familiar faces from their past adventures and the host, Hephiss Wandren (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.jalZUo8LGHwnn7B4#mixing-and-mingling-in-marlstone]{Mixing and Mingling in Marlstone})

  • Take Hephiss Wandren's key and keep her from noticing that it is missing while Janix Mance makes a copy (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.jalZUo8LGHwnn7B4#copying-hephiss-keys]{Copying Hephiss' Keys})

  • If desired, secure the ledger that Hephiss Wandren has taken from Juro Wandren and return it to him (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.jalZUo8LGHwnn7B4#juros-ledger]{Juro's Ledger})

  • Find a way into the underground section of the Marlstone Gala (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.jalZUo8LGHwnn7B4#getting-to-funar]{Getting to Funar})

Throughout the event, the Heist Points mechanic (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.jalZUo8LGHwnn7B4#mechanic:-heist-points]{Mechanic: Heist Points}) can be used to give the party a way out of an unanticipated situation and the Suspicion mechanic (@UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.jalZUo8LGHwnn7B4#mechanic:-suspicion-levels]{Mechanic: Suspicion Levels}) tracks how difficult it is for the party to make their way through the manor.

Point of No Return (Chapter 3)

This event serves as a point of no return for certain Chapter 3 main quests. Once the characters complete this event, they can no longer continue or complete the events of @UUID[JournalEntry.emberChainArc200]{Spreading Sickness} and @UUID[JournalEntry.emberCindaricAr2]{Smoldering Cinders}.

Navigating the Event (Vista & Area Map)

This event has both a vista (Marlstone Gala) and area maps (Marlstone Manor Floor 1 and Marlstone Manor Floor 2). It begins with the Marlstone Gala vista active, shortly after the party has arrived at the gala, giving them the opportunity to speak with various gala attendees in the manor's Grand Hall. Once the party leaves the Grand Hall, switch to the Marlstone Manor Floor 1 area map. Depending on the actions of your party, you may switch back to the vista, or to the Marlstone Manor Floor 2 area map as needed.

Work in Progress: Combined Area Map

In the future, Foundry will allow for switching back and forth between levels (like floor 1 and floor 2 in Marlstone Manor) within a single area map in future. In the interim, they will need to be switched manually.

Mechanic: Heist Points

Using Heist Points

If desired, you may give the party an allotment of 3 heist points, which they can use to counter any unexpected difficulties. When party members choose to use one of the heist points, you determine the skill check that is appropriate for what the party wants to do, based on how feasible it is that they could have done this planning. If the party could have conceivably done the set up during the scouting event @UUID[JournalEntry.GEuq75fq1VfNBud1.JournalEntryPage.Hg1HjuxWR7BzzXhY]{Casing the Joint}, this check is made with advantage.

Use the following DCs as a guideline:

  • DC 5: extremely plausible that the party planned ahead for this

  • DC 10: highly plausible

  • DC 15: somewhat plausible

  • DC 20: somewhat implausible

  • DC 25: highly implausible

  • DC 30: extremely implausible

One member of the party is designated to roll the check. If they succeed, the situation is resolved thanks to the team's planning. If they fail, they are subject to the normal consequences of the experience.

Access and Suspicion

Moving Through The Manor

Throughout their time in Marlstone Manor, the party may need to sneak off, whether it is to take the key to Janix Mance, return the key to Hephiss Wandren, locate the secret door to the lair beneath Marlstone Manor, find Juro Wandren's hidden ledger, or simply search for information and loot. Their difficulty in doing this depenes on how much access they have been given to that section of the manor - open, restricted, or forbidden. For more on access levels, see @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.5MKbu1BthiAQEyaf#manor-access]{Manor Access}.

As the party moves through Marlstone Manor, they may trigger suspicion among the staff and guards, gaining suspicion with failed checks or bold actions as noted below.

Suspicion Levels

Each suspicious act moves the party up a level of suspicion, from no suspicion at all to low to medium to high, with the following consequences:

  • No Suspicion: The party can move freely.

  • Low Suspicion: The party is being observed as they move around the manor. The DC of all stealth checks raises by 1.

  • Moderate Suspicion: As above, and all stealth checks are made with disadvantage.

  • High Suspicion: As above, and all charisma checks are made with disadvantage. If suspicion is raised further from this state, characters are surrounded by guards and taken to @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.sFvtPRnNn9VCwROg]{Guest Bedroom 1}, which serves as an informal holding cell. They are then considered contained, and their suspicion level clears.

Use the outcome boxes below to mark the party's current level of suspicion. They begin with no suspicion unless they had to sneaak into the party after Juro Wandren refused to put them on the list [[/eventState otherhood2Insider refused]], in which case they begin with low suspicion (mark the outcome below).

[[/outcome lowAlert]]

[[/outcome moderateAlert]]

[[/outcome highAlert]]

Checking In With The Team

The party may wish to start by speaking with their allies at the party - Lyla Cevher and Juro Wandren. They can also check back in with the two over the course of the night.

Lyla's Reminders

Lyla is hesitant to speak with the party for too long, lest it draw too much attention to them, but is happy to check in with them briefly about the status of the plan. Her replies vary based on how far the party has gotten in the heist plan.

  • From the start of the evening until the party acts to advance the heist, Lyla's concern is about picking the right moment to strike.

    The timing of this is everything — too early or too late and you could call attention to yourselves. I trust you to find the right moment.

  • If the party has secured@UUID[Item.tFVP9iFAgD0zEhtV]{ Hephiss' Keys} but not copied them, she urges them to move quickly before Hephiss notices their absence.

    Quickly, get the keys to Janix Mance in the gardens. Hephiss will notice that her keys are missing sooner than later, and we need to have them copied by then.

  • If the party has the @UUID[Item.oGApwdmiQ9EoVL4G]{Copy of Hephiss' Keys} and has not yet returned the originals to Hephiss, she offers to help return them to Hephiss if needed and warns that they must not get caught.

    You have a copy of the keys? Good. Let me know if you need help to get the originals back to Hephiss, though it seems like you have things well in hand.

  • If the party has not figured out where Funar is located, Lyla is convinced that he is being held underneath Marlstone Manor and suggests they find an entrance to a lower level.

    There have always been rumors about underground passages in Marlstone. My guess is that wherever Funar is being held, it's somewhere beneath us. Maybe there's a set of stairs somewhere that leads down there?

  • Once the party has located the door to the stairs below, Lyla promises to meet them there after excusing herself from the party.

    Perfect. We should be able to head down there soon. I need to make sure no one notices me sneaking away, but I will meet you there.

Juro's Concerns

Juro is focused on whether the party will help him get the ledger he needs from Hephiss' safe, but can share the following:

  • The ledger is likely in one of the restricted rooms on the floor. He's seen ropes blocking off nearby rooms in the @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.mLzBFHXratqh3i0p]{Gallery}, @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.NgXe2ukpymWe1ngw]{Sitting Room}, and @UUID[JournalEntry.BCFHYDhO5nm7BhDU.JournalEntryPage.ml2ipSVYqgNRvuXP]{Grand Hall Lounge}.

  • He has been sending Hephiss artifacts from the Arctus Plateau at her requesst - often things that have been described as holy or touched by Lantyr - which he believes she may be experimenting on somewhere in the manor. A discussion of artifacts or ruins is also likely to distract her.

  • If the party is caught snooping, Hephiss won't want to make a scene - she'll probably have them stashed somewhere upstairs until the gala is over.

  • If the party doesn't bring Juro the ledger, he may sneak off and attempt to find it himself. Characters can dissuade him from this course of action with a successful [[/check persuasion 18]] or [[/check intimidation 18]] check.

Mixing & Mingling in Marlstone

The Gala is also attended by a distinguished list of notable guests, some of whom the party or Lyla may know and can chat with briefly.

Facilitating Conversations at the Marlstone Gala

While the party is at the Marlstone Gala, they may wish to speak with some of the NPCs they have encountered in their adventures thus far. Those listed below are in attendance at the party - for each, there is a link to their actor for general information/a reminder of who they are, as well as a quote to start conversation and topics they might be willing to discuss.

While all characters below are on the area map, this is a good opportunity to use the @UUID[Scene.emberMarlstoGala]{Marlstone Gala Vista}, as most have portraits that can be placed in the scene and used during conversation.

@UUID[Actor.IsfSfKd2S9mIJsyw]{Agraband Swift}

As much as I love traveling with the caravan, seeing the places and faces that will become stories around the campfire, like yours, there is something special about an event like this, in the place I still think of as home. And one that is, these days, much safer than being out on the road.

Agraband Swift is quick to speak about the dangers faced by the caravans due to the bandits on the Arctus Plateau, and to recount tales of parties he's been to in far-flung lands.

@UUID[Actor.VBHt7Uwke7GZ1OV3]{Amalthea Stonecraft}

I absolutely love a good reason to celebrate, don’t you? Life needs its moments of jollification, especially these days. So tell me, what brings you to the gala? As I look around at all these fancy costumes and pretty faces, I’m reminded of a story I used to tell…

Amalthea loves to tell stories about life on the Arctus Plateau, each of which seems more impossible than the last.

@UUID[Actor.FYprIclhoDOI8FI4]{Arcos Sarinland}

Well, this is a treat! I'm normally tucked away in my office, and I would never have been invited to this sort of thing before I became Guildmaster.

Arcos is happy to talk about the adventuring life and the Anachraenum, a famed society of adventurers holding an Expedition Challenge for promising new recruits.
