In exchange for their assistance, Fernis offers the party access to her former stronghold called the Concourse Hideout. This reward does not come freely, however. The Concourse has recently become overrun by the "Toothbreakers", a violent criminal organization that now controls that waterfront district.

In "The Expedition Challenge", the party learns of Fernis' suspicions, aids the famous adventurer by reclaiming the Concourse Hideout, and enters the Expedition Challenge to compete alongside rival teams of Anachraenum aspirants. Should the party prevail and prove victorious in that challenge they will forge their names in history alongside the Anachraenum's most famous members.

Lightning Strikes Twice.name: Lightning Strikes Twice
Lightning Strikes Twice.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

The party has a chance encounter in Ordain with the @UUID[Actor.emberFulgrBlades]{Fulgurite Blades}. This event can happen if the party enountered the Fulguraite Blades already in the@UUID[JournalEntry.emberOverTheMoon]{Over The Moon} questline, or not, and this might be the first meeting the party has with the Blades.

This is a social event with conditional dialog, questions, and responses, likely based on what happened in the Over the Moon quest.

In this event, the characters can:

  • Learn about the upcoming Expedition Challenge and the Fulgurite's intentions to win it.

  • Choose to be friendly or antagonistic to the Blades, further cementing them as allies or rivals.

Scene

@UUID[Scene.emberVistaOrdStr]{Vista: Ordain Streets}

Blades of Lightning

If the party has not met the Fulgurite Blades, or completed the quest @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOverTheMoon]{Over The Moon} then this event will serve as an introduction to the adventuring party from the Anachraenum. If they have met the Blades, then skip this section and continue on with Fulgurite Again below. Once the Blades have been introduced, scroll down to Future Rivals, to continue the event.

As you approach, several sets of eyes turn your way, and a massive Cor'ak who up to this moment looked bored out of his mind, turns his head and regards you with some interest.

Hey, stop, what do you want then?

A nearby Kivahr woman looks up from the floating book in her hand, her eyes moving from you to the Cor'ak. A second later, her eyes fall back to her notebook to scribble something, and she calls out:

Sajor!

At this point, you notice the tall Nir'ae woman who is standing to one side, already considering you. Nearby, a fidgety Thornling does the same, though his hands seem to be twitching towards a dagger at his waist. Eventually, the woman who must be Sajor comes to stand with the Rorhim and says:

Was there something you wanted?

@Embed[Actor.pgpa26YQys5VDwNu]

@Embed[Actor.dYGD1p1ui2gE9d28]

@Embed[Actor.kHu4Tvu4hKIEAbKj]

@Embed[Actor.nHiypQMDLV9IvTyR]

Sajor and the Fulgurite Blades adventuring group are generally standoffish and a touch wary of strangers walking up to them, but the party can gather some information about them if they approach them in the right way.

General Information

Anyone speaking with the blades can learn the following information without trying to become friendly or impress the group to share information.

  • The Fulgurite Blades are a trainee adventuring party working for the Anachraenum. They are an established team, having been together for several years at this point, although some have been in the guild longer. During this time together, they have become a tight-knit and loyal group.

  • Leeph is the most recent member, having joined only a few months ago.

Characters who succeed on a [[/skill persuasion 16]] [[/skillCheck diplomacy 16]] when attempting to learn information, will be able to learn the following:

  • Sajor is their leader, and she has the near-unflinching loyalty of the other three. Observing the team with a successful [[/skill ins 12]] check, it is clear she has everyone's respect and admiration.

  • The group recently returned from a mission in the Forest of Stone, where they successfully uncovered a major find. Unfortunately, with the Expedition Challenge approaching, they didn't receive the recognition for their efforts that they wanted from the guild.

If the party wants to discuss faith with Kazra, they will learn the following:

Sect of Spectra

Speaking to Kazra, she confirms that she is a member of a rare faction of Spectra's priesthood called the Sect of Arcvold, who believe that the pursuit of magic leads to spiritual enlightenment.

  • As a member of a rare sect, her background is somewhat mysterious, and little is known about her upbringing, and she does not share much with anyone. Sajor, on the other hand, seems to know the full details and was eager for Kazra to join the Fulgerites after discovering the truth.

  • Anyone with [[/knowledge aedir]] can make a [[/skill history 16]] [[/skillCheck diplomacy 16]] and remember that the Sect of Arcvold predates current knowledge and was once a major faction within the Aedir Empire's religious groups. Their name appears sporadically in lost texts, and it is said they have lost temples and mysterious sites hidden across the world. They are also associated with darker practices, with rumors suggesting they engage in unpleasant rituals like self-inflicted pain to enhance mental focus.

Characters that are followers or clerics of Spectra will find that Kazra is more friendly with them, but still remains staunchly loyal to her team.

If the topic of the team wanting help or offering jobs comes up, the following information can be gathered from the Fulgurite Blades:

Is the Team Hiring?

If the players ask to join the Fulgurite Blades, they appear uninterested at the prospect, and Sajor flatly refuses the proposal, shaking her head firmly:

No, we aren't taking new members into the Blades.

Fulgurite Again

@Embed[Actor.pgpa26YQys5VDwNu]

Sajor waves towards you with a smug expression:

Well, look who it is!

Leeph offers an excited salutation.

Hi! You're looking no more worse for wear after the temple. That's good.

Sajor remarks:

Yes, well, there wasn't much danger left. They were always going to be fine.

To this Rorhim grunts, and adds:

Ought to give them something for their help, Sajor.

Sajor scoffs, giving a dismissive wave.

They got their credit in the discovery filing.

The normally quiet Kazra speaks up from the back of the group, drawing a few eyes from her cohorts.

Not what he means, Sajor, and he's right. We did make quite a bit of coin and they played a part in helping us achieve that."

At this, there's a nod from Rorhim. A moment later several sets of expectant eyes settle on Sajor, who sighs a touch dramatically.

Fine…

She pulls a coin purse off her belt and tosses it toward you.

Now, was there anything else?

Sajor throws a coin purse with [[/award party 50gp]] in it to the nearest party member.

Reading the Blades

Insight allows a party member to get a read on any of the blades, gleaning some idea of what they are thinking or feeling. Passive skill checks are listed, but this information can also be gleaned with successful [[/skill ins 13]] checks.

  • Sajor: A [[/skill ins 13 passive format=long]] reveals that she doesn't seem to regret their actions, not immediately at least, it's only as her team expresses misgivings that she'll start to second guess her leadership. She is, ultimately, not a bad person. She just prioritizes her team over everyone else.

  • Rorhim: A [[/skill ins 10 passive format=long]] reveals that the veteran fighter doesn't feel any particular remorse for how things went, but does believe that the party deserves proper compensation for putting their necks on the line, and believes fair is fair. He doesn't believe it's smart to make new enemies if it can be avoided.

  • Leeph: A keen-eyed [[/skill ins 15 passive format=long]] reveals that the chatty little rogue is ultimately ambivalent toward the party and Sajor's actions. They want what's best for them, and the group, and follow Sajor's lead with ease. Their loyalty to Sajor is almost unshakeable, and as such, they go with her plans without even thinking.

  • Kazra: A [[/skill ins 11 passive format=long]] belies the priestess' belief that things should be done to a standard — people paid, credit given, and good relations maintained. She isn't about to start a fight with Sajor about it, but she clearly thinks that it's her job to bring these standards to the fore, and record the outcome.

Future Rivals

Whether the party is meeting the Fulgeruite Blades for the first time or reconnecting after the events of @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOverTheMoon]{Over The Moon}, the group is clearly participating in the upcoming Expedition Challenge. If the party asks the Blades about their intentions to join the challenge, or wants more information on it, read them the following:

Sajor looks carefully at you and then narrows her eyes.

I see, well, you will need to tread carefully. I can see that you have grown since the last time we met, but I assure you, we will win this year's challenge.

If the party continues on this topic of questioning, they can glean the following opinions from the Fulgurite Blades:

About the Expedition Challenge

The Blades are trainee members of the Anachraenum and have been for a few years, except for Leeph, who joined recently and is not currently a trainee member. They generally see the guild of explorers and treasure hunters as a positive thing, but often find themselves frustrated with the guild's slow and almost bureaucratic nature, and feel they have been slightly overlooked lately.

  • It's clear that the Blades have already signed up for Expedition Challenge and are waiting in Ordain for the event to begin. With a successful [[/skill ins 18]] check, all four of the Blades want nothing more than to win the challenge and will likely do anything within their power to achieve that goal, even if it means opposing or fighting other teams.

  • The Expedition Challenge is the second event run by the Anachraenum. The first was held five years ago and was won by an adventurer named Fernis Ossa, along with her team, the Skywarders. Participating in the event grants full membership into the Anachraenum guild immediately, along with a pouch full of gold and the chance to borrow one of the guild's artifacts from the archives. You can compete alone or in teams, but you have a better chance of winning the challenge if you have a strong group.

  • Sajor isn't entirely sure when the challenge will occur, but she knows it could happen at any moment. She is waiting impatiently with the rest of the Blades for news from All-Fable Keep.

If the party is friendly with the Fulgurite Blades during this conversation and in previous interactions, then the group will be less likely to attack them or be aggressive during the upcoming Expedition Challenge.

Cora Attunement: Friends with the Blades

If the party befriends the Fulgurite Blades, each character advances their [[/attunement emberCora +1 anachraenum1FulguritesFriends]] at the conclusion of the event.

[[/outcome friends]]

However, if the party is not friendly to the Blades during this conversation and in previous interactions, then the group will be more likely to attack them and be aggressive during the upcoming Expedition Challenge.

Aura Attunement: New Rivals

If the party makes enemies of the Fulgurite Blades, each character advances their [[/attunement emberAura +1 anachraenum1FulguritesRivals]] at the conclusion of the event.

[[/outcome rivals]]

Once the party is finished with their questioning, the Blades will continue to talk amongst themselves, making a deliberate effort to ignore the party.

Concluding the Event

Next Steps

This event serves as a breadcrumb and an introduction to the upcoming Expedition Challenge. There are no immediate follow-up steps, but the party has now learned that the Expedition Challenge is taking place in Ordain and that most likely, the Fulgurite Baldes will be a mjoar rival group.
Lightning Strikes Twice.soverview: The Expedition Challenge is a major event that attracts many young, hopeful adventuring teams, promising them the opportunity to become full members of the Anachraenum and be richly rewarded with gold and magical items. As such, the Fulgurite Blades have signed up and are waiting in Ordain for the challenge to begin. If the party has not yet encountered the Fulgurite Blades, this will be their first meeting, and they will likely start on the wrong foot, as Sajor will quickly surmise that the party may join and become their competition. Or if the party has already met the Blades already in Over the Moon, the friendly or antagonistic relationship will continue to unfold.
Lightning Strikes Twice.sexposition: The bustling city of Ordain unfolds before you, with numerous figures navigating its busy streets on their way to essential tasks. Some are walking leisurely, while others sit at outdoor tables outside many cafes and restaurants. Amidst the crowd, you spot four figures sitting on the edge of a large fountain; they are undoubtedly members of the Anachraenum, relaxing by the water and seemingly enjoying themselves.
Lightning Strikes Twice.ssummary: We met the Fulgurite Blades in Ordain. They were relaxing in preparation for the upcoming Expedition Challenge held by the Anachraenum and have already signed up, eager to win.

An Auspicious Acquaintance.name: An Auspicious Acquaintance
An Auspicious Acquaintance.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

In this social event, the party is approached by @UUID[Actor.A2SrOhUvUVuV7os0]{Fernis Ossa} who wishes to talk. Fernis is a compatriot of @UUID[Actor.IsfSfKd2S9mIJsyw]{Agraband Swift} and has been watching for the party's arrival in Ordain. In this event, the party can:

  • Get introduce to Fernis and learn some of her and Agraband's shared history.

  • Become informed of Fernis' concerns about the current stewardship of the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrganizatio.JournalEntryPage.lRAxRZ4doNSLC6zw]{Anachraenum}.

  • Consider Fernis' proposition to work together to investigate the truth underlying recent troubling events.

  • Accept a mission to reclaim the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberToothbrkWlk]{Toothbreaker Hideout} from its current occupants, a gang of lawless ruffians called the "Toothbreakers".

Essential Main Quest

This event is the beginning of an important main quest arc. If the party avoids conversation with Fernis in this event, it will be essential for Fernis to approach the party elsewhere or under different circumstances to engage them with her proposition.

Approached by a Stranger

The Approaching Figure

The party will likely wish to assess whether the approaching Ashka may be a threat.

Characters with [[/skill perception 13 passive format=long]] or who succeed on a [[/skill perception 12]][[/skillCheck awareness 12 passive]] check notice a metallic clasp on the figure's tunic which features a distinctive symbol, an ornamented compass with curved decorative blades forming an s-shape behind its cardinal points. A small jewel is set into the center of the compass rose whch glimmers in the light.

  • Characters with [[/knowledge artifacts]], [[/culture emberOrdani]], or who succeed on a [[/skill history 16]][[/skillCheck society 16 passive]] check recognize this symbol as the badge of the Anachraenum, an organization of scholastic lore seekers and treasure-hunting adventurers whose base of operations is here in Ordain.

  • Characters with [[/knowledge arts]], [[/knowledge ancients]], or [[/path emberCosmopolitanFashionista]] recognize the Ashka's attire to be distinctively fashioned in a peculiar style consistent with the ancient Seydiri culture. The clothing appears relatively new, however, and intentionally designed for functional versatility.

It is difficult to assess from the character's expression alone what their intentions are, but characters with [[/skill insight 16 passive format=long]] or who succeed on a [[/skill insight 14]][[/skillCheck deception 14 passive]] check do not sense any duplicity in the figure's approach or demeanor.

If the party is uneasy and tries to avoid conversation with Fernis, she calls after them frantically:

Wait, please! I'm a friend of Agraband Swift and I've been looking for you. We must speak!

If Fernis is allowed to approach, provide her description in greater detail:

@Embed[Actor.A2SrOhUvUVuV7os0 inline]

She introduces herself to the party, saying:

Tide's blessing, and thank you for stopping. I apologize for accosting you unexpectedly , but this was the simplest way to make contact with you. My name is Fernis Ossa, a friend of Agraband Swift, and I've been looking for you. Please — can we step into a cafe or tea room nearby where we might speak in less public surroundings?

Fernis surveys the area for possible options and points at the hanging sign for a tea room a short distance down a side street.

On Your Guard

Characters who are still suspicious of Fernis' intentions may undertake a [[/skill insight 14]][[/skillCheck deception 14 passive]] check to discern that there does not appear to be any suspicious behavior associated with this request and Fernis' suggestion to speak away from the bustle of surrounding crowd seems entirely reasonable.

Characters with [[/knowledge intrigue]], [[/knowledge crime]], or [[/path emberNightwatch]] may consider the value of a test to verify Fernis' claims of association with Agraband Swift. Whatever test the party proposes, Fernis is able to answer truthfully and accurately within reasonable constraints on her knowledge of events.

Who are you?

My name is Fernis Ossa, I am a member of the Anachraenum — an organization of scholars and adventurers here in Ordain — and a friend of Agraband's who informed me of your story and urged me to keep an eye out for your arrival.

About Agraband?

Agraband is my old mentor. We worked together years ago as part of a group — not so unlike your own — which initially formed out of necessity but became defined by objectives far more powerful than mere convenience.

How did you find us?

Agraband told me to look out for your arrival so I called in a favor with a friend in the Veiled Chain who has a close eye on noteworthy arrivals in the city. It's not my doing, but you've actually been watched since arriving in the city. The Veiled Chain is unannily good at what it does.

Evidence of your claims?

I understand this seems a little suspicious, and I don't blame you at all for being cautious. Perhaps if it helps I can confide what Agraband told me about you. From my memory, he said something like…

"Fernis, I had this feeling that began the night we camped beneath the Shard of Akon that this group was going to be something special and they just didn't know it yet. Call it storyteller's intuition, or perhaps nostalgia in the way they reminded me of past glories, but it was something I could recognize. Then they proved themselves heroic in the defense of Helkas and it reinforced my belief that they can change this world in small ways or possibly in big ones."

Beyond these initial questions, Fernis is unwilling to discuss her agenda in a public environment and insists on moving to more discreet surroundings to converse further.

Scene Transition

Once the party is ready to accompany Fernis to the tea room for conversation, mark the following outcome as complete which will automatically transition the view to a different interior scene.

[[/outcome accompanied]]

Early Access Work in Progress

The interior teahouse scene for this event is not yet available and must instead be imagined for now.

A Proposition Over Tea

Fernis accompanies you into a modest but comfortable tea room where you are seated, at Fernis' request, into a discreet cubby near the back wall of the establishment, removed from the din and potential prying eyes or ears of passers-by on the streets outside. She orders refreshment for the table with the attendant and turns to you with a friendly, but businesslike expression.

Thank you for agreeing to speak with me. As much as I would like to ease into things and get to know more about each of you, I think it's best if I get straight to business. The Anachraenum is in some trouble. Trouble which very likely extends beyond the walls of All Fable Keep to the city of Ordain itself. The signs are clear, but the cause is not.

Agraband says that I can trust you and that you are capable — a combination that is rather unique to your group at the moment — leaving me with few options. I need your help to discover and expose treachery within the Anachraenum. To do that you're first going to have to join the guild.

You help me, and I vow to help you in return. I will get you access to knowledge and resources that only the Anachraenum can offer. Additionally, I can provide you with a base of operations here in Ordain — a location that is secret, well positioned, and defensible. Everything you would need if you're going to make an impact in the city.

The party will almost certainly have questions for Fernis about her past or her motives in making this request.

Gathering Information

In addition to the responses presented earlier in the event, in this more secluded location Fernis will share more about her proposition.

Fernis is willing to share any information described in her biography, if asked, but will only volunteer information if she deems it to be directly relevant to the party's questions. The following questions and answers are a subset of what Fernis would be willing to reveal, but most importantly she clarifies that:

  • The prior guildmaster of the Anachraenum, Veron Longspear, was suspiciously killed last year. Since then the operations of the guild have changed.

  • The Expedition Challenge is the culmination of a recent recruitment drive that is prioritizing quantity of Anachraenum members over quality of research.

  • The Concourse Hideout was a valuable base of operations in the city and Fernis regrets letting it fall into the Toothbreaker's hands.

Fernis' Flawed Perspective

Fernis, at this point, has an incomplete perspective on events. She is still mourning the recent loss of Veron Longspear, and she still carries internal regret about the disollution of the Skywarders. Fernis has become unfairly fixated on Arcos Sarinland, the new guildmaster, whom she believes is responsible for a deterioration of Anachraenum values and potentially behind Veron's betrayal.

It is important while roleplaying as Fernis to present this information as things that Fernis believes, rather than as absolute statements of truth. While Arcos may be responsible for some changes in the guild, in truth, he is out of his depth with a leadership position that he is not well suited to hold. Fernis has an incomplete perspective and a flawed outlook in this regard, although her suspicions are important motivation for advancing the plot this quest.

What trouble?

Our former guildmaster Veron Longspear was an exceptional leader and our guild's reputation flourished under his oversight. He was killed last year in the Ruinous Crags while attending to a secret mission that only a handful of people knew about. It's clear to me — at least — that he was betrayed, even if nobody else is willing to consider that theory.

Since then, and under the leadership of our new guildmaster Arcos Sarinland, we've begun taking on contracts for coin rather than for knowledge. We've also been prioritizing recruitment regardless of the new members' competency. The guild has ignored the big questions surrounding the previous guildmaster's death and instead fills the galleries of Ordain's most wealthy patrons with whatever collectors' baubles they fancy us to procure.

You might think it's just bad leadership, but I think there's something deeper going on here.

How to investigate?

In short, I want you to join the Anachraenum so you can be an extra pair of eyes and ears inside the organization.

Before you object, it's not as crazy as it sounds … at least not anymore. It used to be that to fully join our ranks you needed to put in years of hard work and research to establish a track record of noteworthy findings. These days, though, it seems like anyone who is willing to crack open a sealed tomb is offered a badge.

Perhaps you've heard rumor about the upcoming "Expedition Challenge"? Arcos has pulled out an old tradition and repurposed it into a glorified recruitment event. This challenge is a maneuver for publicity and acquiring new recruits.

Why Arcos wants so many new associates in the guild is a big question, but it leaves the door open for you despite your lack of … qualifications.

Why join the Anachraenum?

If you were new Anachraenum members, then Arcos will send you on missions for the guild. This means you'll be able to figure out what he's up to and work with me from the inside to untangle what happened to Veron.

The Expedition Challenge?

It will be commencing in a few days, but there's still time for last-minute signups. I will put in a referral so that Adelyne won't give you any trouble, being relative unknowns as you are. You'll need to visit All-Fable Keep and declare yourselves.

The challenge is an old tradition, a gauntlet and treasure hunt invented to test aspiring members and identify the brightest and most capable groups.

You won't need to actually win the challenge, of course, you only need to finish. My advice would be to take your time and be safe, there are protections in place for challenge participants but you can still come to harm if you're reckless.

A base of operations?

It's called "The Concourse Hideout" and it used to be ours — the secret base of my old group the Skywarders. All-Fable Keep can be a bit stuffy sometimes, and let's just say that not every mission we undertook was purely for official Anachraenum business.

The Skywarders disbanded years ago though, each of us scattered towards different corners of Aterica, and so we left the Concourse Hideout empty for too long. A local gang called the Toothbreakers, brutal and animalistic thugs, discovered its hidden location and took it over as their headquarters.

The Concourse used to be a quaint riverside district that had a humble charm. Since the Toothbreakers moved in several years ago the district has suffered an exodus of businesses and residents alike. It's little more than a ghost town these days.

The Toothbreakers?

A ruthless gang of thugs who have strangled life out of the Concourse turning it into their own petty kingdom. Their signature as a gang is their relationship with Scalemaws, vicious reptilian monstrosities brought up from the Lowland Kingdoms that thrive in the underground waterworks of the Concourse. They are brutal fighters led by a formidable Waerd named Raster Thorn. They won't be easy to break, but if tales of your exploits are true I think you stand a chance.

The Veiled Chain has been unable to deal with them, even their shrewd investigators can't get to the heart of their operation. Either that or they don't care for some reason I cannot imagine. I know exactly where they operate from, though, and I can tell you how to get in.

About the Toothbreakers

The Toothbreakers would have set up operations within a derelict district of the city called the concourse where they are attempting to exert total control. Characters with [[/knowledge crime]] or who succeed on a [[/skill insight 16]][[/skillCheck society 15 passive]] check suspect they may be formidable, but since they are not actively at war with any other organization they could be taken by surprise by swift action.

Characters with [[/culture emberWaerd]] or [[/knowledge monsters]] are familiar with @UUID[Actor.zCaW2IABpatj2TDs]{Scalemaws} and know some information presented in their biography.

Fernis summarizes the tactical challenges that the party will face in assaulting the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberToothbrkWlk]{Toothbreaker Hideout}. Fernis suggests three possible entrances.

The Front Entrance

If the party wants to talk or fight their way in, Fernis describes the location of the main entrance to the complex, a locked metal gate off the side of a canal path.

In case you prefer a direct route, I will provide you with directions to the main entrance to the complex. It is secure and you should expect it to be well-guarded at all times, but if you want to try and bluff your way in or kick down the front door, that is an option. Also, next to the main entrance there is a canal outlet that leads to an interior dock. You could consider swimming in that way.

The Waterworks

If the party prefers a more subtle approach, Fernis provides intricate instructions for how to navigate the network of canals and tunnels that make up the subterranean waterworks underneath the Concourse. The Toothbreaker Hideout is accessible via these tunnels.

If you want a more subtle approach, you can enter the complex via the canals of the waterworks. This is the path I would recommend … but discretion was my preferred tactic and need not be yours. The canals are difficult to move through and you could be vulnerable here if you don't remain undetected.

Captive Fighters

Fernis reluctantly suggests a third option, that the party allow themselves to be taken prisoner to be used as combatants in an underground fighting ring that Raster hosts.

There is one other approach you might consider, although I'm reluctant to even mention it. The Toothbreakers have a track record of capturing people and forcing them to fight in a bloodsport arena that Raster has set up somewhere within the Concourse. You could, perhaps, allow yourselves to be taken prisoner. This would gain you access to the heart of their hideout, but you would have to figure out a way to free yourselves and recover your weapons. It's a big gamble, and you're likely to wind up as Scalemaw food either way.

The party does not need to decide which approach to take right away, as this will be determined in the subsequent event when they visit the Concourse district.

Concluding the Event

If the party is convinced to accept Fernis' proposal, mark the following outcome as complete and, when ready, conclude this event.

[[/outcome accepted]]

Next Steps

Provided the party has accepted Fernis' proposition, there are two avenues which they can explore.

  1. They can pursue reclaiming the Concourse Hideout by visiting @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.0RX8vLjKjRjf3JSj]{The Concourse} and triggering the @UUID[.6wD1TRkMlMFebSNJ]{Reclaiming the Concourse} event.

  2. They can visit @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.SeNNZfhn77kJqUl0]{All-Fable Keep} and enlist to join the upcoming Expedition Challenge in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberAnachrnArc1.JournalEntryPage.rqC17cSbk4oXioCX]{The Challenge Begins} event.
An Auspicious Acquaintance.soverview: The party is approached in the city of Ordain by Fernis Ossa, a famous member of the Anachraenum and friend of Agraband Swift. Word has reached her of the party's exploits and she has sought them out with an opportunity to help each other. Fernis proposes joining forces to recover access to the Concourse Hideout — a useful base of operations within the city — and to sponsor the party's entry into the Anachraenum's upcoming Expedition Challenge.
An Auspicious Acquaintance.sexposition:
The bustle of the city surrounds you in a constant flow of colorful sights, distinctive smells, and countless people busily attending to their daily affairs. Most of the Ordani citizens pay you no mind as you weave your way through the crowds.

As you round the corner of a small market your eye glimpses a distinctive patch of green color that stands out from the cinnabar palette of the Ordain. It is the scaled hood of an Askha woman who stands head and shoulders above most of the crowd. You are certain this is the third time you have seen this woman as you have wandered the city today, and it's becoming clear that she is following you.

Your eyes momentarily meet and it is clear that her gaze is fixed upon you and your companions. She pushes through the intervening crowd, moving closer towards you. There is a faint smile on her face which softens what would otherwise be a determined expression. Her long strides propel her near enough for her to call out a greeting.

Warm tidings, friends! Please, I ask that you favor me with a moment of your time. I have been looking for you.
An Auspicious Acquaintance.ssummary: We met Fernis Ossa, a famous adventurer from the Anachraenum and a friend of Agraband Swift on the streets of the city. She is eager to enlist our help with a mission that clearly extends beyond her old home base and has given us the location in the Waterworks district that we should head to next. She is also willing to sponsor us in the Expedition Challenge being hosted soon by the Anachraenum.

Reclaiming the Concourse.name: Reclaiming the Concourse
Reclaiming the Concourse.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

This combat event takes place within the Concourse Hideout, an underground complex in the waterworks beneath the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.0RX8vLjKjRjf3JSj]{Concourse} district in Ordain. The party's goal in this event is to break the control of the Toothbreakers over the Concourse district and uproot them from their home in the Concourse Hideout such that the stronghold can be reclaimed for @UUID[Actor.A2SrOhUvUVuV7os0]{Fernis} and the party's own use in the years to come.

To accomplish this task, the party will need to eliminate Raster Thorn who rules over the Concourse as a king and leader of the Toothbreakers. In this event, the characters can:

  • Encounter members of the @UUID[Actor.n3MAXRLTxENVeDWB]{Toothbreaker Gang} along with their @UUID[Actor.zCaW2IABpatj2TDs]{Scalemaw} companions, who inhabit and defend the area.

  • Navigate the challenging terrain of the subteranean @UUID[JournalEntry.emberToothbrkWlk.JournalEntryPage.qwl1wP5cuWdhiNP8]{Toothbreaker Hideout}.

  • Confront the vicious gang leader @UUID[Actor.WgXxUcogizL8D5Rh]{Raster Thorn}, whose control over the Toothbreakers is absolute.

Challenge Level

This event is balanced for a level 5 party. A group of level 4 heroes can be successful but will need to employ careful strategy. If the party is not yet level four, it would be advised for them to seek other challenges and revisit this event later.

Area Walkthrough

The initial exposition of this event takes place on the region map until the party chooses their preferred approach to the hideout. Once that choice has been made, gameplay transitions to the "Toothbreaker Hideout" Scene where the central gameplay of this event transpires.

Once inside the hideout, a complete room-by-room description of its environment and the gameplay that occurs there is detailed in the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberToothbrkWlk]{Toothbreaker Hideout} area walkthrough. This area has several special rules and gameplay expectations, so it is advisable to review the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberToothbrkWlk.JournalEntryPage.qwl1wP5cuWdhiNP8]{Gameplay Details} page either before or during the party's exploration of the location.

Choosing an Approach

The event begins with the party choosing their preferred approach to the Toothbreaker Hideout.

Recalling Fernis' Guidance

You may wish to re-summarize for the party the information provided by Fernis Ossa during the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberAnachrnArc1.JournalEntryPage.vkXY7W6Z7z1p6clq]{An Auspicious Acquaintance} event regarding the Toothbreakers and the three possible approaches to their hideout.

Frontal Assault

The Front Entrance

The party knows how to reach the front entrance of the complex, and the directions Fernis provided are not difficult to follow. Fernis cautioned that this front entrance is secure and well-guarded at all times. Trying to enter the hideout in this way will require either guile or a direct attack.

  • Characters with [[/knowledge warfare]] recognize the tactical disadvantages that a frontal assault would face. Narrow corridors, chokepoints, and unfamiliar terrain would all pose disadvantages to an attacking force, not to mention that the party will be outnumbered.

  • Characters with [[/knowledge intrigue]] or [[/knowledge crime]] suspect that it could be possible to talk your way in, if you can fabricate a business proposition that is sufficiently compelling to deserve the Toothbreaker's attention.

If the party pursues this approach, mark the following outcome to trigger a Scene transition after which the party begins exploration of the Toothbreaker Hideout on the exterior @UUID[JournalEntry.emberToothbrkWlk.JournalEntryPage.JSSZTlpCE1Jqsruw]{Canal Path}.

[[/outcome front]]

Ragen Attunement: Frontal Assault

Each character who infiltrates the Concourse via a direct frontal assault advances their [[/attunement emberRagen +1 anachraenum1ConcourseFrontal]] at the conclusion of the event.

Canal Infiltration

Traversing the Waterworks

Fernis also provided instructions on how to reach the hideout via the subterranean waterworks — a labyrinthine network of canals and tunnels. The directions are complex, requiring concentration and good memory to navigate the area.

Attempting to navigate the waterworks consumes one hour of time. The group must undertake a group [[/skill survival 16]][[/skillCheck pathfinding 16 group]] check. If unsuccesful, the party loses their bearings and are forced to retreat to the surface, they may re-attempt the challenge at the cost of another hour of time.

  • Characters with [[/knowledge subterranea]] make their individual checks with advantage.

  • Use of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplAugury0000]{Augury} enables the spell's caster to automatically succeed on their own check.

  • Use of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFindthePat]{Find the Path} automatically succeeds for the entire group challenge.

If the party fails this group challenge 3 times in a row, they suffer one level of &Reference[exhaustion].

  • Characters with [[/knowledge subterranea]] make their individual checks with advantage.

If the party fails this group check 3 times in a row, all members of the party gain the @Condition[exhausted] condition.

If the party pursues this approach, mark the following outcome to trigger a Scene transition after which the party begins exploration of the Toothbreaker Hideout in the northern @UUID[JournalEntry.emberToothbrkWlk.JournalEntryPage.srnlviYxNr0FAcHl]{Canals}.

[[/outcome canals]]

Primordis Attunement: Canal Infiltration

Each character who infiltrates the Concourse via the canal advances their [[/attunement emberPrimordis +1 anachraenum1ConcourseCanal]] at the conclusion of the event.

Taken Captive

Seeking Captivity

Fernis acknowledged a third path for breaching the hideout, which is to become prisoners of the Toothbreakers to be used as fighters in their underground arena. To succeed at this gambit the party must perform the following steps, in order.

  1. A member of the party must succeed on a [[/skill investigation 16]][[/skillCheck awareness 16]] check to locate members of the Toothbreakers somewhere in the Concourse district. Each attempt at this check consumes one hour of time. A character with [[/knowledge crime]] gains advantage+2 Boons on this check.

  2. A member of the party must manipulate the Toothbreakers into aggression using one of the following methods:

    • Succeed on an [[/skill intimidation 15]][[/skillCheck intimidation 15]] check to provoke the Toothbreakers to viewing the party as antagonists. Characters with [[/culture emberWaerd]] or [[/culture emberTayan]] gain advantage on this check.

    • Succeed on a [[/skill deception 15]][[/skillCheck deception 15]] check to masquerade as helpless travelers. Characters with [[/path emberCaravanner]] or [[/path emberSkyWanderer]] have advantage on this check.

    If this check is failed, the Toothbreakers are uninterested in the party who must seek out a different group of thugs to provoke by repeating Step 1.

  3. Each member of the party must succeed on a [[/skill performance 14]][[/skillCheck performance 14]] check to convincingly lose the resulting scuffle and be taken as a prisoner. Characters with [[/culture emberKithil]] or [[/culture emberBejak]] have advantage on this check. Each member of the group who fails this check suffers [[/damage 2d8 bludgeoning]] damagedamage from the [[/hazard 8 physical bludgeoning]]{Toothbreaker Blows} during the process of being subdued.

If the party pursues this approach, mark the following outcome to trigger a Scene transition after which the party begins exploration of the Toothbreaker Hideout as captives in the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberToothbrkWlk.JournalEntryPage.OC1tIVg2iiqHZGFg]{Prison}.

[[/outcome captives]]

Mayis Attunement: Taken Captive

Any character who successfully infiltrates the Concourse by being taken captive advances their [[/attunement emberMayis +1 anachraenum1ConcourseCaptive]] at the conclusion of the event.

Concluding the Event

Regardless of which approach the party pursues, their eventual objective within the Toothbreaker Hideout is to eliminate Raster Thorn, the leader of the gang. Continue the party's exploration of the hideout until that goal is accomplished or until the party withdraws in retreat.

[[/outcome eliminated]]

Luxarum Attunement: Raster Thorn Killed

If Raster Thorn is slain in combat, each character advances their [[/attunement emberLuxarum +1 anachraenum1ConcourseRasterKilled]] at the conclusion of the event.

Akon Attunement: Raster Thorn Spared

If the party chooses to spare Raster Thorn, each character advances their [[/attunement emberAkon +1 anachraenum1ConcourseRasterSpared]] at the conclusion of the event.

  • If the party is successful in eliminating Raster, mark the above outcome as complete and then conclude the event as successful.

  • If the party retreats without eliminating Raster, do not mark this outcome as complete and abandon the event as incomplete, which will allow it to be attempted again in the future.

Milestone Progression

Completing this event (by eliminating Raster Thorn) awards a @UUID[JournalEntry.emberPlayerGuide.JournalEntryPage.jK1PXextPwuJuSnr]{Milestone} point, potentially enabling the party to advance in level.

Next Steps

If the party has not yet visited @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.SeNNZfhn77kJqUl0]{All-Fable Keep} to register for the Anachraenum "Expedition Challenge", their next steps will be to do so in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberAnachrnArc1.JournalEntryPage.rqC17cSbk4oXioCX]{The Challenge Begins} where they will also reunite with Fernis.

Now that the Concourse Hideout has been reclaimed, the party will be able to begin using and improving upon their stronghold.

Stronghold System

Acquiring the Concourse Hideout is the first step of Stronghold progression. Stronghold gameplay and progression is not yet implemented and will be added in a future update.
Reclaiming the Concourse.soverview: The party arrives in the Concourse district with a clear mission, break the stranglehold that the Toothbreaker gang has upon this district and eliminate their vicious leader, Raster Thorn. The gang is operating out of the Concourse Hideout, a hidden stronghold that was formerly the base of operations for Fernis Ossa's adventuring party, the Skywarders. The party must, using guile or force, infiltrate or attack the Toothbreaker stronghold and find a way to take down Raster Thorn.
Reclaiming the Concourse.sexposition:
The signs of neglect around you are evident and disconcerting. This waterfront district near the heart of Ordain should be vibrant and teeming with city life and color, instead it paints a drab picture of urban decay that subtly signals for passers-by to turn around or seek business elsewhere.

The Toothbreaker hideout is nearby. Fernis Ossa provided you with two sets of directions, one to the front entrance of the underground complex and another that would chart a path through the labyrinthine passageways of the subterranean waterworks.
Reclaiming the Concourse.ssummary: We broke the Toothbreakers' hold on the Concourse by eliminating their leader, Raster Thorn. Without their figurehead, the remaining Toothbreakers can be scattered by the Veiled Chain and their hideout will be cleared for us to claim!

An Upcoming Challenge.name: An Upcoming Challenge
An Upcoming Challenge.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

The party visits the All-Fable Keep in Ordain. This may be before meeting @UUID[Actor.A2SrOhUvUVuV7os0]{Fernis Ossa}, or afterwards, as a way to double-check her credentials.

In this social event, the party can:

  • Meet @UUID[Actor.GA8VFWysoIYfNWCL]{Adelyne Goss}, the Loremistress of the Anachraenum

  • Learn about the guild and its preparation for the upcoming Expedition Challenge.

Meeting Adelyne Goss

As the party enters All-Fable Keep and walks through the Entrance Hall, they can stop behind the Salt Breakers who are speaking with Adelyne Goss, and listen to their conversation, read the party the following:

... As I mentioned earlier, you are welcome to join the Expedition Challenge and participate, however, as we approach the start date, the guild is not accepting any new trainee members at this time. We are too busy with other administrative tasks.. now do you have any other pertinent questions?

As the woman behind the counter finishes in a scathing and flat tone, the hand of the figure in the middle touches upon the hilt of a sharp-looking dagger at their belt, but their fingers quickly still.

No, thank you very much for your time. We will be back for the event itself then… Good day, madam.

With that, the three figures dressed in an assortment of mining equipment walk to one side of the hall and begin speaking to each other in low tones. The woman behind the counter now eyes you and beckons you over with a flick of her wrist.

Yes, yes, what can I do for you then, hmm?

@Embed[Actor.GA8VFWysoIYfNWCL]

Talking with Adelyne Goss

Adelyne Goss is the Loremistress of the Anachraenum and is extremely busy preparing for the upcoming Expedition Challenge. She is usually occupied elsewhere and is temporarily handling the duties of the guild receptionist. She will be brief and curt with the party as they ask questions, as if she wants them to understand quickly so she can leave.

Characters who succeed on a [[/skill persuasion 18]] [[/skillCheck diplomacy 18]] check when speaking with Adelyne can convince her that they are merely trying to learn more about the guild will be able to mollify her tone a little, and she will be slightly more friendly in her responses.

  • This slight change in her demeanor will also apply to anyone with [[/knowledge legends]] or [[/knowledge aedir]] who conveys to Adelyne that they are fellow scholars and historians.

Anyone with [[/culture Waerd]] or who succeeds on a [[/skill history 13]] [[/skillCheck society 13]] check recognizes that Adelyne is Waerd and wears traditional Waerd armor under her more Ordani-looking clothing. Given her injuries, it's clear she is an experienced monster hunter.

  • She mentions to anyone with [[/culture Waerd]] that her injuries are from battling a dragon in the Duskflare Jungles in her youth, which she thankfully managed to survive with scars to show for it.

Regardless of her disposition towards the party, Adelyne can share the following information:

  • Adelyne is the Loremistress of the Anachraenum and typically spends most of her time in the underground Amaranthine Archives. Unfortunately, the party cannot enter the archives at this time as they cannot join the guild officially in the run-up to the Expedition Challenge.

About the Expedition Challenge?

This year's Expedition Challenge is expected to be a grand event. It will test the resolve of various new adventuring parties who have traveled to Ordain, as well as some of our trainees from within the guild. No doubt, it will find some eager and capable new members for the guild's ranks. During the challenge, each party will indirectly compete with one another by completing three smaller events that can be done in any order. All these events are just outside the city, with the goal of obtaining a key from each. Once all three keys are acquired, the party can return to Ordain to undertake the final challenge: the dangerous and mysterious Chamber of Ageseros beneath All-Fable Keep itself.

What is the challenge?

Competing in the challenge requires the party to participate in every event set up by the Anachraenum and retrieve the three preliminary keys from across the Arctus Plateau. Retrieving the keys can take place in any order, but all three keys are required to enter the final challenge in the Chamber of Agaseros!

What is the Chamber of Agaseros?

The Chamber of Agaseros is a testing ground for Anachraenum members. It is uniquely dangerous and was created nearly a hundred years ago by a powerful yet unstable wizard named Agaseros, who was a passionate member of Anachraenum.

Who is competing?

There are multiple teams attempting the challenge this year, many of whom have already signed up. Some of these teams are known to me as existing trainees, while others are newcomers to our organization. For example, the group just behind you.

Can we sign up?

I'm afraid I don't have any remaining sign-up sheets with me at this time. Do you have an Anachraenum members' sponsorship? That would make this process much easier. Otherwise, I'm afraid you will have to come back another day.

The party might use this opportunity to inquire with Adelyne about certain historical topics if they previously discussed scholarly pursuits with her:

About the Aedir?

The most well-known ancient empire, their legacy, and legendary collapse during the Shattering are of course undeniable, but it has been over two and a half thousand years since their fall, and much about their culture remains lost to us. Research and investigations into their daily life, government, belief systems, etc., are all ongoing here at the Anachraenum, and we have a number of dedicated teams around themworld who are focused on the Sunfire Empire. In fact, I believe one of our most esteemed members, Rai Jare, is currently putting together the Starshield Commission to travel to the central continent of the Starshield itself.

About the Sedyri?

My personal area of expertise, the Sedyri, are another ancient culture that has been largely lost to history books. Few even recognize the name, but I have theories that their empire once spanned much of the Arctus Plateau shores and far beyond. I also recently learned that there is a special connection to an island to the south called Kadisos involving the Sedyri. It would be fascinating to one day explore it and discover things for myself, but alas, that would be unlikely given my current responsibilities.

The Salt Breakers

The party can also head over and talk to the other group, who call themselves the Salt Breakers, who are still talking in the Entrance Hall.

Talking with the Salt Breakers

The Salt Breakers are a group that has already signed up for the Challenge but is frustrated with the ongoing wait and the lack of support from Anachraenum. They have traveled from the small salt mining town of Pryor, which is located just off the shore of the distant Salt Flats to the south of Ordain.

If the part decides to approach the small group of three, read the following:

The three mining equipment adventurers stop speaking to one another as you approach, and their leader, a stern and expressionless human, crosses his arms, and his eyes narrow.

The small group consists of three @UUID[Actor.mNKKDsvvNi8f0Pel]{Anachraenum Adventurers} and they will answer questions only briefly. Their responses seem generally hostile or dismissive. They have little if any interest in speaking or revealing much about themselves to the party.

  • Blister Brass (Neutral Evil, Arcturian Human, he/him), a huge human with burly, muscular arms and black hair. His short, messy beard appears to have been shaved into a boxy shape. His clothing is a combination of hard, weathered leather, with mining tools scattered around him and a large, sharp pickaxe resting on his back.

  • White Bark (Chaotic Evil, Arcturian Thornling, they/them), a large Thornling with thorny skin as white as the salt from his hometown. Like the others, he is also wearing various mining tools strapped to his body with tough leather straps and belts, and a large lantern with a glowing firefly rests on one hip.

  • Masie Vanrod (Neutral Evil, Arcturian Signborn + Wirrun, she/her), a mix of Signborn and Wirrun who has white skin and fur with two glowing red limbs common to Signborn ancestries holding onto her hips. Her expression is also unreadable, but she appears poised as if about to spring into combat at any moment, and a long barbed spear is gripped tightly in one hand.

A character who succeeds on a [[/skill insight 14]][[/skillCheck awareness 14]] check infers that the Salt Breakers anticipate the possibility of being rivals in the upcoming expedition challenge. It's possible that if the group were not within the confines of a public space, such as the Entrance Hall to the Anachraenum, a fight would have broken out already.

Concluding the Event

Next Steps

This event introduces the party to the existence of the upcoming Expedition Challenge. The party will be able to eventually gain sponsorship to enter the challenge themselves after meeting @UUID[Actor.A2SrOhUvUVuV7os0]{Fernis Ossa} in the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberAnachrnArc1.JournalEntryPage.vkXY7W6Z7z1p6clq]{An Auspicious Acquaintance} event.
An Upcoming Challenge.soverview: As the party explores Ordain, they may choose to investigate All-Fable Keep, one of the largest and most imposing structures that overlooks the southern part of the city. Upon entering the keep, they will encounter Adelyne Goss in the foyer, who is currently speaking to the Salt Breakers, a young adventurer team signing up for the Expedition Challenge. After listening to the closing comments, the party will be able to speak with Adelyne directly and learn more about the challenge.
An Upcoming Challenge.sexposition: All-Fable Keep lives up to its name. As you enter the front gates and step into the Entrance Hall, the size and scale of the structure wash over you. The thick stone walls are framed with massive, weathered wooden beams that have aged over hundreds of years. The high, vaulted ceilings arch far above, adorned with intricate purple tapestries that display the Anachraenum symbol of a bladed compass. Sitting in front of a desk is an older woman with a frown on her face, speaking with three young-looking adventurers, carrying what appears to be mining equipment backpacks and lanterns hooked onto their backs and waists.
An Upcoming Challenge.ssummary: We visited All-Fable Keep and spoke with the Loremistress of the Anachraenum, Adelyne Goss, who was sitting at the front desk. We learned some key information about the upcoming Expedition Challenge from her.

The Challenge Begins.name: The Challenge Begins
The Challenge Begins.text:
Gamemaster's Summary

In this social event, the party arrives at @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.SeNNZfhn77kJqUl0]{All-Fable Keep} for the opening ceremonies of the second Expedition Challenge. In this event, the characters can:

  • Receive some preliminary instructions from the loremistress @UUID[Actor.GA8VFWysoIYfNWCL]{Adelyne Goss}.

  • Meet the teams of fellow challengers against which the party will be competing, including the potentially familiar @UUID[Actor.emberFulgrBlades]{Fulgurite Blades}.

  • Receive an important protective item, the @UUID[Item.jggar2bndAvZthdS]{Frozen Tear}, from the star mage @UUID[Actor.XrFDJNn1Fa7hopqR]{Eveis Brightstone}.

  • Speak briefly with @UUID[Actor.A2SrOhUvUVuV7os0]{Fernis Ossa} and receive some advice from your sponsor.

  • Listen to the opening address presented by the guildmaster @UUID[Actor.FYprIclhoDOI8FI4]{Arcos Sarinland} and receive an initial set of clues with which to begin the challenge.

  • Consider the clues provided to the locations of the first three Challenge Keys.

Early Access Work in Progress

This event will eventually be presented in a Vista scene that depicts the interior of All-Fable Keep. That Vista is not yet available at this stage of Alpha.

Arrival in the Hall

As the party enters the hall, they are stopped and given brief instructions by Adelyne Goss, the loremistress of the Anachraenum. They have only a few moments to talk to her before she guides them further into the hall to wait for the start of the event.

Before you can move forward any further, you are stopped by the outstretched arm of Adelyne Goss.

Ahem.. You need to sign in. Oh, and also make sure you speak with the Star Mage over there before Arcos begins speaking.

@Embed[Actor.GA8VFWysoIYfNWCL]

A Short Conversation with Adelyne Goss

The party does not have long to speak with Adelyne, as she looks both busy, extremely irritated, and impatient all at the same time. Characters can try to convince Adelyne to stop and speak with them to explain a few things with a successful [[/check 16 persuasion]] [[/skillCheck persuasion 16]] check. On a failed check or if a check isn't attempted, Adelyne answers only the most basic "what do we do?" question and describes herself as too busy for further chatter.

What do we do?

That's it. Sign here, yes, here. Good, thank you. Now, please move further into the hall. I have a lot to handle today and no time for idle chatter. Good luck and all that …

The Star Mage?

Adelyne points towards the floating figure hovering in midair on one side of the hall:

You need to speak with Eveis Brightstone over there, our resident Star Mage in the city. She has a magical item for every participant that will help keep you safe during the challenge. It's a requirement to have one when participating, so make sure you speak with her quickly.

Who is Arcos?

Sigh... The guildmaster. You know the head of the Anachraenum … you know where you are, right? He will speak in just a little while, and then the Expedition Challenge will begin.

With that, Adelyne will turn away, her attention drawn to other groups entering the hall.

Flexible Order of Events

The sections presented in this event: @UUID[JournalEntry.emberAnachrnArc1.JournalEntryPage.rqC17cSbk4oXioCX#a-sponsors-advice]{A Sponsor's Advice}, @UUID[JournalEntry.emberAnachrnArc1.JournalEntryPage.rqC17cSbk4oXioCX#investigating-the-competition]{Investigating The Competition}, @UUID[.rqC17cSbk4oXioCX#meeting-the-star-mage]{Meeting the Star Mage}, , and @UUID[JournalEntry.emberAnachrnArc1.JournalEntryPage.rqC17cSbk4oXioCX#the-opening-speech]{The Opening Speech} can be presented or explored in any order. Allow the party to mingle with the characters assembled in the hall and approach these interactions in whatever order interests them.

A Sponsor's Advice

Fernis Ossa is in the hall, and she seems to be joining in the excitement. The party can try to talk to her, and she will spare a few moments to welcome them, but she is otherwise busy, and you can read the following:

@Embed[Actor.A2SrOhUvUVuV7os0 inline readaloud="Fernis Ossa dances among the other teams and groups, her charm and passion on full display as she weaves through the crowd. Many of the groups see her, and their excitement seems to explode. It's clear that having the previous winner of the challenge here brings an electrifying mood to everyone present. She winks at you when you catch her eye, and her smile is almost infectious in its sincerity."]

What should we do?

Fernis looks amused by the question:

Well, just … go mingle. You'll get instructions on what the challenge entails soon enough. For the time being, I suggest using the opportunity to get to know some of the other challengers. You'll also need to talk to Eveis, the Star Mage.

Can you help us?

I could, but I won't. There's enough scrutiny on me already for sponsoring your group to join the challenge. The ultimate goal is for Arcos to view your group as capable and to entrust you with assignments. He won't do that if he thinks you didn't succeed on merit.

Investigating The Competition

The party can now move around the main hall of All-Fable Keep and observe or talk with other parties who appear to be participating in the expedition challenge. Many different aspiring adventuring parties have gathered, some are already Anachraenum trainees, while others are all new to the city. The party may spot some familiar faces.

The Fulgurite Blades

The Fulgurite Blades are standing within the center of the hall, looking by all accounts as if they own the place. Sajor seems to be in her element, as a distant, strong, and commanding member of an established trainee group of the Anachraenum.

It's likely that the party has interacted with the Fulgurite Blades at this point in the past, but if not more information is available in [[/eventState overMoonLightning]] and [[/eventState anachraenum1Fulgurites]].

In brief, the Fulgurite Blades are:

  • @UUID[Actor.pgpa26YQys5VDwNu]{Sajor Velex} (Neutral, Ordani Nir'ae, she/her)

  • @UUID[Actor.dYGD1p1ui2gE9d28]{Rorhim Iron-Cask} (Neutral, Maziran Cor'ak, he/him)

  • @UUID[Actor.kHu4Tvu4hKIEAbKj]{Kazra Steelshift} (Lawful Neutral, Mysterious Kivahr, she/her)

  • @UUID[Actor.nHiypQMDLV9IvTyR]{Leeph} (Chaotic Neutral, Thornling, they/them)

If the party greets or engages with the Fulgurite Blades, Sajor addresses them:

Oh, of course you're here. I don't have any time to speak with you right now, I'm sure the guildmaster will be speaking any moment. I hope you're ready to lose, because WE will be the ones to win the event. Mark my words!

The Coin's Edge

"Coin's Edge" is a group of adventurers who dream of themselves as the next great Wayfinders of the guild. They are generally motivated by plunder and the excitement of reclaiming lost treasures from forgotten places for wealth and fame. Their members are:

  • Arik of Tumblestones (Chaotic Good, Oaken Vrjnhar, he/them)

  • Ellyne Lantress (Lawful Neutral, Cascillian Altyra, she/her)

  • Vaul do'Ramel (Neutral Evil, Bejak Kivahr, he/him)

  • Whimsy Flicket (Chaotic Neutral, Ordani Keth, they/them)

If the party approaches the group and attempts to speak with them, Ellyne will turn and say:

Oh! A fresh set of faces, welcome! We are the Coin's Edge, trainees of the Anachraenum, one and all. We're so eager to get this started. Even if we don't win, I can't wait to finish and join as full members! Are you excited for the start?

The Salt Breakers

"Salt Breakers" are a group of three young glory hunters from the town of Pryor. Feeling trapped within the salt mining industry of their hometown, they decided to break the cycle and make their way to Ordain and join the Anachraenum. The party may have encountered this group previously in [[/eventState anachraenum1Hall]].

Their members are:

  • Blister Brass (Neutral Evil, Arcturian Human, he/him)

  • White Bark (Chaotic Evil, Arcturian Thornling, they/them)

  • Masie Vanrod (Neutral Evil, Arcturian Signborn + Wirrun, she/her)

If the party approaches the group and attempts to speak with them, Brass will turn and say:

We have no interest in speaking with you, leave us alone.

The Lantern's Road

"Lantern's Road" is a group of timid scholars who have banded together to take on the Expedition challenge. They are keenly aware of their lack of physical prowess, and the entire group is mainly interested in joining the Anachraenum so that they can access the knowledge contained within the Amaranthine Archives. Their members are:

  • Coal Kestral (Lawful Good, Lumek Fej + Ashka, they/them)

  • Shanara Waeax (Neutral Good, Tayan Drakon, she/her)

  • Losten Vax (Chaotic Good, Ordani Human, he/him)

  • Ratchet (Neutral Good, Mysterious Hulg'run, they/them)

The party can approach the group and attempt to speak with them, if they met Losten during the [[/eventState anachraenum1Scholar]] event and calmed his attack of anxiety, he will turn and say:

It's you! Well, hello again, it's such an exciting moment, we are just about to start! I'm so glad you managed to make it here. I doubt my little band here will have much chance at winning; we intend to take things very slowly and carefully, but good luck to you!

If they encountered Losten during [[/eventState anachraenum1Scholar]] but he panicked and ran away, he will say:

Oh, it's you! Well … this is a bit awkward. I have to say I sincerely thought you were bandits last time we met, I suppose I was a bit hasty in my trepidation but one can never be too safe traveling alone, I hope you understand.

Otherwise, if they have not previously met Losten, he will greet them saying:

Hi there, we are the Lanterns Road, a group of scholars mostly. We don't plan to rush at the start and will take our time here. You can never be too careful, but good luck to you!

Mug & Cap

"Mug & Cap" are two young troublemakers who have joined the Expedition Challenge to have some fun; they are not interested in becoming Anachraenum members but relish the chance to win prizes and compete with other groups. They are:

  • Mug (Neutral, Waerd Kiska + Wirrun, he/him)

  • Cap (Neutral, Waerd Thornling, they/them)

The party can approach the duo and attempt to speak with them, if they met the pair during [[/eventState anachraenum1Duo]] they notice the party, and you can read the following:

With a groan, Mug turns to you and winces. Well, it seems we were right—you did end up joining the challenge. Oh well, I suppose we'll just have to beat you as well. Good luck in the challenge then.

Otherwise, if they have not previously met Mug and Cap, they will introduce themselves:

Hello there! We are Mug and Cap, from the Lowlands, and we traveled all the way up from Toraga overland to be here today and to win the challenge. We are aiming to win it this year, so good luck to you!

Cora Attunement: Meeting the Competition

If the party manages to meet all 5 of the other parties who've gathered to participate in the Expedition Challenge, each character advances their [[/attunement emberCora +1 anachraenum1OpeningCompetition]] at the conclusion of the event.

An Opportunity to Improvise

The following character, "Vortera", is intentionally mysterious and can be flexibly used to represent a character of the Gamemaster's own creation. They won't explicitly appear later in this quest, but you can feel free to introduce them at various moments if the party needs help or a rival to add spice to proceedings.

Use the following information as a starting point or ignore it completely if you wish to insert a custom character into this event.

The Mysterious Vortera

"Vortera" is a solo adventurer taking on the Expedition Challenge, they are extremely mysterious and cover themselves in a thick black cloak. (Neutral Good, Mysterious Aster, they/them).

Attempting to speak with this character will not go well. Read the following:

The figure seems to regard you slowly with a tilt of their head. They do not speak, but a wave of indescribable magical energy washes over you; clearly, this is a powerful figure, but they do not seem eager to talk.

Characters succeeding on an [[/skill arcana 20]] [[/skillCheck arcana 20]] check suspect that the character's mysterious appearance is the result of a combination of Illusion spells like @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSeeming000]{Seeming} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplNystulsMag]{Arcanist's Magic Aura} specialized illusory magics, likely a combination of signature spells.

Meeting the Star Mage

At some point before departing, the party is required to speak with the mesmerizing figure of Eveis Brightstone, the resident custodian Star Mage of Ordain. They must receive from her an important safety precaution called a @UUID[Item.jggar2bndAvZthdS]{Frozen Tear}.

@Embed[Actor.XrFDJNn1Fa7hopqR]

Eveis floats gracefully before you, suspended in midair and observing the proceedings.

So, another bright and eager group, ready for the challenge, I see.

One of her hands starts to twirl around slowly at first, then with greater speed. Her fingers weave a complex pattern in the air, too fast for you to see, and with a small pop, a floating crystal item appears in her palm.

My name is Eveis Brighstone. I am a Star Mage from the Star Academy. I'm here today as an observer to witness the Expedition Challenge. I also have an item for you so you can be protected from the worst of the dangers prepared for you. It is called a Frozen Tear, and it will activate automatically if you are knocked unconscious, or if you choose to activate it yourself, of course.

Eveis then hands you the strangely shimmering, icy object she just summoned from nothing, or perhaps she has a stash of them and teleported it here. The tear feels cool to the touch but not freezing, and its sharp-looking edges are actually dull and smooth.

Speaking with Eveis Brightstone

Eveis is a towering figure who smiles at the party and is both friendly and warm. However, she is also deliberately keeping her distance and doing her best to stay impartial in the ongoing events. Her participation in the challenge is minor, yet it shows how deeply she cares about protecting the people of Ordain.

Characters who succeed on a [[/check insight 14]] [[/skillCheck awareness 14]] check can tell that she is watching the events keenly, much like a mother would watch her children, and she is trying to keep an eye on everything at once.

Who Are You?

Characters can talk with Eveis about many subjects, and she is eager to discuss almost everything. She is especially friendly and welcoming to any clerics or followers of Spectra. Likely, the party will find Eveis to be extremely interesting, as she is an ancestry that is seen extremely rarely upon the surface. While Eveis will talk to the party about many things, she will not share any details of her people or culture unless the party is able to pry a few scant details from her.

  • Eveis attended the Star Academy and spent many years learning about practical and theoretical magical knowledge. She is the Custodian Star Mage of Ordain, which means that she is responsible for the Gate that is present in @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrdainGazet.JournalEntryPage.EjMYZOv96mtlZfSQ]{Lumiere Wharf} and stops anyone from using it unless they have a permit.

  • A Custodian Star Mage is considered one of the upper ranks of the Star Mages organization, and she works directly under Director Albine Amar. He personally gave her the task of watching over Ordain about 30 years ago, and she has lived in the city ever since.

  • She is a Carrow, a numerous aquatic Ancestry that lives deep within Ember's oceans. Her kind are all female, and although she seems to blush slightly at the topic, they reproduce through a process known as Parthenogenesis, where they lay clutches of eggs that do not require fertilization.

Eveis will brush off any attempts for characters to learn more about her people; however, she can be convinced by characters who succeed on a [[/check persuasion 18]] [[/skillCheck persuasion 18]] check and will share the following:

My people maintain a very strong cultural secrecy, and it is forbidden for those who travel outside our lands to discuss it much. Though I miss my people dearly, they are extreme in their viewpoints, and I do not agree with everything they believe.

Characters with [[/attunement emberMayis]] will notice that Eveis seems to resonate strongly with water magic, and they will be able to see swirling mists of water floating around her. It would appear she has an undeniable strong connection to the Tempest Moon.

The Frozen Tear

Eveis will give every member of the player party a @UUID[Item.jggar2bndAvZthdS]{Frozen Tear}. This item is being carried by all the other participants of the Expedition Challenge, and they are extremely valuable artifacts. At least as far as the people of Ordain are concerned, and Eveis seems to consider them relatively mundane. She will not give nor sell any more of them to characters after the Expedition Challenge is complete. Eveis explains to the party that the enchantment upon this bauble works only while within the Keystone Dungeons or within the Chamber of Agaseros, as their magic has been previously attuned specifically to these locations.

The Star Mages

I am a Star Mage, and we come from a part of the world extremely distant from Ordain on the Rhivan Peninsula. We are experts in space, the stars, and magical knowledge, and we have been active in the world since our founder discovered a way to cross vast distances instantly. We possess a network of portals and gates that connect many major locations and cities, but we also guard them against misuse. Unfortunately, not just anyone can enter a gate and visit the Star Academy and the Gate Nexus located there. We tend to maintain a strictly neutral position on regional politics and follow a policy of non-interference with most aspects of the places we visit.

The Anachraenum

A wonderful organization, dedicated to historical knowledge and investigation, in addition to protection, with many of its members choosing to help others and battle monsters and creatures of darkness. I am especially eager to help those within its ranks in small ways if I am able.

The Frozen Tear?

The tear is a lovely little bauble, although it requires me to visit and set up a number of magical wards and spells so that they work in every location. Thus, it will protect you from all harm if you fall unconscious by covering you in a protective frozen static field, or if you choose to activate it yourself, of course, for a day or two. However, it can only be used at the event locations for the Expedition Challenge you are about to participate in.

Fernis Ossa

Fernis is an old friend; we have known each other for many years. I identified the item she now wields as a weapon when she brought it back for study. She... well, she is very capable, and I’m sure you don’t need me to tell you that she is reliable and can be trusted completely.

Arcos Sarinland

The current guildmaster, yes, an odd little fellow. Seems a bit out of his depth to me, but he's doing his best.

Spectra

My patron goddess, and the light of magic itself. I see her every now myself by visiting her local haunts at the Star Academy or even here in Ordain. Though where she can be found, I'll leave it up to you to figure out.

The Opening Speech

Once the party has finished talking with any of the other groups in the hall, the main part of the event begins with a speech to kick off the Expedition Challenge by the guildmaster of the Anachraenum, Arcos Sarinland.

A loud tapping sound begins across the hall, almost drowned out at first by the conversations and chatter of the various groups, until, with what seems to be irritation, a loud boom shocks everyone into silence. The wispy remnants of a magical spell of some kind float above Eveis as her attention is drawn to a small figure standing on a podium at the head of the room.

@Embed[Actor.FYprIclhoDOI8FI4]

He bows with his entire body and beams towards the group assembled before him.

Thank you all! And thank you, Eveis, for getting everyone's attention!

Everyone is now attentively listening to the guildmaster of the Anachraenum, whom you surprisingly notice seems somewhat out of place in certain respects. Despite his broad smile, he appears tired, and his words reveal a subtle nervousness.

As you all know, the Anachraenum is hosting, once again, a glorious Expedition Challenge! This event will test the skills of fresh, valiant adventurers, scholars, and budding treasure seekers. You will face battles with fierce enemies, clever traps, and puzzles that will leave you stumped for hours on end! Should you succeed in winning the event, then full membership in the Anachraenum will be your reward, along with a heavy pouch of gold and access to the archives and the trove of magical relics we hold there.

And so, a few things to mention before we begin. You may complete the upcoming events in any order, and both solo and group of budding adventurers can compete. If you find yourself in mortal danger, please do not hesitate to use the Frozen Tears, provided by the ever wonderful Eveis Brightstone. There is no shame in accepting a little help, and it will not affect your score, only slow you down a touch! Speaking of slowing down, there are extra points awarded for the speedy collection and completion of all the events, so move swiftly!

Arcos then prepares to provide the assembled teams with three different clues hinting at the locations of the three Keystone Challenges that the parties must complete. They can do them in any order, but must retrieve the Challenge Key from each. Once the parties have all three, they will be able to use them to unlock and undertake the final challenge by entering the fabled Chamber of Agaseros underneath All-Fable Keep itself.

He pauses to catch his breath, and makes sure he still has everyone's attention before nodding mostly to himself and moving on.

Finally, to the heart of the matter! To win the challenge this year, teams will need to find, travel to, and complete the challenges at three specially prepared Keystone Challenges. I will give three clues for each now to help you get started.

Arcos clears his breath with a definative "ahem" and glances down a piece of paper that he clutches:

Where distant waves serenade against the towering stone, Lantyr's descent bathes golden grasses with her lambent glow. There, tower-builders carved a noble dwelling in the earth. Not stranded nor abandoned, a key for those who breach its hall and prove their worth.

Be not offended when forced to wander through thorny twists of this meander. Descend below the auric plains to tread where waters fill the gorge. Brave the onyx monster's ground with maw agape to to paths unknown. Giants marked the yawning way and there your key waits to be found.

Destine's finger stretches out through mesmerizing sanguine boughs. Seek our quarry where falls its head, your challenge lies beside our winter stead. Some here may know it well. Guard your minds but bare your knowledge and find the key through wit or courage.

He draws a deep breath as if pleased with his deliverance, and smiles broadly once more.

Once you have the keys from the end of every Keystone Challenge, return here to All-Fable Keep and complete the final challenge in the Chamber of Agaseros beneath our feet! Be the first to do it all, and you win! Remember, runners-up will receive most of the rewards that winners get, such as full membership and gold, but in smaller amounts, of course. So try your best even if you're behind! And that’s it. With my little speech complete, the second Expedition Challenge of the Anachraenum has begun!

With his speech complete and the challenges beginning, several things happen at once. The Fulgurite Blades begin immediately dashing towards the door, while the group called Lantern's Road gather in a circle and begin talking quietly among themselves. Mug and Cap run up to Arcos, shouting questions towards the guildmaster. The Salt Breakers are shouting loudly at each other, exclaiming their theories without regard for secrecy.

Arcos, realizing that his work is done and that control over the situation is fleeting, cries out a brief "Good luck, everyone!" and dashes from the hall.

Interpreting the Clues

The party currently has three vague clues and directions to travel in order to find the three Keystone Challenges.
